entry.summary: Proposes formulating agentic evolution (iterative program/workflow improvement) as an interactive environment with a stable interface for organizing evidence and revising the evolution mechanism, addressing the gap between rigid fixed procedures and drifting general agents.

entry.title: Uncovering Latent Pathological Signatures in Pulmonary CT via Cross-Window Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Bo Peng, Wujian Xu, Kun Wang, Ximing Liao, Na Wang, Daqian Shi, Tian Li, Jing Gao, Johan Thygesen, Yingqun Ji, Honghan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes cross-window knowledge distillation for pulmonary CT analysis, where student encoders learn clinical priors from teachers trained on the most informative window setting. Achieves significant AUC improvements across COPD, PE, and CTEPD cohorts.

entry.title: Training LLMs with Reinforcement Learning for Intent-Aware Personalized Question Answering

author.name: Maryam Amirizaniani, Benjamin Charles Germain Lee, Jevin West, Nicholas Weber

entry.summary: Proposes IAP, a reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to infer implicit user intent directly from minimal single-turn input for personalized question answering, integrating intent into the reasoning process.

entry.title: Visual Aesthetic Benchmark: Can Frontier Models Judge Beauty?

author.name: Yichen Feng, Yuetai Li, Chunjiang Liu, Yuanyuan Chen, Fengqing Jiang, Yue Huang, Hang Hua, Zhengqing Yuan, Kaiyuan Zheng, Luyao Niu, Bhaskar Ramasubramanian, Basel Alomair, Xiangliang Zhang, Misha Sra, Zichen Chen, Radha Poovendran, Zhangchen Xu

entry.summary: Introduces Visual Aesthetic Benchmark (VAB), showing that scalar aesthetic scores poorly capture comparative preferences. Casts aesthetic evaluation as comparative selection across four dimensions with expert annotations.

entry.title: Mechanism Plausibility in Generative Agent-Based Modeling

author.name: Patrick Zhao, David Huu Pham, Nicholas Vincent

entry.summary: Draws from philosophy of science to argue that generative ABMs using LLMs need mechanism plausibility assessment, not just capability demonstration. Distinguishes between prediction and explanation in LLM-based social simulations.

entry.title: RISED: A Pre-Deployment Safety Evaluation Framework for Clinical AI Decision-Support Systems

author.name: Rohith Reddy Bellibatlu

entry.summary: Proposes RISED, a five-dimension pre-deployment safety evaluation framework for clinical AI covering Reliability, Inclusivity, Sensitivity, Equity, and Deployability, with formal sub-criteria and statistical testing.

entry.title: Seg-Agent: Test-Time Multimodal Reasoning for Training-Free Language-Guided Segmentation

author.name: Chao Hao, Jun Xu, Ji Du, Shuo Ye, Ziyue Qiao, Xiaodong Cun, Guangcong Wang, Xubin Zheng, Zitong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Seg-Agent, a training-free language-guided segmentation approach using test-time multimodal reasoning with MLLMs and SAM, introducing visual reasoning in observation space rather than textual space to improve spatial grounding.

entry.title: Context Training with Active Information Seeking

author.name: Zeyu Huang, Adhiguna Kuncoro, Qixuan Feng, Jiajun Shen, Lucio Dery, Arthur Szlam, Marc'Aurelio Ranzato

entry.summary: Equips context optimization methods with Wikipedia search and browser tools for active information seeking during LLM adaptation. Shows that naive tool addition degrades performance, but a search-based training procedure helps.

entry.title: When Does Hierarchy Help? Benchmarking Agent Coordination in Event-Driven Industrial Scheduling

author.name: Ziqi Wang, Yuhao Yang, Zhiwei Ling, Wenzhuo Qian, Hailiang Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces DESBench, a benchmark for evaluating agent coordination in hierarchical event-driven industrial scheduling, examining when different coordination paradigms succeed or fail in shared, dynamically evolving systems.

entry.title: Delightful Exploration

author.name: Ian Osband

entry.summary: Introduces Delight-gated exploration (DE), a host-override exploration rule that spends exploratory actions only when prospective delight (expected improvement × surprisal) exceeds a gate price. Recovers Pandora's reservation-value rule.

entry.title: Q-Flow: Stable and Expressive Reinforcement Learning with Flow-Based Policy

author.name: JaeHyeok Doo, Byeongguk Jeon, Seonghyeon Ye, Kimin Lee, Minjoon Seo

entry.summary: Introduces Q-Flow, a framework for using flow-based models as RL policies that propagates terminal trajectory value to intermediate states, resolving the instability of backpropagating through numerical solvers.

entry.title: Decoupled and Divergence-Conditioned Prompt for Multi-domain Dynamic Graph Foundation Models

author.name: Haonan Yuan, Qingyun Sun, Junhua Shi, Xingcheng Fu, Jianxin Li, Philip S. Yu

entry.summary: Proposes DyGFM, the first multi-domain dynamic graph foundation model using decoupled and divergence-conditioned prompting to handle inconsistent semantic and temporal patterns across domains.

entry.title: Humanwashing -- It Should Leave You Feeling Dirty

author.name: Ben Wilson, Matimba Swana, Peter Winter, Matt Roach

entry.summary: Critically examines the 'human in the loop' concept in AI decision systems, arguing that the phrase is often used as 'humanwashing' to imply safety without meaningful oversight. Questions whether the loop metaphor helps or hinders understanding of actual human oversight requirements.

entry.title: Improving Reproducibility in Evaluation through Multi-Level Annotator Modeling

author.name: Deepak Pandita, Flip Korn, Chris Welty, Christopher M. Homan

entry.summary: Studies how to improve reproducibility in AI evaluation through multi-level annotator modeling, addressing the variance introduced by human raters in safety and utility assessments. Examines how experimental repeatability improves with annotator pool size.

entry.title: EVA-Bench: A New End-to-end Framework for Evaluating Voice Agents

author.name: Tara Bogavelli, Gabrielle Gauthier Melan\c{c}on, Katrina Stankiewicz, Oluwanifemi Bamgbose, Fanny Riols, Hoang H. Nguyen, Raghav Mehndiratta, Lindsay Devon Brin, Joseph Marinier, Hari Subramani, Anil Madamala, Sridhar Krishna Nemala, Srinivas Sunkara

entry.summary: Presents EVA-Bench, an end-to-end evaluation framework for voice agents that generates realistic simulated conversations via bot-to-bot audio interactions and measures quality across voice-specific failure modes with composite metrics.

entry.title: WARDEN: Endangered Indigenous Language Transcription and Translation with 6 Hours of Training Data

author.name: Ziheng Zhang, Yunzhong Hou, Naijing Liu, Liang Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces WARDEN, a system for transcribing and translating Wardaman, an endangered Australian indigenous language, into English using only 6 hours of annotated audio. Uses separate transcription and translation models to handle extreme low-resource conditions.

entry.title: Population Risk Bounds for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks Trained by DP-SGD with Correlated Noise

author.name: Puyu Wang, Jan Schuchardt, Nikita Kalinin, Junyu Zhou, Sophie Fellenz, Christoph Lampert, Marius Kloft

entry.summary: Establishes the first population risk bounds for Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) trained by mini-batch SGD with gradient clipping, covering both non-private and differentially private training with correlated noise. Extends prior KAN theory from full-batch GD to practical training settings.

entry.title: Machine Learning-Driven Multimodal Spectroscopic Liquid Biopsy for Early Multicancer Detection

author.name: Alejandro Leonardo Garc\'ia Navarro, Javier Cach\'on Ortiz, Javier Gonz\'alez Colsa, Samuel Garc\'ia D\'iaz, Carlos Viadero Valderrama

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal spectroscopic liquid biopsy framework combining FTIR, Raman, and fluorescence spectroscopy with ML for multicancer detection from serum samples.

entry.title: PaMM: Periodic Motif Memory for Atomistic Models with an Explicit Local-Structure Interface

author.name: Ryan Dong

entry.summary: PaMM augments equivariant atomistic models with explicit periodic motif memory via pair and triplet lookup tables, fused with baseline edge representations through gating mechanisms for crystal property prediction.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Prediction of Lung Tumor Growth from Sparse Longitudinal CT Data via Bayesian Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Lingfei Kong, Haoran Ma

entry.summary: Develops a Bayesian PINN combining Gompertz growth dynamics with Bayesian inference for lung tumor growth prediction from sparse CT data, using MAP estimation and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Distinguishing performance gains from learning when using generative AI

author.name: Lixiang Yan, Samuel Greiff, Jason M. Lodge, Dragan Ga\v{s}evi\'c

entry.summary: Discusses the challenge of distinguishing genuine learning from performance gains when using generative AI in education, arguing that AI-boosted performance may not reflect deep cognitive processing.

entry.title: GHGbench: A Unified Multi-Entity, Multi-Task Benchmark for Carbon Emission Prediction

author.name: Yifan Duan, Siyuan Zheng, Lihuan Li, Chao Xue, Flora Salim

entry.summary: Introduces GHGbench, a unified open benchmark for company- and building-level carbon emission prediction, consolidating 32K+ company-year records and 491K+ building-year records with canonical splits for in-distribution and transfer tasks. Fills an important gap in standardized ML benchmarks for climate/sustainability applications.

entry.title: Adaptive Conformal Prediction for Reliable and Explainable Medical Image Classification

author.name: One Octadion, Novanto Yudistira, Lailil Muflikhah

entry.summary: Proposes an Adaptive Lambda Criterion for conformal prediction in medical imaging that minimizes worst-case coverage violation across prediction set size strata, addressing the overconfidence problem of deep learning in diagnostics.

entry.title: Amortized Neural Clustering of Time Series based on Statistical Features

author.name: \'Angel L\'opez-Oriona, Ying Sun

entry.summary: Proposes an algorithm-agnostic approach to time series clustering via amortized neural inference, training networks to approximate optimal partitioning from simulated data, reducing reliance on conventional clustering methods.

entry.title: The Sample Complexity of Multiple Change Point Identification under Bandit Feedback

author.name: Maximilian Graf, Victor Thuot

entry.summary: Studies multiple change point localization under bandit feedback with adaptive algorithms that detect and refine change point locations. Establishes non-asymptotic upper and lower bounds on sample complexity.

entry.title: KamonBench: A Grammar-Based Dataset for Evaluating Compositional Factor Recovery in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Richard Sproat, Stefano Peluchetti

entry.summary: Introduces KamonBench, a grammar-based benchmark using Japanese family crests for evaluating compositional factor recovery in vision-language models. Each crest has known compositional structure enabling evaluation beyond caption accuracy.

entry.title: TruncProof: A Guardrail for LLM-based JSON Generation under Token-Length Constraints

author.name: Yoshio Kato, Shuhei Tarashima

entry.summary: Proposes TruncProof, a grammar-constrained generation method ensuring LLMs produce valid JSON within a predefined token limit using LL(1) parser properties to approximate minimum completion tokens.

entry.title: RAG-Enhanced Large Language Models for Dynamic Content Expiration Prediction in Web Search

author.name: Tingyu Chen, Wenkai Zhang, Li Gao, Lixin Su, Ge Chen, Dawei Yin, Daiting Shi

entry.summary: Presents an LLM-based framework deployed in Baidu search that predicts query-specific content expiration dates using RAG-enhanced temporal reasoning, replacing static time-window filtering.

entry.title: MambaPanoptic: A Vision Mamba-based Structured State Space Framework for Panoptic Segmentation

author.name: Qing Cheng, Damiano Bertolini, Wei Zhang, Dong Wang, Niclas Zeller, Daniel Cremers

entry.summary: Proposes MambaPanoptic, the first fully Mamba-based panoptic segmentation framework with MambaFPN for multi-scale features, achieving linear-complexity long-range context modeling.

entry.title: CRAFT: Clinical Reward-Aligned Finetuning for Medical Image Synthesis

author.name: Yunsung Chung, Alex El Darzi, Carlo El Khoury, Han Feng, Nassir Marrouche, Jihun Hamm

entry.summary: Introduces CRAFT, using a Clinical Alignment Score (CAS) based on foundation models for reward-based finetuning of medical image synthesis, improving clinical plausibility beyond FID/IS metrics.

entry.title: Debunking Grad-ECLIP: A Comprehensive Study on Its Incorrectness and Fundamental Principles for Model Interpretation

author.name: Yongjin Cui, Xiaohui Fan

entry.summary: Demonstrates that Grad-ECLIP (ICML 2024) is mathematically equivalent to a simpler attention-based method and contains flaws in its interpretation results, proposing Attention-ECLIP as a correct alternative.

entry.title: Edit-Compass & EditReward-Compass: A Unified Benchmark for Image Editing and Reward Modeling

author.name: Xuehai Bai, Yang Shi, Yi-Fan Zhang, Xuanyu Zhu, Yuran Wang, Yifan Dai, Xinyu Liu, Yiyan Ji, Xiaoling Gu, Yuanxing Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Edit-Compass and EditReward-Compass benchmarks for evaluating image editing models and reward models, addressing limitations of existing benchmarks that fail to reflect human judgment for frontier models.

entry.title: PhysEditBench: A Protocol-Conditioned Benchmark for Dense Physical-Map Prediction with Image Editors

author.name: Jiaxin Yang, Yu Hou, Muxin Liu, Weixuan Liu, Ze Yuan, Zeming Chen, Zhongrui Wang, Xiaojuan Qi

entry.summary: PhysEditBench evaluates whether general-purpose image editors can predict physical maps (depth, normal, albedo, roughness, metallic) from single RGB images under various prompting protocols.

entry.title: SceneGraphVLM: Dynamic Scene Graph Generation from Video with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Vladislav Makarov, Mark Gizetdinov, Dmitry Yudin

entry.summary: SceneGraphVLM generates scene graphs from images and videos using small VLMs with token-efficient serialization and hallucination-aware RL rewards that balance coverage and precision.

entry.title: Learning to Optimize Radiotherapy Plans via Fluence Maps Diffusion Model Generation and LSTM-based Optimization

author.name: Isabella Poles, Simon Arberet, Riqiang Gao, Martin Kraus, Marco D. Santambrogio, Florin C. Ghesu, Ali Kamen, Dorin Comaniciu

entry.summary: Proposes a diffusion-driven learning-to-optimize method for VMAT radiation therapy planning that generates fluence maps in one step and optimizes them with LSTM, reducing planning time.

entry.title: JANUS: Anatomy-Conditioned Gating for Robust CT Triage Under Distribution Shift

author.name: Lavsen Dahal, Yubraj Bhandari, Geoffrey Rubin, Joseph Y. Lo

entry.summary: JANUS introduces anatomy-conditioned gating for CT triage that conditions ViT visual embeddings on macro-radiomic priors, achieving AUROC 0.88 with strong generalization to external datasets.

entry.title: FiTS: Interpretable Spiking Neurons via Frequency Selectivity and Temporal Shaping

author.name: Jongmin Choi, Joon Son Chung

entry.summary: FiTS introduces spiking neurons that factorize computation into frequency selectivity and temporal shaping, enabling individual neurons to specialize for different temporal patterns.

entry.title: The Unified Autonomy Stack: Toward a Blueprint for Generalizable Robot Autonomy

author.name: Mihir Dharmadhikari, Nikhil Khedekar, Mihir Kulkarni, Morten Nissov, Martin Jacquet, Angelos Zacharia, Marvin Harms, Albert Gassol Puigjaner, Philipp Weiss, Kostas Alexis

entry.summary: Introduces an open-source Unified Autonomy Stack enabling resilient autonomy across diverse aerial and ground robots. Integrates multi-modal perception, planning, and safe navigation, validated in DARPA SubT and other real-world deployments.

entry.title: OceanCBM: A Concept Bottleneck Model for Mechanistic Interpretability in Ocean Forecasting

author.name: Sanah Suri, Kieran Ringel, Maike Sonnewald

entry.summary: Introduces OceanCBM, the first concept bottleneck model for ocean dynamics prediction that routes information through prescribed geophysical concepts, enabling mechanistic interpretability of marine heatwave predictions alongside accurate forecasting.

entry.title: IGT-OMD: Implicit Gradient Transport for Decision-Focused Learning under Delayed Feedback

author.name: Benjamin Amoh, Geoffrey G. Parker, Wesley Marrero

entry.summary: Identifies 'staleness amplification' in decision-focused learning under delayed feedback, where gradient staleness couples with inner-solver sensitivity to inflate regret. Proposes IGT-OMD using implicit gradient transport within online mirror descent with proven regret bounds.

entry.title: Quantifying Potential Observation Missingness in Inverse Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Leo Benac, Abhishek Sharma, Alihan Huyuk, Finale Doshi-Velez

entry.summary: Addresses missing observations in inverse reinforcement learning, where recorded behavioral data may lack information available to the original decision-maker. Develops methods to quantify and account for potential observation missingness, particularly relevant for healthcare IRL.

entry.title: SMA: Submodular Modality Aligner For Data Efficient Multimodal Learning

author.name: Truong Pham, Anay Majee, Rishabh Iyer

entry.summary: Proposes Submodular Modality Aligner (SMA), a combinatorial approach to multimodal alignment that treats multiple augmentations and descriptions as sets, moving beyond pairwise instance-level learning to address modality gaps in low-data settings.

entry.title: Safe Bayesian Optimization for Uncertain Correlations Matrices in Linear Models of Co-Regionalization

author.name: Jannis L\"ubsen, Annika Eichler

entry.summary: Extends safety guarantees for multi-task Bayesian optimization from intrinsic co-regionalization to linear models of co-regionalization, deriving uniform error bounds for vector-valued GP functions.

entry.title: Vector-Quantized Discrete Latent Factors Meet Financial Priors: Dynamic Cross-Sectional Stock Ranking Prediction for Portfolio Construction

author.name: Namhyoung Kim, Jae Wook Song

entry.summary: PRISM-VQ combines expert prior factors with vector-quantized discrete latent factors and mixture-of-experts for dynamic cross-sectional stock ranking, using vector quantization as an information bottleneck.

entry.title: PreFIQs: Face Image Quality Is What Survives Pruning

author.name: Jan Niklas Kolf, Guray Ozgur, Andrea Atzori, \v{Z}iga Babnik, Vitomir \v{S}truc, Naser Damer, Fadi Boutros

entry.summary: PreFIQs proposes an unsupervised face image quality assessment method based on the hypothesis that low-utility images rely on fragile network parameters, measuring quality via embedding displacement under model pruning.

entry.title: CA-GCL: Cross-Anatomy Global-Local Contrastive Learning for Robust 3D Medical Image Understanding

author.name: Hanwen Zhang, Yao Liu, Die Dai, Jiaye Yang, Qiao Liu, Yutong Xie, Peng Wang

entry.summary: CA-GCL addresses representation collapse in 3D medical vision-language pretraining where text embeddings of different anatomies become indistinguishable, proposing cross-anatomy contrastive learning.

entry.title: Sparse Code Uplifting for Efficient 3D Language Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Lovre Antonio Budimir, Yushi Guan, Steve Ryhner, Sven Lon\v{c}ari\'c, Nandita Vijaykumar

entry.summary: SCOUP efficiently associates language features with 3D Gaussians using sparse code uplifting, achieving fast reconstruction, efficient storage, and fast rendering simultaneously for open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding.

entry.title: SpurAudio: A Benchmark for Studying Shortcut Learning in Few-Shot Audio Classification

author.name: Giries Abu Ayoub, Morad Tukan, Loay Mualem

entry.summary: SpurAudio benchmark studies shortcut learning in few-shot audio classification by controlling foreground-background correlations, revealing that models exploit spurious contextual cues.

entry.title: Runtime Monitoring of Perception-Based Autonomous Systems via Embedding Temporal Logic

author.name: Parv Kapoor, Abigail Hammer, Ashish Kapoor, Karen Leung, Eunsuk Kang

entry.summary: Proposes Embedding Temporal Logic (ETL) for runtime monitoring of perception-driven autonomous systems, defining predicates through distances in learned embedding spaces rather than requiring explicit state extraction. Enables monitoring of high-level perceptual concepts directly.

entry.title: UFO: A Domain-Unification-Free Operator Framework for Generalized Operator Learning

author.name: Hanli Qiao, George Em Karniadakis, Muhammad Muniruzzaman

entry.summary: Introduces UFO, a cross-domain neural operator framework that enables interactions among representations defined on distinct domains (physical, spectral, latent) while supporting discretization decoupling between training and inference resolutions.

entry.title: Contextual Bandits for Resource-Constrained Devices using Probabilistic Learning

author.name: Marco Angioli, Kevin Johansson, Antonello Rosato, Amy Loutfi, Denis Kleyko

entry.summary: Extends contextual bandits for resource-constrained devices using probabilistic learning based on hyperdimensional computing, improving upon HD-CB with better convergence and efficiency for on-device deployment.

entry.title: BioSEN: A Bio-acoustic Signal Enhancement Network for Animal Vocalizations

author.name: Tianyu Song, Ton Viet Ta, Ngamta Thamwattana, Hisako Nomura, Linh Thi Hoai Nguyen

entry.summary: Introduces BioSEN, a bio-acoustic signal enhancement model adapted from speech enhancement methods, with specialized modules for animal vocalizations including harmonic structure capture and energy-adaptive gating. Achieves SOTA on three bioacoustic datasets with lower compute.

entry.title: Skill-Aligned Annotation for Reliable Evaluation in Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Abdelrahman Eldesokey, Merey Ramazanova, Ahmad Sait, Ansar Khangeldin, Karen Sanchez, Tong Zhang, Bernard Ghanem

entry.summary: Proposes skill-aligned annotation strategies for text-to-image evaluation where annotation mechanisms match the characteristics of each evaluation skill, showing improved inter-annotator agreement.

entry.title: Z-Order Transformer for Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Can Wang, Lei Liu, Wei Jiang, Dong Xu

entry.summary: Z-Order Transformer uses Z-order curve-based spatial indexing for sparse attention in feed-forward Gaussian Splatting, efficiently capturing spatial/semantic relationships among Gaussians.

entry.title: Local Conformal Calibration of Dynamics Uncertainty from Semantic Images

author.name: Lu\'is Marques, Dmitry Berenson

entry.summary: OCULAR uses conformal prediction with perception information to provide calibrated uncertainty bounds for dynamics models in unseen environments. Leverages visual similarity across environments for transferable guarantees.

entry.title: Learning Transferable Latent User Preferences for Human-Aligned Decision Making

author.name: Alina Hyk, Sandhya Saisubramanian

entry.summary: Proposes a method for learning transferable latent user preferences from limited interactions, enabling LLMs to produce human-aligned decisions across tasks and contexts. Addresses the gap between explicit goals and implicit preferences.

entry.title: ScioMind: Cognitively Grounded Multi-Agent Social Simulation with Anchoring-Based Belief Dynamics and Dynamic Profiles

author.name: Yitian Yang, Yiqun Duan, Linghan Huang, Yiqi Zhu, Francesco Bailo, Chunmeizi Su, Huaming Chen

entry.summary: Introduces ScioMind, a multi-agent social simulation framework combining structured opinion dynamics with LLM reasoning, featuring memory-anchored belief updates modulated by personality-conditioned anchoring strength.

entry.title: TokaMind for Power Grid: Cross-Domain Transfer from Fusion Plasma

author.name: JC Wu, Norton Lee, Kai Siang Chen

entry.summary: Tests whether TokaMind, a transformer foundation model pre-trained on tokamak fusion plasma data, can transfer to structurally analogous domains including power grid synchrophasor monitoring, identifying four transfer-favoring characteristics.

entry.title: PERCEIVE: A Benchmark for Personalized Emotion and Communication Behavior Understanding on Social Media

author.name: Jian Liao, Yujin Zheng, Suge Wang, Jianxing Zheng, Deyu Li

entry.summary: Introduces PERCEIVE, a bilingual benchmark integrating five dimensions of social perception including reader emotional feedback, communication behavior, user attributes, and social graphs. Shifts emotion analysis from author-centric to reader-centric paradigm.

entry.title: Towards Robust Federated Multimodal Graph Learning under Modality Heterogeneity

author.name: Sirui Zhang, Haonan Wang, Xunkai Li, Zekai Chen, Shumeng Li, Hongchao Qin, Rong-Hua Li, Guoren Wang

entry.summary: Addresses federated multimodal graph learning under modality heterogeneity, where different participants have incomplete modalities. Proposes a robust approach handling both missing modalities and federated knowledge sharing.

entry.title: FePySR: A Neural Feature Extraction Framework for Efficient and Scalable Symbolic Regression

author.name: Zhiming Yu, Wangtao Lu, Xin Lai

entry.summary: Introduces FePySR, a two-stage symbolic regression framework that first extracts candidate features using a heterogeneous neural network, then performs structural optimization with PySR in the reduced search space.

entry.title: Adaptive Smooth Tchebycheff Attention for Multi-Objective Policy Optimization

author.name: Alejandro Murillo-Gonzalez, Mahmoud Ali, Lantao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Smooth Tchebycheff framework for multi-objective RL in robotics, dynamically modulating optimization landscape curvature to access non-convex Pareto front regions while maintaining stability.

entry.title: Amortized Guidance for Image Inpainting with Pretrained Diffusion Models

author.name: Yilie Huang, Xun Yu Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Amortized Inpainting with Diffusion (AID), a middle-ground approach for image inpainting that trains a small reusable guidance module offline while keeping the pretrained diffusion backbone fixed, avoiding both task-specific training and per-instance optimization.

entry.title: Context Matters: Auditing Gender Bias in T2I Generation through Risk-Tiered Use-Case Profiles

author.name: Jose Luna, Yankun Wu, Xiaofei Xie, Noa Garcia

entry.summary: Proposes a risk-tiered framework for auditing gender bias in text-to-image generation, arguing that existing metrics are fragmented and context-agnostic. Provides structured evaluation methodology across deployment contexts.

entry.title: ReTool-Video: Recursive Tool-Using Video Agents with Meta-Augmented Tool Grounding

author.name: Xiao Liu, Nayu Liu, Junnan Zhu, Ruirui Chen, Guohui Xiang, Changjian Wang, Kaiwen Wei, Rongzhen Li, Jiang Zhong

entry.summary: Proposes ReTool-Video, a tool-augmented video agent with 134 registered tools and a recursive tool-calling mechanism for compositional video reasoning. Addresses limitations of flat action spaces in existing video agents.

entry.title: Causality-Aware End-to-End Autonomous Driving via Ego-Centric Joint Scene Modeling

author.name: Seokha Moon, Minseung Lee, Joon Seo, Jinkyu Kim, Jungbeom Lee

entry.summary: Proposes CaAD, a causality-aware end-to-end autonomous driving framework that captures reciprocal causal dependencies between the ego vehicle and surrounding agents in a shared latent representation. Addresses the common oversight of causal inter-dependencies in existing end-to-end driving methods.

entry.title: Cross Modality Image Translation In Medical Imaging Using Generative Frameworks

author.name: Giulia Romoli, Alessia Capoccia, Filippo Ruffini, Francesco Di Feola, Luca Boldrini, Arturo Chiti, Renato Cuocolo, Tugba Akinci D'Antonoli, Fatemeh Darvizeh, Marcello Di Pumpo, Bradley J. Erickson, Liu Fang, Deborah Fazzini, Paola Feraco, Fabrizia Gelardi, Francesco Gossetti, Ana Isabel Hern\'aiz Ferrer, Michail E. Klontzas, Seyedmehdi Payabvash, Katrine Riklund, Sara N. Strandberg, Valerio Guarrasi, Paolo Soda

entry.summary: Provides a standardized comparative evaluation framework for 3D medical image-to-image translation across seven generative models (GANs and diffusion) on oncological imaging tasks. Addresses the lack of reproducible benchmarks in the space where most methods operate only on 2D slices.

entry.title: Amplification to Synthesis: A Comparative Analysis of Cognitive Operations Before and After Generative AI

author.name: Liz Cho, Dongwook Yoon

entry.summary: Compares cognitive operation (influence operation) patterns on Twitter/X between the 2016 and 2024 US elections, examining how generative AI may have shifted tactics from bot-driven amplification to AI-synthesized content. Analyzes over 133,000 posts.

entry.title: scShapeBench: Discovering geometry from high dimensional scRNAseq data

author.name: Andrew J Steindl, Jo\~ao Felipe Rocha, Brian Tshilengi Di Bassinga, Zachary Warren, Matthew Scicluna, C\'esar Miguel Valdez C\'ordova, Shabarni Gupta, Leire Torices, Daniel Neumann, Timothy J. Mann, Ihuan Gunawan, Dhananjay Bhaskar, John G Lock, Christine L Chaffer, Guy Wolf, Smita Krishnaswamy

entry.summary: Introduces scShapeBench, a benchmark for discovering geometric and topological structures in single-cell RNA sequencing data. Addresses the problem that analysis pipelines assume specific data shapes (clusters, trees, trajectories) without tools to determine which shape is appropriate.

entry.title: Low-Rank Adapters Initialization via Gradient Surgery for Continual Learning

author.name: Joana Pasquali, Ramiro N. Barros, Arthur S. Bianchessi, Vin\'icius Conte Turani, Jo\~ao Vitor Boer Abitante, Rafaela Cappelari Ravazio, Christian Mattjie, Ot\'avio Parraga, Lucas S. Kupssinsk\"u, Rodrigo C. Barros

entry.summary: Proposes SLICE, a gradient-surgery-based initialization for LoRA adapters in continual learning that reconciles current and prior task gradients through projection and truncated SVD to reduce catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Hessian Matching for Machine-Learned Coarse-Grained Molecular Dynamics

author.name: Sanya Murdeshwar, Sanjit Shashi, Kevin Bachelor, William Noid, Ashwin Lokapally, Razvan Marinescu

entry.summary: Augments coarse-grained molecular dynamics force matching with stochastic Hessian-vector product matching to capture second-order curvature of the free-energy surface, improving CG neural potentials without constructing the full Hessian.

entry.title: ASAP: Amortized Doubly-Stochastic Attention via Sliced Dual Projection

author.name: Huy Tran, Max Milkert, David Hyde

entry.summary: Introduces ASAP, a train-then-compile method for doubly-stochastic attention that trains with Sinkhorn scaling then distills to iteration-free inference, combining training efficiency of Sinkhorn with deployment efficiency of amortized approaches.

entry.title: ERPPO: Entropy Regularization-based Proximal Policy Optimization

author.name: Changha Lee, Gyusang Cho

entry.summary: ERPPO extends MAPPO for multi-agent RL in high-dimensional environments by introducing entropy regularization to handle non-stationary observations, with a Distributional Spatiotemporal Ambiguity learner for object detection uncertainty.

entry.title: QLAM: A Quantum Long-Attention Memory Approach to Long-Sequence Token Modeling

author.name: Hoang-Quan Nguyen, Sankalp Pandey, Khoa Luu

entry.summary: Introduces QLAM, a quantum-inspired long-attention memory approach for sequence modeling that leverages quantum superposition principles to enhance state-space models' ability to capture long-range dependencies with linear-time computation.

entry.title: NeuroRisk: Physics-Informed Neural Optimization for Risk-Aware Traffic Engineering

author.name: Yingming Mao, Ximeng Liu, Jingyi Cheng, Xiyuan Liu, Jiashuai Liu, Yike Liu, Zhen Yao, Yuzhou Zhou, Siyuan Feng, Qiaozhu Zhai, Shizhen Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces NeuroRisk, a physics-informed neural approach for risk-aware traffic engineering in WANs that handles correlated failure scenarios at operational timescales, unifying existing risk-aware formulations under a Sort-and-Select structure.

entry.title: A General B\'ezier Tree Encoding Counterfactual Framework for Retinal-Vessel-Mediated Disease Analysis

author.name: Tan Su, Ethan Elio Meidinger, Lin Gu, Ruogu Fang

entry.summary: Proposes a Bézier Tree Encoding Counterfactual Framework for retinal vessel analysis, enabling parameter-level causal interventions on geometric axes (tortuosity, caliber) while preserving vessel topology.

entry.title: Parallel Scan Recurrent Neural Quantum States for Scalable Variational Monte Carlo

author.name: Ejaaz Merali, Mohamed Hibat-Allah, Mohammad Kohandel, Richard T. Scalettar, Ehsan Khatami

entry.summary: Shows that modern recurrent architectures with parallel scan can achieve fast, accurate neural quantum state simulations, challenging the view that RNNs are inherently sequential and less scalable for variational Monte Carlo.

entry.title: What Does LLM Refinement Actually Improve? A Systematic Study on Document-Level Literary Translation

author.name: Shaomu Tan, Dawei Zhu, Ke Tran, Michael Denkowski, Sony Trenous, Bill Byrne, Leonardo Ribeiro, Felix Hieber

entry.summary: Systematic study of iterative self-refinement for document-level literary translation across nine LLMs and seven language pairs, finding document-level MT followed by segment-level refinement is the robust recipe.

entry.title: Is Video Anomaly Detection Misframed? Evidence from LLM-Based and Multi-Scene Models

author.name: Furkan Mumcu, Michael J. Jones, Anoop Cherian, Yasin Yilmaz

entry.summary: Argues that video anomaly detection is being misframed by emphasis on general multi-scene models using MLLM features, which introduces semantic bias and suppresses spatial localization of scene-specific anomalies.

entry.title: WildPose: A Unified Framework for Robust Pose Estimation in the Wild

author.name: Jianhao Zheng, Liyuan Zhu, Zihan Zhu, Iro Armeni

entry.summary: Presents WildPose, a unified monocular pose estimation framework combining feedforward perception with differentiable bundle adjustment for robust performance in both dynamic and static environments.

entry.title: HarmoGS: Robust 3D Gaussian Splatting in the Wild via Conflict-Aware Gradient Harmonization

author.name: Yulei Kang, Tianze Zhu, Jian-Fang Hu, Jianhuang Lai, Wei-Shi Zheng

entry.summary: HarmoGS proposes a conflict-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that addresses transient distractors and illumination inconsistencies in wild scenes through gradient-level harmonization rather than just masking.

entry.title: GenCape: Structure-Inductive Generative Modeling for Category-Agnostic Pose Estimation

author.name: Jiyong Rao, Yu Wang, Shengjie Zhao

entry.summary: GenCape introduces a generative framework for category-agnostic pose estimation that infers keypoint relationships from support images without predefined skeletons or textual descriptions.

entry.title: DiffST: Spatiotemporal-Aware Diffusion for Real-World Space-Time Video Super-Resolution

author.name: Zheng Chen, Ruofan Yang, Jin Han, Dehua Song, Zichen Zou, Chunming He, Yong Guo, Yulun Zhang

entry.summary: DiffST introduces an efficient spatiotemporal-aware video diffusion framework for real-world space-time video super-resolution with one-step sampling and full video processing.

entry.title: Neural Video Compression with Domain Transfer

author.name: Tiange Zhang, Rongqun Lin, Xiandong Meng, Haofeng Wang, Xing Tian, Qi Zhang, Siwei Ma

entry.summary: DCVC-DT proposes lightweight online domain transfer for neural video compression that adapts latent representations during inference without modifying encoder/decoder parameters.

entry.title: Unlocking Patch-Level Features for CLIP-Based Class-Incremental Learning

author.name: Hao Sun, Zi-Jun Ding, Da-Wei Zhou

entry.summary: Unlocks patch-level features from CLIP for class-incremental learning, arguing that current CIL methods discard rich local semantic information by only using global CLS tokens.

entry.title: DeepFilters: Scattering-Aware Pupil Engineering with Learned Digital Filter Reconstruction for Extended Depth of Field Microscopy

author.name: Joseph L. Greene, Suet YIng Chan, Qilin Deng, Jeffrey Alido, Alexandra Lion, Guorong Hu, Ruipeng Guo, Tongyu Li, Kivilcim Kili\c{c}, Ian Davison, Lei Tian

entry.summary: DeepFilters jointly optimizes pupil filters and digital reconstruction for extended depth-of-field microscopy with scattering awareness, extending usable depth from 16μm to >400μm in clear media.

entry.title: DynoJEPP: Joint Estimation, Prediction and Planning in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Mikolaj Kliniewski, Jesse Morris, Yiduo Wang, Ian R. Manchester, Viorela Ila

entry.summary: DynoJEPP introduces directed factors in factor graphs to jointly optimize estimation, prediction, and planning in dynamic environments while preventing information backflow that corrupts state estimates.

entry.title: HCSG: Human-Centric Semantic-Geometric Reasoning for Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Haoxuan Xu, Tianfu Li, Wenbo Chen, Yi Liu, Jin Wu, Huashuo Lei, Yunfan Lou, Lujia Wang, Hesheng Wang, Haoang Li

entry.summary: HCSG is the first human-centric framework for Vision-Language Navigation that actively reasons about human intentions and social norms rather than treating pedestrians as mere obstacles.

entry.title: The case for fine-grained tracking of compute for AI

author.name: Farhan

entry.summary: Argues that current compute tracking metrics (FLOP/s, bandwidth) are becoming inadequate as architectures diversify. Proposes building separate compute-scaling models per architecture type to better track AI compute advancement.

entry.title: PROMETHEUS: Automating Deep Causal Research Integrating Text, Data and Models

author.name: Sridhar Mahadevan

entry.summary: Introduces PROMETHEUS, a framework that converts heterogeneous knowledge sources into causal atlases—sheaf-like families of local causal models with restriction maps and gluing diagnostics. Uses category-theoretic structures (Topos) for organizing causal knowledge.

entry.title: Strikingness-Aware Evaluation for Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning

author.name: Rikui Huang, Shengzhe Zhang, Wei Wei

entry.summary: Proposes a strikingness-aware evaluation framework for Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning that weights events by their unexpectedness rather than treating all events equally, better measuring true reasoning ability.

entry.title: TimelineReasoner: Advancing Timeline Summarization with Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Liancheng Zhang, Xiaoxi Li, Zhicheng Dou

entry.summary: Proposes TimelineReasoner, a framework shifting timeline summarization from static generation to active reasoning with Large Reasoning Models, using iterative evidence acquisition and temporal consistency validation.

entry.title: PG-LRF: Physiology-Guided Latent Rectified Flow for Electro-Hemodynamic PPG-to-ECG Generation

author.name: Xiaoda Wang, Minxiao Wang, Kaiqiao Han, Defu Cao, Ching Chang, Yidan Shi, Runze Yan, Xiao Luo, Yan Liu, Xiao Hu, Yizhou Sun, Wei Wang, Carl Yang

entry.summary: Proposes PG-LRF, a physiology-guided latent rectified flow model for generating ECG signals from PPG wearable data, incorporating physiological electro-hemodynamic priors into the latent space.

entry.title: Are Compact Rationales Free? Measuring Tile Selection Headroom in Frozen WSI-MIL

author.name: Hyun Do Jung, Jungwon Choi, Soojung Choi, Yujin Oh, Hwiyoung Kim

entry.summary: Studies post-hoc rationale highlighting for frozen WSI-MIL classifiers, introducing FOCI to find compact, model-sufficient tile subsets that recover slide-level predictions without retraining, measuring the gap between attention-based and optimal rationales.

entry.title: The End Justifies the Mean: A Linear Ranking Rule for Proportional Sequential Decisions

author.name: Carmel Baharav, Niclas Boehmer, Bailey Flanigan, Maximilian T. Wittmann

entry.summary: Studies how to collectively choose a linear ranking rule for repeated sequential decisions, proving existence and computing proportionally fair scoring vectors that satisfy individual proportionality guarantees.

entry.title: FRAME: Forensic Routing and Adaptive Multi-path Evidence Fusion for Image Manipulation Detection

author.name: Kaixiang Zhao, Tianrun Yu, Aoxu Zhang, Junhao Su, Porter Jenkins, Amanda Hughes

entry.summary: Proposes FRAME for image manipulation detection through forensic routing and adaptive multi-path evidence fusion, combining multiple forensic signals to improve robustness and generalization across manipulation types.

entry.title: When Absolute State Fails: Evaluating Proprioceptive Encodings for Robust Manipulation

author.name: Maxime Alvarez, Ryo Watanabe, Paul Crook, Afshin Zeinaddini Meymand, Suvin Kurian, Pablo Ferreiro, Genki Sano

entry.summary: Studies how to encode robot proprioceptive state for better generalization in end-to-end policies, finding that simple joint-space representations improve both in- and out-of-distribution performance compared to absolute state representations.

entry.title: Counterfactual Reasoning for Causal Responsibility Attribution in Probabilistic Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Chunyan Mu, Muhammad Najib

entry.summary: Formalizes counterfactual causal responsibility attribution in multi-agent systems using concurrent stochastic games and Shapley values. Shows the method satisfies fairness and consistency properties.

entry.title: SECOND-Grasp: Semantic Contact-guided Dexterous Grasping

author.name: Han Yi Shin, Heeju Ko, Jaewon Mun, Qixing Huang, Jaehyeok Lee, Sung June Kim, Honglak Lee, Sujin Jang, Sangpil Kim

entry.summary: Proposes SECOND-Grasp, a framework integrating physical stability and semantic understanding for dexterous grasping, using coarse contact proposals from vision-language models refined for physical feasibility.

entry.title: PanoWorld: Towards Spatial Supersensing in 360$^\circ$ Panorama World

author.name: Changpeng Wang, Xin Lin, Junhan Liu, Yuheng Liu, Zhen Wang, Donglian Qi, Yunfeng Yan, Xi Chen

entry.summary: Proposes PanoWorld for native panoramic understanding by MLLMs, requiring reasoning over equirectangular projection panoramas as continuous observer-centered spaces rather than decomposing into perspective views.

entry.title: The Readability Spectrum: Patterns, Issues, and Prompt Effects in LLM-Generated Code

author.name: Hengzhi Ye, Fengyuan Ran, Weiwei Xu, Minghui Zhou

entry.summary: Systematically investigates code readability of LLM-generated code compared to human-written code, establishing a comprehensive readability model and examining how prompt design affects readability.

entry.title: HLS-Seek: QoR-Aware Code Generation for High-Level Synthesis via Proxy Comparative Reward Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Qingyun Zou, Feng Yu, Hongshi Tan, Yao Chen, Bingsheng He, WengFai Wong

entry.summary: Proposes HLS-Seek, a QoR-aware code generation framework for High-Level Synthesis that uses a comparative proxy reward model instead of expensive synthesis-in-the-loop RL, achieving 99.53% Pareto-dominance accuracy.

entry.title: Weakly Supervised Segmentation as Semantic-Based Regularization

author.name: Stefano Colamonaco, Andrei-Bogdan Florea, Jaron Maene

entry.summary: Proposes a neurosymbolic approach to weakly supervised semantic segmentation that integrates differentiable fuzzy logic constraints with SAM foundation models. Weak annotations and domain priors are unified as continuous logical constraints for fine-tuning, then the refined model produces improved pseudo-labels.

entry.title: Learning When to Act: Communication-Efficient Reinforcement Learning via Run-Time Assurance

author.name: Adam Haroon, Erick J. Rodr\'iguez-Seda, Cody Fleming, Tristan Schuler

entry.summary: Proposes a safe reinforcement learning framework that jointly learns control inputs and communication-efficient timing decisions under a Lyapunov safety shield. An RTA layer provides strictly stronger safety guarantees than constrained MDP methods by overriding via one-step-ahead Lyapunov prediction.

entry.title: Neurodata Without Boredom: Benchmarking Agentic AI for Data Reuse

author.name: Ling-Qi Zhang, Kristin Branson

entry.summary: Proposes using agentic AI (LLMs) to solve the neuroscience data reuse problem, where highly fragmented data formats require substantial manual effort to decipher. Benchmarks LLM agents on the task of understanding bespoke data formatting choices.

entry.title: Spatiotemporal downscaling and nowcasting of urban land surface temperatures with deep neural networks

author.name: Solomiia Kurchaba, Angela Meyer

entry.summary: Uses U-Net to combine geostationary (high temporal, low spatial resolution) and polar orbiting (high spatial, low temporal) satellite observations for 1km/15-min land surface temperature estimation.

entry.title: Generative Modeling of Approximately Periodic Time Series by a Posterior-Weighted Gaussian Process

author.name: Elias Reich, Saverio Messineo, Stefan Huber

entry.summary: Proposes a Gaussian process generative model for approximately periodic time series that decouples intra-repetition structure from inter-repetition variability using a posterior-weighted kernel.

entry.title: TurboGR: An Accelerated Training System for Large-Scale Generative Recommendation

author.name: Huichao Chai, Zhixin Wu, Xuemiao Li, Shiqing Fan, Hengfeng Wang, Maojun Peng, Lu Xu, Yaoyuan Wang, Yibo Jin, Wei Guo, Yongxiang Feng

entry.summary: Presents TurboGR, an Ascend NPU-optimized training system for generative recommendation models, addressing the mismatch between irregular sparse operations and NPU dense-computation design.

entry.title: MedCore: Boundary-Preserving Medical Core Pruning for MedSAM

author.name: Cenwei Zhang, Suncheng Xiang, Lei You

entry.summary: Proposes MedCore, a structured pruning framework for MedSAM that preserves boundary fidelity during compression by identifying structures important for medical adaptation and boundary leverage through dual-intervention scoring.

entry.title: R-DMesh: Video-Guided 3D Animation via Rectified Dynamic Mesh Flow

author.name: Zijie Wu, Lixin Xu, Puhua Jiang, Sicong Liu, Chunchao Guo, Xiang Bai

entry.summary: Presents R-DMesh, a framework for video-guided 3D animation that handles pose misalignment between user-provided meshes and reference videos through a rectified dynamic mesh flow approach.

entry.title: TokAlign++: Advancing Vocabulary Adaptation via Better Token Alignment

author.name: Chong Li, Yingzhuo Deng, Wen Yang, Jiajun Zhang, Chengqing Zong

entry.summary: Introduces TokAlign++ for vocabulary adaptation in LLMs by learning bilingual token alignment lexicons from monolingual representations, improving transfer between models with different vocabularies.

entry.title: Creativity Bias: How Machine Evaluation Struggles with Creativity in Literary Translations

author.name: Kyo Gerrits, Rik van Noord, Ana Guerberof Arenas

entry.summary: Shows that automatic evaluation metrics and LLM-as-judge poorly correlate with professional literary translators' assessments, particularly failing to evaluate creativity in translations.

entry.title: When Do LLMs Generate Realistic Social Networks? A Multi-Dimensional Study of Culture, Language, Scale, and Method

author.name: Sai Hemanth Kilaru, Sriram Theerdh Manikyala, Raghav Upadhyay, Sri Sai Kumar Ramavath, Srivika Nunavathu, Dalal Alharthi

entry.summary: Systematically studies how LLMs generate synthetic social networks across cultural contexts, languages, model scales, and prompting architectures, using 192 verified directed networks.

entry.title: DirectTryOn: One-Step Virtual Try-On via Straightened Conditional Transport

author.name: Xianbing Sun, Jiahui Zhan, Liqing Zhang, Jianfu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DirectTryOn, a one-step virtual try-on method using straightened conditional transport, exploiting the observation that VTON outputs are highly constrained by inputs making straight trajectories natural.

entry.title: ImageAttributionBench: How Far Are We from Generalizable Attribution?

author.name: Tingshu Mou, Zhipeng Wei, Chao Gong, Jingjing Chen, Xingjun Ma

entry.summary: Introduces ImageAttributionBench, a comprehensive dataset for attributing synthetic images to their source generative models, covering diverse modern architectures and semantic domains.

entry.title: EgoForce: Robust Online Egocentric Motion Reconstruction via Diffusion Forcing

author.name: Inwoo Hwang, Donggeun Lim, Hojun Jang, Young Min Kim

entry.summary: Proposes EgoForce, an online framework for reconstructing full-body motion from noisy egocentric input using diffusion forcing with temporally asymmetric noise for real-time applications.

entry.title: PRA-PoE: Robust Alzheimer's Diagnosis with Arbitrary Missing Modalities

author.name: Guangqian Yang, Ye Du, Wenlong Hou, Qian Niu, Shujun Wang

entry.summary: PRA-PoE addresses missing modality challenges in Alzheimer's disease diagnosis using prototype-anchored representations and product-of-experts, handling distribution shifts between training and deployment.

entry.title: RoSplat: Robust Feed-Forward Pixel-wise Gaussian Splatting for Varying Input Views and High-Resolution Rendering

author.name: Hoang Chuong Nguyen, Renjie Wu, Jose M. Alvarez, Miaomiao Liu

entry.summary: RoSplat addresses over-brightness and hole artifacts in feed-forward Gaussian Splatting when input view count varies, proposing alpha normalization and auxiliary 3D sampling supervision.

entry.title: Unifying Physically-Informed Weather Priors in A Single Model for Image Restoration Across Multiple Adverse Weather Conditions

author.name: Jiaqi Xu, Xiaowei Hu, Lei Zhu, Pheng-Ann Heng

entry.summary: Presents a unified image restoration model for multiple adverse weather conditions using physics-informed weather priors that model both close-range particle effects and distant fog effects based on distance.

entry.title: Bayesian In Vivo Tracking of Synapses using Joint Poisson Deconvolution and Diffeomorphic Registration

author.name: Shashwat Kumar, Dominic M. Padova, Binish Narang, Gabrielle I. Coste, Austin R. Graves, Richard L. Huganir, Adam S. Charles, Michael I. Miller, Anuj Srivastava

entry.summary: Develops a Bayesian framework for tracking synapses in vivo using joint Poisson deconvolution and diffeomorphic registration, addressing challenges of low SNR two-photon microscopy.

entry.title: Rethinking Graph Convolution for 2D-to-3D Hand Pose Lifting

author.name: Chanyoung Kim, Donghyun Kim, Dong-Hyun Sim, Seong Jae Hwang, Youngjoong Kwon

entry.summary: Shows that standard multi-head self-attention outperforms graph convolutional networks for 2D-to-3D hand pose lifting, challenging the assumption that explicit graph structure is beneficial.

entry.title: The Geno-Synthetic Algorithm: Type-Factored Coevolutionary Optimization for Heterogeneous Genotypes and Assembled Phenotypes

author.name: Alex Bogdan

entry.summary: GSA is a type-factored coevolutionary framework where gene families of different types (integers, reals, categoricals, embeddings) evolve in parallel with type-native operators and assemble into phenotypes.

entry.title: Lifelong Learning in Vision-Language Models: Enhanced EWC with Cross-Modal Knowledge Retention

author.name: Hamza Ahmed Durrani, Rafay Suleman Durrani

entry.summary: Presents a continual learning framework for large vision-language models combining enhanced Elastic Weight Consolidation with parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Addresses catastrophic forgetting while preserving cross-modal alignments.

entry.title: Distributionally Robust Safety Under Arbitrary Uncertainties: A Safety Filtering Approach

author.name: Daniel M. Cherenson, Haejoon Lee, Taekyung Kim, Dimitra Panagou

entry.summary: Proposes a distributionally robust safety filtering approach for nonlinear systems under unknown disturbance distributions. Uses Wasserstein ambiguity sets and reduces the online computation to a one-dimensional search.

entry.title: SID: Sliding into Distribution for Robust Few-Demonstration Manipulation

author.name: Yicheng Ma, Wei Yu, Zhian Su, Xidan Zhang, Huixu Dong

entry.summary: SID learns an object-centric motion field from a few canonicalized demonstrations to guide manipulation toward the demonstrated distribution, enabling robust generalization across poses, viewpoints, and disturbances.

entry.title: Learning Responsibility-Attributed Adversarial Scenarios for Testing Autonomous Vehicles

author.name: Yizhuo Xiao, Haotian Yan, Ying Wang, Zhongpan Zhu, Yuxin Zhang, Xintao Yan, Mustafa Suphi Erden, Cheng Wang

entry.summary: CARS integrates responsibility attribution into adversarial scenario generation for testing autonomous driving, distinguishing between failures from system deficiencies versus unavoidable traffic conflicts.

entry.title: Apollo Update May 2026

author.name: Marius Hobbhahn

entry.summary: Apollo Research update: focusing on scheming science, monitoring for coding agents (Watcher product), and governance of automated AI R&D. Now have an SF office and are hiring across technical roles.

entry.title: BEHAVE: A Hybrid AI Framework for Real-Time Modeling of Collective Human Dynamics

author.name: Helene Malyutina

entry.summary: Proposes BEHAVE, a hybrid AI framework modeling collective human dynamics as a complex dynamical system with phase transitions, using body micro-dynamics to detect group-level escalation or breakdown in real time.

entry.title: An Agentic LLM-Based Framework for Population-Scale Mental Health Screening

author.name: Giuliano Lorenzoni, Paulo Alencar, Donald Cowan

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic LLM framework for population-scale mental health screening where each pipeline stage is a LangChain agent with explicit policies and proxy-guided evaluation, with stages incrementally locked once validated.

entry.title: RS-Claw: Progressive Active Tool Exploration via Hierarchical Skill Trees for Remote Sensing Agents

author.name: Liangtian Liu, Zeyuan Wang, Ziyu Li, Kai Ouyang, Zichao Tang, Chengfu Liu, Haifeng Li, Hanwen Yu, Wentao Yang, Cheng Yang, Dongyang Hou

entry.summary: Proposes RS-Claw, a progressive active tool exploration framework for remote sensing agents using hierarchical skill trees, addressing the challenge of dynamically balancing context load and toolset completeness.

entry.title: Learning Local Constraints for Reinforcement-Learned Content Generators

author.name: Debosmita Bhaumik, Julian Togelius, Georgios N. Yannakakis, Ahmed Khalifa

entry.summary: Combines Wave Function Collapse's local constraints with PCGRL reinforcement learning for game level generation, constraining the RL action space with learned local patterns while achieving global properties like playability.

entry.title: Quantifying Sensitivity for Tree Ensembles: A symbolic and compositional approach

author.name: S. Akshay, Chaitanya Garg, Ashutosh Gupta, Kuldeep S. Meel, Ajinkya Naik

entry.summary: Proposes a symbolic and compositional approach for quantifying sensitivity of decision tree ensembles—counting regions susceptible to misclassification from small feature changes—with certified error and confidence bounds.

entry.title: Active Sensing with Meta-Reinforcement Learning for Emitter Localization from RF Observations

author.name: M. Shamail J. Khan, Nisha L. Raichur, Lucas Heublein, Christian Wielenberg, Alexander Mattick, Tobias Feigl, Christopher Mutschler, Felix Ott

entry.summary: Formulates GNSS interference localization as an active sensing problem using meta-reinforcement learning, where an agent sequentially explores to localize RF emitters under partial observability and changing channel conditions.

entry.title: Grid-Orch: An LLM-Powered Orchestrator for Distribution Grid Simulation and Analytics

author.name: Boming Liu, Jin Dong, Jamie Lian

entry.summary: Introduces Grid-Orch, an LLM-powered framework using Model Context Protocol to enable natural language interaction with power distribution simulation tools, covering power flow, voltage analysis, and optimization across 36 domain-specific tools.

entry.title: Anatomy-Slot: Unsupervised Anatomical Factorization for Homologous Bilateral Reasoning in Retinal Diagnosis

author.name: Yingzhe Ma, Xiao Yang, Yuguo Yin, Zheyu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Anatomy-Slot for bilateral retinal diagnosis, using unsupervised anatomical slot decomposition and cross-eye alignment to enable homologous structure comparison, improving AUC by 4.2% over ViT-L baseline on ODIR-5K.

entry.title: Bridging Domain Gaps with Target-Aligned Generation for Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Minung Kim, Jeongmo Kim, Gwanwoo Choi, Seungyul Han

entry.summary: Proposes Target-aligned Coverage Expansion (TCE) for cross-domain offline RL, using a dual score-based generative model to synthesize target-consistent transitions when the target dataset is limited.

entry.title: Vividh-ASR: A Complexity-Tiered Benchmark and Optimization Dynamics for Robust Indic Speech Recognition

author.name: Kush Juvekar, Kavya Manohar, Aditya Srinivas Menon, Arghya Bhattacharya, Kumarmanas Nethil

entry.summary: Introduces Vividh-ASR, a complexity-stratified benchmark for Hindi and Malayalam ASR across four difficulty tiers. Proposes reverse multi-stage fine-tuning that enables a 244M Whisper model to match larger commercial systems.

entry.title: MLGIB: Multi-Label Graph Information Bottleneck for Expressive and Robust Message Passing

author.name: Chaokai Wu, Haofu Shi, Ningxuan Ma, Jianghong Ma, Xiaofeng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Multi-Label Graph Information Bottleneck (MLGIB) to address over-squashing in multi-label graphs by formulating message passing as constrained information transmission under irrelevant label noise.

entry.title: "It became a self-fulfilling prophecy": How Lived Experiences are Entangled with AI Predictions in Menstrual Cycle Tracking Apps

author.name: Wendy Zhou, Pelin Karaturhan, Alexandra Weilenmann, Jichen Zhu

entry.summary: Examines how AI predictions in menstrual cycle tracking apps become self-fulfilling prophecies, with users understanding their lived experiences through potentially faulty AI predictions. Uses interviews and autoethnography.

entry.title: What Limits Vision-and-Language Navigation ?

author.name: Yunheng Wang, Yuetong Fang, Taowen Wang, Lusong Li, Kun Liu, Junzhe Xu, Zizhao Yuan, Yixiao Feng, Jiaxi Zhang, Wei Lu, Zecui Zeng, Renjing Xu

entry.summary: Proposes StereoNav for vision-and-language navigation, addressing the sim-to-real gap through robust spatial grounding and cross-domain priors rather than simply scaling model size and data.

entry.title: CUBic: Coordinated Unified Bimanual Perception and Control Framework

author.name: Xingyu Wang, Pengxiang Ding, Jingkai Xu, Donglin Wang, Zhaoxin Fan

entry.summary: Proposes CUBic, a unified framework for bimanual robotic manipulation that reformulates coordination as a unified perceptual modeling problem through shared tokenized representations bridging perception and control.

entry.title: Locale-Conditioned Few-Shot Prompting Mitigates Demonstration Regurgitation in On-Device PII Substitution with Small Language Models

author.name: Anuj Sadani, Deepak Kumar

entry.summary: Proposes a fully on-device PII substitution pipeline using a small language model, finding that locale-conditioned few-shot prompting prevents demonstration regurgitation that naive prompting causes in quantized models.

entry.title: HetScene: Heterogeneity-Aware Diffusion for Dense Indoor Scene Generation

author.name: Zini Chen, Junming Huang, Rong Zhang, Jiamin Xu, Cheng Peng, Chi Wang, Weiwei Xu

entry.summary: Introduces HetScene, a diffusion-based approach for generating dense indoor scenes that decomposes objects into primary and secondary categories based on their structural roles. Addresses limitations of existing methods that treat all objects homogeneously, which fails for complex dense layouts needed in embodied AI simulation.

entry.title: RTLC -- Research, Teach-to-Learn, Critique: A three-stage prompting paradigm inspired by the Feynman Learning Technique that lifts LLM-as-judge accuracy on JudgeBench with no fine-tuning

author.name: Andrea Morandi

entry.summary: Introduces RTLC, a three-stage prompting method inspired by the Feynman Learning Technique that improves LLM-as-judge accuracy on JudgeBench without fine-tuning. Uses research, teach-to-learn, and critique stages with ensemble-of-thought sampling to boost judge quality.

entry.title: Di-BiLPS: Denoising induced Bidirectional Latent-PDE-Solver under Sparse Observations

author.name: Zhonghao Li, Chaoyu Liu, Qian Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Di-BiLPS, a neural framework for solving both forward and inverse PDE problems under extremely sparse observations. Combines a variational autoencoder for compression with bidirectional processing and denoising-based regularization.

entry.title: AGOP as Explanation: From Feature Learning to Per-Sample Attribution in Image Classifiers

author.name: Raj Kiran Gupta Katakam

entry.summary: Introduces AGOP-Weighted, a novel attribution method for image classifiers that multiplies per-sample gradients by a training-distribution prior derived from the Average Gradient Outer Product. Connects feature learning theory with explainability.

entry.title: VIP-COP: Context Optimization for Tabular Foundation Models

author.name: Yilong Chen, Xueying Ding, Leman Akoglu

entry.summary: Introduces VIP-COP for context optimization in tabular foundation models, estimating importance of training examples and features for hard context optimization to handle context length limits and out-of-distribution data sizes.

entry.title: Efficient Sensor Fusion for Gesture Recognition on Resource-Constrained Devices

author.name: Pietro Bartoli, Christian Veronesi, Tommaso Bondini, Andrea Giudici, Franco Zappa

entry.summary: Proposes efficient sensor fusion combining low-resolution ToF and IR thermal sensors with a compact grouped-convolution CNN for privacy-preserving gesture recognition on resource-constrained smart eyewear.

entry.title: Multimodal Graph-based Classification of Esophageal Motility Disorders

author.name: Alexander Geiger, Lars Wagner, Daniel Rueckert, Alois Knoll, Dirk Wilhelm, Alissa Jell

entry.summary: Applies multimodal ML combining HRIM recordings with patient information and graph-based modeling for classifying esophageal motility disorders, analyzing 104 patients.

entry.title: Real-World Challenges in Fake News Detection: Dealing with Posts by Cold Users

author.name: Sai Keerthana Karnam, Abhirup Kundu, Jashn Arora, Manish Jain, Animesh Mukherjee

entry.summary: Studies fake news detection in the challenging 'cold user' setting where users have minimal platform history. Shows that SOTA approaches relying on user behavior degrade significantly for cold users and proposes mitigation strategies.

entry.title: Optimization in Sparse 2D to Dense 3D Weakly Supervised Learning: Application to Multi-Label Segmentation of Large ex vivo MRI Data

author.name: Paul Hoareau, Kuan Yi Wang, Brandon Bujak, Roy Sun, Govind Nair, Irene Cortese, Charidimos Tsagkas, Daniel Reich, Julien Cohen-Adad

entry.summary: Studies sparse 2D to dense 3D weakly supervised learning for multi-label segmentation of high-resolution ex vivo MRI, analyzing how regularization strategies transfer across dimensions in a Teacher-Student framework.

entry.title: SHM-Agents: A Generalist-Specialist Integrated Agent System for Structural Health Monitoring

author.name: Yuequan Bao, Xing Li, Huabin Sun, Dawei Liu, Yuxuan Tian, Haiyang Hu

entry.summary: Proposes SHM-Agents, a system integrating LLM reasoning with specialized structural health monitoring algorithms, enabling end-to-end execution of SHM tasks via natural language with modular expansion.

entry.title: Reducing Bias and Variance: Generative Semantic Guidance and Bi-Layer Ensemble for Image Clustering

author.name: Feijiang Li, Zhenxiong Li, Jieting Wang, Zizheng Jiu, Saixiong Liu, Liang Du

entry.summary: Proposes GSEC for image clustering, combining generative semantic guidance with a bi-layer ensemble to reduce both bias and variance. Addresses limitations of matching-based approaches with predefined vocabularies.

entry.title: Beyond Explained Variance: A Cautionary Tale of PCA

author.name: Gionni Marchetti

entry.summary: Demonstrates PCA's failure to capture nonlinear manifold structure in a paleontological dataset, revealing a ring-like topology via t-SNE and persistent homology that PCA's linear scatterplot misrepresents as clusters.

entry.title: Dense vs Sparse Pretraining at Tiny Scale: Active-Parameter vs Total-Parameter Matching

author.name: Abdalrahman Wael

entry.summary: Compares dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) transformers at tiny scale under controlled conditions, finding MoE outperforms dense models matched by active parameters but underperforms when matched by total parameters.

entry.title: The Cost of Perfect English: Pragmatic Flattening and the Erasure of Authorial Voice in L2 Writing Supported by GenAI

author.name: Ao Liu, Shanhua Zhu

entry.summary: Studies 'pragmatic flattening' where GenAI tools systematically erase culturally preferred politeness and authorial stance in L2 writing, showing models correct grammar while homogenizing pragmatic diversity.

entry.title: GeoBuildBench: A Benchmark for Interactive and Executable Geometry Construction from Natural Language

author.name: Jinwoong Kim, Rui Yang, Huishuai Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces GeoBuildBench, a benchmark evaluating whether LLMs can convert natural-language geometry problems into executable constructions via domain-specific language programs, testing 489 problems.

entry.title: LongBEL: Long-Context and Document-Consistent Biomedical Entity Linking

author.name: Adam Remaki, Xavier Tannier, Christel G\'erardin

entry.summary: Introduces LongBEL, a document-level biomedical entity linking framework combining full-document context with a prediction memory trained on cross-validated predictions to reduce cascading errors.

entry.title: Linking Extreme Discourse to Structural Polarization in Signed Interaction Networks

author.name: Zhijin Guo, Li Zhang, Tyler Bonnet, Janet B. Pierrehumbert, Xiaowen Dong

entry.summary: Proposes a language-grounded signed-network pipeline linking extreme discourse to structural polarization using LLM stance scores as continuous edge weights, validated with spectral and frustration-based measures.

entry.title: DIVER:Diving Deeper into Distilled Data via Expressive Semantic Recovery

author.name: Qianxin Xia, Zhiyong Shu, Wenbo Jiang, Jiawei Du, Jielei Wang, Guoming Lu

entry.summary: Proposes DIVER, a dual-stage dataset distillation framework that uses pre-trained diffusion models to recover expressive semantics from distilled data, improving cross-architecture generalization.

entry.title: GuardMarkGS: Unified Ownership Tracing and Edit Deterrence for 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Utae Jeong, Jaewan Choi, Junseok Lee, Jongheon Jeong, Sang Ho Yoon, ByoungSoo Koh, Sangpil Kim

entry.summary: Presents GuardMarkGS, the first unified framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting protection that jointly optimizes watermarking for ownership tracing and adversarial perturbations for edit deterrence.

entry.title: Multi-Modal Guided Multi-Source Domain Adaptation for Object Detection

author.name: Sangin Lee, Seokjun Kwon, Jeongmin Shin, Namil Kim, Yukyung Choi

entry.summary: MS-DePro proposes depth-guided localization and multi-modal prompt learning for multi-source domain adaptation in object detection, leveraging domain-agnostic depth as a complementary modality.

entry.title: FedHPro: Federated Hyper-Prototype Learning via Gradient Matching

author.name: Huan Wang, Jun Shen, Haoran Li, Zhenyu Yang, Jun Yan, Ousman Manjang, Yanlong Zhai, Di Wu, Guansong Pang

entry.summary: FedHPro introduces hyper-prototypes for federated learning optimized via gradient matching, addressing semantic drift issues in existing prototype-based FL methods.

entry.title: HADAR-Based Thermal Infrared Hyperspectral Image Restoration

author.name: Cheng Dai, Jiale Lin, Bingxuan Song, Yifei Chen, Jiashuo Chen, Xin Yuan, Fanglin Bao

entry.summary: HAIR proposes physics-driven thermal infrared hyperspectral image restoration using HADAR rendering equation and atmospheric radiative transfer to decompose scenes into temperature, emissivity, and texture.

entry.title: Generative Motion In-betweening by Diffusion over Continuous Implicit Representations

author.name: Shiyu Fan, Paul Henderson, Edmond S. L. Ho

entry.summary: Proposes motion in-betweening via diffusion over implicit neural representations, enabling sampling from extremely sparse keyframe data while maintaining smoothness.

entry.title: Nonsmooth Set-Gradient Ascent to the Pareto Front via Layered Hypervolume and Magnitude Indicators

author.name: Michael T. M. Emmerich

entry.summary: Develops nonsmooth set-gradient ascent for moving approximation sets toward Pareto fronts using layered hypervolume and magnitude indicators with formal convergence analysis.

entry.title: COSMIC: Concurrent Optimization of Structure, Material, and Integrated Control for robotic systems

author.name: Qinsong Guo, Liwei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes COSMIC, a gradient-based co-design framework that simultaneously optimizes the topology, material distribution, and control policy of truss-lattice robots. This mirrors biological co-evolution where structure and behavior evolve together.

entry.title: Enhancing a Risk Model by Adding Transient Statistical Factors

author.name: Alexandros E. Tzikas, Emmanuel J. Cand\`es, Trevor Hastie, Stephen P. Boyd, Mykel J. Kochenderfer, Ronald N. Kahn

entry.summary: Proposes a method to enhance existing financial risk models by adding transient statistical factors via maximum likelihood estimation, capturing changing market regimes that third-party models miss. Authors include Candès, Hastie, and Boyd.

entry.title: LMPath: Language-Mediated Priors and Path Generation for Aerial Exploration

author.name: Jonathan A. Diller, Fernando Cladera, Camillo J. Taylor, Vijay Kumar

entry.summary: Presents LMPath, a pipeline using language models and vision foundation models to generate semantically-informed exploration priors for UAV search missions from satellite imagery. Given a target object description, it determines relevant search regions rather than using geometric coverage patterns.

entry.title: Phy-CoSF: Physics-Guided Continuous Spectral Fields Reconstruction and Super-Resolution for Snapshot Compressive Imaging

author.name: Wudi Chen, Zhiyuan Zha, Xin Yuan, Shigang Wang, Bihan Wen, Jiantao Zhou, Gang Yan, Zipei Fan, Ce Zhu

entry.summary: Phy-CoSF combines deep unfolding networks with implicit neural representations for continuous spectral reconstruction and super-resolution in coded aperture snapshot spectral imaging.

entry.title: MUJICA: Multi-skill Unified Joint Integration of Control Architecture for Wheeled-Legged Robots

author.name: Yuqi Li, Peng Zhai, Yueqi Zhang, Xiaoyi Wei, Quancheng Qian, Zhengxu He, Qianxiang Yu, Lihua Zhang

entry.summary: MUJICA is a unified proprioceptive control framework for wheeled-legged robots integrating multiple locomotion skills (omnidirectional movement, climbing, fall recovery) within a single RL policy.

entry.title: WD-FQDet: Multispectral Detection Transformer via Wavelet Decomposition and Frequency-aware Query Learning

author.name: Chunjin Yang, Xiwei Zhang, Yiming Xiao, Fanman Meng

entry.summary: WD-FQDet decouples modality-shared and modality-specific information in infrared-visible detection using wavelet decomposition into low/high frequency domains with frequency-specific fusion.

entry.title: Few-Shot Physics-Informed Neural Network for Shape Reconstruction of Concentric-Tube Robots

author.name: Navid Feizi, Filipe C. Pedrosa, Rajni V. Patel, Jagadeesan Jayender

entry.summary: Develops a physics-informed neural network for kinematic modeling of concentric tube robots that embeds Cosserat rod equations and learns from few-shot data. Achieves full-state estimation with limited training samples.

entry.title: On the Size Complexity and Decidability of First-Order Progression

author.name: Jens Classen, Daxin Liu

entry.summary: Analyzes the size complexity of first-order progression in the Situation Calculus, showing that under reasonable assumptions, first-order progression grows only polynomially for local-effect, normal, and acyclic action classes. Also establishes decidability results.

entry.title: Multimodal Hidden Markov Models for Persistent Emotional State Tracking

author.name: Anamika Ragu, Aneesh Jonelagadda

entry.summary: Proposes using sticky factorial HDP-HMMs over multimodal valence-arousal representations to model conversational emotion as latent emotional regimes, tracking persistent phases rather than utterance-level emotions.

entry.title: Prime Successor Irreducibility: Turing Machine Complexity, Kolmogorov Complexity, and Weakness-Based Formulations

author.name: Ben Goertzel, Bill Lauritzen

entry.summary: Develops conjectures expressing computational irreducibility in the prime sequence—that no general algorithm can compute the next prime substantially faster than sequential testing except on sparse inputs. Formalizes this in Turing-machine and Kolmogorov complexity frameworks.

entry.title: Representing Higher-Order Networks: A Survey of Graph-Based Frameworks

author.name: Takaaki Fujita, Florentin Smarandache

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey of graph-based frameworks for representing higher-order networks, covering multiway, hierarchical, temporal, multilayer, recursive, and tensor-based interactions beyond pairwise graphs.

entry.title: SP-GCRL: Influence Maximization on Incomplete Social Graphs

author.name: Haohua Niu, Yuxuan Yang, Lingfeng Zhang, Hao Li, Jiao Liang, Zongfu Luo, Luca Rossi

entry.summary: Proposes SP-GCRL for influence maximization on incomplete social graphs, combining social-propagation-aware diffusion modeling with graph contrastive RL to handle missing edges and non-stationary dynamics.

entry.title: BoostTaxo: Zero-Shot Taxonomy Induction via Boosting-Style Agentic Reasoning and Constraint-Aware Calibration

author.name: Yancheng Ling, Zhenlin Qin, Leizhen Wang, Zhenliang Ma

entry.summary: Introduces BoostTaxo, a boosting-style LLM framework for zero-shot taxonomy induction that performs parent identification in a coarse-to-fine manner with structure-aware score calibration.

entry.title: MorphOPC: Advancing Mask Optimization with Multi-scale Hierarchical Morphological Learning

author.name: Yuting Hu, Lei Zhuang, Chen Wang, Ruiyang Qin, Hua Xiang, Gi-joon Nam, Jinjun Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes MorphOPC, a multi-scale hierarchical model that formulates photomask generation as a sequence of morphological operations for optical proximity correction in semiconductor manufacturing. Targets improving pattern fidelity at nanometer scales.

entry.title: CROP: Expert-Aligned Image Cropping via Compositional Reasoning and Optimizing Preference

author.name: Zhitong Dong, Chao Li, Jie Yu, Hao Chen

entry.summary: Reformulates aesthetic image cropping as a multimodal reasoning task for VLMs, using compositional reasoning to align automated cropping with expert human preferences rather than relying on saliency or retrieval.

entry.title: Pyramid Self-contrastive Learning Framework for Test-time Ultrasound Image Denoising

author.name: Jiajing Zhang, Bingze Dai, Xi Zhang, Yue Xu, Wei-Ning Lee

entry.summary: Proposes a test-time training framework for one-shot ultrasound image denoising using aperture-to-aperture self-supervision, avoiding domain shift problems of pre-trained denoisers.

entry.title: Plan Before You Trade: Inference-Time Optimization for RL Trading Agents

author.name: Eun Go, Rohan Deb, Arindam Banerjee

entry.summary: Proposes FPILOT, an inference-time optimization framework for RL trading agents inspired by MPC, using price forecasts at decision time to optimize portfolio allocation without iterative rollouts.

entry.title: A Unified Perspective for Learning Graph Representations Across Multi-Level Abstractions

author.name: Mohamed Mahmoud Amar, Nairouz Mrabah, Mohamed Bouguessa, Abdoulaye Banir\'e Diallo

entry.summary: Proposes a unified graph self-supervised learning framework targeting node-level through graph-level information via linear combination of similarity scores, with adaptive penalty strengths per example.

entry.title: Large Language Models for Agentic NetOps and AIOps: Architectures, Evaluation, and Safety

author.name: Muhammad Bilal, Jon Crowcroft, Ruizhi Wang, Xiaolong Xu, Schahram Dustdar

entry.summary: Survey/position paper on using LLMs for network operations (NetOps) and AIOps, organizing literature around autonomy hierarchies, tool scope, evidence traces, and assurance contracts for operational decision-making.

entry.title: Multi-Quantile Regression for Extreme Precipitation Downscaling

author.name: Hamed Najafi, Gareth Lagerwall, Jayantha Obeysekera, Jason Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Q-SRDRN for extreme precipitation downscaling using multi-quantile regression with pinball loss, addressing the systematic under-prediction of heavy-tail events that drive flood risk.

entry.title: Protocol-Driven Development: Governing Generated Software Through Invariants and Evidence

author.name: Jun He, Deying Yu

entry.summary: Introduces Protocol-Driven Development (PDD), a framework where the primary software artifact is a machine-enforceable protocol (structural, behavioral, and observational invariants) rather than implementation code, aimed at governing AI-generated software.

entry.title: Rethinking Efficient Graph Coarsening via a Non-Selfishness Principle

author.name: Xu Bai, Bin Lu, Kun Zhang, Shengbo Chen, Xinbing Wang, Chenghu Zhou, Meng Jin

entry.summary: Proposes NOPE, a graph coarsening method based on a 'non-selfishness' principle that prioritizes collective neighborhood influence over pairwise similarity matching, achieving linear memory and near-linear computational complexity.

entry.title: EvObj: Learning Evolving Object-centric Representations for 3D Instance Segmentation without Scene Supervision

author.name: Jiahao Chen, Zihui Zhang, Yafei Yang, Jinxi Li, Shenxing Wei, Zhixuan Sun, Bo Yang

entry.summary: Introduces EvObj for unsupervised 3D instance segmentation that bridges the geometric domain gap between synthetic pretraining and real-world point clouds using evolving object-centric representations.

entry.title: IndicMedDialog: A Parallel Multi-Turn Medical Dialogue Dataset for Accessible Healthcare in Indic Languages

author.name: Shubham Kumar Nigam, Suparnojit Sarkar, Piyush Patel

entry.summary: Introduces IndicMedDialog, a parallel multi-turn medical dialogue dataset across English and nine Indic languages, created through LLM-generated synthetic consultations with translation and human verification.

entry.title: AI Harness Engineering: A Runtime Substrate for Foundation-Model Software Agents

author.name: Hailin Zhong, Shengxin Zhu
