entry.summary: Proposes AI Harness Engineering, formalizing the runtime substrate that mediates between foundation models and development environments. Identifies eleven component responsibilities for reliable software-engineering agents.

entry.title: LLMs as annotators of credibility assessment in Danish asylum decisions: evaluating classification performance and errors beyond aggregated metrics

author.name: Galadrielle Humblot-Renaux, Mohammad N. S. Jahromi, Rohat Bakuri-J{\o}rgensen, Marieke Anne Heyl, Asta S. Stage Jarlner, Maria Vlachou, Anna Murphy H{\o}genhaug, Desmond Elliott, Thomas Gammeltoft-Hansen, Thomas B. Moeslund

entry.summary: Investigates LLMs as annotators for credibility assessment in Danish asylum decisions. Introduces RAB-Cred dataset with expert annotations and benchmarks 21 open-weight models across 30 prompt configurations.

entry.title: ArcVQ-VAE: A Spherical Vector Quantization Framework with ArcCosine Additive Margin

author.name: Jaeyung Kim, YoungJoon Yoo

entry.summary: Proposes ArcVQ-VAE, introducing a spherical angular-margin prior for VQ-VAE codebooks to improve codebook utilization and representation quality through ball-bounded norm regularization and arccos additive margin loss.

entry.title: Towards Unified Surgical Scene Understanding:Bridging Reasoning and Grounding via MLLMs

author.name: Jincai Huang, Shihao Zou, Yuchen Guo, Jingjing Li, Wei Ji, Kai Wang, Shanshan Wang, Weixin Si

entry.summary: Proposes SurgMLLM, a unified surgical scene understanding framework bridging high-level reasoning and pixel-level visual grounding within a single multimodal LLM, fine-tuned for surgical video analysis.

entry.title: Dynamical Predictive Modelling of Cardiovascular Disease Progression Post-Myocardial Infarction via ECG-Trained Artificial Intelligence Model

author.name: Riccardo Cavarra, Lupo Lovatelli, Shaheim Ogbomo-Harmitt, Shahid Aziz, Adelaide De Vecchi, Andrew King, Oleg Aslanidi

entry.summary: Proposes a pretrained AI model combining contrastive learning with patient-specific temporal ECG information for predicting post-myocardial infarction outcomes. The self-supervised pretraining approach significantly outperforms training from scratch (0.794 vs 0.608 AUC), demonstrating value of foundation model approaches for limited medical data.

entry.title: (How) Do Large Language Models Understand High-Level Message Sequence Charts?

author.name: Mohammad Reza Mousavi

entry.summary: Tests whether LLMs (Gemini-3, GPT-5.4, Qwen-3.6) understand the formal semantics of High-Level Message Sequence Charts (HMSCs), a visual modeling language underlying UML Sequence Diagrams. Examines consistency of LLM handling with formal semantics.

entry.title: ConRetroBert: EMA Stabilized Dual Encoders for Template-Based Single-Step Retrosynthesis

author.name: Mohammad Jahid Ibna Basher, Ali Khodabandeh Yalabadi, Ivan Garibay, Ozlem Ozmen Garibay

entry.summary: Reframes template-based retrosynthesis as dense retrieval and listwise ranking rather than global classification, using contrastive pretraining with EMA-stabilized dual encoders. Argues that template methods' underperformance stems from the learning formulation, not templates themselves.

entry.title: A Hybrid Tucker-LSTM Tensor Network Model for SOC Prediction in Electric Vehicles

author.name: Han Wang, Ying Wang, Bing Wang

entry.summary: Combines Tucker tensor decomposition with LSTM networks for state-of-charge prediction in electric vehicle batteries, using full-lifecycle field data.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Driven Anomaly Detection for Psychotic Relapse Using Smartwatches: Forecasting and Multi-Task Learning Fusion

author.name: Nikolaos Tsalkitzis, Panagiotis P. Filntisis, Petros Maragos, Niki Efthymiou

entry.summary: Develops smartwatch-based frameworks for daily psychotic relapse detection using cardiac forecasting and multi-task learning with Transformer encoders. Uses uncertainty-based anomaly scoring from ensemble MLPs.

entry.title: On Privacy-Preserving Image Transmission in Low-Altitude Networks: A Swin Transformer-Based Framework with Federated Learning

author.name: Kexin Zhang, Lixin Li, Yuna Yan, Xin Zhang, Wensheng Lin, Rui Li, Dongwei Zhao, Zhu Han

entry.summary: Proposes a Swin Transformer-based semantic communication framework with federated learning for privacy-preserving image transmission from UAVs to ground stations under bandwidth constraints.

entry.title: Decision Support for Marketplace Policies under Incomplete Evidence: From Replay to Launch Readiness

author.name: Prashant Shekhar, Caroline Howard

entry.summary: Proposes a decision support system for marketplace policy evaluation that distinguishes between promising and actionable evidence, integrating offline replay with uncertainty quantification to determine launch readiness.

entry.title: DisAgg: Distributed Aggregators for Efficient Secure Aggregation in Federated Learning

author.name: Haaris Mehmood, Giorgos Tatsis, Dimitrios Alexopoulos, Karthikeyan Saravanan, Jie Xu, Anastasios Drosou, Mete Ozay

entry.summary: Proposes DisAgg, a secure aggregation protocol for federated learning that uses a committee of aggregator clients to perform secret-sharing-based aggregation, reducing cryptographic overhead compared to existing approaches like OPA.

entry.title: CommonWhy: A Dataset for Evaluating Entity-Based Causal Commonsense Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Armin Toroghi, Faeze Moradi Kalarde, Scott Sanner

entry.summary: Introduces CommonWhy, a dataset of 15,000 why-questions for evaluating entity-based causal commonsense reasoning in LLMs, focusing on abductive reasoning and explanation generation.

entry.title: PersonalAI 2.0: Enhancing knowledge graph traversal/retrieval with planning mechanism for Personalized LLM Agents

author.name: Mikhail Menschikov, Matvey Iskornev, Alexander Kharitonov, Alina Bogdanova, Mikhail Belkin, Ekaterina Lisitsyna, Artyom Sosedka, Victoria Dochkina, Ruslan Kostoev, Ilia Perepechkin, Evgeny Burnaev

entry.summary: Introduces PersonalAI 2.0, a framework enhancing LLM systems through dynamic knowledge graph traversal with adaptive iterative search guided by entities, matched vertices, and clue-queries.

entry.title: R^2-Mem: Reflective Experience for Memory Search

author.name: Xinyuan Wang, Wenyu Mao, Junkang Wu, Xiang Wang, Xiangnan He

entry.summary: Proposes R²-Mem, a reflective experience framework for memory search agents that learns from prior search trajectories through rubric-guided evaluation and self-reflection to avoid repeated mistakes.

entry.title: Edit-level Majority Voting Mitigates Over-Correction in LLM-based Grammatical Error Correction

author.name: Takumi Goto, Yusuke Sakai, Taro Watanabe

entry.summary: Proposes edit-level majority voting over multiple LLM-generated candidates for grammatical error correction, reducing over-correction without additional training across nine benchmarks in seven languages.

entry.title: A Data Efficiency Study of Synthetic Fog for Object Detection Using the Clear2Fog Pipeline

author.name: Mohamed Ahmed Mohamed, Xiaowei Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Clear2Fog, a physics-based pipeline for simulating fog on clear-weather driving datasets with camera-LiDAR consistency, achieving 92.95% human preference and improving object detection with limited real foggy data.

entry.title: Prediction of Rectal Cancer Regrowth from Longitudinal Endoscopy

author.name: Jorge Tapias Gomez, Despoina Kanata, Aneesh Rangnekar, Christina Lee, Hannah Williams, Hannah Thompson, J. Joshua Smith, Francisco Sanchez-Vega, Mert R. Sabuncu, Julio Garcia-Aguilar, Harini Veeraraghavan

entry.summary: Develops TREX, a longitudinal deep learning approach for predicting rectal cancer regrowth from paired endoscopy images using siamese Swin Transformers with dual cross-attention.

entry.title: PRISM: Prior Rectification and Uncertainty-Aware Structure Modeling for Diffusion-Based Text Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Zihang Xu, Xiaoyang Liu, Zheng Chen, Yulun Zhang, Xiaokang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes PRISM for text image super-resolution with flow-matching prior rectification for unreliable text conditions and structure-guided uncertainty-aware encoding for fine-grained stroke boundaries.

entry.title: Uncertainty-aware Spatial-Frequency Registration and Fusion for Infrared and Visible Images

author.name: Xingyuan Li, Haoyuan Xu, Xingyue Zhu, Jun Ma, Yang Zou, Zhiying Jiang, Jinyuan Liu

entry.summary: Proposes SFRF framework for infrared-visible image fusion that incorporates uncertainty estimation and thermal radiation consistency to handle misalignment issues. Addresses cumulative registration errors that contaminate fusion results.

entry.title: Flow Augmentation and Knowledge Distillation for Lightweight Face Presentation Attack Detection

author.name: Muhammad Shahid Jabbar, Muhammad Sohail Ibrahim, Taha Hasan Masood Siddique, Kejie Huang, Shujaat Khan

entry.summary: Proposes a knowledge distillation approach for face presentation attack detection that uses optical flow during training but eliminates it at inference, enabling lightweight real-time deployment.

entry.title: HIR-ALIGN: Enhancing Hyperspectral Image Restoration via Diffusion-Based Data Generation

author.name: Li Pang, Heng Zhao, Yijia Zhang, Deyu Meng, Xiangyong Cao

entry.summary: HIR-ALIGN augments hyperspectral image restoration training with synthetic data generated by diffusion models that match target distributions, serving as a plug-and-play domain adaptation framework.

entry.title: Generative Texture Diversification of 3D Pedestrians for Robust Autonomous Driving Perception

author.name: Arka Bhowmick, Enes Ozeren, Ahmed Abdullah, Oliver Wasenmuller

entry.summary: Proposes generating diverse 3D pedestrian textures from single base assets using generative models for synthetic autonomous driving data, improving detection model robustness.

entry.title: Improved monocular depth prediction using distance transform over pre-semantic contours with self-supervised neural networks

author.name: Marwane Hariat, Antoine Manzanera, David Filliat

entry.summary: Enhances self-supervised monocular depth estimation in low-texture areas by applying distance transforms over pre-semantic contours to augment discriminative power.

entry.title: TRUST-TAEA: A trustworthiness-guided two-archive evolutionary algorithm with variable-grouping sparse search for large-scale multi-objective optimization

author.name: JunYi Cui

entry.summary: TRUST-TAEA proposes a trustworthiness-guided two-archive evolutionary algorithm for large-scale multi-objective optimization with variable grouping and sparse search.

entry.title: Multistep Belief Space Dynamics Learning For Risk-Aware Control

author.name: Jason Gibson, Bogdan Vlahov, Patrick Spieler, Evangelos A. Theodorou

entry.summary: Presents a learning framework for predicting how uncertainty in vehicle dynamics evolves over time, enabling real-time risk-aware Model Predictive Control. The approach focuses on learning distributional dynamics with appropriate structure for MPC optimization.

entry.title: Galilean State Estimation for Inertial Navigation Systems with Unknown Time Delay

author.name: Giulio Delama, Martin Scheiber, Yixiao Ge, Tarek Hamel, Stephan Weiss, Robert Mahony

entry.summary: Proposes a Galilean state estimation framework for inertial navigation that jointly estimates GNSS measurement delay online using an equivariant Extended Kalman Filter on the Galilean group, avoiding offline delay calibration.

entry.title: Design of Magnetic Continuum Robots with Tunable Force Response Using Rotational Ring Pairs

author.name: Alex Sayres, Giovanni Pittiglio

entry.summary: Proposes a novel magnetic continuum robot design with rotational ring pairs that enable online tuning of magnetic response direction and intensity at the tip, adding steering DOF without controlling external fields.

entry.title: Optimal sequential tests yield log-optimal e-processes

author.name: Ashwin Ram, Aaditya Ramdas

entry.summary: Proves that asymptotically optimal sequential tests can be aggregated into asymptotically log-optimal e-processes, completing the equivalence between optimal sequential testing and log-optimal e-processes.

entry.title: Voters are surprisingly open to talking about AI risk

author.name: less_raichu

entry.summary: Reports that voters are increasingly open to discussing AI existential risk, with 55% now thinking AI will do more harm than good. Provides practical advice for political canvassing on AI risk topics ahead of CA-11 and NY-12 primaries.

entry.title: Spectral Energy Centroid: a Metric for Improving Performance and Analyzing Spectral Bias in Implicit Neural Representations

author.name: Tomasz D\k{a}dela, Adam Kania, Maciej Rut, Przemys{\l}aw Spurek

entry.summary: Introduces the Spectral Energy Centroid (SEC) metric for understanding and improving frequency tuning in implicit neural representations (INRs), revealing the significant effect of model depth on frequency learning that prior work missed.

entry.title: Robot Squid Game: Quadrupedal Locomotion for Traversing Narrow Tunnels

author.name: Amir Hossain Raj, Dibyendu Das, Xuesu Xiao

entry.summary: Uses RL with procedural environment generation and policy distillation (teacher-student) to train quadruped robots to traverse narrow tunnels, adapting locomotion to varying tunnel configurations.

entry.title: Modeling Heterophily in Multiplex Graphs: An Adaptive Approach for Node Classification

author.name: Kamel Abdous, Nairouz Mrabah, Mohamed Bouguessa

entry.summary: Proposes a method for node classification in multiplex graphs that adaptively handles both homophilic and heterophilic interactions across different edge types/dimensions.

entry.title: Coordinating Multiple Conditions for Trajectory-Controlled Human Motion Generation

author.name: Deli Cai, Haoyang Ma, Changxing Ding

entry.summary: Proposes CMC, a decoupled framework for trajectory-controlled human motion generation that coordinates text and trajectory conditions through a divide-and-conquer strategy, addressing conflicts between conditions during the denoising process.

entry.title: SoK: A Comprehensive Analysis of the Current Status of Neural Tangent Generalization Attacks with Research Directions

author.name: Thushari Hapuarachchi, Kaiqi Xiong

entry.summary: Provides the first comprehensive analysis of Neural Tangent Generalization Attacks (NTGA), a clean-label data poisoning method for protecting unauthorized training data. Covers classification, taxonomy, and future research directions.

entry.title: Drag within Prior Distribution: Text-Conditioned Point-Based Image Editing within Distribution Constraints

author.name: Haoyang Hu, Masataka Seo, Yen-Wei Chen

entry.summary: Introduces CLIP-based evaluation for point-based image editing to prevent noise latent deviation from inversion trajectories, addressing artifacts from large handle-target distances.

entry.title: Texture Regenerating and Grafting Using Genome-Driven Neural Cellular Automata

author.name: Mirela-Magdalena Catrina, Ioana Cristina Plajer, Alexandra B\u{a}icoianu

entry.summary: Advances multi-texture synthesis with Neural Cellular Automata by enabling self-regeneration of damaged textures and seamless grafting of distinct textures through genome channel initialization.

entry.title: Belief-Space Residual Risk for Automated Driving under Localization Uncertainty

author.name: Nijinshan Karunainayagam, Nils Gehrke, Frank Diermeyer

entry.summary: Extends residual risk metrics for automated driving to explicitly account for ego-vehicle localization uncertainty modeled as a Gaussian distribution. Uses particle-based estimation to compute expected risk over the belief distribution.

entry.title: Asymptotically Optimal Ergodic Coverage on Generalized Motion Fields

author.name: Christian Hughes, Yilang Liu, Yanis Lahrach, Julia Engdahl, Houston Warren, Darrick Lee, Fabio Ramos, Travis Miles, Ian Abraham

entry.summary: Proposes asymptotically optimal ergodic coverage methods for robots operating in time-varying flow fields, relevant to ocean exploration. Provides formal guarantees for coverage in underactuated, open-loop settings.

entry.title: Relative Pose-Velocity Estimation Using Dual IMU Measurements and Relative Position Sensing

author.name: Alessandro Melis, Tarek Bouazza, Soulaimane Berkane, Tarek Hamel

entry.summary: Addresses relative pose-velocity estimation between a vehicle and moving target using dual IMUs and relative position measurements. Formulates dynamics on SE_2(3) and designs a deterministic Riccati observer with global exponential convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Systems in Emergency Departments: Validation Study on a ED Digital Twin

author.name: Markus Wenzel, Tobias Strapatsas, Jessika Kress, Dorothea Sauer, Nele Gessler, Horst K. Hahn

entry.summary: Develops a hybrid DES-ABM simulation of emergency departments, validating against real-world KPIs and implementing known optimization strategies to compare simulated vs documented outcomes.

entry.title: Adaptive mine planning under geological uncertainty: A POMDP framework for sequential decision-making

author.name: Hamza Khalifi, Jef Caers, Yassine Taha, Mostafa Benzaazoua, Abdellatif Elghali

entry.summary: Formulates mine production scheduling as a POMDP rather than traditional stochastic optimization, introducing a hybrid SA-POMDP architecture that integrates expectation of future belief updates into sequential extraction decisions.

entry.title: ChannelKAN: Multi-Scale Dual-Domain Channel Prediction via Hybrid CNN-KAN Architecture

author.name: Nanqing Jiang, Zhangyao Song, Tao Guo, Xiaoyu Zhao, Yinfei Xu

entry.summary: Proposes ChannelKAN, a hybrid CNN-KAN architecture for wireless channel prediction in massive MIMO-OFDM systems, leveraging Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with Chebyshev polynomial activations for nonlinear temporal modeling.

entry.title: Controllable Quantum Memory Capacity in Quantum Reservoir Networks with Tunable partial-SWAPs

author.name: Erik L. Connerty, Ethan N. Evans

entry.summary: Advances quantum reservoir computing with controllable memory capacity through tunable partial-SWAP operations, demonstrating analytical control over fading memory in recurrent quantum architectures.

entry.title: Compact Latent Manifold Translation: A Parameter-Efficient Foundation Model for Cross-Modal and Cross-Frequency Physiological Signal Synthesis

author.name: Bo Cui, Xiaowen Song, Yaowen Zhang, Shunzhe Zhang, B. J. F. van Beijnum, Monique Tabak, Ying Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Compact Latent Manifold Translation (CLMT), a 0.09B parameter framework for cross-modal and cross-frequency physiological signal synthesis (ECG/PPG) using discrete translation with hierarchical residual quantization.

entry.title: Stylized Text-to-Motion Generation via Hypernetwork-Driven Low-Rank Adaptation

author.name: Junhyuk Jeon, Seokhyeon Hong, Junyong Noh

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight style conditioning framework for text-to-motion generation using hypernetwork-generated LoRA parameters, enabling dynamic style modulation without style-specific fine-tuning.

entry.title: OpenAaaS: An Open Agent-as-a-Service Framework for Distributed Materials-Informatics Research

author.name: Peng Kang, Bixuan Li, Xiaoya Huang, Shuo Shi, Weiqiao Zhou, Zhen Li, Yu Liu, Lei Zheng

entry.summary: Presents OpenAaaS, an open Agent-as-a-Service framework for distributed materials informatics research, addressing the 'last mile' problem of composing LLM capabilities and materials data across institutional boundaries. Targets materials discovery for harsh environments like high-temperature alloys.

entry.title: A Unified Three-Stage Machine Learning Framework for Diabetes Detection, Subtype Discrimination, and Cognitive-Metabolic Hypothesis Testing

author.name: Vishal Pandey, Ruzina Haque Laskar, Rishav Tewari

entry.summary: A three-stage ML framework for diabetes detection, subtype clustering, and metabolic-cognitive association analysis using standard classifiers on the NCSU dataset.

entry.title: Interpretable Machine Learning for Antepartum Prediction of Pregnancy-Associated Thrombotic Microangiopathy Using Routine Longitudinal Laboratory Data

author.name: Chuanchuan Sun, Zhen Yu, Qin Fan, Qingchao Chen, Feng Yu

entry.summary: Applies interpretable ML to predict pregnancy-associated thrombotic microangiopathy (P-TMA) from routine longitudinal lab data, capturing subtle multidimensional patterns masked by normal pregnancy changes. Retrospective study on 300 pregnancies.

entry.title: Context-Aware Web Attack Detection in Open-Source SIEM Systems via MITRE ATT&CK-Enriched Behavioral Profiling

author.name: Badr Alboushy, Assef Jafar, Mohamad Aljnidi, Mohamad Bashar Disoki, Aref Shaheed

entry.summary: Presents Smart-SIEM, an AI module for Wazuh SIEM with per-source-IP behavioral context vectors and MITRE ATT&CK technique frequencies, using a two-stage LightGBM/XGBoost cascade for web attack detection.

entry.title: Neural Surrogate Forward Modelling For Electrocardiology Without Explicit Intracellular Conductivity Tensor

author.name: Shaheim Ogbomo-Harmitt, Cesare Magnetti, Jakub Grzelak, Oleg Aslanidi

entry.summary: Presents a deep learning approach for cardiac forward modeling that maps intracellular potentials to ECGs without explicit conductivity tensor inputs, achieving R² of 0.949 on a small 74-subject dataset.

entry.title: M3Net: A Macro-to-Meso-to-Micro Clinical-inspired Hierarchical 3D Network for Pulmonary Nodule Classification

author.name: Jinyue Li, Yuzhou Yu, Jingjing Yang, Meng Fu, Yani Zhang, Shuyao He, Dianlong Ge, Xin Ning, Yannan Chu, Qiankun Li

entry.summary: Proposes M3Net, a clinically-inspired hierarchical 3D network for pulmonary nodule classification that mimics radiologists' multi-scale diagnostic workflow from macro to micro scales.

entry.title: 3D RL-DWA: A Hybrid Reinforcement Learning and Dynamic Window Approach for Goal-Directed Local Navigation in Multi-DoF Robots

author.name: Chiara Castellani, Enrico Turco, Domenico Prattichizzo

entry.summary: Combines reinforcement learning with Dynamic Window Approach for 3D navigation of deformable microrobots in simulated vascular networks. The hybrid method outperforms pure RL or model-based approaches on 1080 trials.

entry.title: Calibration-Free Gas Source Localization with Mobile Robots: Source Term Estimation Based on Concentration Measurement Ranking

author.name: Wanting Jin, Agatha Duranceau, \.Izzet Ka\u{g}an Er\"unsal, Alcherio Martinoli

entry.summary: Proposes a calibration-free gas source localization method using mobile robots that relies on concentration measurement ranking rather than absolute values, avoiding the need for frequent sensor recalibration.

entry.title: Epistemic Immunodepression in the Age of AI

author.name: Tuyen Tran

entry.summary: A pediatric surgeon argues that AI is eroding science's self-correction capacity by enabling mass production of superficially valid but unchecked research, using the metaphor of 'epistemic immunodepression' from medicine.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Tutoring for Algorithm Tracing and Problem-Solving in AI Education

author.name: Mragisha Jain, Tirth Bhatt, Griffin Pitts, Aum Pandya, Peter Brusilovsky, Narges Norouzi, Arto Hellas, Juho Leinonen, Bita Akram

entry.summary: Presents KITE, a RAG-based intelligent tutoring system for algorithm courses that uses intent-aware Socratic responses with progressive scaffolding, combining multimodal RAG with educational pedagogy.

entry.title: IdeaForge: A Knowledge Graph-Grounded Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Methodology Innovation Analysis and Patent Claim Generation

author.name: Joy Bose

entry.summary: Presents IdeaForge, a knowledge graph-grounded multi-agent framework that integrates TRIZ, Design Thinking, and SCAMPER through specialist agents for innovation analysis and patent claim generation.

entry.title: Unweighted ranking for value-based decision making with uncertainty

author.name: Aar\'on L\'opez Garc\'ia, Natalia Criado, Jose Such

entry.summary: Introduces a Fuzzy-Unweighted Value-Based Decision Making framework where agents make decisions aligned with human values using both quantitative and qualitative criteria, addressing normative bias from arbitrary stakeholder weights.

entry.title: Scale-Gest: Scalable Model-Space Synthesis and Runtime Selection for On-Device Gesture Detection

author.name: Abdul Basit, Saim Rehman, Muhammad Shafique

entry.summary: Presents Scale-Gest, a runtime adaptive gesture detection framework that expands a single detector into a family of tiny-YOLO architectures with device-calibrated accuracy-complexity-energy profiles, selecting appropriate modes based on battery constraints.

entry.title: AgenticAITA: A Proof-Of-Concept About Deliberative Multi-Agent Reasoning for Autonomous Trading Systems

author.name: Ivan Letteri

entry.summary: Introduces AgenticAITA, a multi-agent LLM framework for autonomous trading that replaces traditional signal-then-execute paradigms with deliberative reasoning loops among specialized agents, without offline training.

entry.title: PRISM: Perinuclear Ring-based Image Segmentation Method for Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Classification

author.name: Larissa Ferreira Rodrigues Moreira, Leonardo Gabriel Ferreira Rodrigues, Rodrigo Moreira, Andr\'e Ricardo Backes

entry.summary: Proposes PRISM for leukemia classification using adaptive concentric perinuclear rings around cell nuclei instead of explicit cytoplasmic segmentation, achieving competitive accuracy without heavy neural architectures.

entry.title: Controlling Logical Collapse in LLMs via Algebraic Ontology Projection over F2

author.name: Hisashi Miyashita, Mgnite Inc

entry.summary: Introduces Algebraic Ontology Projection (AOP) to project LLM hidden states into the Galois Field F2, testing whether LLMs encode ontological relations in algebraic structures. Achieves up to 93.33% zero-shot inclusion accuracy with no model tuning. The approach is novel but from a small company with limited validation.

entry.title: Neural QAOA$^{2}$: Differentiable Joint Graph Partitioning and Parameter Initialization for Quantum Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Zubin Zheng, Jiahao Wu, Shengcai Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Neural QAOA², an end-to-end differentiable framework for quantum combinatorial optimization that jointly generates graph partitions and initial parameters, addressing limitations of heuristic partitioning in QAOA.

entry.title: Margin-calibrated Classifier Guidance for Property-driven Synthesis Planning

author.name: Najwa Laabid, Vikas Garg

entry.summary: Proposes margin-calibrated classifier guidance for steering retrosynthesis models toward reactions satisfying specific constraints. Introduces Sequence Completion Reward-margin loss to overcome limitations of cross-entropy-trained classifiers.

entry.title: STAR: Semantic-Temporal Adaptive Representation Learning for Few-Shot Action Recognition

author.name: Hongli Liu, Yu Wang, Shengjie Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes STAR for few-shot action recognition, addressing semantic-temporal misalignment between static text prompts and sparse visual cues through a dual semantic-alignment and temporal-aware framework.

entry.title: X-Restormer++: 1st Place Solution for the UG2+ CVPR 2026 All-Weather Restoration Challenge

author.name: Youwei Pan, Leilei Cao, Yingfang Zhu, Fengjie Zhu

entry.summary: Presents the winning solution for CVPR 2026 UG2+ Challenge on all-weather image restoration, building on X-Restormer with spatially-adaptive scaling and edge-preserving losses.

entry.title: Constitutional Governance in Metric Spaces

author.name: Ehud Shapiro, Nimrod Talmon

entry.summary: Proposes a polynomial-time framework for constitutional governance in metric spaces, integrating aggregation, deliberation, amendment, and consensus stages. Bypasses NP-hardness of metric-space aggregators.

entry.title: Generating synthetic computed tomography for radiotherapy: SynthRAD2025 challenge report

author.name: Viktor Rogowski, Maarten L. Terpstra, Niklas Wahl, Florian Kamp, Erik van der Bijl, Arthur Jr. Galapon, Christopher Kurz, Bowen Xin, Zhengxiang Sun, Hollie Min, Gregg Belous, Jason Dowling, Yan Xia, Siyuan Mei, Fuxin Fan, Arthur Longuefosse, Javier Sequeiro Gonzalez, Miguel Diaz Benito, Alvaro Garcia Martin, Fabien Baldacci, Valentin Boussot, C\'edric H\'emon, Jean-Claude Nunes, Jean-Louis Dillenseger, Zhiyuan Zhang, Jinghua Cai, Han Bing, Tan Zuopeng, Ricardo Brioso, Daniele Loiacono, Guillaume Landry, Adrian Thummerer, Matteo Maspero

entry.summary: SynthRAD2025 challenge report benchmarking synthetic CT generation from MRI and CBCT across 2,362 patients from five European centers. Evaluates methods for MRI-only radiotherapy and CBCT-based adaptive workflows.

entry.title: Beyond Anthropomorphism: Exploring the Roles of Perceived Non-humanity and Structural Similarity in Deep Self-Disclosure Toward Generative AI

author.name: Satoru Shibuya

entry.summary: Studies why people deeply self-disclose to generative AI, finding that perceived non-humanity (reducing evaluation apprehension) and structural similarity (perceived logical alignment) are key factors beyond anthropomorphism. A survey of 2,400 participants shows high scores on both dimensions yield an 11x higher likelihood of disclosure.

entry.title: Weakly-Supervised Spatiotemporal Anomaly Detection

author.name: Urvi Gianchandani, Praveen Tirupattur, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Explores weakly supervised spatiotemporal anomaly detection using only video-level labels, applying multiple instance learning with ranking loss to localize anomalies in both space and time without detailed annotations.

entry.title: Identifying the nonlinear string dynamics with port-Hamiltonian neural networks

author.name: Maximino Linares, Guillaume Doras, Thomas H\'elie

entry.summary: Applies Port-Hamiltonian Neural Networks to learning Hamiltonian PDE systems for musical acoustics, extending PHNNs from ODE to PDE settings for modeling nonlinear string dynamics.

entry.title: The Payment Heterogeneity Index: An Integrated Unsupervised Framework for High-Volume Procurement Oversight and Decision Support

author.name: Kyriakos Christodoulides

entry.summary: Introduces the Payment Heterogeneity Index (PHI), an unsupervised composite statistic for detecting anomalous patterns in post-award public procurement payments, combining modality, asymmetry, tail behavior, and structural dispersion measures.

entry.title: Recurrent Transformer-Based Near- and Far-Field THz Wideband Channel Estimation for UM-MIMO

author.name: Dmitry Artemasov (Center for Next Generation Wireless and IoT, Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology, Moscow, Russia), Alexander Shmatok (Center for Next Generation Wireless and IoT, Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology, Moscow, Russia), Kirill Andreev (Center for Next Generation Wireless and IoT, Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology, Moscow, Russia), Alexey Frolov (Center for Next Generation Wireless and IoT, Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology, Moscow, Russia), Manjesh K. Hanawal (Department of IEOR, Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, India), Nikola Zlatanov (Faculty of Computer and Engineering Sciences, Innopolis University, Innopolis, Russia)

entry.summary: Proposes a recurrent Transformer-based channel estimation method for THz UM-MIMO systems that handles both near-field and far-field effects in 6G networks with hybrid beamforming architectures.

entry.title: CO-MAP: A Reinforcement Learning Approach to the Qubit Allocation Problem

author.name: Ankit Kulshrestha, Xiaoyuan Liu

entry.summary: Formulates quantum qubit mapping as a combinatorial optimization problem and uses reinforcement learning to find solutions, aiming to minimize SWAP gate overhead in quantum circuit compilation.

entry.title: FIND: Toward Multimodal Financial Reasoning and Question Answering for Indic Languages

author.name: Sarmistha Das, Vaibhav Vishal, Syed Ibrahim Ahmad, Manish Gupta, Sriparna Saha

entry.summary: Introduces FinVQA, a benchmark for financial numerical and multimodal reasoning in six Indic languages with 18,900 samples across 14 financial domains, addressing multilingual financial AI gaps.

entry.title: WhatsApp Vaccine Discourse (WhaVax): An Expert-Annotated Dataset and Benchmark for Health Misinformation Detection

author.name: J\^onatas H. dos Santos, Julio C. S. Reis, Philipe Melo, Jo\~ao F. H. Olivetti, Thales H. Silva, Matheus Gontijo Guimaraes, Glaucio de Souza, Marcos A. Gon\c{c}alves, Fabricio Benevenuto, Filipe B. B. Zanovello, Marco A. G. Rodrigues, Cristiano X. Lima

entry.summary: Introduces WhaVax, an expert-annotated dataset of vaccine-related WhatsApp messages from Brazilian groups for health misinformation detection, with detailed characterization of misinformation patterns.

entry.title: M2Retinexformer: Multi-Modal Retinexformer for Low-Light Image Enhancement

author.name: Youssef Aboelwafa, Hicham G. Elmongui, Marwan Torki

entry.summary: Proposes M2Retinexformer for low-light image enhancement that incorporates depth, luminance, and semantic features into the Retinex framework through multi-scale cross-attention fusion.

entry.title: BiPneu: Design and Control of a Bipolar-Pressure Pneumatic System for Soft Robots

author.name: Yu Mei, Xinyu Zhou, Vedant Naik, Alan Gao, Xiaobo Tan

entry.summary: Presents BiPneu, a scalable bipolar-pressure pneumatic system for soft robots with a dual-mode sliding-mode controller that handles both positive and negative pressure regulation with seamless transitions.

entry.title: MoCCA: A Movable Circle Probability of Collision Approximation

author.name: Tobias Kern, Christian Birkner

entry.summary: MoCCA proposes an analytical probability-of-collision approximation for automated driving using a movable circle that optimally approximates vehicle geometry, balancing fidelity and computational cost.

entry.title: Dynamics Computation of Soft-Rigid Hybrid-Link System and Its Application to Motion Analysis of an Athlete Wearing Sport Prosthesis

author.name: Sunghee Kim, Yuta Shimane, Taiki Ishigaki, Ko Yamamoto

entry.summary: Develops a motion analysis framework for athletes wearing flexible sport prostheses by combining rigid-body and soft-body modeling in a unified hybrid-link system, enabling inverse dynamics analysis of prosthesis-body interaction.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware 3D Position Refinement for Multi-UAV Systems

author.name: Hosam Alamleh, Damir Pulatov

entry.summary: Presents a decentralized 3D position refinement method for multi-UAV systems that fuses local estimates with neighbor information using uncertainty-aware weighting and learned trust scores to handle GNSS degradation.

entry.title: Non-asymptotic quantisation of spherically symmetric distributions

author.name: Luc Pronzato, Anatoly Zhigljavsky

entry.summary: Analyzes non-asymptotic quantization of spherically symmetric distributions, showing that for moderate sample sizes in high dimensions, random quantizers on appropriately-sized spheres achieve near-optimal performance, contrasting with Zador's asymptotic theory.

entry.title: An Agentic AI Framework with Large Language Models and Chain-of-Thought for UAV-Assisted Logistics Scheduling with Mobile Edge Computing

author.name: Hanwen Zhang, Dusit Niyato, Wei Zhang, Xin Lou, Malcolm Yoke Hean Low

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic AI framework using LLMs with chain-of-thought reasoning for joint UAV logistics scheduling and mobile edge computing in cloud manufacturing environments.

entry.title: Diversity of Extensions in Abstract Argumentation

author.name: Johannes K. Fichte, Markus Hecher, Yasir Mahmood, Zhengjun Wang

entry.summary: Introduces a quantitative notion of diversity for extensions in abstract argumentation frameworks, measuring how far apart different accepted viewpoints are, with systematic complexity classification.

entry.title: AI-Generated Slides: Are They Good? Can Students Tell?

author.name: Juho Leinonen, Lisa Zhang, Arto Hellas

entry.summary: Examines using GenAI to generate course slides from instructor notes, comparing end-to-end tools, general LLMs, and coding assistants. Finds coding assistants produce the most accurate slides and students have mixed reactions.

entry.title: Domain Adaptation of Large Language Models for Polymer-Composite Additive Manufacturing Using Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Fine-Tuning

author.name: Saiful Islam Sagor, Tania Haghighi, Minhaj Nur Alam, Erina Baynojir Joyee

entry.summary: Investigates RAG and fine-tuning strategies for adapting foundation LLMs to the polymer-composite additive manufacturing domain, comparing approaches for expert-level question answering.

entry.title: CoRe-Gen: Robust Spectrum-to-Structure Generation under Imperfect Fingerprint Conditions

author.name: Tianbo Liu, Chixiang Lu, Jing Hao, Hengyu Zhang, Lifei Wang, Haibo Jiang, Xiaojuan Qi

entry.summary: Addresses the condition mismatch problem in molecular structure elucidation from mass spectra, where models trained on clean fingerprints must operate on noisy predicted ones. Proposes CoRe-Gen to improve robustness of spectrum-to-structure generation.

entry.title: Stable Attention Response for Reliable Precipitation Nowcasting

author.name: Penghui Wen, Zexin Hu, Sen Zhang, Patrick Filippi, Xiaogang Zhu, Allen Benter, Thomas Bishop, Zhiyong Wang, Kun Hu

entry.summary: Shows that cross-sample instability of attention-response energy is an underexplored source of forecasting unreliability in precipitation nowcasting. Proposes a stabilization method with theoretical and empirical backing.

entry.title: McCast: Memory-Guided Latent Drift Correction for Long-Horizon Precipitation Nowcasting

author.name: Penghui Wen, Yu Luo, Lintao Wang, Mengwei He, Patrick Filippi, Thomas Francis Bishop, Zhiyong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes McCast, a memory-guided latent drift correction method for precipitation nowcasting that actively corrects autoregressive drift during rollouts using temporally ordered memory.

entry.title: Children's English Reading Story Generation via Supervised Fine-Tuning of Compact LLMs with Controllable Difficulty and Safety

author.name: Qian Shen (University of Florida, Gainesville, USA), Fanghua Cao (University of Florida, Gainesville, USA), Min Yao (University of Florida, Gainesville, USA), Shlok Gilda (University of Florida, Gainesville, USA), Bonnie J. Dorr (University of Florida, Gainesville, USA), Walter L. Leite (University of Florida, Gainesville, USA)

entry.summary: Fine-tunes compact 8B-parameter LLMs on expert-designed children's reading curricula to generate age-appropriate English stories with controllable reading difficulty and safety. Demonstrates that smaller models can match larger ones for this specific educational application.

entry.title: CAWI: Copula-Aligned Weight Initialization for Randomized Neural Networks

author.name: Mushir Akhtar, M. Tanveer, Mohd. Arshad

entry.summary: Proposes CAWI, a weight initialization framework for randomized neural networks that draws input-to-hidden weights from data-fitted copulas to capture inter-feature dependence structure rather than ignoring correlations.

entry.title: Multitask Multimodal Fusion with Tabular Foundation Models for Peak and Durability Prediction of Pertussis Booster Response

author.name: Divya Sitani

entry.summary: Proposes multitask multimodal fusion using tabular foundation models for predicting both peak and durability of pertussis booster immune responses, addressing the biological dissociation between acute and long-term immunity.

entry.title: A Five-Layer MLOps Architecture for Connected Automated Driving

author.name: Bastian Lampe, Lutz Eckstein

entry.summary: Proposes a five-layer MLOps architecture for connected automated driving systems, addressing the challenge of continuous ML model improvement across vehicle fleets.

entry.title: Conformal Anomaly Detection in Python: Moving Beyond Heuristic Thresholds with 'nonconform'

author.name: Oliver Hennh\"ofer, Maximilian Kirsch, Christine Preisach

entry.summary: Presents 'nonconform', a Python package for conformal anomaly detection that converts anomaly scores into calibrated p-values with statistical guarantees, integrating with scikit-learn and pyod.

entry.title: Color Constancy in Hyperspectral Imaging via Reduced Spectral Spaces

author.name: G. Dofri Vidarsson, Liying Lu, Sabine S\"usstrunk

entry.summary: Studies illuminant estimation using hyperspectral imaging, systematically analyzing how spectral dimensionality and representation choice affect performance within the Color-by-Correlation framework.

entry.title: Research Summary: May 13, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
A strong day for MoE architecture design and optimizer theory, alongside critical AI safety findings on monitoring reliability and emergent misalignment.

  • Slicing and Dicing (Meta) delivers the first systematic MoE design study across 2,000+ pretraining runs up to 6.6B params, establishing actionable guidelines for expert count, granularity, and load balancing
  • ExploitGym (Carlini, Song, Wallace et al.) benchmarks whether AI agents can convert known CVEs into working exploits, a critical dual-use capability evaluation
  • Overtrained, Not Misaligned analyzes 1M+ model responses across 12 open-source models, attributing emergent misalignment to overtraining rather than genuine value drift
  • Classifier Context Rot reveals that frontier safety monitors (Opus 4.6, GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1) miss dangerous actions 2–30× more often late in long contexts

On the optimization front, SODA unifies Muon, Lion, AdEMAMix, and NAdam under a single Optimistic Dual Averaging framework, while a separate study shows Muon's spectral rescaling success extends to random and inverted spectra, challenging its geometric narrative. ProFIL combines linear probes with RL filtering to reduce reasoning theater in chain-of-thought. FragBench exposes cross-session attack blind spots where benign-looking fragments bypass all tested safety filters. Geometric Factual Recall proves logarithmic embedding dimensions suffice for factual memorization in transformers, and 20/20 VLMs demonstrates +11.7pp average improvement through data curation alone.

entry.title: Slicing and Dicing: Configuring Optimal Mixtures of Experts

author.name: Margaret Li, Sneha Kudugunta, Danielle Rothermel, Luke Zettlemoyer

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic study of over 2,000 MoE pretraining runs varying expert count, granularity, shared experts, and load balancing, finding that performance consistently improves with more fine-grained experts at every scale studied.

entry.title: Classifier Context Rot: Monitor Performance Degrades with Context Length

author.name: Sam Martin, Fabien Roger

entry.summary: Demonstrates that frontier LLMs (Opus 4.6, GPT 5.4, Gemini 3.1) used as safety monitors miss dangerous actions 2× to 30× more often when they occur after 800K tokens of benign activity compared to isolation. Proposes partial mitigation via periodic reminders.

entry.title: ExploitGym: Can AI Agents Turn Security Vulnerabilities into Real Attacks?

author.name: Zhun Wang, Nico Schiller, Hongwei Li, Srijiith Sesha Narayana, Milad Nasr, Nicholas Carlini, Xiangyu Qi, Eric Wallace, Elie Bursztein, Luca Invernizzi, Kurt Thomas, Yan Shoshitaishvili, Wenbo Guo, Jingxuan He, Thorsten Holz, Dawn Song

entry.summary: ExploitGym is a large-scale benchmark evaluating whether AI agents can turn known vulnerabilities into working exploits. Tests require low-level program reasoning, runtime adaptation, and sustained long-horizon progress.

entry.title: Overtrained, Not Misaligned

author.name: Joel Schreiber, Ariel Goldstein

entry.summary: Conducts the most comprehensive study of emergent misalignment (EM) to date across 12 open-source models (8B-671B), finding EM replicates in GPT-4o but only 2/12 open-source models show it consistently. Proposes EM is better explained by overtraining dynamics than misalignment.

entry.title: Optimistic Dual Averaging Unifies Modern Optimizers

author.name: Thomas Pethick, Wanyun Xie, Roman Machacek, Volkan Cevher

entry.summary: SODA unifies state-of-the-art optimizers (Muon, Lion, AdEMAMix, NAdam) under a generalized Optimistic Dual Averaging framework. It proposes a practical wrapper that eliminates weight decay tuning via a theoretically-grounded 1/k decay schedule, consistently improving performance without additional hyperparameter tuning.

author.name: Astha Mehta (Isabella), Niruthiha Selvanayagam (Isabella), Cedric Lam (Isabella), Hengxu Li (Isabella), Phuc-Nguyen Nguyen (Isabella), Raymond Lee (Isabella), Olivia McGoffin (Isabella), My (Isabella), Luong, Arthur Coll\'e, Jamie Johnson, David Williams-King, Linh Le

entry.title: Three Regimes of Context-Parametric Conflict: A Predictive Framework and Empirical Validation

author.name: Pruthvinath Jeripity Venkata

entry.summary: Proposes a three-regime framework to reconcile contradictory findings about how LLMs handle conflicts between training knowledge and provided context. Identifies distinct processing situations that explain why some studies find models ignore context while others find they defer.

entry.title: BSO: Safety Alignment Is Density Ratio Matching

author.name: Tien-Phat Nguyen, Truong Nguyen, Thin Nguyen, Duy Minh Ho Nguyen, Ngoc-Thanh Dinh, Trung Le

entry.summary: Shows that safety alignment can be reformulated as density ratio matching between optimal safe and unsafe policies, yielding BSO—a family of single-stage Bregman divergence losses for simultaneous helpfulness and safety optimization.

entry.title: Primal Generation, Dual Judgment: Self-Training from Test-Time Scaling

author.name: Yizhu Jiao, Ruixiang Zhang, Richard Bai, Jiawei Han, Ronan Collobert, Yizhe Zhang

entry.summary: DuST framework harvests the comparative information from test-time scaling (sampling multiple candidates and judging among them) as training signal, defining a 'dual judgment space' for self-training code generation models.

entry.title: Qwen-Scope: Turning Sparse Features into Development Tools for Large Language Models

author.name: Boyi Deng, Xu Wang, Yaoning Wang, Yu Wan, Yubo Ma, Baosong Yang, Haoran Wei, Jialong Tang, Huan Lin, Ruize Gao, Tianhao Li, Qian Cao, Xuancheng Ren, Xiaodong Deng, An Yang, Fei Huang, Dayiheng Liu, Jingren Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces Qwen-Scope, an open-source suite of Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) built on the Qwen model family, covering 14 groups across 7 model variants from Qwen3 and Qwen3.5. Demonstrates SAEs can serve as practical development tools for inspecting, controlling, and improving LLMs.

entry.title: Metaphor Is Not All Attention Needs

author.name: Olga Sorokoletova, Francesco Giarrusso, Giacomo De Luca, Piercosma Bisconti, Matteo Prandi, Federico Pierucci, Marcello Galisai, Vincenzo Suriani, Daniele Nardi

entry.summary: Investigates why literary/poetic jailbreaks succeed against LLM safety mechanisms through interpretability analysis of attention patterns. Finds that stylistic reformulations fundamentally alter how models process prompts, not just bypass surface-level filters.

entry.title: Anti-Self-Distillation for Reasoning RL via Pointwise Mutual Information

author.name: Guobin Shen, Xiang Cheng, Chenxiao Zhao, Lei Huang, Jindong Li, Dongcheng Zhao, Xing Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Anti-Self-Distillation (AntiSD) for reasoning RL, which identifies that self-distillation inflates confidence on structural tokens while deflating deliberation tokens. Ascends divergence to preserve search behavior.

entry.title: Entropy Polarity in Reinforcement Fine-Tuning: Direction, Asymmetry, and Control

author.name: Jiazheng Zhang, Ziche Fu, Junrui Shen, Yunbin Zhao, Yunke Zhang, Zhiheng Xi, Long Ma, Chenxin An, Zhihao Zhang, Shichun Liu, Dingwei Zhu, Shihan Dou, Shaofan Liu, Han Li, Wiggin Zhou, Aiden Adams, Tao Gui, Fei Huang, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang

entry.summary: Develops a theoretical framework for entropy mechanics in RLVR for LLMs, introducing entropy polarity as a token-level quantity predicting how updates reshape policy entropy, revealing structural asymmetry in reinforcement.

entry.title: When Looking Is Not Enough: Visual Attention Structure Reveals Hallucination in MLLMs

author.name: Fanpu Cao, Xin Zou, Xuming Hu, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Shows that high-frequency structure of visual attention (measured by Laplacian energy) reveals where hallucinations emerge in multimodal LLMs. Identifies both hallucination emergence layers and ground-truth recovery layers.

entry.title: Learning, Fast and Slow: Towards LLMs That Adapt Continually

author.name: Rishabh Tiwari, Kusha Sareen, Lakshya A Agrawal, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Matei Zaharia, Kurt Keutzer, Inderjit S Dhillon, Rishabh Agarwal, Devvrit Khatri

entry.summary: Introduces a fast-slow learning framework for LLMs combining parameter updates (slow learning) with in-context adaptation (fast learning), inspired by dual-process theory. Addresses catastrophic forgetting and plasticity loss.

entry.title: Unlocking LLM Creativity in Science through Analogical Reasoning

author.name: Andrew Shen, Shaul Druckmann, James Zou

entry.summary: Introduces analogical reasoning (AR) as a method to mitigate mode collapse in LLM solution generation for scientific problems. AR generates cross-domain analogies based on shared relational structure, improving solution diversity by 90-173% compared to baselines.

entry.title: Few-Shot Truly Benign DPO Attack for Jailbreaking LLMs

author.name: Sangyeon Yoon, Wonje Jeung, Yoonjun Cho, Dongjae Jeon, Albert No

entry.summary: Demonstrates that DPO fine-tuning with only 10 harmless preference pairs (benign prompt, helpful answer preferred, refusal dispreferred) can weaken LLM safety alignment. Attack works on OpenAI's fine-tuning API.

entry.title: Red-Teaming Agent Execution Contexts: Open-World Security Evaluation on OpenClaw

author.name: Hongwei Yao, Yiming Liu, Yiling He, Bingrun Yang

entry.summary: Introduces DeepTrap, a framework for discovering contextual vulnerabilities in agentic systems by formulating adversarial context manipulation as black-box trajectory-level optimization. Tests on OpenClaw with 42 cases spanning six vulnerability classes.

entry.title: Taming Extreme Tokens: Covariance-Aware GRPO with Gaussian-Kernel Advantage Reweighting

author.name: Cheng Wang, Qin Liu, Wenxuan Zhou, Muhao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a hyperparameter-free, covariance-weighted optimization method for GRPO that uses Gaussian kernel to down-weight extreme token-level updates. Addresses exploration-exploitation tradeoff in reasoning model training.

entry.title: Missing Old Logits in Asynchronous Agentic RL: Semantic Mismatch and Repair Methods for Off-Policy Correction

author.name: Zhong Guan, Yongjian Guo, Haoran Sun, Wen Huang, Shuai Di, Xiong Jun Wu, Likang Wu, Hongke Zhao

entry.summary: Identifies a critical failure mode in asynchronous RL for LLM agents where missing historical logits corrupt PPO-style importance ratios, and proposes repair methods for off-policy correction in heterogeneous training systems.

entry.title: Beyond GRPO and On-Policy Distillation: An Empirical Sparse-to-Dense Reward Principle for Language-Model Post-Training

author.name: Yuanda Xu, Hejian Sang, Zhengze Zhou, Ran He, Zhipeng Wang, Alborz Geramifard

entry.summary: Argues for a sparse-to-dense reward principle: use sparse RL (GRPO) where exploration is productive (larger models), and dense token-level distillation where the goal is compression (smaller students). Shows this allocation outperforms using either alone.

entry.title: One-Step Generative Modeling via Wasserstein Gradient Flows

author.name: Jiaqi Han, Puheng Li, Qiushan Guo, Renyuan Xu, Stefano Ermon, Emmanuel J. Cand\`es

entry.summary: W-Flow trains one-step generators by first defining a Wasserstein gradient flow evolution from reference to target distribution, then compressing it into a single neural network step using Sinkhorn divergence.

entry.title: Pretraining Exposure Explains Popularity Judgments in Large Language Models

author.name: Jamshid Mozafari, Bhawna Piryani, Adam Jatowt

entry.summary: Provides the first large-scale analysis of LLM popularity bias grounded in fully observable pretraining data, using OLMo and the Dolma corpus (7.4 trillion tokens) to show that entity preferences correlate with pretraining frequency, not real-world popularity.

entry.title: SenseNova-U1: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with NEO-unify Architecture

author.name: Haiwen Diao, Penghao Wu, Hanming Deng, Jiahao Wang, Shihao Bai, Silei Wu, Weichen Fan, Wenjie Ye, Wenwen Tong, Xiangyu Fan, Yan Li, Yubo Wang, Zhijie Cao, Zhiqian Lin, Zhitao Yang, Zhongang Cai, Yuwei Niu, Yue Zhu, Bo Liu, Chengguang Lv, Haojia Yu, Haozhe Xie, Hongli Wang, Jianan Fan, Jiaqi Li, Jiefan Lu, Jingcheng Ni, Junxiang Xu, Kaihuan Liang, Lianqiang Shi, Linjun Dai, Linyan Wang, Oscar Qian, Peng Gao, Pengfei Liu, Qingping Sun, Rui Shen, Ruisi Wang, Shengnan Ma, Shuang Yang, Siyi Xie, Siying Li, Tianbo Zhong, Xiangli Kong, Xuanke Shi, Yang Gao, Yongqiang Yao, Yves Wang, Zhengqi Bai, Zhengyu Lin, Zixin Yin, Wenxiu Sun, Ruihao Gong, Quan Wang, Lewei Lu, Lei Yang, Ziwei Liu, Dahua Lin

entry.summary: SenseNova-U1 introduces NEO-unify architecture that treats multimodal understanding and generation as synergistic views of a single process. Releases 8B dense and 30B-A3B MoE variants as native unified multimodal models.

entry.title: Verbalised evaluation awareness in language models has little effect on their behaviour

author.name: Amelie Knecht

entry.summary: Provides evidence that verbalized evaluation awareness (VEA) in chain-of-thought reasoning does not lead to meaningful behavioral changes (eval gaming). Tested across 8 open-weight LRMs and 4 benchmarks, finding negligible distribution shifts when models notice they're being evaluated.

entry.title: SpatialForge: Bootstrapping 3D-Aware Spatial Reasoning from Open-World 2D Images

author.name: Zishan Liu, Ruoxi Zang, Yanglin Zhang, Wei Liu, Yin Zhang, Jian Yao, Jiayin Zheng, Zhengzhe Liu

entry.summary: Introduces SpatialForge, a scalable data synthesis pipeline that transforms wild 2D images into spatial reasoning supervision for VLMs. Addresses the limited scene diversity of existing 3D spatial datasets.

entry.title: Evolutionary Task Discovery: Advancing Reasoning Frontiers via Skill Composition and Complexity Scaling

author.name: Liqin Ye, Yanbin Yin, Michael Galarnyk, Yuzhao Heng, Sudheer Chava, Chao Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Evolutionary Task Discovery (EvoTD) for synthesizing diverse and complex training data for LLM reasoning via directed search over algorithmic skills and complexity attributes.

entry.title: Proteus: A Self-Evolving Red Team for Agent Skill Ecosystems

author.name: Zhaojiacheng Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces Proteus, a self-evolving red team framework that iteratively revises agent skills to bypass audits and produce verified runtime harm, measuring adaptive leakage risk.

entry.title: Test-Time Compute for Dense Retrieval: Agentic Program Generation with Frozen Embedding Models

author.name: Han Xiao

entry.summary: Demonstrates that test-time compute benefits small embedding models for dense retrieval via agentic program search. Discovers that the optimal strategy reduces to a softmax-weighted centroid of top-K documents, providing parameter-free improvements across 7 model families.

entry.title: Under the Hood of SKILL.md: Semantic Supply-chain Attacks on AI Agent Skill Registry

author.name: Shoumik Saha, Kazem Faghih, Soheil Feizi

entry.summary: Studies semantic supply-chain attacks on AI agent skill registries (SKILL.md files), showing that textual triggers can manipulate skill discovery, selection, and loading. Achieves up to 86% pairwise win rate in adversarial skill visibility.

entry.title: Overcoming Dynamics-Blindness: Training-Free Pace-and-Path Correction for VLA Models

author.name: Yanyan Zhang, Chaoda Song, Vikash Singh, Xinpeng Li, Kai Ye, Zhe Hu, Zhongzhu Pu, Yu Yin, Vipin Chaudhary

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free, closed-form inference-time correction for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that addresses their blindness to temporal dynamics. Decomposes correction into pace and path components.

entry.title: Every Bit, Everywhere, All at Once: A Binomial Multibit LLM Watermark

author.name: Thibaud Gloaguen, Robin Staab, Mark Vero, Martin Vechev

entry.summary: Proposes a new multibit LLM watermarking approach using binomial encoding to encode every bit of a payload at every token position, with a stateful encoder for dynamic pressure redistribution.

entry.title: GEAR: Granularity-Adaptive Advantage Reweighting for LLM Agents via Self-Distillation

author.name: Sijia Li, Yuchen Huang, Zifan Liu, Yanping Li, Jingjing Fu, Li Zhao, Jiang Bian, Ling Zhang, Jun Zhang, Rui Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GEAR, an adaptive granularity credit assignment framework for LLM agents that reshapes trajectory-level GRPO advantage using token- and segment-level signals from self-distillation.

entry.title: Not How Many, But Which: Parameter Placement in Low-Rank Adaptation

author.name: Arijit Sehanobish, Charles Lovering

entry.summary: Studies parameter placement in LoRA adapters, finding that under SFT any random subset works due to low-rank stable gradients, but under GRPO only gradient-informed placement succeeds because GRPO gradients are high-rank and near-orthogonal.

entry.title: Trust the Batch, On- or Off-Policy: Adaptive Policy Optimization for RL Post-Training

author.name: Rasool Fakoor, Murdock Aubry, Nicholas Stranges, Alexander J. Smola

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive policy optimization that automatically adjusts trust regions based on batch statistics, eliminating fragile hyperparameters in large-model RL training where training and rollout systems differ.

entry.title: 3D-Belief: Embodied Belief Inference via Generative 3D World Modeling

author.name: Yifan Yin, Zehao Wen, Jieneng Chen, Zehan Zheng, Nanru Dai, Haojun Shi, Suyu Ye, Aydan Huang, Zheyuan Zhang, Alan Yuille, Jianwen Xie, Ayush Tewari, Tianmin Shu

entry.summary: Proposes 3D-Belief, reframing world modeling as embodied belief inference in 3D space—maintaining and updating multi-hypothesis beliefs about unobserved 3D world as observations arrive, rather than just novel-view synthesis.

entry.title: Don't Look at the Numbers: Visual Anchoring Bias and Layer-wise Representation in VLMs

author.name: M. Shalankin

entry.summary: Demonstrates that embedded numeric anchors on images systematically bias Vision-Language Model quality judgments across six VLMs, with effects 2.5x larger than severe image quality degradation. Layer-wise probing reveals architecture-dependent integration patterns of the anchoring bias.

entry.title: From Noise to Diversity: Random Embedding Injection in LLM Reasoning

author.name: Heejun Kim, Seungpil Lee, Jewon Yeom, Jaewon Sok, Seonghyeon Park, Jeongjae Park, Taesup Kim, Sundong Kim

entry.summary: Studies Random Soft Prompts (RSPs) - randomly sampled embedding vectors with no learned content - and finds they achieve accuracy comparable to optimized soft prompts on math reasoning. The mechanism involves attention redistribution and implicit ensembling.

entry.title: Efficient LLM Reasoning via Variational Posterior Guidance with Efficiency Awareness

author.name: Zizhao Chen, Yuying Li, Siting Lin, Lianxi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a variational posterior guidance method to address the 'overthinking' problem in LLM reasoning chains. Uses cognitive science insights to prove posterior distributions guided by reference answers break sampling bottlenecks, improving inference efficiency without elaborate reward functions.

entry.title: Continuous Discovery of Vulnerabilities in LLM Serving Systems with Fuzzing

author.name: Yunze Zhao, Yibo Zhao, Yuchen Zhang, Zaoxing Liu, Michelle L. Mazurek

entry.summary: GRIEF is a greybox fuzzer for LLM inference engines that treats multi-request traces as inputs and detects crashes, hangs, performance pathologies, and silent output corruption in serving systems.

entry.title: Human-AI Productivity Paradoxes: Modeling the Interplay of Skill, Effort, and AI Assistance

author.name: Ali Aouad, Thodoris Lykouris, Huiying Zhong

entry.summary: Models human-AI interaction showing productivity paradoxes: increased AI assistance can degrade productivity through endogenous skill development effects and AI unreliability. Demonstrates potential for skill stratification.

entry.title: Agent-BRACE: Decoupling Beliefs from Actions in Long-Horizon Tasks via Verbalized State Uncertainty

author.name: Joykirat Singh, Zaid Khan, Archiki Prasad, Justin Chih-Yao Chen, Akshay Nambi, Hyunji Lee, Elias Stengel-Eskin, Mohit Bansal

entry.summary: Introduces Agent-BRACE, which decouples belief states from actions in LLM agents operating in partially observable environments. Uses verbalized state uncertainty to maintain compact belief representations for long-horizon tasks.

entry.title: PRISM: A Geometric Risk Bound that Decomposes Drift into Scale, Shape, and Head

author.name: Chieh-Yen Lin, Shao-Hua Sun

entry.summary: Proposes PRISM, a closed-form upper bound on cross-entropy risk gap between LLM variants (quantized, LoRA, distilled) that decomposes representation drift into scale, shape, and head components.

entry.title: Is Monotonic Sampling Necessary in Diffusion Models?

author.name: Muhammad Haris Khan

entry.summary: Systematically tests whether monotonic sampling schedules in diffusion models are necessary. Designs nonmonotonic schedule families and evaluates across DDPM, EDM, and Flow Matching.

entry.title: SkillSafetyBench: Evaluating Agent Safety under Skill-Facing Attack Surfaces

author.name: Chang Jin, An Wang, Zeming Wei, Kai Wang, Biaojie Zeng, Qiaosheng Zhang, Chao Yang, Jingjing Qu, Xia Hu, Xingcheng Xu

entry.summary: Presents SkillSafetyBench with 155 adversarial cases for evaluating agent safety under skill-mediated attack surfaces where benign requests interact with malicious skill materials.

entry.title: H\"older Policy Optimisation

author.name: Yuxiang Chen, Dingli Liang, Yihang Chen, Ziqin Gong, Chenyang Le, Zhaokai Wang, Jiachen Zhu, Lingyu Yang, Jianghao Lin, Weinan Zhang, Jun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes HölderPO, a generalization of GRPO that unifies token-level probability aggregation via Hölder means, allowing adaptive tuning between different aggregation strategies during training to avoid collapse.

entry.title: Scalable Token-Level Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models

author.name: Rui Min, Tianyu Pang, Chao Du, Minhao Cheng, Yi R. Fung

entry.summary: Proposes TokenHD, a pipeline for training token-level hallucination detectors with a scalable data engine for synthesizing annotations and a training recipe for reasoning-intensive tasks.

entry.title: Solve the Loop: Attractor Models for Language and Reasoning

author.name: Jacob Fein-Ashley, Paria Rashidinejad

entry.summary: Introduces Attractor Models that refine outputs by solving for fixed points with implicit differentiation, enabling constant training memory regardless of effective depth and adaptive iteration count. Outperforms existing looped transformers.

entry.title: ADMM-Q: An Improved Hessian-based Weight Quantizer for Post-Training Quantization of Large Language Models

author.name: Ryan Lucas, Mehdi Makni, Xiang Meng, Adam Deng, Rahul Mazumder

entry.summary: ADMM-Q uses a combinatorial ADMM approach for post-training quantization of LLMs, gradually enforcing quantization constraints while minimizing layer-wise reconstruction error. Shows improvements over GPTQ especially at aggressive sub-4-bit quantization.

entry.title: The first global agricultural field boundary map at 10m resolution

author.name: Caleb Robinson, Gedeon Muhawenayo, Subash Khanal, Zhanpei Fang, Isaac Corley, Ana M. T\'arano, Lyndon Estes, Jennifer Marcus, Nathan Jacobs, Hannah Kerner, Inbal Becker-Reshef, Juan M. Lavista Ferres

entry.summary: Presents the first global agricultural field boundary map at 10m resolution, comprising 3.17 billion field polygons across 241 countries for 2024-2025, produced using U-Net segmentation on satellite imagery.

entry.title: TextSeal: A Localized LLM Watermark for Provenance & Distillation Protection

author.name: Tom Sander, Hongyan Chang, Tom\'a\v{s} Sou\v{c}ek, Tuan Tran, Valeriu Lacatusu, Sylvestre-Alvise Rebuffi, Alexandre Mourachko, Surya Parimi, Christophe Ropers, Rashel Moritz, Vanessa Stark, Hady Elsahar, Pierre Fernandez

entry.summary: Introduces TextSeal, a watermarking scheme for LLMs building on Gumbel-max sampling with dual-key generation, entropy-weighted scoring, and multi-region localization. Supports speculative decoding and multi-token prediction with no inference overhead, and is robust to dilution in mixed human/AI documents.

entry.title: Correcting Selection Bias in Sparse User Feedback for Large Language Model Quality Estimation: A Multi-Agent Hierarchical Bayesian Approach

author.name: Andrea Morandi, Mahesh Viswanathan

entry.summary: Addresses selection bias in LLM user feedback (thumbs up/down), proposing a three-agent hierarchical Bayesian pipeline to correct for the fact that feedback comes disproportionately from extreme satisfaction/dissatisfaction. Claims naive averages can be 40-50 percentage points off.

entry.title: UniVLR: Unifying Text and Vision in Visual Latent Reasoning for Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Houcheng Jiang, Jiajun Fu, Junfeng Fang, Chen Gao, Xiang Wang, Xiangnan He, Yong Li

entry.summary: Proposes UniVLR, which unifies textual reasoning and visual evidence into a shared visual workspace for multimodal LLMs, rendering reasoning traces with auxiliary images and compressing into visual latent tokens for inference.

entry.title: When Policy Entropy Constraint Fails: Preserving Diversity in Flow-based RLHF via Perceptual Entropy

author.name: Xiaofeng Tan, Jun Liu, Bin-Bin Gao, Yuanting Fan, Xi Jiang, Chengjie Wang, Hongsong Wang, Feng Zheng

entry.summary: Reveals that policy entropy stays constant in flow-matching models even as perceptual diversity collapses during RLHF, explaining why entropy regularization fails. Proposes perceptual entropy as an alternative for preserving diversity.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning, Agency and Taste

author.name: epicurus

entry.summary: Argues that RL progress continues faster than expected because horizon length is not the binding constraint it was thought to be. Draws on the author's work as an Anthropic Fellow to explain how agency and 'taste' in RL enable effective credit assignment over long horizons.

entry.title: DreamAvoid: Critical-Phase Test-Time Dreaming to Avoid Failures in VLA Policies

author.name: Xianzhe Fan, Yuxiang Lu, Shenyuan Gao, Xiaoyang Wu, Ruihua Han, Manling Li, Hengshuang Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes DreamAvoid, a test-time dreaming framework for VLA models that anticipates and avoids failures during critical manipulation phases by learning success-failure boundaries.

entry.title: A Mechanistic Investigation of Supervised Fine Tuning

author.name: Ruhaan Chopra

entry.summary: Uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to mechanistically investigate how Supervised Fine-Tuning changes LLM representations. Despite high cosine similarity before/after SFT, sparse latents diverge significantly, revealing task-specific and layer-specific feature changes.

entry.title: Controllable User Simulation

author.name: Guy Tennenholtz, Ofer Meshi, Amir Globerson, Uri Shalit, Jihwan Jeong, Craig Boutilier

entry.summary: Formalizes controllable user simulation as a causal inference problem, showing that standard supervised fine-tuning on post-hoc trajectory labels produces structurally biased simulators due to look-ahead bias from the behavior policy. Proposes causal corrections.

entry.title: Seir\^enes: Adversarial Self-Play with Evolving Distractions for LLM Reasoning

author.name: Chi Zhang, Haibo Qiu, Qiming Zhang, Yufei Xu, Xinbo Gao, Jing Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Seirênes, a self-play RL framework where a single model simultaneously learns to construct distracting contexts and solve problems despite those distractions. Transforms contextual interference from a failure mode into a training signal for more resilient reasoning.

entry.title: On-Policy Self-Evolution via Failure Trajectories for Agentic Safety Alignment

author.name: Bo Yin, Qi Li, Xinchao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes FATE, an on-policy self-evolving framework for agentic safety alignment that transforms verifier-scored failure trajectories into repair supervision without expert demonstrations. Addresses the safety-utility tradeoff at the trajectory level.

entry.title: Reward Hacking in Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Anas Mahmoud, MohammadHossein Rezaei, Zihao Wang, Anisha Gunjal, Bing Liu, Yunzhong He

entry.summary: Studies reward hacking in rubric-based RL, separating verifier failure (training verifier credits what reference verifiers reject) from rubric-design limitations (strong verifiers favor responses that rubric-free judges rate worse). Tests across medical and science domains.

entry.title: Enabling Performant and Flexible Model-Internal Observability for LLM Inference

author.name: Nengneng Yu, Sixian Xiong, Yibo Zhao, Wei Wang, Zaoxing Liu

entry.summary: DMI-Lib provides high-speed internal observability for LLM inference, treating model inspection as a systems primitive. Uses GPU-CPU memory abstraction (Ring²) to decouple observation from the inference hot path with only 0.4-6.8% overhead.

entry.title: Leveraging RAG for Training-Free Alignment of LLMs

author.name: John T. Halloran

entry.summary: RAG-Pref uses retrieval-augmented generation for training-free LLM alignment by conditioning on preferred/dispreferred samples during inference. Shows improved refusal guardrails against agentic attacks without fine-tuning.

entry.title: DiffScore: Text Evaluation Beyond Autoregressive Likelihood

author.name: Wen Lai, Yingli Shen, Dingnan Jin, Qing Cui, Jun Zhou, Maosong Sun, Alexander Fraser

entry.summary: Proposes DiffScore, a text evaluation framework built on Masked Large Diffusion Language Models that uses bidirectional context to eliminate positional bias inherent in autoregressive evaluation.

entry.title: From Generic Correlation to Input-Specific Credit in On-Policy Self Distillation

author.name: Guobin Shen, Lei Huang, Xiang Cheng, Chenxiao Zhao, Jindong Li, Dongcheng Zhao, Xing Yu

entry.summary: Analyzes on-policy self-distillation for LLMs, showing the token reward equals a Bayesian filtering increment whose sum is the pointwise mutual information between response and feedback. Proposes improvements for input-specific credit.

entry.title: Behavioral Integrity Verification for AI Agent Skills

author.name: Yuhao Wu, Tung-Ling Li, Hongliang Liu

entry.summary: Formalizes Behavioral Integrity Verification (BIV) for AI agent skills, enabling comparison between declared and actual capabilities to detect deviations and malicious skills.

entry.title: The Illusion of Power Capping in LLM Decode: A Phase-Aware Energy Characterisation Across Attention Architectures

author.name: Bole Ma, Ayesha Afzal, Jan Eitzinger, Gerhard Wellein

entry.summary: Reveals that GPU power capping is illusory for LLM autoregressive decode phase, which is memory-bound and never triggers power caps. Tests across GQA, MLA, Gated DeltaNet, and Mamba2 on H200.

entry.title: No More, No Less: Task Alignment in Terminal Agents

author.name: Sina Mavali, David Pape, Jonathan Evertz, Samira Abedini, Devansh Srivastav, Thorsten Eisenhofer, Sahar Abdelnabi, Lea Sch\"onherr

entry.summary: Introduces TAB (Task Alignment Benchmark) for terminal agents that tests whether agents can correctly follow relevant environmental instructions while ignoring irrelevant or misleading ones—measuring 'no more, no less' alignment.

entry.title: TokenRatio: Principled Token-Level Preference Optimization via Ratio Matching

author.name: Truong Nguyen, Tien-Phat Nguyen, Linh Ngo Van, Duy Minh Ho Nguyen, Khoa Doan, Trung Le

entry.summary: Introduces TokenRatio, deriving token-level preference optimization from a token-level Bradley-Terry model using Bregman divergence density-ratio matching, providing principled per-token alignment from sequence-level preferences.

entry.title: Stories in Space: In-Context Learning Trajectories in Conceptual Belief Space

author.name: Eric Bigelow, Rapha\"el Sarfati, Daniel Wurgaft, Owen Lewis, Thomas McGrath, Jack Merullo, Atticus Geiger, Ekdeep Singh Lubana

entry.summary: Shows that LLMs assign beliefs over low-dimensional geometric 'conceptual belief spaces' during in-context learning, and that story understanding can be viewed as trajectories through these spaces as beliefs update.

entry.title: Language Modeling with Hyperspherical Flows

author.name: Justin Deschenaux, Caglar Gulcehre

entry.summary: Proposes Flow Language Models on hyperspheres rather than one-hot vectors, reducing dimensionality from vocabulary size to a fixed embedding dimension while giving Gaussian noise meaningful semantic interpretation.

entry.title: Error whitening: Why Gauss-Newton outperforms Newton

author.name: Maricela Best McKay, Nathan P. Lawrence, Brian Wetton, R. Bhushan Gopaluni

entry.summary: Provides a function-space analysis explaining why Gauss-Newton outperforms Newton's method in practice. Shows GGN projects Newton direction onto the model's tangent space, eliminating parameterization-induced distortions.

entry.title: Sobolev Regularized MMD Gradient Flow

author.name: Chenyang Tian, Bharath K. Sriperumbudur, Arthur Gretton, Zonghao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Sobolev-regularized MMD gradient flow with global convergence guarantees that don't rely on isoperimetric assumptions on the target distribution, applicable to both sampling and generative modeling.

entry.title: Multi-Stream LLMs: Unblocking Language Models with Parallel Streams of Thoughts, Inputs and Outputs

author.name: Guinan Su, Yanwu Yang, Xueyan Li, Jonas Geiping

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Stream LLMs that enable parallel streams of thoughts, inputs, and outputs, breaking the single-stream bottleneck where agents cannot act while reading/thinking. Addresses fundamental limitations of sequential message-exchange formats in AI agents.

entry.title: Reconstruction of Personally Identifiable Information from Supervised Finetuned Models

author.name: Sae Furukawa, Alina Oprea

entry.summary: First study of PII reconstruction from supervised fine-tuned LLMs. Constructs multi-turn medical and legal Q&A datasets with PII to evaluate adversarial reconstruction under varying threat models. Reveals privacy vulnerabilities in SFT.

entry.title: Sampling More, Getting Less: Calibration is the Diversity Bottleneck in LLMs

author.name: Amin Banayeeanzade, Qingchuan Yang, Dhruv Tarsadiya, Fatemeh Bahrani, Leonardo Blas, Alfy Samuel, Robin Jia, Meisam Razaviyayn, Sai Praneeth Karimireddy

entry.summary: Introduces a validity-diversity framework explaining LLM diversity collapse through two forms of miscalibration: order calibration (ranking valid over invalid tokens) and magnitude calibration (probability mass distribution among valid tokens). Provides actionable insights for improving output diversity.

entry.title: AgentShield: Deception-based Compromise Detection for Tool-using LLM Agents

author.name: Yassin H. Rassul, Tarik A. Rashid

entry.summary: Proposes AgentShield, a deception-based detection framework for compromised LLM agents that places fake tools, credentials, and allowlisted parameters as traps. Evaluates across English, Kurdish, and Arabic.

entry.title: World Action Models: The Next Frontier in Embodied AI

author.name: Siyin Wang, Junhao Shi, Zhaoyang Fu, Xinzhe He, Feihong Liu, Chenchen Yang, Yikang Zhou, Zhaoye Fei, Jingjing Gong, Jinlan Fu, Mike Zheng Shou, Xuanjing Huang, Xipeng Qiu, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Survey paper introducing the World Action Models (WAMs) paradigm for embodied AI—foundation models that unify predictive state modeling with action generation, targeting joint distribution over future states and actions.

entry.title: Covering Human Action Space for Computer Use: Data Synthesis and Benchmark

author.name: Miaosen Zhang, Xiaohan Zhao, Zhihong Tan, Zhou Huoshen, Yijia Fan, Yifan Yang, Kai Qiu, Bei Liu, Justin Wagle, Chenzhong Yin, Mingxi Cheng, Ji Li, Qi Dai, Chong Luo, Xu Yang, Xin Geng, Baining Guo

entry.summary: CUActSpot benchmark evaluates computer-use agents on complex, long-tail GUI interactions across five modalities. Analysis shows a small fraction of complex interactions causes disproportionate task failures, suggesting data scarcity as root cause.

entry.title: Hide to See: Reasoning-prefix Masking for Visual-anchored Thinking in VLM Distillation

author.name: Seonghoon Yu, Dongjun Nam, Byung-Kwan Lee, Jeany Son

entry.summary: Introduces a think-answer distillation framework for VLMs that masks reasoning prefixes to force students to rely more on visual evidence during thinking, improving visual grounding in compact models.

entry.title: The Many Faces of On-Policy Distillation: Pitfalls, Mechanisms, and Fixes

author.name: Siqi Zhu, Xuyan Ye, Hongyu Lu, Weiye Shi, Ge Liu

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive empirical study of on-policy distillation (OPD) and on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) for LLMs, identifying when they work and fail. Finds OPD is sensitive to teacher choice and loss formulation for math reasoning, while OPSD fails due to absence of privileged information at test time.

entry.title: Breaking $\textit{Winner-Takes-All}$: Cooperative Policy Optimization Improves Diverse LLM Reasoning

author.name: Haoxuan Chen, Tianming Liang, Wei-Shi Zheng, Jian-Fang Hu

entry.summary: Proposes GCPO (Group Cooperative Policy Optimization), which shifts RLVR training from rollout competition to team cooperation for maximizing global diversity in LLM reasoning. Addresses exploration collapse in GRPO where models converge on narrow solution patterns.

entry.title: Can LLM Agents Respond to Disasters? Benchmarking Heterogeneous Geospatial Reasoning in Emergency Operations

author.name: Junjue Wang, Weihao Xuan, Heli Qi, Pengyu Dai, Kunyi Liu, Hongruixuan Chen, Zhuo Zheng, Junshi Xia, Stefano Ermon, Naoto Yokoya

entry.summary: Introduces DORA, the first agentic benchmark for end-to-end disaster response with 515 expert-authored tasks across 45 real disasters spanning 10 types. Includes gold trajectories with 3,500 tool-call steps covering multi-sensor reasoning, evacuation planning, and report generation.

entry.title: Explaining and Breaking the Safety-Helpfulness Ceiling via Preference Dimensional Expansion

author.name: ShiYing Huang, Liang Lin, Yuer Li, Kaiwen Luo, Zhenhong Zhou, An Zhang, Junhao Dong, Kun Wang, Zhigang Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes breaking the safety-helpfulness ceiling through preference dimensional expansion, scaling up reward model rollout dimensions to fundamentally expand the Pareto frontier rather than forcing compromises along a fixed frontier.

entry.title: Rollout Cards: A Reproducibility Standard for Agent Research

author.name: Charlie Masters, Ziyuan Liu, Stefano V. Albrecht
