author.name: Konstantinos Oikonomidis, Jan Quan, Kimon Antonakopoulos, Antonio Silveti-Falls, Volkan Cevher, Panagiotis Patrinos

entry.summary: Develops proximal preconditioned gradient methods extending the Muon and Scion optimizers with proximal operations for constrained optimization. Analyzes convergence under heavy-tailed noise and proposes variance-reduced versions.

entry.title: ReVision: Scaling Computer-Use Agents via Temporal Visual Redundancy Reduction

author.name: Amirhossein Abaskohi, Yuhang He, Peter West, Giuseppe Carenini, Pranit Chawla, Vibhav Vineet

entry.summary: Introduces ReVision for scaling computer-use agents by reducing temporal visual redundancy in GUI interaction trajectories. Trains a patch selector to remove redundant visual patches across consecutive screenshots while preserving spatial structure.

entry.title: Human-Grounded Multimodal Benchmark with 900K-Scale Aggregated Student Response Distributions from Japan's National Assessment of Academic Ability

author.name: Kyosuke Takami, Yuka Tateisi, Satoshi Sekine, Yusuke Miyao

entry.summary: Presents a multimodal benchmark from Japan's National Assessment of Academic Ability with ~900K aggregated student response distributions. Enables direct comparison of MLLM and human performance on authentic K-12 exams with real diagrams and layouts.

entry.title: Learning to Foresee: Unveiling the Unlocking Efficiency of On-Policy Distillation

author.name: Yuchen Cai, Ding Cao, Liang Lin, Chunxi Luo, Xin Xu, Kai Yang, Weijie Liu, Saiyong Yang, Tianxiang Zhao, Guangzhong Sun, Guiquan Liu, Junfeng Fang

entry.summary: Investigates why on-policy distillation (OPD) is efficient for LLM post-training. Argues OPD provides 'foresight' by establishing stable update trajectories early, concentrating updates on critical modules and exhibiting stronger low-rank structure.

entry.title: Probabilistic Calibration Is a Trainable Capability in Language Models

author.name: Davide Baldelli, Sruthi Kuriakose, Maryam Hashemzadeh, Amal Zouaq, Sarath Chandar

entry.summary: Studies whether probabilistic calibration is a trainable capability in LLMs through Calibration Fine-Tuning on synthetic distribution-matching tasks. Shows both soft-target and hard-target methods substantially improve structured-sampling fidelity across 12 models.

entry.title: PreScam: A Benchmark for Predicting Scam Progression from Early Conversations

author.name: Weixiang Sun, Shang Ma, Yiyang Li, Tianyi Ma, Zehong Wang, Colby Nelson, Xusheng Xiao, Yanfang Ye

entry.summary: Introduces PreScam, a benchmark of 11,573 real-world conversational scam instances for modeling how scams progress over time. Built from 177,989 user-submitted reports spanning 20 scam categories.

entry.title: AgentDisCo: Towards Disentanglement and Collaboration in Open-ended Deep Research Agents

author.name: Jiarui Jin, Zexuan Yan, Shijian Wang, Wenxiang Jiao, Yuan Lu

entry.summary: Presents AgentDisCo, an architecture that formulates deep research as adversarial optimization between information exploration and exploitation, using critic and generator agents with meta-optimization for strategy discovery.

entry.title: Can Graphs Help Vision SSMs See Better?

author.name: Dhruv Parikh, Anvitha Ramachandran, Haoyang Fan, Mustafa Munir, Rajgopal Kannan, Viktor Prasanna

entry.summary: Introduces GraphScan, a graph-informed scan operator for Vision State Space Models that explicitly models which local patches should exchange information before global state-space mixing, improving over predefined geometric traversals.

entry.title: LDDR: Linear-DPP-Based Dynamic-Resolution Frame Sampling for Video MLLMs

author.name: Jingfeng Chen, Jiawen Qian, Wendi Deng, Yinuo Guo, Jiaqi Yu, Sicong Leng, Raghuveer Thirukovalluru, Bhuwan Dhingra

entry.summary: Proposes LDDR, a training-free video frame sampling framework using query-aware Determinantal Point Process selection with dynamic resolution allocation for Video MLLMs, achieving 3x speedup over standard DPP.

entry.title: XWOD: A Real-World Benchmark for Object Detection under Extreme Weather Conditions

author.name: Chih-Hsin Chen, Yu-Tung Liu, Amar Fadillah, Kuan-Ting Lai, Dong Liu

entry.summary: Introduces XWOD, a large-scale real-world object detection benchmark with 10,010 images across seven extreme weather conditions for autonomous driving, addressing limitations of existing weather-robustness datasets.

entry.title: Robust Promptable Video Object Segmentation

author.name: Sohyun Lee, Yeho Gwon, Lukas Hoyer, Konrad Schindler, Christos Sakaridis, Suha Kwak

entry.summary: First comprehensive study on robust promptable video object segmentation (PVOS) under input corruptions. Constructs benchmark with 351 real-world adverse condition videos and proposes MoGA method using memory-conditioned gated-rank adaptation.

entry.title: UHR-Micro: Diagnosing and Mitigating the Resolution Illusion in Earth Observation VLMs

author.name: Shuo Ni, Tong Wang, Jing Zhang, He Chen, Haonan Guo, Ning Zhang, Bo Du

entry.summary: UHR-Micro benchmarks VLMs on ultra-high-resolution Earth observation imagery, revealing a 'resolution illusion' where higher input resolution doesn't reliably improve perception of micro-scale targets. 11,253 instructions across 1,212 UHR images.

entry.title: G$^2$TR: Generation-Guided Visual Token Reduction for Separate-Encoder Unified Multimodal Models

author.name: Junxian Li, Kai Liu, Zizhong Ding, Zhixin Wang, Zhikai Chen, Renjing Pei, Yulun Zhang

entry.summary: G²TR proposes generation-guided visual token reduction for unified multimodal models, recognizing that understanding-side tokens must also preserve generation capabilities, unlike in pure understanding models.

entry.title: Beyond Localization: A Comprehensive Diagnosis of Perspective-Conditioned Spatial Reasoning in MLLMs from Omnidirectional Images

author.name: Yuangong Chen (The Hong Kong Polytechnic University), Wai Keung Wong (The Hong Kong Polytechnic University), Jiaxing Li (Guangzhou University), Ioannis Patras (Queen Mary University of London), Xu Zheng (Queen Mary University of London, HKUST)

entry.summary: PCSR-Bench is a diagnostic benchmark with 84,373 QA pairs from 2,600 omnidirectional images evaluating perspective-conditioned spatial reasoning in MLLMs. Tests foundational perception and advanced compositional reasoning under viewpoint changes.

entry.title: From Imagined Futures to Executable Actions: Mixture of Latent Actions for Robot Manipulation

author.name: Yajie Li, Bozhou Zhang, Chun Gu, Zipei Ma, Jiahui Zhang, Jiankang Deng, Xiatian Zhu, Li Zhang

entry.summary: MoLA transforms imagined future videos into executable robot actions through a control-oriented latent interface, addressing the mismatch between visual realism in video generation and control relevance for manipulation.

entry.title: ECHO: Continuous Hierarchical Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Yanbin Hu, Jin Cui, Jiayi Lu, Ruixuan Yang, Jun Ye, Boran Zhao, Xingyu Chen, Xuguang Lan, Pengju Ren

entry.summary: ECHO proposes hierarchical memory for VLA models using hyperbolic autoencoders to organize robot experiences in continuous hierarchical space, enabling efficient retrieval and generalization for long-horizon manipulation.

entry.title: Morphologically Equivariant Flow Matching for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Max Siebenborn, Daniel Ordo\~nez Apraez, Sophie Lueth, Giulio Turrisi, Massimiliano Pontil, Claudio Semini, Georgia Chalvatzaki

entry.summary: Introduces a C2-equivariant flow matching policy that enforces morphological symmetry (bilateral/ambidextrous) for bimanual mobile manipulation. Formalizes how symmetry constrains optimal bimanual policies and shows this inductive bias improves learning efficiency.

entry.title: SafeManip: A Property-Driven Benchmark for Temporal Safety Evaluation in Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Chengyue Huang, Khang Vo Huynh, Sebastian Elbaum, Zsolt Kira, Lu Feng

entry.summary: Introduces SafeManip, a benchmark for evaluating temporal safety properties in robotic manipulation using Linear Temporal Logic over finite traces (LTLf). Goes beyond task success to evaluate temporal ordering constraints like contamination avoidance and proper sequencing.

entry.title: PIVOT: Bridging Planning and Execution in LLM Agents via Trajectory Refinement

author.name: Tuo Zhang, Alin-Ionut Popa, Yan Xu, Rui Song, Dimitrios Dimitriadis

entry.summary: PIVOT addresses plan-execution misalignment in LLM agents through a self-supervised framework treating trajectories as optimizable objects refined via environment interaction. Uses four stages: PLAN, INSPECT, EVOLVE, and VERIFY with textual gradients encoding discrepancies.

entry.title: AcuityBench: Evaluating Clinical Acuity Identification and Uncertainty Alignment

author.name: Robin Linzmayer (Department of Computer Science, Columbia University, Department of Biomedical Informatics, Columbia University), Georgianna Lin (Department of Biomedical Informatics, Columbia University), Di Coneybeare (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Jason Chu (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Trudi Cloyd (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Manish Garg (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Miles Gordon (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Elizabeth Hartofilis (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Benjamin Hong (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Ashraf Hussain (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Eugene Y. Kim (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Oluchi Iheagwara King (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Ross McCormack (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Erica Olsen (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), John K. Riggins Jr (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Mustafa N. Rasheed (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Dana L. Sacco (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Vinay Saggar (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Osman R. Sayan (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Amit Shembekar (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Janice Shin-Kim (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Wendy W. Sun (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), Bernard P. Chang (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), David Kessler (Department of Emergency Medicine, Columbia University Irving Medical Center), No\'emie Elhadad (Department of Computer Science, Columbia University, Department of Biomedical Informatics, Columbia University)

entry.summary: Introduces AcuityBench, a benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs correctly identify urgency of care from medical presentations. Harmonizes five datasets under a four-level acuity framework with 914 cases including physician-disagreement cases for uncertainty calibration.

entry.title: CuSearch: Curriculum Rollout Sampling via Search Depth for Agentic RAG

author.name: Jianghan Shen, Siqi Luo, Xinyu Cheng, Jing Xiong, Yue Li, Jiyao Liu, Jiashi Lin, Yirong Chen, Junjun He

entry.summary: Proposes CuSearch, a curriculum-based rollout sampling strategy for agentic RAG training that prioritizes deeper-search trajectories which provide denser supervision for retrieval policy learning. Addresses heterogeneity in trajectory informativeness during RLVR training.

entry.title: SafeSteer: A Decoding-level Defense Mechanism for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Xinyi Zeng, Xue Yang, Jingyuan Zhang, Huanqian Yan, Xiang Chen, Kaiwen Wei, Hankun Kang, Yu Tian

entry.summary: Introduces SafeSteer, a decoding-level defense mechanism for multimodal LLMs that exploits their intrinsic ability to distinguish harmful inputs during decoding. Observes that image-based attacks are more stealthy than text-based ones.

entry.title: Allegory of the Cave: Measurement-Grounded Vision-Language Learning

author.name: Kepeng Xu, Li Xu, Gang He, Wenxin Yu

entry.summary: Studies whether grounding vision-language models in RAW camera measurements (pre-ISP) rather than post-processed RGB improves reasoning. Proposes PRISM-VL with camera-conditioned grounding and exposure-bracketed supervision, improving performance on challenging visual conditions.

entry.title: From Clever Hans to Scientific Discovery: Interpreting EEG Foundational Transformers with LRP

author.name: Justus Meyer zu Bexten, Nico Scherf, Bogdan Franczyk, Simon M. Hofmann

entry.summary: Investigates attention-aware LRP for interpreting EEG foundation models, extending LRP from CNN-based to Transformer-based EEG models. Uncovers 'Clever Hans' behavior in motor imagery tasks and surfaces novel neurobiological hypotheses.

entry.title: Domain Restriction via Multi SAE Layer Transitions

author.name: Elias Shaheen, Avi Mendelson

entry.summary: Shows that SAE layer transitions provide domain-specific signatures for detecting out-of-domain texts in LLMs. Proposes lightweight methods for learning on internal dynamics to restrict LLMs to specific domains.

entry.title: MM-OptBench: A Solver-Grounded Benchmark for Multimodal Optimization Modeling

author.name: Zhong Li, Qi Huang, Yuxuan Zhu, Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri, Niki van Stein, Thomas B\"ack, Matthijs van Leeuwen, Zaiwen Wen, Lincen Yang

entry.summary: Introduces MM-OptBench, a benchmark for multimodal optimization modeling where models must construct mathematical formulations and solver code from text-and-visual problem specifications including tables, graphs, maps, and dashboards.

entry.title: Executable Agentic Memory for GUI Agent

author.name: Zerui Qin, Sheng Yue, Xingyuan Hua, Yongjian Fu, Ju Ren

entry.summary: Proposes Executable Agentic Memory (EAM), a knowledge graph-based approach that shifts GUI agent planning from free-form generation to retrieval-and-execution. Uses state-aware DFS for memory construction and Q-function guided MCTS for planning.

entry.title: Vertex-Softmax: Tight Transformer Verification via Exact Softmax Optimization

author.name: Navid Rezazadeh, Arash Gholami Davoodi

entry.summary: Proves that exact optimization of softmax over interval constraints in transformer verification is attained at box vertices, with only linearly many candidates after sorting. Yields Vertex-Softmax primitive with log-linear complexity.

entry.title: AESOP: Adversarial Execution-path Selection to Overload Deep Learning Pipelines

author.name: Tingxi Li, Mingfang Ji, Ravishka Shemal Rathnasuriya, Simin Chen, Yitao Hu, Wei Yang

entry.summary: Demonstrates AESOP, an adversarial attack on ML inference pipelines that exploits dynamic execution paths. Path-aware targeting inflates FLOPs by 2,407× compared to single-model attacks on identical inputs and budgets.

entry.title: Simpson's Paradox in Behavioral Curves: How Aggregation Distorts Parametric Models of User Dynamics

author.name: Chao Zhou

entry.summary: Demonstrates Simpson's Paradox in behavioral curve modeling: individual Goodreads users peak at ~11 exposures while aggregate peaks at ~34 (3x gap), driven by survival bias. Validated across multiple platforms with MovieLens as negative control.

entry.title: SEVO: Semantic-Enhanced Virtual Observation for Robust VLA Manipulation via Active Illumination and Data-Centric Collection

author.name: Tianchonghui Fang, Yuan Zhuang, Fei Miao

entry.summary: SEVO improves cross-environment robustness of Vision-Language-Action policies through data-centric approaches: body-fixed cameras, active illumination, and background removal, without modifying policy architecture.

entry.title: ReAD: Reinforcement-Guided Capability Distillation for Large Language Models

author.name: Xueqi Cheng, Xugui Zhou, Tyler Derr, Yushun Dong

entry.summary: ReAD studies capability distillation under fixed token budgets, finding systematic cross-capability transfer patterns. Uses reinforcement learning to optimize distillation allocation across capabilities.

entry.title: Causal Fairness for Survival Analysis

author.name: Drago Plecko

entry.summary: Extends causal fairness framework to survival/time-to-event analysis, disentangling causal mechanisms through which protected attributes influence outcomes in temporal settings.

entry.title: PointGS: Semantic-Consistent Unsupervised 3D Point Cloud Segmentation with 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Yixiao Song, Qingyong Li, Wen Wang, Zhicheng Yan

entry.summary: Proposes PointGS for unsupervised 3D point cloud segmentation using 3D Gaussian Splatting as a bridge between 2D foundation models and 3D points, addressing semantic consistency issues in 2D-3D transfer.

entry.title: Cochise: A Reference Harness for Autonomous Penetration Testing

author.name: Andreas Happe, J\"urgen Cito

entry.summary: Presents Cochise, a minimal 597-LOC reference harness for autonomous penetration testing experiments with LLM-driven agents. Implements Planner-Executor architecture with SSH-based execution.

entry.title: Debiased Model-based Representations for Sample-efficient Continuous Control

author.name: Jiafei Lyu, Zichuan Lin, Scott Fujimoto, Kai Yang, Yangkun Chen, Saiyong Yang, Zongqing Lu, Deheng Ye

entry.summary: Proposes DR.Q for debiased model-based representations in continuous control, addressing issues where existing methods fail to capture relevant variables and overfit to early replay buffer experiences.

entry.title: Learning What Matters: Adaptive Information-Theoretic Objectives for Robot Exploration

author.name: Youwei Yu, Jionghao Wang, Zhengming Yu, Wenping Wang, Lantao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Quasi-Optimal Experimental Design (QOED) for robot exploration that adapts information-theoretic objectives to account for weakly observable parameters, avoiding distorted information measures in high-dimensional systems.

entry.title: Uncertainty Quantification for LLM-based Code Generation

author.name: Senrong Xu, Yuhao Tan, Yanke Zhou, Guangyuan Wu, Zenan Li, Yuan Yao, Taolue Chen, Feng Xu, Xiaoxing Ma

entry.summary: Proposes RisCoSet for uncertainty quantification in LLM code generation using multiple hypothesis testing to construct risk-controlling prediction sets, overcoming limitations of prior PAC prediction set approaches.

entry.title: EHR-RAGp: Retrieval-Augmented Prototype-Guided Foundation Model for Electronic Health Records

author.name: Saeed Shurrab, Mariam Al-Omari, Dana El Samad, Farah E. Shamout

entry.summary: Introduces EHR-RAGp, a retrieval-augmented foundation model for electronic health records that uses prototype-guided retrieval to dynamically integrate relevant patient history across diverse clinical event types.

entry.title: Predicting Decisions of AI Agents from Limited Interaction through Text-Tabular Modeling

author.name: Eilam Shapira, Moshe Tennenholtz, Roi Reichart

entry.summary: Studies predicting unfamiliar AI agent decisions from limited interactions, framing it as target-adaptive text-tabular prediction in bargaining/negotiation games where counterpart's internals are hidden.

entry.title: ACSAC: Adaptive Chunk Size Actor-Critic with Causal Transformer Q-Network

author.name: Qian Chen, Junqiao Zhao, Hongtu Zhou, Hang Yu, Yanping Zhao, Chen Ye, Guang Chen

entry.summary: Proposes ACSAC, an actor-critic method with adaptive chunk sizes using a causal transformer Q-network that selects temporally extended actions of varying lengths based on context.

entry.title: Enforcing Constraints in Generative Sampling via Adaptive Correction Scheduling

author.name: Noah Trupin, Yexiang Xue

entry.summary: Formalizes constraint enforcement in generative sampling as a correction scheduling problem, introducing adaptive scheduling that allocates projection budget to steps that most perturb the trajectory, rather than applying projection uniformly.

entry.title: Behavioral Mode Discovery for Fine-tuning Multimodal Generative Policies

author.name: Alberta Longhini, David Emukpere, Jean-Michel Renders, Seungsu Kim

entry.summary: Proposes unsupervised mode discovery for fine-tuning generative policies (e.g., diffusion policies) with RL, using mutual information as intrinsic reward to maintain behavioral diversity while improving task performance.

entry.title: Learning Weakly Communicating Average-Reward CMDPs: Strong Duality and Improved Regret

author.name: Kihyun Yu, Beomhan Baek, Dabeen Lee

entry.summary: Establishes strong duality for weakly communicating average-reward CMDPs and proposes a primal-dual algorithm achieving improved regret and constraint violation bounds for linear CMDPs.

entry.title: Compositional Neural Operators for Multi-Dimensional Fluid Dynamics

author.name: Hamda Hmida, Hsiu-Wen Chang, Youssef Mesri

entry.summary: Compositional Neural Operators decompose complex PDEs into reusable Foundation Blocks (convection, diffusion, etc.), enabling modular composition for 2D fluid dynamics problems.

entry.title: Online Continual Learning with Dynamic Label Hierarchies

author.name: Xinrui Wang, Shao-Yuan Li, Bart{\l}omiej Twardowski, Alexandra Gomez-Villa, Songcan Chen

entry.summary: Introduces DHOCL, a new continual learning setting with dynamically evolving label hierarchies where taxonomies change across granularities and samples provide supervision at varying hierarchy levels.

entry.title: ROMER: Expert Replacement and Router Calibration for Robust MoE LLMs on Analog Compute-in-Memory Systems

author.name: Wenyong Zhou, Yuannuo Feng, Yizhe Chen, Taiqiang Wu, Wendong Xu, Wenbo Qi, Zhengwu Liu, Wang Kang, Ngai Wong

entry.summary: ROMER is the first systematic study of MoE LLMs under analog compute-in-memory hardware noise, finding that noise critically disrupts expert load balance, and proposing expert replacement and router calibration.

entry.title: On the Importance of Multistability for Horizon Generalization in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Asad Bakija, Florent De Geeter, Julien Brandoit, Pierre Sacr\'e, Guillaume Drion

entry.summary: Formalizes 'temporal horizon generalization' in RL—the ability to retain optimal behavior at longer horizons than trained on—and shows that multistability in recurrent memory is necessary for achieving this in POMDPs. Provides a formal framework connecting dynamical systems theory to RL.

entry.title: Instruction Lens Score: Your Instruction Contributes a Powerful Object Hallucination Detector for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Runhe Lai, Xinhua Lu, Yanqi Wu, Jinlun Ye, Weijiang Yu, Ruixuan Wang

entry.summary: Reveals that instruction token embeddings in multimodal LLMs implicitly encode visual information and filter erroneous visual embeddings. Proposes Instruction Lens Score (InsLen) as a training-free, plug-and-play object hallucination detector combining calibrated local and context consistency scores.

entry.title: From Message-Passing to Linearized Graph Sequence Models

author.name: Jo\"el Mathys, Basil Rohner, Saku Peltonen, Roger Wattenhofer

entry.summary: Introduces Linearized Graph Sequence Models, a framework recasting message-passing graph computation as sequence modeling. Separates computational processing depth from information propagation depth, allowing graph architecture decisions to be treated as sequence modeling choices.

entry.title: MLCommons Chakra: Advancing Performance Benchmarking and Co-design using Standardized Execution Traces

author.name: Srinivas Sridharan, Andy Balogh, Bradford M. Beckmann, Brian Coutinho, Louis Feng, Sheng Fu, Sanshan Gao, Mehryar Garakani, Taekyung Heo, David Kanter, Josh Ladd, Ziwei Li, Winston Liu, Changhai Man, Dan Mihailescu, Spandan More, Joongun Park, Ashwin Ramachandran, Vinay Ramakrishnaiah, Saeed Rashidi, Vijay Janapa Reddi, Puneet Sharma, Phio Tian, William Won, Hanjiang Wu, Huan Xu, Jinsun Yoo, Tushar Krishna

entry.summary: Presents MLCommons Chakra, an open ecosystem for AI/ML performance benchmarking using standardized execution traces (ETs) that represent compute, memory, communication operations, dependencies, and resource constraints for distributed workloads.

entry.title: Generative climate downscaling enables high-resolution compound risk assessment by preserving multivariate dependencies

author.name: Takuro Kutsuna, Noriko N. Ishizaki, Norihiro Oyama, Hiroaki Yoshida

entry.summary: Proposes a diffusion-based multivariate generative framework for climate downscaling that preserves inter-variable correlations critical for compound hazard assessment. Achieves 50x resolution increase while reducing correlation errors fourfold compared to baselines. Applied to meteorological variables over Japan for heat stress and wildfire risk.

entry.title: PrivacySIM: Evaluating LLM Simulation of User Privacy Behavior

author.name: James Flemings, Murali Annavaram

entry.summary: Introduces PrivacySIM, an evaluation suite benchmarking LLM simulation of individual privacy behavior against ground-truth responses from 1,000 users across five privacy studies. Tests whether persona attributes can drive accurate individual-level privacy decision simulation.

entry.title: Information-Theoretic Generalization Bounds for Sequential Decision Making

author.name: Futoshi Futami, Masahiro Fujisawa

entry.summary: Develops information-theoretic generalization bounds for sequential decision-making by extending supersample CMI frameworks to handle adaptive data collection. Introduces sequential supersample framework with row-wise exchangeability for online learning, bandits, and streaming settings.

entry.title: Instructions shape Production of Language, not Processing

author.name: Andreas Waldis, Leshem Choshen, Yufang Hou, Yotam Perlit

entry.summary: Reveals that instructions primarily shape language model production (output generation) rather than processing (input understanding), through cognitively-inspired probing across five tasks. Task-specific information in output tokens varies substantially and correlates with behavior, while input representations remain stable.

entry.title: On Predicting the Post-training Potential of Pre-trained LLMs

author.name: Xiaoyuan Li, Yubo Ma, Kexin Yang, Moxin Li, Keqin Bao, Wenie Wang, Fuli Feng, Dayiheng Liu

entry.summary: Introduces RuDE for predicting LLM post-training potential before actual post-training, using rubric-based discriminative evaluation. Proposes a 4C Taxonomy for constructing controlled contrastive pairs to assess base model plasticity.

entry.title: Learning Agentic Policy from Action Guidance

author.name: Yuxiang Ji, Zengbin Wang, Yong Wang, Shidong Yang, Ziyu Ma, Guanhua Chen, Zonghua Sun, Liaoni Wu, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: Proposes ActGuide-RL, which injects action data from human interactions as plan-style reference guidance for agentic RL, enabling policies to overcome reachability barriers to reward states. Jointly optimizes guided and unguided rollouts.

entry.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of ASR models using Sparse Autoencoders

author.name: Dan Pluth, Zachary Nicholas Houghton, Yu Zhou, Vijay K. Gurbani

entry.summary: First application of Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to interpret Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models, extending mechanistic interpretability techniques from text LLMs to audio processing models.

entry.title: PD-4DGS:Progressive Decomposition of 4D Gaussian Splatting for Bandwidth-Adaptive Dynamic Scene Streaming

author.name: Jiachen Li, Guangzhi Han, Jin Wan, Delong Han, Yuan Gao, Min Li, Mingle Zhou, Gang Li

entry.summary: Presents PD-4DGS, the first framework for progressive compression and on-demand streaming of 4D Gaussian Splatting, enabling adaptive-bitrate delivery of dynamic scenes without requiring full model download.

entry.title: STRIDE: Training-Free Diversity Guidance via PCA-Directed Feature Perturbation in Single-Step Diffusion Models

author.name: Ankit Yadav, Arpit Garg, Ta Duc Huy, Lingqiao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes STRIDE for improving sample diversity in single-step diffusion models by applying PCA-directed perturbations to intermediate features, respecting the model's learned feature geometry.

entry.title: LiBrA-Net: Lie-Algebraic Bilateral Affine Fields for Real-Time 4K Video Dehazing

author.name: Yongcong Wang, Chengchao Shen, Guangwei Gao, Wei Wang, Pengwen Dai, Dianjie Lu, Guijuan Zhang, Zhuoran Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes LiBrA-Net for real-time 4K video dehazing using Lie-algebraic bilateral affine fields, decoupling prediction cost from output resolution for ultra-high-definition processing on consumer GPUs.

entry.title: The Midas Touch for Metric Depth

author.name: Yu Ma, Zizhan Guo, Zuyi Xiong, Haoran Zhang, Yi Feng, Hongbo Zhao, Hanli Wang, Rui Fan

entry.summary: Presents MTD (Midas Touch for Depth), converting relative depth to metric depth using sparse 3D data via segment-wise recovery with sparse graph optimization and discontinuity-aware geodesic refinement.

entry.title: Single-Shot HDR Recovery via a Video Diffusion Prior

author.name: Chinmay Talegaonkar, Jinshi He, Christopher McKenna, Nicholas Antipa

entry.summary: Re-casts single-shot HDR reconstruction as conditional video generation, fine-tuning a video diffusion model to generate exposure brackets from a single LDR input, then fusing with predicted per-pixel weights.

entry.title: DORA: Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent for Token Merging in Vision Transformers

author.name: Kaixuan He, Song Chen, Yi Kang

entry.summary: Proposes DORA, the first RL-driven online inference framework for dynamic token merging in Vision Transformers, formulating merging as a sequential MDP where an agent adapts strategy per block and input.

entry.title: CAST: Collapse-Aware multi-Scale Topology Fusion for Multimodal Coreset Selection

author.name: Boran Zhao, Hetian Liu, Zhenxian Hu, Yuqing Yuan, Yu Yan, Pengju Ren

entry.summary: Proposes CAST for multimodal coreset selection using multi-scale topology fusion to handle cross-modal information imbalance and ensure distributional equivalence between coreset and full dataset.

entry.title: When Brains Disagree: Biological Ambiguity Underlies the Challenge of Amyloid PET Synthesis from Structural MRI

author.name: Louise E. G. Baron, Ross Callaghan, David M. Cash, Philip S. Weston, Hojjat Azadbakht, Hui Zhang

entry.summary: Investigates why synthesizing amyloid PET from structural MRI is fundamentally ill-posed due to biological ambiguity: neurodegeneration (MRI) and amyloid pathology (PET) are temporally decoupled in Alzheimer's disease. Provides scientific evidence for an intrinsic limitation of this synthesis approach.

entry.title: Vector Scaffolding: Inter-Scale Orchestration for Differentiable Image Vectorization

author.name: Jaerin Lee, Kanggeon Lee, Kyoung Mu Lee

entry.summary: Vector Scaffolding introduces hierarchical optimization for differentiable image vectorization, shifting from flat pixel-matching to structured topological construction. Addresses 'polygon soup' problem where existing methods produce uneditable outputs.

entry.title: SyncDPO: Enhancing Temporal Synchronization in Video-Audio Joint Generation via Preference Learning

author.name: Xin Cheng, Xihua Wang, Ying Ba, Yuyue Wang, Kaisi Guan, Yinbo Wang, Wenpu Li, Ruihua Song

entry.summary: SyncDPO applies Direct Preference Optimization to improve temporal synchronization in video-audio joint generation, addressing the insufficiency of MSE loss for penalizing subtle temporal misalignments.

entry.title: Fast Image Super-Resolution via Consistency Rectified Flow

author.name: Jiaqi Xu, Wenbo Li, Haoze Sun, Fan Li, Zhixin Wang, Long Peng, Jingjing Ren, Haoran Yang, Xiaowei Hu, Renjing Pei, Pheng-Ann Heng

entry.summary: FlowSR reformulates image super-resolution as rectified flow from LR to HR images with consistency learning for single-step high-quality SR. Addresses the slow multi-step sampling of diffusion-based SR.

entry.title: PRISM: : Planning and Reasoning with Intent in Simulated Embodied Environments

author.name: Yunn Kang Lim, Pengzhan Sun, Ziyi Bai, Xun Xu, Angela Yao, Xulei Yang, Shijie Li

entry.summary: Introduces PRISM, a diagnostic benchmark for LLM-based embodied agents that goes beyond binary success/failure to identify which cognitive capability (perception, reasoning, long-horizon planning) is responsible for task failure. Built on photorealistic multi-room environments with 300 human-verified tasks structured into capability tiers.

entry.title: Learning Action Manifold with Multi-view Latent Priors for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Junjin Xiao, Dongyang Li, Yandan Yang, Shuang Zeng, Tong Lin, Xinyuan Chang, Feng Xiong, Mu Xu, Xing Wei, Zhiheng Ma, Qing Zhang, Wei-Shi Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes methods to improve VLA models for manipulation: a Geometry-Guided Gated Transformer for multi-view feature alignment to address depth ambiguity, and Action Manifold Learning to predict actions on valid manifolds. Shows improvements on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real robots.

entry.title: How Useful Is Cross-Domain Generalization for Training LLM Monitors?

author.name: Sam Martin, Fabien Roger

entry.summary: Studies whether training LLM classifiers on multiple tasks improves performance on new domains. Finds partial cross-domain generalization but identifies edge cases where fine-tuned models fail to follow prompts when classification context changes.

entry.title: LEAP: Unlocking dLLM Parallelism via Lookahead Early-Convergence Token Detection

author.name: Haohui Zhang, Zhiye Wang, Xiaoying Gan, Xinbing Wang, Bo Jiang

entry.summary: Reveals that many tokens in diffusion language models converge to correct predictions early but fail to reach confidence thresholds. Proposes LEAP with lookahead early-convergence detection to unlock more parallelism.

entry.title: SkillGen: Verified Inference-Time Agent Skill Synthesis

author.name: Yuchen Ma, Yue Huang, Han Bao, Haomin Zhuang, Swadheen Shukla, Michel Galley, Xiangliang Zhang, Stefan Feuerriegel

entry.summary: Introduces SkillGen, a multi-agent framework that synthesizes auditable skills from agent trajectories via contrastive induction over successes and failures, identifying reusable patterns and failure modes for iterative refinement.

entry.title: WildRelight: A Real-World Benchmark and Physics-Guided Adaptation for Single-Image Relighting

author.name: Lezhong Wang, Mehmet Onurcan Kaya, Siavash Bigdeli, Jeppe Revall Frisvad

entry.summary: Introduces WildRelight, the first in-the-wild dataset for evaluating single-image relighting models, with real outdoor scenes under varying natural illuminations paired with HDR environment maps.

entry.title: Multi-Timescale Conductance Spiking Networks: A Sparse, Gradient-Trainable Framework with Rich Firing Dynamics for Enhanced Temporal Processing

author.name: Alex Fulleda-Garcia, Saray Soldado-Magraner, Josep Maria Margarit-Taul\'e

entry.summary: Introduces multi-timescale conductance spiking networks that provide gradient trainability, dynamical richness, and high sparsity simultaneously for temporal processing tasks.

entry.title: STRABLE: Benchmarking Tabular Machine Learning with Strings

author.name: Gioia Blayer, Myung Jun Kim, F\'elix Lefebvre, Lennart Purucker, Alan Arazi, Eilam Shapira, Roi Reichart, Frank Hutter, Marine Le Morvan, David Holzm\"uller, Ga\"el Varoquaux

entry.summary: Introduces STRABLE, a benchmark of 108 real-world tables with string entries for evaluating tabular ML methods. Investigates whether dedicated string-handling architectures are needed or if encoding strings as numbers suffices, finding that string encoding choices significantly impact performance.

entry.title: Aligning Flow Map Policies with Optimal Q-Guidance

author.name: Christos Ziakas, Alessandra Russo, Avishek Joey Bose

entry.summary: Introduces flow map policies for fast action generation in RL by learning to take arbitrary-size jumps across generative dynamics of flow-based policies. Formulates online adaptation via optimal Q-guidance for offline-to-online RL, addressing the inference latency problem of diffusion/flow policies.

entry.title: From Token to Token Pair: Efficient Prompt Compression for Large Language Models in Clinical Prediction

author.name: Mingcheng Zhu, Zhiyao Luo, Yu Liu, Tingting Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes Medical Token-Pair Encoding (MedTPE), a layered tokenization method that compresses EHR sequences for LLM-based clinical prediction without information loss or additional inference cost. Achieves lossless compression by extending standard tokenization for medical data.

entry.title: Online Learning-to-Defer with Varying Experts

author.name: Dang Hoang Duy, Yannis Montreuil, Maxime Meyer, Axel Carlier, Lai Xing Ng, Wei Tsang Ooi

entry.summary: Introduces the first online Learning-to-Defer algorithm for multiclass classification with bandit feedback and dynamically varying expert pools. Achieves sublinear regret guarantees under general and low-noise conditions.

entry.title: An Empirical Study of Automating Agent Evaluation

author.name: Kang Zhou, Sangmin Woo, Haibo Ding, Kiran Ramnath, Subramanian Chidambaram, Aosong Feng, Vinayak Arannil, Muhyun Kim, Ishan Singh, Darren Wang, Zhichao Xu, Megha Gandhi, Nirmal Prabhu, Soumya Smruti Mishra, Vivek Singh, Gouri Pandeshwar, Lin Lee Cheong

entry.summary: Introduces EvalAgent, an AI assistant for automating end-to-end agent evaluation. Shows that simply prompting coding assistants achieves only 30% execution success for evaluation, motivating domain-specific evaluation knowledge encoding.

entry.title: SkillGraph: Skill-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Agents via Evolving Skill Graphs

author.name: Xiaoyuan Li, Moxin Li, Keqin Bao, Yubo Ma, Wenjie Wang, Dayiheng Liu, Fuli Feng

entry.summary: Proposes SkillGraph, representing reusable agent skills as nodes in a directed graph with typed edges encoding prerequisite, enhancement, and co-occurrence relations. Enables structural retrieval and maintenance of skill libraries for LLM agents.

entry.title: Chronicles-OCR: A Cross-Temporal Perception Benchmark for the Evolutionary Trajectory of Chinese Characters

author.name: Gengluo Li, Shangpin Peng, Xingyu Wan, Chengquan Zhang, Hao Feng, Xin Xu, Pian Wu, Bang Li, Zengmao Ding, Yongge Liu, Yipei Ye, Yang Yang, Zhan Shu, Guojun Yan, Zhe Li, Can Ma, Weiping Wang, Yu Zhou, Han Hu

entry.summary: Chronicles-OCR is the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLLMs across the complete evolutionary trajectory of Chinese characters (Seven Chinese Scripts), spanning thousands of years. Tests cross-temporal visual perception capabilities.

entry.title: UniCustom: Unified Visual Conditioning for Multi-Reference Image Generation

author.name: Yiyan Xu, Qiulin Wang, Wenjie Wang, Yunyao Mao, Xintao Wang, Pengfei Wan, Kun Gai, Fuli Feng

entry.summary: UniCustom addresses multi-reference image generation by unifying visual conditioning: instead of separating semantic ViT and appearance VAE features, it integrates them so the model can correctly associate subjects with their reference appearances.

entry.title: Skill Drift Is Contract Violation: Proactive Maintenance for LLM Agent Skill Libraries

author.name: Linfeng Fan, Yuan Tian, Ziwei Li, Zhiwu Lu

entry.summary: Formulates skill drift in LLM agent skill libraries as contract violation, extracting executable environment contracts from skill documents and validating role-bearing assumptions against live conditions for precision maintenance.

entry.title: BARISTA: A Multi-Task Egocentric Benchmark for Compositional Visual Understanding

author.name: Patrick Knab, Orgest Xhelili, Inis Buzi, Drago Andres Guggiana Nilo, Mohd Saquib Khan, Lorenz Kolb, Manuel Scherzer, Kerem Yildirir, Christian Bartelt, Philipp Johannes Schubert

entry.summary: BARISTA is a densely annotated egocentric benchmark of 185 coffee-preparation videos with per-frame scene graphs, covering object localization, hand-object interactions, relational parsing, and procedural inference in a unified evaluation.

entry.title: DiffSegLung: Diffusion Radiomic Distillation for Unsupervised Lung Pathology Segmentation

author.name: Rezkellah Noureddine Khiati, Pierre-Yves Brillet, Catalin Fetita

entry.summary: DiffSegLung introduces Diffusion Radiomic Distillation for unsupervised lung pathology segmentation, using handcrafted radiomic descriptors as physics-grounded teacher for contrastive learning in a 3D diffusion U-Net.

entry.title: RankQ: Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning via Self-Supervised Action Ranking

author.name: Andrew Choi, Wei Xu

entry.summary: Proposes RankQ, an offline-to-online RL method that uses a self-supervised ranking loss to structure Q-values, avoiding both value overestimation and excessive behavior cloning. This addresses the tension between pessimism needed offline and exploration needed online.

entry.title: Engagement Process: Rethinking the Temporal Interface of Action and Observation

author.name: Jialian Li, Yuchen Cao, Junhong Liu, Weiran Guo, Xutao Wang, Jiaming Song, Jiahao Zhang, Jie Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Engagement Process (EP), an interaction formalism that extends POMDPs by making time explicit in the action-observation interface, representing actions and observations as decoupled event streams. Captures deliberation latency, delayed feedback, and persistent actions.

entry.title: GAR: Carbon-Aware Routing for LLM Inference via Constrained Optimization

author.name: Disha Sheshanarayana, Rajat Subhra Pal, Manjira Sinha, Tirthankar Dasgupta

entry.summary: Introduces Green-Aware Routing (GAR), a constrained optimization framework for LLM inference that minimizes per-request CO2 emissions while maintaining accuracy and latency SLOs. Accounts for time-varying grid carbon intensity and model energy differences.

entry.title: Rethinking Positional Encoding for Neural Vehicle Routing

author.name: Chuanbo Hua, Federico Berto, Andre Hottung, Nayeli Gast Zepeda, Yining Ma, Zihan Ma, Paula Wong-Chung, Changhyun Kwon, Cathy Wu, Kevin Tierney, Jinkyoo Park

entry.summary: Formalizes three structural properties for positional encoding in neural vehicle routing (anisometric distances, cyclic topology, hierarchical depot structure) and proposes routing-aware PE designs satisfying these properties.

entry.title: Counterfactual Trace Auditing of LLM Agent Skills

author.name: Xiaolin Zhou, Jinbo Liu, Li Li, Ryan A. Rossi, Xiyang Hu

entry.summary: Introduces Counterfactual Trace Auditing (CTA) for measuring how agent skills change behavior, pairing with-skill and without-skill traces to emit structured Skill Influence Pattern annotations describing behavioral rather than just outcome effects.

entry.title: OmniRefine: Alignment-Aware Cooperative Compression for Efficient Omnimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Yuchen Deng, Zidang Cai, Hai-Tao Zheng, Jie Wang, Feidiao Yang, Yuxing Han

entry.summary: Proposes OmniRefine, a training-free two-stage framework for compressing audio-visual tokens in omnimodal LLMs. Uses correspondence-preserving chunk refinement and cooperative compression to maintain cross-modal alignment while reducing inference cost.

entry.title: ToolCUA: Towards Optimal GUI-Tool Path Orchestration for Computer Use Agents

author.name: Xuhao Hu, Xi Zhang, Haiyang Xu, Kyle Qiao, Jingyi Yang, Xuanjing Huang, Jing Shao, Ming Yan, Jieping Ye

entry.summary: Proposes ToolCUA for learning optimal GUI-Tool path selection in computer use agents through staged training. Introduces an interleaved GUI-Tool trajectory scaling pipeline to address scarcity of high-quality training data.

entry.title: MMTB: Evaluating Terminal Agents on Multimedia-File Tasks

author.name: Chiyeong Heo, Jaechang Kim, Junhyuk Kwon, Hoyoung Kim, Dongmin Park, Jonghyun Lee, Jungseul Ok

entry.summary: Introduces MMTB (MultiMedia-TerminalBench), a benchmark of 105 tasks evaluating terminal agents on multimedia file operations (audio/video), requiring agents to understand content and convert evidence into appropriate actions.

entry.title: PASA: A Principled Embedding-Space Watermarking Approach for LLM-Generated Text under Semantic-Invariant Attacks

author.name: Zhenxin Ai, Haiyun He

entry.summary: Proposes PASA, a watermarking algorithm for LLM-generated text that operates on semantic clusters in latent embedding space, making it robust to paraphrasing attacks while remaining distortion-free.

entry.title: An Executable Benchmarking Suite for Tool-Using Agents

author.name: Zhiqing Zhong, Zhijing Ye, Jiamin Wang, Xiaodong Yu

entry.summary: Presents a benchmarking suite for tool-using agents that makes evaluation components explicit (workloads, drivers, evidence contracts). Connects WebArena, SWE-Gym, and MiniWoB++ through common infrastructure.

entry.title: Control Charts for Multi-agent Systems

author.name: Hayden Helm, Carey Priebe, Brandon Duderstadt

entry.summary: Extends adaptive control charts to multi-agent systems for automated monitoring. Shows these are necessary for learning agents and vulnerable to adversarial defection strategies.

entry.title: Oversmoothing as Representation Degeneracy in Neural Sheaf Diffusion

author.name: Arif D\"onmez, Axel Mosig, Ellen Fritsche, Katharina Koch

entry.summary: Develops a quiver-theoretic interpretation of Neural Sheaf Diffusion, showing that oversmoothing corresponds to representation degeneracy via direct-sum decompositions of incidence-quiver representations.

entry.title: Beyond Similarity Search: Tenure and the Case for Structured Belief State in LLM Memory

author.name: Jeffrey Flynt

entry.summary: Argues cross-session LLM memory is a state management problem, not a search problem. Presents Tenure, a local-first proxy maintaining structured belief state instead of similarity-based retrieval.

entry.title: LPDP: Inference-Time Reward Control for Variable-Length DNA Generation with Edit Flows

author.name: Jeongchan Kim, Yunkyung Ko, Jong Chul Ye

entry.summary: LPDP applies Edit Flows for inference-time reward-guided variable-length DNA generation using biologically plausible operations (insertion, deletion, substitution). Training-free local optimization approach.

entry.title: TRACE: Temporal Routing with Autoregressive Cross-channel Experts for EEG Representation Learning

author.name: Fan Ma, Qier An, Peng Chen, Lingfei Qian, Xiang Lan, Mingyang Jiang, Zhiling Gu, Xenophon Papademetris, Hua Xu

entry.summary: TRACE proposes autoregressive EEG pre-training with temporally adaptive cross-channel expert routing. Derives routing decisions from causal cross-channel history for adaptive computation.

entry.title: Digital Identity for Agentic Systems: Toward a Portable Authorization Standard for Autonomous Agents

author.name: Partha Madhira

entry.summary: Proposes a portable authorization standard for autonomous AI agents in enterprise settings. Defines typed constraint algebra and decision-consistent evaluation semantics for agent identity and authority.

entry.title: EpiCastBench: Datasets and Benchmarks for Multivariate Epidemic Forecasting

author.name: Madhurima Panja, Danny D'Agostino, Huitao Li, Tanujit Chakraborty, Nan Liu

entry.summary: Presents EpiCastBench, a benchmarking framework with 40 curated multivariate epidemic datasets spanning multiple diseases and regions, for evaluating epidemic forecasting models.

entry.title: Focusable Monocular Depth Estimation

author.name: Yuxin Du, Tao Lin, Zile Zhong, Runting Li, Xiyao Chen, Jiting Liu, Chenglin Liu, Ying-Cong Chen, Yuqian Fu, Bo Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces Focusable Monocular Depth Estimation (FDE), allowing users to specify target regions via prompts for prioritized depth accuracy, with a Multi-scale Fusion module.

entry.title: CR^2: Cost-Aware Risk-Controlled Routing for Wireless Device-Edge LLM Inference

author.name: Nan Xue, Shengkang Chen, Zhiyong Chen, Jiangchao Yao, Yaping Sun, Zixia Hu, Meixia Tao

entry.summary: Proposes CR^2, a cost-aware risk-controlled routing framework for device-edge LLM inference in wireless settings, balancing latency, energy, and accuracy constraints.

entry.title: Efficient and Adaptive Human Activity Recognition via LLM Backbones

author.name: Aleksandr Bredikhin, Philippe Lalanda, German Vega

entry.summary: Proposes using pre-trained LLMs as temporal backbones for sensor-based human activity recognition, bridging the modality gap between inertial time series and text.

entry.title: Anomaly-Aware Vision-Language Adapters for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection

author.name: Muhammad Aqeel, Maham Nazir, Uzair Khan, Marco Cristani, Francesco Setti

entry.summary: Proposes AVA-DINO for zero-shot anomaly detection with dual specialized branches for normal vs anomalous patterns, adapting frozen DINOv3 features with text-guided routing and achieving state-of-the-art results.

entry.title: Pretraining Strategies and Scaling for ECG Foundation Models: A Systematic Study

author.name: M A Al-Masud, Nils Strodthoff

entry.summary: Systematic study of pretraining strategies for ECG foundation models, comparing 5 self-supervised objectives and investigating scaling behavior up to 11M samples from public sources.

entry.title: KAN-CL: Per-Knot Importance Regularization for Continual Learning with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

author.name: Minjong Cheon

entry.summary: Proposes KAN-CL, leveraging Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks' spline parameterization for continual learning with per-knot importance regularization, achieving 88-93% forgetting reduction over baselines on Split-CIFAR tasks.

entry.title: A Switching System Theory of Q-Learning with Linear Function Approximation

author.name: Donghwan Lee, Han-Dong Lim

entry.summary: Develops a switching-system interpretation of Q-learning with linear function approximation based on joint spectral radius, connecting convergence to stability of switched systems.

entry.title: Steerable Neural ODEs on Homogeneous Spaces

author.name: Emma Andersdotter, Daniel Persson, Fredrik Ohlsson

entry.summary: Introduces steerable neural ODEs on homogeneous spaces that transport features as sections of associated vector bundles, ensuring G-equivariance through invariant vector fields and connections.

entry.title: COSMOS: Model-Agnostic Personalized Federated Learning with Clustered Server Models and Pseudo-Label-Only Communication

author.name: Ben Rachmut, Luise Ge, William Yeoh, Ning Zhang, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik

entry.summary: Introduces COSMOS, a model-agnostic federated learning framework handling both architectural and statistical heterogeneity through server-side clustering of clients by prediction similarity on public data.

entry.title: DeconDTN-Toolkit: A Library for Evaluation and Enhancement of Robustness to Provenance Shift

author.name: Yongsen Tan, Zhecheng Sheng, Xiruo Ding, Serguei V. S. Pakhomov, Trevor Cohen

entry.summary: Introduces DeconDTN-Toolkit for evaluating and remediating provenance shift (where data source-label relationships change at deployment), establishing connections to counterfactual invariance and invariant learning.

entry.title: Quotient-Categorical Representations for Bellman-Compatible Average-Reward Distributional Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ege C. Kaya, Aliasghar Pourghani, Vijay Gupta, Abolfazl Hashemi

entry.summary: Introduces quotient-space formulation for average-reward distributional RL that handles the inherent translation ambiguity in bias estimation, with a categorical parameterization and convergence guarantees.

entry.title: OverNaN: NaN-Aware Oversampling for Imbalanced Learning with Meaningful Missingness

author.name: Amanda S Barnard

entry.summary: OverNaN extends oversampling methods to handle missing values directly by treating missingness as informative structure rather than a defect, operating on incomplete feature vectors without imputation.

entry.title: Primal-Dual Policy Optimization for Linear CMDPs with Adversarial Losses

author.name: Kihyun Yu, Seoungbin Bae, Dabeen Lee

entry.summary: Proposes primal-dual policy optimization for adversarial linear constrained MDPs, achieving the first sublinear regret and constraint violation bounds when losses are adversarially chosen and costs are stochastic.

entry.title: Targeted Tests for LLM Reasoning: An Audit-Constrained Protocol

author.name: Hongmin Li

entry.summary: Proposes an audit-constrained protocol for evaluating LLM reasoning, where prompt variants are generated from a grammar, rendered deterministically, and counted as errors only after semantic and extraction audit.

entry.title: MIST: Reliable Streaming Decision Trees for Online Class-Incremental Learning via McDiarmid Bound

author.name: Phu-Hoa Pham, Chi-Nguyen Tran, Nguyen Lam Phu Quy, Dao Sy Duy Minh, Huynh Trung Kiet, Long Tran-Thanh

entry.summary: MIST addresses streaming decision trees for online class-incremental learning, identifying that Information Gain's range scales with log2(K) classes, making Hoeffding-style bounds unreliable as class count grows.

entry.title: Unlocking Compositional Generalization in Continual Few-Shot Learning

author.name: Phu-Quy Nguyen-Lam, Phu-Hoa Pham, Dao Sy Duy Minh, Chi-Nguyen Tran, Huynh Trung Kiet, Long Tran-Thanh

entry.summary: Proposes decoupling representation learning from compositional inference for continual few-shot learning, leveraging patch-level semantic geometry from self-supervised models for compositional generalization.

entry.title: Federated Client Selection under Partial Visibility: A POMDP Approach with Spatio-Temporal Attention

author.name: Qijun Hou, Yuchen Shi, Pingyi Fan, Khaled B. Letaief

entry.summary: Formulates federated client selection under partial visibility as a POMDP, using spatio-temporal attention-based RL to handle the realistic constraint that only a subset of clients is observable each round.

entry.title: Stop Marginalizing My Dreams: Model Inversion via Laplace Kernel for Continual Learning

author.name: Patryk Krukowski, Jacek Tabor, Przemys{\l}aw Spurek, Marek \'Smieja, {\L}ukasz Struski

entry.summary: REMIX addresses data-free continual learning by introducing structured full-covariance modeling for feature distributions in model inversion, replacing the limiting diagonal covariance assumption.

entry.title: Understanding Sample Efficiency in Predictive Coding

author.name: Gaspard Oliviers, Elene Lominadze, Rafal Bogacz

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of why Predictive Coding (PC) is more sample-efficient than Backpropagation (BP) by introducing a 'target alignment' metric. Derives analytical expressions for deep linear networks showing PC achieves better alignment, especially with wide hidden layers.

entry.title: Towards Order Fairness: Mitigating LLMs Order Sensitivity through Dual Group Advantage Optimization

author.name: Xu Chu, Guanyu Wang, Zhijie Tan, Xinrong Chen, Ziyu Li, Tong Mo, Weiping Li

entry.summary: Proposes a method to mitigate order bias in LLMs (where performance depends on input arrangement) through Dual Group Advantage Optimization. Unlike prior approaches that either increase inference cost or sacrifice accuracy, this method addresses inherent order bias without these tradeoffs.

entry.title: SOAR: Scale Optimization for Accurate Reconstruction in NVFP4 Quantization

author.name: Chengzhu Bao, Xianglong Yan, Zhiteng Li, Guangshuo Qin, Guanghua Yu, Yulun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SOAR for improving NVFP4 quantization of LLMs through closed-form joint optimization of global and block-wise scales, plus decoupled dequantization scale optimization. Addresses suboptimal scale selection in existing 4-bit microscaling methods.

entry.title: MetaColloc: Optimization-Free PDE Solving via Meta-Learned Basis Functions

author.name: Zichuan Yang

entry.summary: Proposes MetaColloc, an optimization-free PDE solver that meta-trains neural basis functions offline, then solves new PDEs at test time through a single linear least-squares step (or Newton-Raphson for nonlinear PDEs). Eliminates per-equation neural network training.

entry.title: FERA: Uncertainty-Aware Federated Reasoning for Large Language Models

author.name: Ruhan Wang, Chengkai Huang, Zhiyong Wang, Junda Wu, Rui Wang, Tong Yu, Julian McAuley, Lina Yao, Dongruo Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes FERA, a training-free framework for federated reasoning with LLMs that handles uncertainty in client reliability across different queries. Uses iterative server-client collaboration without centralizing data or requiring training.

entry.title: ShardTensor: Domain Parallelism for Scientific Machine Learning

author.name: Corey Adams, Peter Harrington, Akshay Subramaniam, Mohammad Shoaib Abbas, Jaideep Pathak, Mike Pritchard, Sanjay Choudhry

entry.summary: Introduces ShardTensor, a domain parallelism framework for scientific ML that enables scaling input data beyond single-device memory by distributing spatial dimensions. Decouples spatial dimensionality from hardware constraints for arbitrary resolution data.

entry.title: When to Ask a Question: Understanding Communication Strategies in Generative AI Tools

author.name: Charlotte Park, Kate Donahue, Manish Raghavan

entry.summary: Analyzes when AI models should ask clarifying questions vs. infer user intent, formalizing the tradeoff between personalization benefits and querying costs. Shows that under-specification in LLM inputs can privilege majority viewpoints, raising fairness concerns.

entry.title: GeomHerd: A Forward-looking Herding Quantification via Ricci Flow Geometry on Agent Interactive Simulations

author.name: Lake Yang, Junwei Su, Jingfeng Zeng, Wenhao Lu, Xingzhi Qian, Weitong Zhang, Chuan Wu, Dunhong Jin

entry.summary: Proposes GeomHerd, a framework using Ricci flow geometry on agent interaction graphs to quantify financial herding behavior in a forward-looking manner. Uses LLM-driven multi-agent simulations of financial traders to generate interaction graphs, bypassing the observability lag of price-correlation methods.

entry.title: FIS-DiT: Breaking the Few-Step Video Inference Barrier via Training-Free Frame Interleaved Sparsity

author.name: Jian Tang, Jiawei Fan, Qingbin Liu, Zheng Wei

entry.summary: Proposes FIS-DiT, a training-free framework for accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers by exploiting frame-level spatial redundancy rather than temporal trajectory redundancy. Addresses diminishing returns of step-wise acceleration in few-step distilled models.

entry.title: Events as Triggers for Behavioral Diversity in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Hannes B\"uchi, Manon Flageat, Eduardo Sebasti\'an, Amanda Prorok

entry.summary: Proposes using events as triggers for behavioral diversity in multi-agent RL, decoupling agent identity from behavior. Events are state changes that induce qualitative task changes, enabling agents to adopt different roles at appropriate moments.

entry.title: Freeze Deep, Train Shallow: Interpretable Layer Allocation for Continued Pre-Training

author.name: Yu-Hang Wu, Qin-Yuan Liu, Qiu-Yang Zhao, Bo Jiang, Jiang-Feng Yang, Qing-Wei Cong

entry.summary: Proposes LayerTracer, an architecture-agnostic framework for diagnosing which layers to freeze or train during continued pre-training. Reveals deep layers are critical for task execution and stable against disruptive updates, recommending 'freeze deep, train shallow' strategy.

entry.title: Do Language Models Encode Knowledge of Linguistic Constraint Violations?

author.name: Hardy, Sebastian Pad\'o

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLMs encode representations of linguistic constraint violations using sparse autoencoders. Introduces a sensitivity score for identifying violation-specific features and proposes methods for unsupervised detection.

entry.title: Unpacking the Eye of the Beholder: Social Location, Identity, and the Moving Target of Political Perspectives

author.name: Elena Sirotkina

entry.summary: Develops a Perspectivist Visual Political Sentiment classifier trained on 82K evaluations from 5,575 adults that predicts how different identity groups will evaluate the same political image, preserving systematic disagreement rather than averaging it away.

entry.title: Lite3R: A Model-Agnostic Framework for Efficient Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Haoyu Zhang, Zeyu Zhang, Zedong Zhou, Yang Zhao, Hao Tang

entry.summary: Proposes Lite3R, a model-agnostic teacher-student framework for efficient 3D reconstruction that replaces dense attention with sparse attention patterns and handles low-precision execution challenges.

entry.title: HamBR: Active Decision Boundary Restoration Based on Hamiltonian Dynamics for Learning with Noisy Labels

author.name: Ningkang Peng, Jingyang Mao, Qianfeng Yu, Xiaoqian Peng, Peirong Ma, Yanhui Gu

entry.summary: Proposes HamBR, using Hamiltonian dynamics for active decision boundary restoration in learning with noisy labels, addressing the boundary collapse problem where models can't distinguish hard clean samples from noisy ones.

entry.title: Leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models for All-in-One Image Restoration via a Mixture of Frequency Experts

author.name: Eunho Lee, Youngbae Hwang, Rei Kawakami

entry.summary: Proposes an MLLM-guided all-in-one image restoration framework using multimodal embeddings as guidance with a mixture of frequency experts for handling composite degradations.

entry.title: A Mimetic Detector for Adversarial Image Perturbations

author.name: Johnny Corbino

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free adversarial perturbation detector using high-order mimetic operators that detects attacks as a property of the input alone in O(HW) time, requiring no retraining or access to the attacked network.

entry.title: PointForward: Feedforward Driving Reconstruction through Point-Aligned Representations

author.name: Cheng Chi, Xianqi Wang, Hongcheng Luo, Mingfei Tu, Gangwei Xu, Zehan Zhang, Bing Wang, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Sida Peng, Xin Yang, Haiyang Sun

entry.summary: Proposes PointForward for feedforward driving scene reconstruction using point-aligned 3D Gaussian Splatting, initializing sparse 3D queries in world space for multi-view consistent dynamic scene reconstruction.

entry.title: Grounding by Remembering: Cross-Scene and In-Scene Memory for 3D Functional Affordances

author.name: Qirui Wang, Jingyi He, Yining Pan, Xulei Yang, Shijie Li

entry.summary: Proposes AFFORDMEM, grounding 3D functional affordances through cross-scene and in-scene geometric memory, maintaining category-level affordance memory banks to guide frozen VLMs toward small operable regions.

entry.title: ScaleMoGen: Autoregressive Next-Scale Prediction for Human Motion Generation

author.name: Inwoo Hwang, Hojun Jang, Bing Zhou, Jian Wang, Young Min Kim, Chuan Guo

entry.summary: Presents ScaleMoGen, a scale-wise autoregressive framework for text-driven human motion generation using coarse-to-fine prediction across skeletal-temporal scales with bitwise quantization.

entry.title: SB-BEVFusion: Enhancing the Robustness against Sensor Malfunction and Corruptions

author.name: Markus Essl, Marta Moscati, Mubashir Noman, Muhammad Zaigham Zaheer, Usman Naseem, Shah Nawaz, Markus Schedl

entry.summary: Proposes a framework-agnostic fusion module for camera-LiDAR BEV fusion that handles missing or corrupted modalities, demonstrating robustness improvements when integrated into BEVFusion.

entry.title: Few-Shot Synthetic Data Generation with Diffusion Models for Downstream Vision Tasks

author.name: Daniil Dushenev, Nazariy Karpov, Daniil Zinovjev, Alexander Gorin, Konstantin Kulikov

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight synthetic data augmentation pipeline using LoRA-finetuned diffusion models on as few as 20-50 real images for rare class generation. Evaluated on chest X-ray pathology and industrial defect detection tasks.

entry.title: 4DVGGT-D: 4D Visual Geometry Transformer with Improved Dynamic Depth Estimation

author.name: Ying Zang, Xuanyi Liu, Yidong Han, Deyi Ji, Chaotao Ding, Yuanqi Hu, Qi Zhu, Xuanfu Li, Jin Ma, Lingyun Sun, Tianrun Chen, Lanyun Zhu

entry.summary: 4DVGGT-D proposes a training-free progressive decoupling framework for dynamic 4D scene reconstruction from monocular video, separating camera ego-motion from object motion through dynamic-mask-guided pose estimation.

entry.title: FuTCR: Future-Targeted Contrast and Repulsion for Continual Panoptic Segmentation

author.name: Nicholas Ikechukwu, Keanu Nichols, Deepti Ghadiyaram, Bryan A. Plummer

entry.summary: FuTCR addresses continual panoptic segmentation by using future-targeted contrast and repulsion to prevent the model from collapsing background categories together, improving later identification of new categories from previously unlabeled objects.

entry.title: Leveraging Non-Equilibrium ECRAM Dynamics for Short-Term Plasticity in Neuromorphic Circuits

author.name: Alex Currie, Sean Borkholder, Nithil Harris Manimaran, Huayuan Han, Cory Merkel, Ke Xu, Tejasvi Das

entry.summary: Transforms non-equilibrium ionic dynamics in ECRAM devices from undesirable variability into a computational resource for short-term plasticity in neuromorphic circuits through device-circuit-system co-design.

entry.title: RIO: Flexible Real-Time Robot I/O for Cross-Embodiment Robot Learning

author.name: Pablo Ortega-Kral, Eliot Xing, Arthur Bucker, Vernon Luk, Junseo Kim, Owen Kwon, Angchen Xie, Nikhil Sobanbabu, Yifu Yuan, Megan Lee, Deepam Ameria, Bhaswanth Ayapilla, Jaycie Bussell, Guanya Shi, Jonathan Francis, Jean Oh

entry.summary: Presents RIO, an open-source Python framework providing flexible, lightweight components for robot control, teleoperation, data formatting, sensor configuration, and policy deployment across diverse hardware platforms. Aims to reduce fragmentation in cross-embodiment robot learning infrastructure.

entry.title: From Reaction to Anticipation: Proactive Failure Recovery through Agentic Task Graph for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Sheng Xu, Ruixing Jin, Huayi Zhou, Bo Yue, Guanren Qiao, Yunxin Tai, Yueci Deng, Kui Jia, Guiliang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces AgentChord, a system that models manipulation tasks as directed task graphs enriched with anticipatory recovery branches before execution. Shifts from reactive failure recovery to proactive planning, enabling immediate corrective responses when failures occur.

entry.title: X-Imitator: Spatial-Aware Imitation Learning via Bidirectional Action-Pose Interaction

author.name: Kai Xiong, Hongjie Fang, Lixin Yang, Cewu Lu

entry.summary: Proposes X-Imitator, a dual-path framework that models spatial perception and action execution as a tightly coupled bidirectional loop for robotic manipulation. Reciprocally conditions pose predictions on past actions and vice versa, mimicking human internal forward/inverse models.

entry.title: Variational predictive resampling

author.name: Laura Battaglia, Stefano Cortinovis, Chris Holmes, David T. Frazier, Jack Jewson

entry.summary: Proposes Variational Predictive Resampling (VPR), a scalable posterior sampling method that exploits variational inference's predictive strength within a predictive-resampling framework. Iteratively imputes future observations from variational predictives and updates the approximation.

entry.title: When should an AI incident trigger an international response? Criteria for international escalation and implications for the design of AI incident frameworks

author.name: Josephine Schwab

entry.summary: Proposes criteria for when AI incidents should trigger international responses, focusing on cross-border coordination needs. Argues for clear definitions of incidents across risk domains and data availability requirements for detection of triggering conditions.

entry.title: Do Enterprise Systems Need Learned World Models? The Importance of Context to Infer Dynamics

author.name: Jishnu Sethumadhavan Nair, Patrice Bechard, Rishabh Maheshwary, Surajit Dasgupta, Sravan Ramachandran, Aakash Bhagat, Shruthan Radhakrishna, Pulkit Pattnaik, Johan Obando-Ceron, Shiva Krishna Reddy Malay, Sagar Davasam, Seganrasan Subramanian, Vipul Mittal, Sridhar Krishna Nemala, Christopher Pal, Srinivas Sunkara, Sai Rajeswar

entry.summary: Questions whether enterprise systems need learned world models when business rules are readable at inference time. Proposes enterprise discovery agents that read configurable transition dynamics at runtime rather than learning them from historical data.

entry.title: No Action Without a NOD: A Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Architecture for Reliable Service Agents

author.name: Zixu Yang, Hang Zheng, Nan Jiang, Zhiyang Tang, Situo Zhang, Xiaobao Wu, Lu Chen, Kai Yu

entry.summary: Proposes NOD (Navigator-Operator-Director), a heterogeneous multi-agent architecture for reliable service agents. Externalizes task state into a structured Global State and introduces selective external oversight before critical actions.

entry.title: Stargazer: A Scalable Model-Fitting Benchmark Environment for AI Agents under Astrophysical Constraints

author.name: Xinge Liu, Terry Jingchen Zhang, Bernhard Sch\"olkopf, Zhijing Jin, Kristen Menou

entry.summary: Introduces Stargazer, a scalable benchmark environment for evaluating AI agents on physics-grounded model-fitting tasks using radial-velocity time series data. Tests 8 frontier agents across 120 tasks including real archival astrophysics cases.

entry.title: Enhancing Multilingual Counterfactual Generation through Alignment-as-Preference Optimization

author.name: Yilong Wang, Qianli Wang, Bohao Chu, Yihong Liu, Jing Yang, Simon Ostermann

entry.summary: Introduces Macro, a preference alignment framework using DPO for multilingual self-generated counterfactual explanations, addressing the validity-minimality trade-off across languages.

entry.title: Rank Is Not Capacity: Spectral Occupancy for Latent Graph Models

author.name: Nikolaos Nakis, Panagiotis Promponas, Konstantinos Tsirkas, Katerina Mamali, Eftychia Makri, Leandros Tassiulas, Nicholas A. Christakis

entry.summary: Proposes Spectra, replacing rank as the unit of analysis for latent graph models with the spectrum of a learned positive semidefinite kernel, providing principled capacity measurement for graph embeddings.

entry.title: Support-Proximity Augmented Diffusion Estimation for Offline Black-Box Optimization

author.name: Yonghan Yang, Ye Yuan, Zipeng Sun, Linfeng Du, Bowei He, Haolun Wu, Can Chen, Xue Liu

entry.summary: SPADE uses conditional diffusion models for forward surrogate modeling in offline black-box optimization, with enhancements to address out-of-distribution extrapolation through support-proximity awareness.

entry.title: Fair Conformal Classification via Learning Representation-Based Groups

author.name: Senrong Xu, Yanke Zhou, Yuhao Tan, Zenan Li, Yuan Yao, Taolue Chen, Feng Xu, Xiaoxing Ma

entry.summary: Introduces a fair conformal prediction framework that constructs prediction sets with conditional coverage guarantees on adaptively identified subgroups, including those defined by nonlinear feature combinations. Balances compactness of prediction sets with equalized coverage.

entry.title: Approximation of Maximally Monotone Operators : A Graph Convergence Perspective

author.name: Takashi Furuya, Yury Korolev, Takaharu Yaguchi

entry.summary: Proposes a paradigm shift in operator learning by using graph convergence (Painlevé-Kuratowski convergence) instead of uniform or Lp approximation for discontinuous/set-valued operators. Proves that maximally monotone operators can be approximated by encoder-decoder architectures in this sense.

entry.title: Vision2Code: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Evaluating Image-to-Code Generation

author.name: Ajay Vikram Periasami, Junlin Wang, Bhuwan Dhingra

entry.summary: Introduces Vision2Code, a reference-code-free benchmark for evaluating VLMs on image-to-code generation across 15 datasets and 6 visual domains. Uses VLM raters with dataset-specific rubrics to score rendered outputs against source images.

entry.title: EPIC: Efficient Predicate-Guided Inference-Time Control for Compositional Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Sunung Mun, Sunghyun Cho, Jungseul Ok

entry.summary: Introduces EPIC, a training-free inference-time framework for compositional text-to-image generation. Parses prompts into visual programs with typed predicates, then verifies generated images against these programs, refining until all predicates are satisfied.

entry.title: OmniThoughtVis: A Scalable Distillation Pipeline for Deployable Multimodal Reasoning Models

author.name: Yuanhao Yue, Chengyu Wang, Yuanjie Lyu, Lei Shen, Jun Huang

entry.summary: Presents OmniThoughtVis, a scalable distillation pipeline for transferring multimodal chain-of-thought reasoning from large teacher models to smaller deployment-oriented MLLMs. Generates structured CoT traces with joint annotation and filtering.

entry.title: Self-Distilled Trajectory-Aware Boltzmann Modeling: Bridging the Training-Inference Discrepancy in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Kecheng Chen, Ziru Liu, Xijia Tao, Hui Liu, Yibing Liu, Xinyu Fu, Shi Wu, Suiyun Zhang, Dandan Tu, Lingpeng Kong, Rui Liu, Haoliang Li

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Distilled Trajectory-Aware Boltzmann Modeling to address training-inference discrepancy in Diffusion Language Models. Bridges the gap between single-step training reconstruction and multi-step inference denoising.

entry.title: Selection, Not Fusion: Radar-Modulated State Space Models for Radar-Camera Depth Estimation

author.name: Zhangcheng Hou, Tomoaki Ohtsuki

entry.summary: Introduces Radar-Modulated Selection (RMS) for radar-camera depth estimation, injecting radar signals directly into Mamba's selective scan mechanism rather than fusing features outside the backbone. This principled approach modulates the state space model's internal dynamics.

entry.title: MoCam: Unified Novel View Synthesis via Structured Denoising Dynamics

author.name: Haofeng Liu, Yang Zhou, Ziheng Wang, Zhengbo Xu, Zhan Peng, Jie Ma, Jun Liang, Shengfeng He, Jing Li

entry.summary: MoCam introduces structured denoising dynamics for novel view synthesis, orchestrating a progression from geometry priors (early stages) to appearance priors (later stages) within the diffusion process.

entry.title: Cross-Modal-Domain Generalization Through Semantically Aligned Discrete Representations

author.name: Souptik Sen, Raneen Younis, Zahra Ahmadi

entry.summary: CoDAAR introduces cross-modal discrete alignment through index-level codebook alignment, preserving modality-specific structures while achieving generalizable cross-modal representations. Resolves the trade-off between generalizability and modality specificity.

entry.title: Revisiting Photometric Ambiguity for Accurate Gaussian-Splatting Surface Reconstruction

author.name: Jiahe Li, Jiawei Zhang, Xiao Bai, Jin Zheng, Xiaohan Yu, Lin Gu, Gim Hee Lee

entry.summary: AmbiSuR addresses photometric ambiguity in Gaussian Splatting surface reconstruction by identifying primitive-wise ambiguities and leveraging intrinsic self-indication potential for disambiguation.

entry.title: 3DGS$^3$: Joint Super Sampling and Frame Interpolation for Real-Time Large-Scale 3DGS Rendering

author.name: Yibo Zhao, Fan Gao, Youcheng Cai, Ligang Liu

entry.summary: 3DGS³ is a post-rendering framework that jointly performs super sampling and frame interpolation for 3DGS, using gradient-aware processing to achieve high-resolution, high-frame-rate rendering without modifying the splatting pipeline.

entry.title: Nautilus: From One Prompt to Plug-and-Play Robot Learning

author.name: Yufeng Jin, Jianfei Guo, Xiaogang Jia, Yu Deng, Zechu Li, Han Liu, Weiran Liao, Vignesh Prasad, Mathias Franzius, Gerhard Neumann, Georgia Chalvatzaki

entry.summary: Proposes NAUTILUS, an open-source harness that turns a single user prompt into ready-to-use robot learning workflows for reproduction, evaluation, fine-tuning, and deployment. Uses distilled procedural priors from robotics research to bridge the gap between coding agents and actual robotics workflows.

entry.title: Goal-Oriented Reasoning for RAG-based Memory in Conversational Agentic LLM Systems

author.name: Jiazhou Liang, Armin Toroghi, Yifan Simon Liu, Faeze Moradi Kalarde, Liam Gallagher, Scott Sanner

entry.summary: Introduces Goal-Mem, a goal-oriented memory retrieval approach for conversational AI agents that reasons about missing intermediate facts rather than relying solely on semantic similarity to raw user utterances.

entry.title: Split the Differences, Pool the Rest: Provably Efficient Multi-Objective Imitation

author.name: Ziyad Sheebaelhamd, Luca Viano, Volkan Cevher, Claire Vernade

entry.summary: Introduces Multi-Output Augmented Behavioral Cloning (MA-BC) for multi-objective imitation learning that partitions divergent expert data while pooling non-conflicting demonstrations. Proves faster convergence than single-expert learners with theoretical Pareto-optimality guarantees.

entry.title: Search Your Block Floating Point Scales!

author.name: Tanmaey Gupta, Hayden Prairie, Xiaoxia Wu, Reyna Abhyankar, Qingyang Wu, Austin Silveria, Pragaash Ponnusamy, Jue Wang, Ben Athiwaratkun, Leon Song, Tri Dao, Daniel Y. Fu, Chris De Sa

entry.summary: Proposes ScaleSearch, an alternative strategy for selecting scale factors in Block Floating Point quantization that searches over mantissa bits to minimize quantization error rather than using the fixed maximum-magnitude scale. Integrates with existing quantization frameworks.

entry.title: Task-Adaptive Embedding Refinement via Test-time LLM Guidance

author.name: Ariel Gera, Shir Ashury-Tahan, Gal Bloch, Ohad Eytan, Assaf Toledo

entry.summary: Explores LLM-guided query refinement for improving embedding model performance on zero-shot tasks. Uses LLM feedback on a small document set to refine query embeddings in real time, achieving up to 25% improvement on challenging benchmarks.

entry.title: RealDiffusion: Physics-informed Attention for Multi-character Storybook Generation

author.name: Qi Zhao, Jun Chen, Ivor Tsang, Guang Dai

entry.summary: RealDiffusion uses physics-informed attention (heat diffusion as dissipative prior) for multi-character storybook generation, addressing the tension between narrative dynamism and character identity coherence across frames.

entry.title: VIP: Visual-guided Prompt Evolution for Efficient Dense Vision-Language Inference

author.name: Hao Zhu, Shuo Jin, Wenbin Liao, Jiayu Xiao, Yan Zhu, Siyue Yu, Feng Dai

entry.summary: VIP introduces visual-guided prompt evolution for training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, moving beyond CLIP to leverage the spatially-aware dino.txt framework. Addresses semantic ambiguity of text queries in dense prediction.

entry.title: GeoQuery: Geometry-Query Diffusion for Sparse-View Reconstruction

author.name: Xiao Cao, Yuze Li, Youmin Zhang, Jiayu Song, Cheng Yan, Wen Li, Lixin Duan

entry.summary: GeoQuery uses explicit geometric guidance from 3DGS to construct reliable query features for diffusion-based sparse-view reconstruction, addressing the failure of multi-view self-attention when rendered views are heavily corrupted.
