entry.title: Black-Box Optimization of Mixed Binary-Continuous Variables: Challenges and Opportunities in Evolutionary Model Merging

author.name: Md. Robiul Islam Niloy

entry.summary: Surveys evolutionary model merging techniques for LLMs, organizing them into parameter-space, data-flow-space, and hybrid categories. Identifies under-specified optimization challenges in data flow space merging.

entry.title: Constraint-Data-Value-Maximization: Utilizing Data Attribution for Effective Data Pruning in Low-Data Environments

author.name: Danilo Brajovic, David A. Kreplin, Marco F. Huber

entry.summary: Introduces Constraint-Data-Value-Maximization (CDVM) for data pruning in low-data environments, showing that Shapley-based data values are suboptimal for this setting. Casts pruning as constrained optimization that maximizes total influence while penalizing redundancy.

entry.title: TOPPO: Rethinking PPO for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning with Critic Balancing

author.name: Yuanpeng Li, Gefei Lin, Annie Qu, Rui Miao

entry.summary: Proposes TOPPO (Tail-Optimized PPO) for multi-task RL, diagnosing that PPO suffers from critic-side gradient ill-conditioning where easy tasks dominate value function updates. Introduces Critic Balancing modules to improve gradient conditioning across tasks.

entry.title: Read, Grep, and Synthesize: Diagnosing Cross-Domain Seed Exposure for LLM Research Ideation

author.name: Yunju Choi, Min Song

entry.summary: Studies whether LLM ideation systems benefit from targeted cross-domain retrieval or simply diverse exposure through PaperGym pipeline. Finds tool-augmented extraction improves specificity and paraphrase-based retrieval broadens coverage, but synthesis results are nuanced.

entry.title: OptArgus: A Multi-Agent System to Detect Hallucinations in LLM-based Optimization Modeling

author.name: Zhong Li, Zihan Guo, Xiaohan Lu, Juntao Wang, Jie Song, Chao Shen, Jiageng Wu, Mingyang Sun

entry.summary: Introduces OptArgus, a multi-agent system for detecting hallucinations in LLM-based optimization modeling. Develops a fine-grained hallucination taxonomy for optimization (objective, variable, constraint, implementation failures) and performs structural consistency auditing.

entry.title: Autonomy and Agency in Agentic AI: Architectural Tactics for Regulated Contexts

author.name: Damir Safin, Dian Balta

entry.summary: Introduces a two-dimensional design space (agency × autonomy) with five ordered levels for deploying agentic AI in regulated contexts. Provides architectural tactics for balancing system capabilities with human oversight requirements.

entry.title: Large Language Models as Amortized Pareto-Front Generators for Constrained Bi-Objective Convex Optimization

author.name: Peipei Xu, SiYuan Ma, Yaohua Liu, Yu Wu, Guanliang Liu, Yang Zhang, Yong Liu

entry.summary: Introduces DIPS, a framework that fine-tunes LLMs as amortized Pareto-front generators for constrained bi-objective convex optimization. Given a textual problem description, it directly outputs feasible continuous decision vectors approximating the Pareto front.

entry.title: $\xi$-DPO: Direct Preference Optimization via Ratio Reward Margin

author.name: Zhengyuan Fan, Zhonghua Wu, Yuxuan Du, Qun Chen

entry.summary: Proposes ξ-DPO, a reference-free preference optimization method that addresses the hyperparameter coupling issue in SimPO through ratio reward margin formulation. Shows β controls sample filtering and γ's effect depends on reward gap structure.

entry.title: MambaNetBurst: Direct Byte-level Network Traffic Classification without Tokenization or Pretraining

author.name: Gayan K. Kulatilleke, Siamak Layeghy, Mahsa Baktashmotlagh, Marius Portmann

entry.summary: MambaNetBurst applies Mamba-2 architecture directly to raw packet bytes for network traffic classification without tokenization or pretraining. Achieves competitive results across six benchmarks with a compact model.

entry.title: Adversarial SQL Injection Generation with LLM-Based Architectures

author.name: Ali Karakoc, H. Birkan Yilmaz

entry.summary: Introduces two LLM-based systems (RADAGAS and RefleXQLi) for generating adversarial SQL injection attacks to test web application firewalls. Tests against 10 WAFs.

entry.title: LiBaGS: Lightweight Boundary Gap Synthesis for Targeted Synthetic Data Selection

author.name: Abhishek Moturu, Anna Goldenberg, Babak Taati

entry.summary: LiBaGS selects synthetic training data by scoring candidates on decision-boundary proximity, uncertainty, and real-data density. Targets sparse boundary neighborhoods rather than adding random synthetic data.

entry.title: NexOP: Joint Optimization of NEX-Aware k-space Sampling and Image Reconstruction for Low-Field MRI

author.name: Tal Oved, Efrat Shimron

entry.summary: Introduces NexOP, a deep learning framework for jointly optimizing sampling patterns and reconstruction across multiple signal acquisitions (NEX) in low-field MRI, exploiting the NEX dimension for acceleration.

entry.title: REFNet++: Multi-Task Efficient Fusion of Camera and Radar Sensor Data in Bird's-Eye Polar View

author.name: Kavin Chandrasekaran, Sorin Grigorescu, Gijs Dubbelman, Pavol Jancura

entry.summary: Proposes REFNet++ for multi-task camera-radar fusion in bird's-eye polar view, using variational encoder-decoder to align range-Doppler radar spectrum with camera images.

entry.title: Spectral Vision Transformer for Efficient Tokenization with Limited Data

author.name: Alexandra G. Roberts, Maneesh John, Jinwei Zhang, Dominick Romano, Mert Sisman, Ki Sueng Choi, Heejong Kim, Mert R. Sabuncu, Thanh D. Nguyen, Alexey V. Dimov, Pascal Spincemaille, Brian H. Kopell, Yi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a spectral vision transformer that tokenizes images in the frequency domain rather than spatial patches, offering theoretical guarantees like spatial invariance and optimal SNR. Targets medical imaging scenarios with limited data and reduced parameters.

entry.title: Set-Aggregated Genome Embeddings for Microbiome Abundance Prediction

author.name: Younhun Kim, Georg K. Gerber, Travis E. Gibson

entry.summary: Uses set-aggregated genome embeddings (SAGE) with genomic language models to predict microbial community abundance profiles, exploiting few-shot learning capabilities of GLMs for novel genome generalization.

entry.title: Manifold Sampling via Entropy Maximization

author.name: Cornelius V. Braun, Tilman Burghoff, Marc Toussaint

entry.summary: Proposes MASEM for sampling on manifolds with unknown disconnected components defined by smooth constraints, using entropy maximization with k-nearest-neighbor estimation and resampling.

entry.title: Finite Volume-Informed Neural Network Framework for 2D Shallow Water Equations: Rugged Loss Landscapes and the Importance of Data Guidance

author.name: Xiaofeng Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Data-Guided FVM-PINN, replacing the strong-form PDE residual in PINNs with a differentiable finite-volume loss on unstructured meshes for shallow water equations. Shows physics-only training often fails.

entry.title: FastUMAP: Scalable Dimensionality Reduction via Bipartite Landmark Sampling

author.name: Hongmin Li

entry.summary: FastUMAP accelerates UMAP through landmark-based bipartite graph construction and Nyström spectral warm start, providing tunable runtime-fidelity tradeoff via landmark ratio on datasets up to 70K samples.

entry.title: Robust Multi-Agent Path Finding under Observation Attacks: A Principled Adversarial-Plus-Smoothing Training Recipe

author.name: Riad Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes adversarial training recipes (Adv-PPO) for decentralized multi-agent path finding that maintain robustness under observation perturbations, preventing cascading failures where one agent's perturbed action blocks neighbors.

entry.title: EqOD: Symmetry-Informed Stability Selection for PDE Identification

author.name: Gnankan Landry Regis N'guessan, Bum Jun Kim

entry.summary: EqOD combines Galilean invariance detection with stability selection for PDE identification, automatically reducing candidate libraries when symmetries are detected from trajectory data.

entry.title: Partial Model Sharing Improves Byzantine Resilience in Federated Conformal Prediction

author.name: Ehsan Lari, Reza Arablouei, Stefan Werner

entry.summary: Proposes Byzantine-resilient federated conformal prediction that protects both training and calibration phases through partial model sharing and histogram-based Byzantine detection.

entry.title: Decomposing the Generalization Gap in PROTAC Activity Prediction: Variance Attribution and the Inter-Laboratory Ceiling

author.name: Thor Klamt, Wolfgang Nejdl, Ming Tang

entry.summary: Decomposes the generalization gap in PROTAC activity prediction between random-split and leave-one-target-out evaluation, identifying inter-laboratory measurement variance as a fundamental ceiling.

entry.title: NOFE -- Neural Operator Function Embedding

author.name: Lars Uebbing, Harald L. Joakimsen, Siyan Chen, Georgios Leontidis, Kristoffer K. Wickstr{\o}m, Michael C. Kampffmeyer, S\'ebastien Lef\`evre, Arnt-B{\o}rre Salberg, Robert Jenssen

entry.summary: Introduces Neural Operator Function Embedding (NOFE), a framework for continuous dimensionality reduction that learns function-to-function mappings via Graph Kernel Operators, enabling mesh-free evaluation. Establishes theoretical connection to sheaf-to-sheaf mappings and outperforms PCA, t-SNE, and UMAP on local structure preservation.

entry.title: Resilient Vision-Tabular Multimodal Learning under Modality Missingness

author.name: Camillo Maria Caruso, Valerio Guarrasi, Paolo Soda

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal transformer framework for joint vision-tabular learning in medical settings that handles pervasive modality missingness without imputation or heuristic model switching. Integrates vision, tabular, and fusion encoders with weighted unimodal representations.

entry.title: A Unified Graph Language Model for Multi-Domain Multi-Task Graph Alignment Instruction Tuning

author.name: Haibo Chen, Xin Wang, Jiaheng Chao, Ling Feng, Wenwu Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a unified graph language model that aligns GNN-encoded representations across multiple domains and tasks with LLM token space, addressing the gap where existing GLMs fail to generalize across diverse graph data.

entry.title: ORCE: Order-Aware Alignment of Verbalized Confidence in Large Language Models

author.name: Chen Li, Xiaoling Hu, Songzhu Zheng, Jiawei Zhou, Chao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes ORCE, a decoupled order-aware framework for verbalized confidence calibration in LLMs. Generates answers first, then estimates confidence separately with order-aware alignment, avoiding interference between answer accuracy and confidence calibration.

entry.title: Interpretable rainfall modelling reveals rapid reorganisation of Amazonian rainfall under vegetation loss

author.name: Lilly Horvath-Makkos, Fayyaz Minhas

entry.summary: Uses an interpretable neural network for hourly rainfall prediction to reveal how vegetation loss reorganizes Amazonian rainfall. Combines pathway diagnostics and sensitivity analyses to identify causal effects of deforestation on precipitation patterns.

entry.title: Adaptive Policy Learning Under Unknown Network Interference

author.name: Aidan Gleich, Eric Laber, Alexander Volfovsky

entry.summary: Develops a Thompson sampling algorithm for adaptive experimentation that jointly learns the interference network between units and optimizes treatment allocations. Returns both an optimized treatment policy and interference network estimate.

entry.title: Beyond Manual Curation: Augmenting Targeted Protein Degradation Databases via Agentic Literature Extraction Workflows

author.name: Yaochen Rao, Farzaneh Jalalypour, N. M. Anoop Krishnan, Roc\'io Mercado

entry.summary: Introduces an agentic LLM workflow for extracting targeted protein degradation (TPD) data from scientific literature, addressing the bottleneck of manual database curation. Handles compound identifiers, assay contexts, and multi-section information extraction.

entry.title: Post-ADC Inference: Valid Inference After Active Data Collection

author.name: Shuichi Nishino, Tomohiro Shiraishi, Teruyuki Katsuoka, Ichiro Takeuchi

entry.summary: Addresses the problem of valid statistical inference when data has been collected through active data collection methods like Bayesian optimization (TPE, GP-UCB). Proposes methods to correct for adaptive sampling bias when the inferential target is constructed post-hoc. Important for making sequential optimization results statistically rigorous.

entry.title: Model-based Bootstrap of Controlled Markov Chains

author.name: Ziwei Su, Imon Banerjee, Diego Klabjan

entry.summary: Proposes and analyzes model-based bootstrap for transition kernels in finite controlled Markov chains with possibly nonstationary policies, applicable to offline RL. Establishes distributional consistency in both long-chain and episodic regimes.

entry.title: ORBIT: Preserving Foundational Language Capabilities in GenRetrieval via Origin-Regulated Merging

author.name: Neha Verma, Nikhil Mehta, Shao-Chuan Wang, Naijing Zhang, Alicia Tsai, Li Wei, Lukasz Heldt, Lichan Hong, Ed Chi, Xinyang Yi

entry.summary: Proposes ORBIT, a method to preserve foundational language capabilities during Generative Retrieval fine-tuning by tracking and constraining the distance between fine-tuned and original model weights. Addresses catastrophic forgetting in GenRetrieval.

entry.title: Ada-MK: Adaptive MegaKernel Optimization via Automated DAG-based Search for LLM Inference

author.name: Wenxin Dong, Mingqing Hu, Guanghui Yu, Qiang Fu, Peng Xu, Hui Xu, Yue Xing, Xuewu Jiao, Shuanglong Li, Lin Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Ada-MK, an automated DAG-based search framework for MegaKernel optimization that addresses the portability-efficiency tension for LLM inference on resource-constrained GPUs. Targets millisecond-range latency for online advertising systems.

entry.title: Safety-Oriented Evaluation of Language Understanding Systems for Air Traffic Control

author.name: Yujing Chang, Yash Guleria, Duc-Thinh Pham, Nhut-Huy Pham, Ningli Wang, Vu N. Duong, Sameer Alam

entry.summary: Proposes a safety-oriented, consequence-aware evaluation framework for LLM-based language understanding in Air Traffic Control. Reveals that high aggregate accuracy masks dangerous semantic errors like incorrect runway identifiers.

entry.title: Overview of the MedHopQA track at BioCreative IX: track description, participation and evaluation of systems for multi-hop medical question answering

author.name: Rezarta Islamaj, Joey Chan, Robert Leaman, Jongmyung Jung, Hyeongsoon Hwang, Quoc-An Nguyen, Hoang-Quynh Le, Harikrishnan Gurushankar Saisudha, Ganesh Chandrasekar, Rustam R. Taktashov, Nadezhda Yu. Bizyukova, Sofia I. R. Concei\c{c}\~ao, Paulo R. C. Lopes, Reem Abdel Salam, Mary Adewunmi, Zhiyong Lu

entry.summary: Overview of the BioCreative IX MedHopQA shared task benchmarking multi-hop reasoning for LLMs in the biomedical domain, with 1,000 QA pairs requiring two-hop reasoning across Wikipedia pages, attracting 48 submissions from 13 teams.

entry.title: ZeroIDIR: Zero-Reference Illumination Degradation Image Restoration with Perturbed Consistency Diffusion Models

author.name: Hai Jiang, Zhen Liu, Yinjie Lei, Songchen Han, Bing Zeng, Shuaicheng Liu

entry.summary: Proposes ZeroIDIR, a zero-reference diffusion framework for illumination degradation restoration that trains solely on degraded images, combining adaptive gamma correction with diffusion reconstruction.

entry.title: Deep Probabilistic Unfolding for Quantized Compressive Sensing

author.name: Gang Qu, Ping Wang, Siming Zheng, Xin Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes deep probabilistic unfolding for quantized compressive sensing with a closed-form likelihood gradient projection and dual-domain Mamba module for feature fusion.

entry.title: PoseBridge: Bridging the Skeletonization Gap for Zero-Shot Skeleton-Based Action Recognition

author.name: Sanghyeon Lee, Jinwoo Kim, Jong Taek Lee

entry.summary: Proposes PoseBridge for zero-shot skeleton-based action recognition that bridges HPE intermediate representations to skeleton-text alignment, recovering semantic cues lost during skeletonization.

entry.title: GeoR-Bench: Evaluating Geoscience Visual Reasoning

author.name: Yushuo Zheng, Zicheng Zhang, Huiyu Duan, Chunyi Li, Zijian Chen, Ziheng Jia, Yue Shi, Ke Gu, Xiongkuo Min, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: Introduces GeoR-Bench for evaluating geoscience visual reasoning in AI systems, addressing the gap between task-specific benchmarks and open-ended real-world geoscience problems.

entry.title: ShapeCodeBench: A Renewable Benchmark for Perception-to-Program Reconstruction of Synthetic Shape Scenes

author.name: Shivam Kumar

entry.summary: Introduces ShapeCodeBench, a renewable benchmark for perception-to-program reconstruction where models must emit executable drawing programs from rendered images. Evaluates Claude Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5.

entry.title: M$^4$-SAM: Multi-Modal Mixture-of-Experts with Memory-Augmented SAM for RGB-D Video Salient Object Detection

author.name: Jiyuan Liu, Jia Lin, Xiaofei Zhou, Runmin Cong, Deyang Liu, Zhi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes M4-SAM, extending SAM2 for RGB-D video salient object detection with Modality-Aware MoE-LoRA, hierarchical feature fusion, and prompt-free memory initialization.

entry.title: Mitigating Action-Relation Hallucinations in LVLMs via Relation-aware Visual Enhancement

author.name: Zhenxin Qin, Qiang Li, Qingzhuo Wang, Ruiyang Qin, Zhihua Wei, Wen Shen

entry.summary: Proposes a framework to mitigate action-relation hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models by locating action-relevant image regions and enhancing attention to them. The key insight is that insufficient visual attention is the primary cause of these hallucinations. Introduces an Action-Relation Sensitivity metric for systematic evaluation.

entry.title: Optimizing 4D Wires for Sparse 3D Abstraction

author.name: Dong-Yi Wu, Tong-Yee Lee

entry.summary: Presents a unified framework for 3D geometric abstraction using a single continuous 4D wire (B-spline with spatial coordinates and variable width). Transforms 3D sketching from local density accumulation to a global routing problem.

entry.title: Learning Ego-Centric BEV Representations from a Perspective-Privileged View: Cross-View Supervision for Online HD Map Construction

author.name: Daniel Lengerer, Mathias Pechinger, Klaus Bogenberger, Carsten Markgraf

entry.summary: Cross-View Supervision (CVS) transfers geometric and topological priors from overhead perspective into camera-based BEV encoders for HD map construction, aligning representations in shared BEV feature space.

entry.title: EgoEV-HandPose: Egocentric 3D Hand Pose Estimation and Gesture Recognition with Stereo Event Cameras

author.name: Luming Wang, Hao Shi, Jiajun Zhai, Kailun Yang, Kaiwei Wang

entry.summary: EgoEV-HandPose proposes end-to-end framework for 3D bimanual pose estimation from stereo event cameras, introducing KeypointBEV for stereo fusion and providing a large-scale stereo event dataset.

entry.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Efficient Retrospective Dynamic Scene Novel View Synthesis with a Standardized Benchmark

author.name: Yunxiao Zhang, Suryansh Kumar

entry.summary: Argues that in synchronized multi-view sports settings, per-frame 3DGS without explicit temporal coupling is sufficient for dynamic scene novel view synthesis. Provides standardized benchmark for retrospective NVS.

entry.title: On the Impact of Crossover in Many-Objective Optimization: A Runtime Analysis of NSGA-III

author.name: Andre Opris

entry.summary: Provides theoretical runtime analysis of NSGA-III with crossover on the m-objective OneJumpZeroJump function, demonstrating asymptotic speedups from crossover in many-objective optimization.

entry.title: Forecast-aware Gaussian Splatting for Predictive 3D Representation in Language-Guided Pick-and-Place Manipulation

author.name: Kaixin Jia, Jiacheng Xu

entry.summary: Introduces Forecast-GS, a predictive 3D representation framework using Gaussian Splatting that models the task-completed state for language-conditioned robotic manipulation. Unlike existing systems that only reason over the current scene, this approach evaluates whether candidate actions lead to feasible task-consistent outcomes. Validated on real-world pick-and-place tasks.

entry.title: LLM-X: A Scalable Negotiation-Oriented Exchange for Communication Among Personal LLM Agents

author.name: Giuliano Lorenzoni (University of Waterloo), Paulo Alencar (University of Waterloo), Donald Cowan (University of Waterloo)

entry.summary: Proposes LLM-X, a scalable negotiation-oriented exchange enabling direct LLM-to-LLM coordination with typed message protocols, federated gateways, and policy enforcement. First empirical evaluation of LLM-based multi-agent negotiation at scale.

entry.title: Optimal LTLf Synthesis

author.name: Yujian Cao, Sven Schewe, Qiyi Tang, Shufang Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces optimal LTLf synthesis for multi-objective specifications that may not be jointly realizable. Proposes max-guarantee synthesis (a priori guarantees), max-observation synthesis (a posteriori maximization), and incremental variants.

entry.title: OOM-Free Alpamayo via CPU-GPU Memory Swapping for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Seungwoo Roh, Huiyeong Kim, Jong-Chan Kim

entry.summary: Presents a CPU-GPU memory swapping framework for Vision-Language-Action models in autonomous driving, reducing VRAM requirements from 20-60GB to commodity GPU levels through sequential layering, pipelined transfers, and GPU-resident layer policies.

entry.title: Automated Reformulation of Robust Optimization via Memory-Augmented Large Language Models

author.name: Jinbiao Chen, Shuang Jin, Guoyun Zhang, Junyu Zhang, Guanyi Wang, Hanzhang Qin

entry.summary: Introduces AutoRO-Bench for evaluating LLM-based robust optimization reformulation, with an automated data generation pipeline. Also develops a memory-augmented LLM approach for the multi-step reasoning required in RO reformulation.

entry.title: Intermediate Artifacts as First-Class Citizens: A Data Model for Durable Intermediate Artifacts in Agentic Systems

author.name: Josh Rosen, Seth Rosen

entry.summary: Argues for treating intermediate artifacts in agentic AI systems as first-class citizens - typed, structured, versioned, and dependency-aware work products rather than ephemeral state. Proposes a data model for durable intermediate artifacts.

entry.title: MultiSoc-4D: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Instruction-Induced Label Collapse in Closed-Set LLM Annotation of Bengali Social Media

author.name: Souvik Pramanik, S. M. Riaz Rahman Antu, Shak Mohammad Abyad, Md. Ibrahim Khalil, Md. Shahriar Hussain

entry.summary: Presents MultiSoc-4D, a Bengali social media benchmark revealing 'instruction-induced label collapse' where LLMs systematically prefer certain labels when annotating in low-resource languages, even with explicit closed-set instructions.

entry.title: AlphaEarth Satellite Embeddings for Modelling Climate Sensitive Diseases Towards Global Health Resilience

author.name: Usman Nazir, I-Han Cheng, Sara Khalid

entry.summary: Evaluates AlphaEarth satellite embeddings as predictors of population health outcomes (malaria, respiratory infection, undernutrition) across multiple countries, finding them useful as scalable complements to traditional health surveillance.

entry.title: When and How to Canonize: A Generalization Perspective

author.name: Yonatan Sverdlov, Benjamin Friedman, Snir Hordan, Nadav Dym

entry.summary: Introduces theoretical framework analyzing generalization of canonized models vs invariant architectures vs group averaging, establishing that canonized models' error bounds are between invariant models (best case) and non-invariant baselines (worst case).

entry.title: Newton's Lantern: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Finetuning AC Power Flow Warm Start Models

author.name: Shourya Bose, Helgi Hilmarsson, Dhruv Suri

entry.summary: Newton's Lantern uses reinforcement learning to finetune neural warm starts for AC power flow solvers, proving that error direction (not magnitude) determines convergence near voltage collapse.

entry.title: Benchmarking LLM-Based Static Analysis for Secure Smart Contract Development: Reliability, Limitations, and Potential Hybrid Solutions

author.name: Stefan-Claudiu Susan, Andrei Arusoaie, Dorel Lucanu

entry.summary: Benchmarks LLM-based static analysis for smart contract vulnerability detection, finding that LLMs rely on lexical biases (identifier naming) leading to high false positives rather than semantic understanding.

entry.title: Generative Diffusion Prior Distillation for Long-Context Knowledge Transfer

author.name: Nilushika Udayangani, Kishor Nandakishor, Marimuthu Palaniswami

entry.summary: Uses diffusion-based knowledge distillation to transfer full-sequence knowledge to partial time series classifiers. Teacher generates synthetic features to bridge the gap from limited partial observations.

entry.title: Weather-Robust Cross-View Geo-Localization via Prototype-Based Semantic Part Discovery

author.name: Chi-Nguyen Tran, Dao Sy Duy Minh, Huynh Trung Kiet, Nguyen Lam Phu Quy, Phu-Hoa Pham, Long Tran-Thanh

entry.summary: Proposes SkyPart for cross-view geo-localization that separates layout from texture in patch-based vision transformers, addressing altitude-related scale variation for drone navigation.

entry.title: Crash Assessment via Mesh-Based Graph Neural Networks and Physics-Aware Attention

author.name: Gabriel Curtosi, Carlos Manuel Ruiz Ruiz, Fabiola Cavaliere, Xabier Larr\'ayoz Izcara

entry.summary: Proposes hybrid surrogate models combining graph neural networks and attention mechanisms for predicting time-resolved deformation fields in vehicle crash simulations.

entry.title: Improving the Performance and Learning Stability of Parallelizable RNNs Designed for Ultra-Low Power Applications

author.name: Julien Brandoit, Arthur Fyon, Damien Ernst, Guillaume Drion

entry.summary: Proposes improvements to parallelizable RNNs (Bistable Memory Recurrent Units) for ultra-low power applications by identifying gradient blocking during state updates and introducing cumulative update formulation.

entry.title: Rethink the Role of Neural Decoders in Quantum Error Correction

author.name: Ge Yan, Shanchuan Li, Yuxuan Du

entry.summary: Revisits neural decoders for quantum error correction on surface codes under explicit accuracy-latency constraints, unifying five architectural paradigms and evaluating them up to distance d=9 (161 qubits).

entry.title: TriBand-BEV: Real-Time LiDAR-Only 3D Pedestrian Detection via Height-Aware BEV and High-Resolution Feature Fusion

author.name: Mohammad Khoshkdahan, Alexey Vinel

entry.summary: Introduces TriBand-BEV encoding for LiDAR-only 3D pedestrian detection, mapping point clouds into a 2D BEV tensor with three height bands, reformulating 3D detection as 2D detection for real-time performance.

entry.title: Transferable Delay-Aware Reinforcement Learning via Implicit Causal Graph Modeling

author.name: Chenran Zhao, Dianxi Shi, Yaowen Zhang, Chunping Qiu, Shaowu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a transferable delay-aware RL method using implicit causal graph modeling with field-node encoders and message-passing to handle random delays and enable cross-task knowledge transfer.

entry.title: SEMIR: Semantic Minor-Induced Representation Learning on Graphs for Visual Segmentation

author.name: Luke James Miller, Yugyung Lee

entry.summary: Introduces SEMIR, a representation learning framework that decouples inference from the native image grid by learning topology-preserving latent graph representations for segmenting small sparse structures.

entry.title: On the Approximation Complexity of Matrix Product Operator Born Machines

author.name: Chao Li, Zerui Tao, Yuchen Cong, Jian Xu, Qibin Zhao

entry.summary: Characterizes approximation complexity of Matrix Product Operator Born Machines, proving NP-hardness for KL approximation in general while showing tractability under locality and spectral-gap conditions for structured targets.

entry.title: Adaptive TD-Lambda for Cooperative Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yue Deng, Zirui Wang, Yin Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive TD(λ) for cooperative multi-agent RL by approximating policy distribution using Q-value statistics rather than direct computation, addressing the intractability of joint policy distribution estimation.

entry.title: Stochastic Minimum-Cost Reach-Avoid Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jingduo Pan, Taoran Wu, Yiling Xue, Bai Xue

entry.summary: Introduces reach-avoid probability certificates (RAPCs) for stochastic RL where agents must reach targets while avoiding obstacles with probability guarantees while minimizing costs. Develops a contraction-based Bellman formulation as a principled approach to integrating safety constraints.

entry.title: QDSB: Quantized Diffusion Schr\"odinger Bridges

author.name: Tobias Fuchs, Florian Kalinke, Nadja Klein

entry.summary: Proposes Quantized Diffusion Schrödinger Bridges (QDSB) that accelerate training of simulation-free Schrödinger bridges by quantizing the source distribution, reducing the cost of repeatedly solving entropic optimal transport on minibatches.

entry.title: Learning plug-in surrogate endpoints for randomized experiments

author.name: Alessandro-Umberto Margueritte, Ahmet Zahid Balc{\i}o\u{g}lu, Jesse Krijthe, Dave Zachariah, Fredrik D. Johansson

entry.summary: Studies plug-in composite surrogates for randomized experiments—functions of post-treatment variables that can substitute for primary outcomes. Proposes two methods for learning surrogate endpoints from data, addressing the gap between causal formalization and practical algorithms.

entry.title: Empowering VLMs for Few-Shot Multimodal Time Series Classification via Tailored Agentic Reasoning

author.name: Lin Li, Jiawei Huang, Qihao Quan, Dan Li, Boxin Li, Xiao Zhang, Erli Meng, Wenjie Feng, Jian Lou, See-Kiong Ng

entry.summary: Proposes MarsTSC, the first VLM agentic reasoning framework for few-shot multimodal time series classification. Uses a self-evolving knowledge bank refined through Generator, Reflector, and Modifier roles for iterative reasoning improvement.

entry.title: PG-3DGS: Optimizing 3D Gaussian Splatting to Satisfy Physics Objectives

author.name: Zachary Lee, Maxwell Jacobson, Yexiang Xue

entry.summary: Introduces Physics-Guided 3D Gaussian Splatting (PG-3DGS) that couples differentiable physics simulation with 3D Gaussian representations to generate structures satisfying physical functionality constraints, not just visual accuracy.

entry.title: Checkup2Action: A Multimodal Clinical Check-up Report Dataset for Patient-Oriented Action Card Generation

author.name: Sike Xiang, Shuang Chen, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Jialin Yu, Yijia Sun, Philip Torr, Amir Atapour-Abarghouei

entry.summary: Presents Checkup2Action, a multimodal clinical check-up report dataset for generating structured patient-oriented action cards. Combines page layouts, tables, biomarkers, and imaging findings with prioritized follow-up recommendations.

entry.title: SAGE: Scalable Automated Robustness Augmentation for LLM Knowledge Evaluation

author.name: Xiaoyuan Li, Yuzhe Wang, Moxin Li, Keqin Bao, Rui Men, Yichang Zhang, Dayiheng Liu, Wenjie Wang, Fuli Feng

entry.summary: Proposes SAGE, a framework for scalable robustness augmentation of knowledge evaluation benchmarks using fine-tuned smaller models. Addresses the cost and reliability issues of LLM-assisted generate-then-verify pipelines.

entry.title: Question Difficulty Estimation for Large Language Models via Answer Plausibility Scoring

author.name: Jamshid Mozafari, Bhawna Piryani, Adam Jatowt

entry.summary: Introduces Q-DAPS, a method for estimating question difficulty for LLMs by computing entropy over plausibility scores of candidate answers, outperforming readability and retrieval-based baselines across four QA datasets.

entry.title: Dynamic Full-body Motion Agent with Object Interaction via Blending Pre-trained Modular Controllers

author.name: Sanghyeok Nam, Byoungjun Kim, Daehyung Park, Tae-Kyun Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for generating dynamic full-body human-object interaction motions by blending pretrained modular controllers, enabling long-term dynamic interactions like running while holding objects.

entry.title: JACoP: Joint Alignment for Compliant Multi-Agent Prediction

author.name: Qingze Liu, Alen Mrdovic, Danrui Li, Mathew Schwartz, Sejong Yoon, Mubbasir Kapadia

entry.summary: Presents JACoP, a multi-stage framework for collectively compliant multi-agent trajectory prediction using MRF-based alignment to ensure social collision avoidance and environmental compliance.

entry.title: RevealLayer: Disentangling Hidden and Visible Layers via Occlusion-Aware Image Decomposition

author.name: Binhao Wang, Shihao Zhao, Bo Cheng, Qiuyu Ji, Yuhang Ma, Liebucha Wu, Shanyuan Liu, Dawei Leng, Yuhui Yin

entry.summary: RevealLayer is a diffusion-based framework for decomposing images into multiple RGBA layers, recovering occluded content. Features Region-Aware Attention, Occlusion-Guided Completion, and addresses dataset scarcity for multi-layer natural images.

entry.title: Cluster-Aware Neural Collapse Prompt Tuning for Long-Tailed Generalization of Vision-Language Models

author.name: Boyang Guo, Liang Li, Lin Peng, Yuhan Gao, Xichun Sheng, Chenggang Yan

entry.summary: Cluster-aware neural collapse prompt tuning (CPT) enhances tail-class discriminability in prompt-tuned vision-language models without sacrificing generalization. Mines semantic assignments to create cluster-invariant spaces for long-tailed recognition.

entry.title: PairDropGS: Paired Dropout-Induced Consistency Regularization for Sparse-View Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Hantang Li, Qiang Zhu, Xiandong Meng, Xingtao Wang, Debin Zhao, Xiaopeng Fan

entry.summary: PairDropGS revisits dropout-based sparse-view 3DGS from a consistency regularization perspective, constructing paired dropped Gaussian subsets and enforcing consistency between them for more stable reconstruction.

entry.title: UniFixer: A Universal Reference-Guided Fixer for Diffusion-Based View Synthesis

author.name: Sihan Chen, Xiang Zhang, Yang Zhang, Tunc Aydin, Christopher Schroers

entry.summary: UniFixer is a universal reference-guided framework that fixes degradation artifacts in diffusion-based view synthesis across spatial, temporal, and backbone dimensions through a coarse-to-fine strategy.

entry.title: GaitProtector: Impersonation-Driven Gait De-Identification via Training-Free Diffusion Latent Optimization

author.name: Huiran Duan, Qian Zhou, Zhongliang Guo, Junhao Dong, Yuqi Li, Guoying Zhao, Yingli Tian

entry.summary: GaitProtector formulates gait de-identification as combined obfuscation (repelling from source identity) and impersonation (attracting toward target identity) using training-free diffusion latent optimization.

entry.title: EgoForce: Forearm-Guided Camera-Space 3D Hand Pose from a Monocular Egocentric Camera

author.name: Christen Millerdurai, Shaoxiang Wang, Yaxu Xie, Vladislav Golyanik, Didier Stricker, Alain Pagani

entry.summary: EgoForce recovers absolute 3D hand pose from monocular egocentric cameras using forearm as a geometric anchor to resolve depth-scale ambiguity and generalize across head-mounted device configurations.

entry.title: SplitFed-CL: A Split Federated Co-Learning Framework for Medical Image Segmentation with Inaccurate Labels

author.name: Zahra Hafezi Kafshgari, Hadi Hadizadeh, Parvaneh Saeedi

entry.summary: SplitFed-CL addresses heterogeneous label quality in split federated learning for medical image segmentation through a co-learning framework with global teacher guidance and consistency regularization.

entry.title: Graph-Grounded Optimization: Rao-Family Metaheuristics, Classical OR, and SLM-Driven Formulation over Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Madhulatha Mandarapu (samyama.ai), Sandeep Kunkunuru (samyama.ai)

entry.summary: Proposes graph-grounded optimization paradigm where optimization problem parameters come from knowledge graphs via Cypher queries rather than text. Implements in open-source samyama-graph database across seven real-world problems.

entry.title: NavOL: Navigation Policy with Online Imitation Learning

author.name: Xiaofei Wei, Chun Gu, Li Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes NavOL, an online imitation learning paradigm for robot navigation that interacts with a simulator and updates using expert demonstrations gathered online. Addresses distribution shift by training in a rollout-update loop with a global planner providing ground truth.

entry.title: Sensor Design for Accuracy-Bounded Estimation via Maximum-Entropy Likelihood Synthesis

author.name: Raktim Bhattacharya

entry.summary: Proposes a maximum-entropy approach to sensor design that inverts the traditional flow: given an error budget, synthesize the measurement likelihood that enforces accuracy while injecting minimal information beyond the dynamical prior. Avoids requiring explicit sensor forward models.

entry.title: Optimisation: Selective versus Predictive

author.name: Raymond Douglas

entry.summary: Distinguishes between selective optimization (behavior selected for outcomes, like evolution) and predictive optimization (behavior guided by predictions, like planning). Argues this distinction is crucial for understanding AI systems and avoiding confused reasoning about optimization.

entry.title: Transformer Interpretability from Perspective of Attention and Gradient

author.name: Yongjin Cui, Xiaohui Fan, Huajun Chen

entry.summary: Studies Transformer interpretability through the lens of attention and gradient, proposing a method that guides gradient/attention direction for more comprehensive feature region interpretation. Demonstrates adversarial-style image class alteration imperceptible to humans.

entry.title: CAMPA: Efficient and Aligned Multimodal Graph Learning via Decoupled Propagation and Aggregation

author.name: Daohan Su, Hao Liu, Xunkai Li, Yinlin Zhu, Xiong Yongfu, Yi Liu, Hongchao Qin, Rong-Hua Li, Guoren Wang

entry.summary: Presents CAMPA for efficient multimodal graph learning via decoupled propagation and aggregation. Identifies and addresses modal conflict in both propagation (cross-modal semantic divergence) and aggregation (misaligned feature trajectories) stages.

entry.title: Measuring What Matters Beyond Text: Evaluating Multimodal Summaries by Quality, Alignment, and Diversity

author.name: Abid Ali, Diego Molla-Aliod, Usman Naseem

entry.summary: Introduces MM-Eval, a unified evaluation framework for multimodal summarization that integrates text quality, cross-modal alignment, and visual diversity assessments. Addresses fragmentation in current MSMO evaluation approaches.

entry.title: MolDeTox: Evaluating Language Model's Stepwise Fragment Editing for Molecular Detoxification

author.name: Jueon Park, Wonjune Jang, Jiwoo Lee, Yein Park, Jaewoo Kang

entry.summary: Introduces MolDeTox, a benchmark evaluating LLMs and VLMs on stepwise molecular fragment editing for reducing toxicity in drug discovery. Addresses limitations of existing toxicity repair benchmarks including limited diversity and reliance on proxy models.

entry.title: CAAFC: Chronological Actionable Automated Fact-Checker for misinformation / non-factual hallucination detection and correction

author.name: Islam Eldifrawi, Shengrui Wang, Amine Trabelsi

entry.summary: Introduces CAAFC, a chronological actionable automated fact-checking framework that surpasses existing AFC and hallucination detection systems. Operates on claims, conversations, and documents with alignment to professional fact-checking practices.

entry.title: Measuring Accuracy and Energy-to-Solution of Quantum Fine-Tuning of Foundational AI Models

author.name: Oliver Knitter, Sang Hyub Kim, Maximilian Wurzer, Jonathan Mei, Claudio Girotto, Karen Horovitz, Chi Chen, Masako Yamada, Frederik F. Fl\"other, Martin Roetteler

entry.summary: Experimentally measures energy-to-solution of hybrid quantum-classical fine-tuning of AI models using power instrumentation of a trapped-ion quantum processor. Shows quantum models achieve accuracy competitive with classical baselines with favorable energy scaling.

entry.title: Structural Interpretations of Protein Language Model Representations via Differentiable Graph Partitioning

author.name: Siddhant Dutta, Edward Tan Beng Wai, Soumick Sarker, Pasan Gunawardane, Jagath C. Rajapakse

entry.summary: Proposes SoftBlobGIN, a framework that projects ESM-2 protein language model representations onto contact graphs for structure-aware message passing and learning coarse functional substructures, achieving 92.8% accuracy on enzyme classification.

entry.title: Quantifying the Reconstructability of Astrophysical Methods with Large Language Models and Information Theory: A Case Study in Spectral Reconstruction

author.name: Hsing Wen Lin, Zong-Fu Sie

entry.summary: Uses information theory (Shannon entropy, Jensen-Shannon divergence) to quantify how effectively astrophysical methods can be reconstructed from written descriptions by LLMs. Case study on TNO spectral reconstruction.

entry.title: Localization Boosting for Growth Markets: Mitigating Cross-Locale Behavioral Bias in Learning-to-Rank

author.name: Suryaa Veerabathiran Seran, Ashwin Naresh Kumar, Tracy Holloway King, Jing Zheng

entry.summary: Addresses cross-locale bias in Adobe Express's learning-to-rank system where US content dominates non-US locales. Proposes multi-objective framework combining behavioral supervision, VLM relevance, and local content boosting.

entry.title: Rethinking external validation for the target population: Capturing patient-level similarity with a generative model

author.name: Mohammad Azizmalayeri (on behalf of the NHR THI registration committee), Ameen Abu-Hanna (on behalf of the NHR THI registration committee), Saskia Houterman (on behalf of the NHR THI registration committee), Marije M. Vis (on behalf of the NHR THI registration committee), Giovanni Cin\`a (on behalf of the NHR THI registration committee)

entry.summary: Proposes using autoencoders to quantify patient-level similarity to development data for external model validation, distinguishing model deficiencies from case-mix effects without sharing original data.

entry.title: Trade-offs in Decentralized Agentic AI Discovery Across the Compute Continuum

author.name: Patrizio Dazzi, Emanuele Carlini, Matteo Mordacchini, Saul Urso

entry.summary: Studies trade-offs among DHT-based overlay families (Chord, Pastry, Kademlia) for decentralized agent discovery across the compute continuum.

entry.title: High-lift Wing Separation Control via Bayesian Optimization and Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ricard Montal\`a, Bernat Font, Oriol Lehmkuhl, Ricardo Vinuesa, Ivette Rodriguez

entry.summary: Investigates active flow control of a high-lift wing using Bayesian optimization and deep reinforcement learning with large-eddy simulations, achieving 10.9% efficiency improvement.

entry.title: The Missing GAP: From Solving Square Jigsaw Puzzles to Handling Real World Archaeological Fragments

author.name: Ofir Itzhak Shahar, Gur Elkin, Ohad Ben-Shahar

entry.summary: Introduces GAP, jigsaw puzzle datasets with eroded irregular pieces mimicking real archaeological fragments, and PuzzleFlow, a ViT+flow-matching framework for solving these puzzles. Bridges computer vision puzzle-solving with real archaeology.

entry.title: QAP-Router: Tackling Qubit Routing as Dynamic Quadratic Assignment with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Kien X. Nguyen, Ankit Kulshrestha, Ilya Safro, Xiaoyuan Liu

entry.summary: Frames qubit routing as a dynamic Quadratic Assignment Problem and uses RL to solve it, capturing interaction-distance coupling in a unified formulation for quantum circuit compilation.

entry.title: Agent-Based Post-Hoc Correction of Agricultural Yield Forecasts

author.name: Matthew Beddows, Aiden Durrant, Georgios Leontidis

entry.summary: Proposes a structured LLM agent framework for post-hoc correction of crop yield forecasts, encoding agricultural domain knowledge across tools for phase detection, bias learning, and range validation.

entry.title: CORE: Cyclic Orthotope Relation Embedding for Knowledge Graph Completion

author.name: Yingqi Zeng, Luying Wang, Huiling Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes CORE, embedding entities and relations on a torus manifold as cyclic orthotopes for knowledge graph completion, avoiding absolute boundary constraints of previous region-based methods.

entry.title: FeatMap: Understanding image manipulation in the feature space and its implications for feature space geometry

author.name: Elias B. Krey, Nils Neukirch, Nils Strodthoff

entry.summary: FeatMap investigates how input-space manipulations (geometric, photometric, semantic) can be mapped in feature space, providing insights into the geometric structure of intermediate neural network representations.

entry.title: $\varepsilon$-Good Action Identification in Fixed-Budget Monte Carlo Tree Search

author.name: Yinan Li, Tuan Nguyen, Kwang-Sung Jun

entry.summary: Studies ε-good action identification in fixed-budget Monte Carlo Tree Search for depth-2 max-min trees, proposing an ε-agnostic algorithm with instance-dependent error bounds.

entry.title: Beyond Prediction: Interval Neural Networks for Uncertainty-Aware System Identification

author.name: Mehmet Ali Ferah, Tufan Kumbasar

entry.summary: Develops interval neural networks (LSTM and Neural ODE) for uncertainty-aware system identification using interval arithmetic, avoiding probabilistic assumptions while propagating uncertainty through predictions.

entry.title: A Controlled Counterexample to Strong Proxy-Based Explanations of OOD Performance: in a Fixed Pretraining-and-Probing Setup

author.name: Hongmin Li

entry.summary: A controlled counterexample showing that task-agnostic structure proxies for pretraining corpora can fail to predict OOD probe accuracy, even in a fixed pretraining-and-probing setup.

entry.title: Learning Feature Encoder with Synthetic Anomalies for Weakly Supervised Graph Anomaly Detection

author.name: Yingjie Zhou, Yuqin Xie, Fanxing Liu, Dongjin Song, Ce Zhu, Lingqiao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a feature encoder for weakly supervised graph anomaly detection using synthetic anomalies, learning representations that reduce intra-class variance while remaining sensitive to anomalies.

entry.title: Fed-BAC: Federated Bandit-Guided Additive Clustering in Hierarchical Federated Learning

author.name: Satwat Bashir, Tasos Dagiuklas, Muddesar Iqbal

entry.summary: Fed-BAC integrates additive cluster personalization with a two-level bandit framework for hierarchical federated learning, using contextual bandits for cluster assignment and Thompson Sampling for client selection.

entry.title: Limits of Learning Linear Dynamics from Experiments

author.name: Ayb\"uke Ulusarslan, Niki Kilbertus, Nora Schneider

entry.summary: Characterizes when identifiability holds for controlled linear time-invariant systems when standard conditions (controllability, persistent excitation) fail, showing which parts of the system remain identifiable. Provides a complete picture of what can and cannot be learned from experimental data.

entry.title: Elicitation-Augmented Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Alvar Haltia, Ville Hyv\"onen, Samuel Kaski

entry.summary: Develops elicitation-augmented Bayesian optimization that combines direct function evaluations with pairwise comparisons from domain experts who cannot explicitly quantify their knowledge. Provides a principled Bayesian framework for integrating tacit expert knowledge.

entry.title: Investigating simple target-covariate relationships for Chronos-2 and TabPFN-TS

author.name: Gaspard Berthelier, Mariia Baranova, Andrei-Tiberiu Pantea, Etienne Le Naour, Adrien Petralia, Tahar Nabil, Themis Palpanas

entry.summary: Evaluates how well time series foundation models Chronos-2 and TabPFN-TS handle covariate integration through controlled experiments with simple target-covariate relationships. Finds TabPFN-TS captures these relationships better than Chronos-2, especially at short horizons.

entry.title: FedSurrogate: Backdoor Defense in Federated Learning via Layer Criticality and Surrogate Replacement

author.name: Fatima Z. Abacha, Sin G. Teo, Yuanxiang Wu, Lucas C. Cordeiro, Mustafa A. Mustafa

entry.summary: Proposes FedSurrogate, a backdoor defense for federated learning combining bidirectional gradient alignment filtering with layer-adaptive anomaly detection. Addresses high false-positive rates of existing defenses under non-IID data by concentrating detection on security-critical layers.

entry.title: Learning U-Statistics with Active Inference

author.name: Xiaoning Wang, Yuyang Huo, Liuhua Peng, Changliang Zou

entry.summary: Develops an active inference framework for U-statistics that selectively queries informative labels under a fixed budget while preserving valid statistical inference. Uses augmented inverse probability weighting and characterizes optimal sampling rules for variance minimization.

entry.title: MULTI: Disentangling Camera Lens, Sensor, View, and Domain for Novel Image Generation

author.name: Sonali Godavarthy, Matthias Neuwirth-Trapp, Tim-Felix Faasch, Maarten Bieshaar, Michael Moeller, Danda Pani Paudel

entry.summary: Introduces MULTI, a method for disentangling imaging factors like camera lens, sensor type, viewpoint, and domain characteristics in text-to-image models via Textual Inversion. Identifies a new challenge of imaging factor disentanglement.

entry.title: A proximal gradient algorithm for composite log-concave sampling

author.name: Linghai Liu, Sinho Chewi

entry.summary: Proposes a proximal gradient sampling algorithm for composite log-concave distributions achieving near-optimal iteration complexity matching the smooth case. Uses restricted Gaussian oracle for non-smooth components.

entry.title: HEBATRON: A Hebrew-Specialized Open-Weight Mixture-of-Experts Language Model

author.name: Noam Kayzer, Dan Revital, Ori Bar Joseph, Smadar Arvatz, Or Levi, Tal Geva, Shaltiel Shmidman, Amir DN Cohen, Noam Ordan, Omer Baruch, Kate Zinkovskaia, Zevi Apini, Sarel Weinberger

entry.summary: Presents Hebatron, a Hebrew-specialized MoE language model built on NVIDIA Nemotron-3, using a three-phase easy-to-hard curriculum with anti-forgetting anchoring. Achieves 73.8% Hebrew reasoning average while activating only 3B of 30B parameters.

entry.title: Efficient LLM-based Advertising via Model Compression and Parallel Verification

author.name: Wenxin Dong, Chang Gao, Guanghui Yu, Xuewu Jiao, Mingqing Hu, Qiang Fu, Peng Xu, Penghui Wei, Hui Xu, Yue Xing, Shuanglong Li, Lin Liu

entry.summary: Proposes an efficient generative targeting framework for advertising combining adaptive group quantization, layer-adaptive sparsification, and prefix-tree parallel verification for LLM inference acceleration. Achieves significant speedup with acceptable quality degradation.

entry.title: Context Convergence Improves Answering Inferential Questions

author.name: Jamshid Mozafari, Bhawna Piryani, Adam Jatowt

entry.summary: Investigates how passage structure affects LLM performance on inferential questions, finding that passages built from higher 'convergence' sentences (those that better eliminate wrong answers) substantially improve QA accuracy.

entry.title: Predicting Disagreement with Human Raters in LLM-as-a-Judge Difficulty Assessment without Using Generation-Time Probability Signals

author.name: Yo Ehara

entry.summary: Proposes a method for predicting when LLM-as-a-Judge difficulty ratings will disagree with human raters, without needing generation-time probability signals, using ordinal scale properties for cross-LLM comparison.

entry.title: USEMA: a Scalable Efficient Mamba Like Attention for Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Elisha Dayag, Nhat Thanh Tran, Jack Xin

entry.summary: Proposes USEMA, a Mamba-like attention mechanism for medical image segmentation that uses local window attention with arithmetic averaging for global context, addressing the quadratic complexity of transformers.

entry.title: Hi-GaTA: Hierarchical Gated Temporal Aggregation Adapter for Surgical Video Report Generation

author.name: Kedi Sun, Chaohui Dang, Yue Feng, James Glasbey, Theodoros N. Arvanitis, Le Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Hi-GaTA, a hierarchical gated temporal adapter for surgical video report generation, with a benchmark of 214 simulated surgical videos with surgeon-authored reports.

entry.title: ScribbleDose: Scribble-Guided Dose Prediction in Radiotherapy

author.name: Zhenxi Zhang, Yitao Zhuang, Yao Pu, Peixin Yu, Zirong Li, Yan Xia, Hui Li, Bin Li, Fuchen Zheng, Ge Ren

entry.summary: Proposes ScribbleDose, a scribble-guided dose prediction framework for radiotherapy that generates dense anatomical masks from sparse scribble annotations using a Scribble Completion Module.

entry.title: TB-AVA: Text as a Semantic Bridge for Audio-Visual Parameter Efficient Finetuning

author.name: Seongah Kim, Dinh Phu Tran, Hyeontaek Hwang, Saad Wazir, Duc Do Minh, Daeyoung Kim

entry.summary: Proposes TB-AVA, using text as a semantic bridge for audio-visual understanding with parameter-efficient adaptation of frozen encoders and gated semantic modulation.

entry.title: Revisiting Shadow Detection from a Vision-Language Perspective

author.name: Yonghui Wang, Wengang Zhou, Hao Feng, Houqiang Li

entry.summary: Revisits shadow detection using vision-language framework (SVL) where language provides explicit semantic reference to disambiguate shadows from dark surfaces, addressing visual ambiguity limitations.

entry.title: Interactive State Space Model with Cross-Modal Local Scanning for Depth Super-Resolution

author.name: Chen Wu, Ling Wang, Zhuoran Zheng, Xiangyu Chen, Jingyuan Xia, Weidong Jiang, Jiantao Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Interactive State Space Model with cross-modal local scanning for guided depth super-resolution, enabling dense semantic-aware interactions between RGB and depth modalities with linear complexity.

entry.title: What Does It Mean for a Medical AI System to Be Right?

author.name: Antony Gitau

entry.summary: Philosophical examination of what 'correctness' means for medical AI, grounded in the case of plasma cell classification for multiple myeloma diagnosis. Argues correctness is multi-dimensional: data quality, explainability, clinical meaningfulness, and accountability.

entry.title: EchoTracker2: Enhancing Myocardial Point Tracking by Modeling Local Motion

author.name: Md Abulkalam Azad, Vegard Holmstr{\o}m, John Nyberg, Lasse Lovstakken, H{\aa}vard Dalen, Bj{\o}rnar Grenne, Andreas {\O}stvik

entry.summary: EchoTracker2 is a fine-stage-only architecture for myocardial point tracking in echocardiography, arguing that coarse initialization is unnecessary given the locally confined nature of cardiac motion.

entry.title: LychSim: A Controllable and Interactive Simulation Framework for Vision Research

author.name: Wufei Ma, Chloe Wang, Siyi Chen, Jiawei Peng, Patrick Li, Alan Yuille

entry.summary: LychSim is a simulation framework built on Unreal Engine 5 with streamlined Python API for vision research, supporting procedural environment generation and OOD evaluation with minimal graphics expertise.

entry.title: Computational Design of a Low-Visibility UAV Using a Human-Aligned Perceptual Metric

author.name: Jingxian Wang, Chen Yu, David Matthews, Emma Alexander, Sam Kriegman, Michael Rubenstein

entry.summary: Introduces Phantom Twist, a single-propeller UAV designed for low visibility by spinning rapidly and exploiting motion blur. Uses an automated two-stage design pipeline optimizing component placement to minimize visibility (measured by LPIPS perceptual metric) while satisfying flight constraints. Validated with real prototypes.

entry.title: DexTwist: Dexterous Hand Retargeting for Twist Motion via Mixed Reality-based Teleoperation

author.name: Dongmyoung Lee, Chengxi Li, Dongheui Lee

entry.summary: Proposes DexTwist, a functional twist-retargeting approach for MR-based dexterous teleoperation that addresses failures in contact-rich rotational manipulation (cap opening, key turning) caused by embodiment gaps between human and robot hands.

entry.title: A Barrier-Metric First-Order Method for Linearly Constrained Bilevel Optimization

author.name: Tenglong Hong, Paul Grigas

entry.summary: Develops a barrier-metric first-order method for bilevel optimization with polyhedral lower constraints. Uses logarithmic barrier smoothing to obtain differentiable approximations and a proxy-gradient algorithm requiring only first-order information.

entry.title: Multi-Agent System Identification with Nonlinear Sheaf Diffusion

author.name: Nivar Anwer, Hans Riess, Matthew Hale

entry.summary: Studies multi-agent system identification with nonlinear sheaf Laplacian dynamics, showing that the obstruction to recovering interaction laws from trajectory data is topological. Provides characterization of when edge potential functions can be identified from node observations.

entry.title: From Model Uncertainty to Human Attention: Localization-Aware Visual Cues for Scalable Annotation Review

author.name: Moussa Kassem Sbeyti, Joshua Holstein, Philipp Spitzer, Nadja Klein, Gerhard Satzger

entry.summary: Studies the effect of visualizing spatial uncertainty in AI-assisted annotation workflows through a controlled study with 120 participants. Finds that uncertainty visualization helps annotators identify spatial errors that would otherwise be systematically missed.

entry.title: EDGER: EDge-Guided with HEatmap Refinement for Generalizable Image Forgery Localization

author.name: Minh-Khoa Le-Phan, Minh-Hoang Le, Minh-Triet Tran, Trong-Le Do

entry.summary: EDGER is a dual-branch framework for image forgery localization using edge-guided segmentation and heatmap refinement. Handles arbitrary resolution images and detects manipulation boundaries through high-frequency inconsistencies.

entry.title: PoseCompass: Intelligent Synthetic Pose Selection for Visual Localization

author.name: Yanan Zhou, Zhaoyan Qian, Yanli Li, Nan Yang, Zhongliang Guo, Dong Yuan

entry.summary: PoseCompass proposes intelligent synthetic pose selection for 3DGS-based absolute pose regression, ranking poses by localization difficulty, coverage novelty, and rendering quality to avoid redundant augmentation.

entry.title: On What We Can Learn from Low-Resolution Data

author.name: Theresa Dahl Frehr, Niels Henrik Pontoppidan, Hiba Nassar, Tommy Sonne Alstr{\o}m

entry.summary: Studies the information content of low-resolution data when models are evaluated on high-resolution data, motivated by settings where wearable devices or privacy constraints force data aggregation. Provides theoretical and empirical analysis of when mixed-resolution data is useful.

entry.title: Contrastive Learning under Noisy Temporal Self-Supervision for Colonoscopy Videos

author.name: Luca Parolari, Pietro Gori, Lamberto Ballan, Carlo Biffi, Loic Le Folgoc

entry.summary: Proposes contrastive learning framework for colonoscopy videos that leverages temporal structure for self-supervised associations while handling noisy labels through a noise-aware approach.

entry.title: Do Vision-Language-Models show human-like logical problem-solving capability in point and click puzzle games?

author.name: Dominik Helfenstein, Marco Menner, Maximilian Triebel

entry.summary: Introduces VLATIM, a benchmark for evaluating VLMs on point-and-click puzzle games (The Incredible Machine 2), testing the gap between high-level reasoning and precise continuous action execution. Structured into five progressive parts from basic grounding to complex physical reasoning.

entry.title: Rethinking LLMOps for Fraud and AML: Building a Compliance-Grade LLM Serving Stack

author.name: Prathamesh Vasudeo Naik, Naresh Dintakurthi, Yue Wang

entry.summary: Introduces a compliance-grade LLM serving stack for fraud detection and AML, optimized for prefix-heavy, schema-constrained prompts. Uses vLLM with open-weight models (Llama, Qwen) and addresses prefix reuse, KV-cache efficiency, and output validation for regulated environments.

entry.title: Revisiting Privacy Preservation in Brain-Computer Interfaces: Conceptual Boundaries, Risk Pathways, and a Protection-Strength Grading Framework

author.name: Lei Sun, Xiuqing Mao, Shuai Zhang, Qingyu Zeng, Min Zhao, Jiyuan Li, Wenle Dong

entry.summary: Reviews privacy preservation in brain-computer interfaces under ISO/IEC 8663:2025, defining privacy boundaries, protection objects, and a protection-strength grading framework. Covers risks across collection, transmission, storage, training, inference, and feedback.

entry.title: Native Explainability for Bayesian Confidence Propagation Neural Networks: A Framework for Trusted Brain-Like AI

author.name: Georgios Makridis, Georgios Fatouros, John Soldatos, George Katsis, Dimosthenis Kyriazis

entry.summary: Proposes a native explainability framework for Bayesian Confidence Propagation Neural Networks (BCPNN), motivated by the EU AI Act requirements for transparent, trustworthy AI on edge devices. First systematic framework for explaining BCPNN decisions.

entry.title: Beyond Inefficiency: Systemic Costs of Incivility in Multi-Agent Monte Carlo Simulations

author.name: Alison Moldovan-Mauer, Benedikt Mangold

entry.summary: Uses LLM-based multi-agent systems as a controlled sociological sandbox to study costs of incivility in debates. Monte Carlo simulations show uncivil communication increases convergence time in structured adversarial debates.

entry.title: Random-Set Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Tommy Woodley, Shireen Kudukkil Manchingal, Matteo Tolloso, Davide Bacciu, Fabio Cuzzolin

entry.summary: Proposes Random-Set Graph Neural Networks for quantifying node-level epistemic uncertainty in GNNs using random set theory. The framework addresses challenges like missing edges and over-smoothing that introduce uncertainty in graph data representations.

entry.title: LISA: Cognitive Arbitration for Signal-Free Autonomous Intersection Management

author.name: Abderrahmane Lakas, Mohamed Amine Ferrag, Merouane Debbah

entry.summary: Proposes LISA, an LLM-based cognitive arbitration system for signal-free autonomous intersection management that uses LLMs as primary decision-makers rather than auxiliary components for coordinating vehicles.

entry.title: QuIDE: Mastering the Quantized Intelligence Trade-off via Active Optimization

author.name: Xiantao Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes QuIDE, a unified metric for evaluating quantized neural networks that collapses compression-accuracy-latency into a single score. Finds 4-bit optimal for simple tasks and LLMs, 8-bit optimal for complex CNN tasks.

entry.title: Hierarchical Multi-Scale Graph Neural Networks: Scalable Heterophilous Learning with Oversmoothing and Oversquashing Mitigation

author.name: Md Sazzad Hossen, Avimanyu Sahoo

entry.summary: Introduces Hierarchical Multi-view HAAR (HMH), a spectral GNN framework for heterophilous graph classification that addresses hub-dominated aggregation and oversmoothing with near-linear time scaling.

entry.title: SURGE: Surrogate Gradient Adaptation in Binary Neural Networks

author.name: Haoyu Huang, Boyu Liu, Linlin Yang, Yanjing Li, Yuguang Yang, Xuhui Liu, Canyu Chen, Zhongqian Fu, Baochang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SURGE, a learnable gradient compensation framework for binary neural networks that uses dual-path gradient compensator with parallel full-precision auxiliary branch to address gradient mismatch in binarization.

entry.title: Backbone-Equated Diffusion OOD via Sparse Internal Snapshots

author.name: Yadang Alexis Rouzoumka, Jean Pinsolle, Eug\'enie Terreaux, Christ\`ele Morisseau, Jean-Philippe Ovarlez, Chengfang Ren

entry.summary: Proposes a fair evaluation protocol for diffusion-based OOD detectors and introduces Canonical Feature Snapshots (CFS), showing that much of diffusion OOD detection capability comes from just a few internal activations at low noise levels.

entry.title: DCVD: Dual-Channel Cross-Modal Fusion for Joint Vulnerability Detection and Localization

author.name: Wenxin Tang, Wenbin Li, Junliang Liu, Jingyu Xiao, Xi Xiao, Mingzhe Liu, Jinlong Yang, Xuan Liu, Yuehe Ma, Wang Luo, Qing Li, Lei Wang, Peng Xiangli

entry.summary: Proposes DCVD, a dual-channel cross-modal framework for joint function-level vulnerability detection and statement-level localization, exploiting complementary sequential, structural, and semantic information.

entry.title: Towards Model-Free Learning in Dynamic Population Games: An Application to Karma Economies

author.name: Matteo Cederle, Saverio Bolognani, Gian Antonio Susto

entry.summary: Studies model-free equilibrium learning in Karma-based dynamic population games, where agents learn from private experience rather than centralized game knowledge. Provides convergence results for agents joining existing equilibria.

entry.title: DenseTRF: Texture-Aware Unsupervised Representation Adaptation for Surgical Scene Dense Prediction

author.name: Guiqiu Liao, Matja\v{z} Jogan, Daniel A. Hashimoto

entry.summary: DenseTRF adapts surgical scene segmentation across domains using texture-centric slot attention for self-supervised representation learning, improving robustness to distribution shifts.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Teacher-Student Ensemble Learning for Traffic State Estimation with a Varying Speed Limit Scenario

author.name: Archie J. Huang, Dongdong Wang, Shaurya Agarwal, Mohamed Abdel-Aty, Md Mahmudul Islam, Muhammad Shahbaz

entry.summary: Combines physics-informed deep learning with teacher-student ensemble training for traffic state estimation under varying speed limits, addressing changing traffic dynamics.

entry.title: Spatial Adapter: Structured Spatial Decomposition and Closed-Form Covariance for Frozen Predictors

author.name: Wen-Ting Wang, Wei-Ying Wu, Hao-Yun Huang, Xuan-Chun Wang

entry.summary: Spatial Adapter is a parameter-efficient post-hoc layer for frozen predictors that provides structured spatial representation of residual fields with closed-form covariance via ADMM.

entry.title: Exact Stiefel Optimization for Probabilistic PLS: Closed-Form Updates, Error Bounds, and Calibrated Uncertainty

author.name: Haoran Hu, Xingce Wang

entry.summary: Develops exact Stiefel optimization for probabilistic partial least squares with closed-form updates, error bounds, and calibrated uncertainty in a unified pipeline.

entry.title: Unlocking UML Class Diagram Understanding in Vision Language Models

author.name: Artem Naboichenko, Ren\'e Peinl

entry.summary: Presents a benchmark for visual question answering on UML class diagrams and shows that LoRA fine-tuning can outperform larger VLMs like Qwen 3.5 27B on this specific domain.

entry.title: A Research Agenda on Agents and Software Engineering: Outcomes from the Rio A2SE Seminar

author.name: Davide Taibi, Henry Muccini, Karthik Vaidhyanathan, Marcos Kalinowski, Michele Albano, Antonio Pedro Santos Alves, Renato Cerqueira, Mateus Devino, Matteo Esposito, Rodrigo Falc\~ao, Vinicius Henning, Foutse Khomh, Valentina Lenarduzzi, Qinghua Lu, Mat\'ias Mart\'inez, Henrique Mello, Daniel Mendez, Lucas Romao

entry.summary: Reports outcomes from a seminar on Agents and Software Engineering, identifying six thematic areas and research priorities at the intersection of agentic AI and software engineering practices.

entry.title: Modulation Consistency-based Contrastive Learning for Self-Supervised Automatic Modulation Classification

author.name: Chenxu Wang, Shuang Wang, Lirong Han, Xinyu Hu, Hanlin Mo, Hantong Xing, Licheng Jiao

entry.summary: Proposes modulation consistency-based contrastive learning for self-supervised automatic modulation classification, using temporal segments as natural positive pairs.

entry.title: Property-Level Reconstructability of Agent Decisions: An Anchor-Level Pilot Across Vendor SDK Adapter Regimes

author.name: Oleg Solozobov

entry.summary: Applies a Decision Trace Reconstructor to six public vendor SDK regimes to measure how well agent decisions can be reconstructed post-hoc, finding three tiers of governance completeness across regimes.

entry.title: Mind the Pause: Disfluency-Aware Objective Tuning for Multilingual Speech Correction with LLMs

author.name: Deepak Kumar, Baban Gain, Asif Ekbal

entry.summary: Proposes disfluency-aware objective tuning for multilingual speech correction using LLMs, addressing the problem of ASR transcript disfluencies that reduce readability for downstream applications.

entry.title: Reconnecting Fragmented Citation Networks with Semantic Augmentation

author.name: Vu Thi Huong, Annika Buchholz, Imene Khebouri, Thorsten Koch, Tim Kunt, Wolfgang Peters-Kottig, Tomasz Stompor, Janina Zittel

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid framework integrating citation topology with LLM-based text similarity to reconnect fragmented citation networks in mathematics and operations research, using 662K publications.

entry.title: Enabling AI-Native Mobility in 6G: A Real-World Dataset for Handover, Beam Management, and Timing Advance

author.name: Mannam Veera Narayana, Rohit Singh, Deepa M. R, Radha Krishna Ganti

entry.summary: Presents a real-world 5G dataset collected across multiple mobility modes (pedestrian to train) for AI-native beam management, handover, and timing advance research in 6G communications.

entry.title: Deep Learning for Protein Complex Prediction and Design

author.name: Ziwei Xie

entry.summary: A thesis investigating deep learning for protein complex structure prediction and design, focusing on domain-specific architectures capturing hierarchical protein structures and search algorithms for navigating sequence spaces.

entry.title: A Comparative Study of Model Selection Criteria for Symbolic Regression

author.name: Ali Soltani, Gabriel Kronberger, Fabricio Olivetti de Franca, Mattia Billa, Alessandro Lucantonio

entry.summary: Systematic empirical comparison of model selection criteria (AIC, BIC, MDL, etc.) for symbolic regression across different data regimes, addressing the open problem of automatic solution selection from Pareto fronts.

entry.title: More Than Meets the Eye: A Semantics-Aware Traffic Augmentation Framework for Generalizable Website Fingerprinting

author.name: Youquan Xian, Xueying Zeng, Lingjia Meng, Lei Cui, Runhan Song, Wei Wang, Zhengquan Ding, Peng Liu, Zhiyu Hao

entry.summary: SATA is a semantics-aware traffic augmentation framework for website fingerprinting that addresses generalization failures under geographic and temporal shifts by modeling application-layer semantics.

entry.title: Multi-Narrow Transformation as a Single-Model Ensemble: Boundary Conditions, Mechanisms, and Failure Modes

author.name: Tatsuhito Hasegawa, Taisei Tanaka

entry.summary: Investigates Multi-Narrow vs Single-Wide network configurations under matched parameter budgets, finding that effectiveness of single-model ensembles via narrow branches depends strongly on data regime and architecture.

entry.title: A Composite Activation Function for Learning Stable Binary Representations

author.name: Seokhun Park, Choeun Kim, Kwanho Lee, Sehyun Park, Insung Kong, Yongdai Kim

entry.summary: Proposes HTAF, a smooth sigmoid-tanh composite approximation to the Heaviside function that enables stable gradient-based training of networks with binary activations.

entry.title: FedOUI: OUI-Guided Client Weighting for Federated Aggregation

author.name: Alberto Fern\'andez-Hern\'andez, Jose I. Mestre, Cristian P\'erez-Corral, Manuel F. Dolz, Jose Duato, Enrique S. Quintana-Ort\'i

entry.summary: FedOUI uses the Overfitting-Underfitting Indicator for client weighting in federated aggregation, down-weighting structurally atypical clients based on activation-level signals.

entry.title: U-STS-LLM A Unified Spatio-Temporal Steered Large Language Model for Traffic Prediction and Imputation

author.name: Yichen Zhang, Jun Li

entry.summary: Proposes a unified LLM-based framework for both traffic prediction and imputation in cellular networks, using spatio-temporal steering to adapt a single model to both tasks.

entry.title: STAGE: Tackling Semantic Drift in Multimodal Federated Graph Learning

author.name: Zekai Chen, Xun Wu, Xunkai Li, Yihan Sun, Rong-Hua Li, Guoren Wang

entry.summary: Addresses semantic drift in multimodal federated graph learning where clients with different modalities (text, images) produce inconsistent representations. Proposes STAGE framework to handle false semantic agreement and neighborhood noise amplification in cross-modal federated settings.

entry.title: Approximation Theory of Laplacian-Based Neural Operators for Reaction-Diffusion System

author.name: Takashi Furuya, Ryo Ozawa, Jenn-Nan Wang

entry.summary: Establishes explicit approximation error bounds for neural operators applied to reaction-diffusion systems (Gierer-Meinhardt model), connecting bounds to network depth, width, and spectral rank through Laplacian spectral representation of Green's functions.

entry.title: Delay-Empowered Causal Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Chenran Zhao, Dianxi Shi, Haotian Wang, Mengzhu Wang, Yaowen Zhang, Chunping Qiu, Shaowu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes DECHRL for hierarchical RL with delayed effects, explicitly modeling causal structure of state transitions and stochastic delay distributions. Addresses the limitation of existing methods that assume fixed delays or require prior knowledge of delay distributions.

entry.title: Hypernetworks for Dynamic Feature Selection

author.name: Javier Fumanal-Idocin, Raquel Fernandez-Peralta, Javier Andreu-Perez

entry.summary: Proposes Hyper-DFS, a hypernetwork-based approach to dynamic feature selection that generates classifier parameters specific to each feature subset on demand. Shows theoretical structural complexity advantages over mask-embedding approaches.

entry.title: Environment-Adaptive Preference Optimization for Wildfire Prediction

author.name: Enyi Jiang, Wu Sun

entry.summary: Proposes Environment-Adaptive Preference Optimization (EAPO) for wildfire prediction that handles long-tailed distributions and distribution shifts. Adapts predictions to new environments through preference optimization rather than standard learning objectives.

entry.title: Acceleration of horizontal numerical advection for atmospheric modeling through surrogate modeling with temporal coarse-graining

author.name: Manho Park, Christopher V. Rackauckas, Christopher W. Tessum

entry.summary: Develops a machine-learned advection solver that achieves speedup through temporal coarse-graining (larger integration steps than CFL condition allows). Uses CNNs to predict mass flux from concentrations and CFL numbers for atmospheric modeling.

entry.title: Debiasing Message Passing to Mitigate Popularity Bias in GNN-based Collaborative Filtering

author.name: Md Aminul Islam, Ahmed Sayeed Faruk, Sourav Medya, Elena Zheleva

entry.summary: Addresses popularity bias in GNN-based collaborative filtering by debiasing the message passing process itself, rather than using external corrections. Shows that repeated aggregation amplifies popularity bias and proposes in-aggregation corrections.

entry.title: Decomposing Evolutionary Mixture-of-LoRA Architectures: The Routing Lever, the Lifecycle Penalty, and a Substrate-Conditional Boundary

author.name: Ramchand Kumaresan

entry.summary: Decomposes an evolutionary mixture-of-LoRA system into router, lifecycle, and evaluation components through factorial experiments on a ~150M parameter model. Finds the router rewrite carries the entire improvement while the evolutionary lifecycle actually hurts performance.

entry.title: ChunkFlow: Communication-Aware Chunked Prefetching for Layerwise Offloading in Distributed Diffusion Transformer Inference

author.name: Han Meng (University of California, Merced), Danny Willow Liu (University of Chicago), Dong Li (University of California, Merced, Yotta Labs)

entry.summary: Proposes ChunkFlow, a communication-aware chunked prefetching strategy for layerwise offloading in distributed diffusion transformer inference. Addresses the contention between prefetch and inter-GPU communication on shared PCIe paths.

entry.title: Instruct-ICL: Instruction-Guided In-Context Learning for Post-Disaster Damage Assessment

author.name: Armin Zarbaft, Ehsan Karimi, Nhut Le, Maryam Rahnemoonfar

entry.summary: Proposes Instruct-ICL for post-disaster damage assessment using multimodal LLMs with instruction-guided in-context learning. Addresses prompt sensitivity and the impracticality of training task-specific models during time-critical disaster response.

entry.title: Keeping Score: Efficiency Improvements in Neural Likelihood Surrogate Training via Score-Augmented Loss Functions

author.name: Alexander Shen, Mikael Kuusela

entry.summary: Proposes augmenting standard binary cross-entropy loss with score (gradient) information for training neural likelihood surrogates in simulation-based inference. Improves the tradeoff between surrogate quality and simulation cost for structured stochastic process models.

entry.title: Optimal Policy Learning under Budget and Coverage Constraints

author.name: Giovanni Cerulli

entry.summary: Studies optimal policy learning under combined budget and minimum coverage constraints, showing a knapsack-type structure with affine threshold rules. Analyzes Greedy-Lagrangian and rank-and-cut algorithms with near-optimal guarantees.

entry.title: Predicting Psychological Well-Being from Spontaneous Speech using LLMs

author.name: Erfan Loweimi, Sofia de la Fuente Garcia, Saturnino Luz

entry.summary: Investigates zero-shot prediction of psychological well-being scores from spontaneous speech using 12 instruction-tuned LLMs. Achieves Spearman correlations up to 0.8 on 80% of data, suggesting LLMs can extract meaningful cues from speech transcripts.

entry.title: YFPO: A Preliminary Study of Yoked Feature Preference Optimization with Neuron-Guided Rewards for Mathematical Reasoning

author.name: Yifan Le

entry.summary: Proposes YFPO, a preliminary study of using neuron activation patterns as internal reward signals for preference optimization in mathematical reasoning. Attempts to leverage model internals rather than external preference data.

entry.title: A Comparative Study of Controlled Text Generation Systems Using Level-Playing-Field Evaluation Principles

author.name: Michela Lorandi, Anya Belz

entry.summary: Develops a level-playing-field evaluation framework for controlled text generation systems, applying standardized output processing and shared evaluation methods to enable fair comparison across different CTG approaches.

entry.title: PresentAgent-2: Towards Generalist Multimodal Presentation Agents

author.name: Wei Wu, Ziyang Xu, Zeyu Zhang, Yang Zhao, Hao Tang

entry.summary: Introduces PresentAgent-2, an agentic framework that generates complete presentation videos from user queries, including deep research, slide creation, script generation, and video composition across three presentation modes.
