entry.summary: Introduces Kaczmarz Linear Attention, deriving linear attention update rules from the Kaczmarz algorithm for online regression, replacing the learned coefficient in GDN with a principled derivation.

entry.title: Causal Stories from Sensor Traces: Auditing Epistemic Overreach in LLM-Generated Personal Sensing Explanations

author.name: Shanshan Zhu, Han Zhang, J. Doris Chi, Subigya Nepal, Koustuv Saha

entry.summary: Introduces epistemic overreach (EO) as a measure for when LLM explanations of personal sensing data imply more than available evidence justifies, auditing 14,922 explanations across three sensing datasets.

entry.title: Reasoning-Aware Training for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Md Atik Ahamed, Mihir Parmar, Palash Goyal, Chun-Liang Li, Qiang Cheng, Tomas Pfister, Jinsung Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes STRIDE, a framework integrating LLM reasoning into time series foundation models by distilling reasoning traces into the continuous embedding space, bridging the modality gap between text and temporal data.

entry.title: Event Fields: Learning Latent Event Structure for Waveform Foundation Models

author.name: Li Na, Yuanyun Zhang, Shi Li

entry.summary: Proposes a new class of waveform foundation models that model physiological time series as realizations of latent event processes rather than token sequences. Uses self-supervised learning with consistency across stochastic segmentations and time-frequency projections.

entry.title: Gate-and-Merge: Zero-shot Compositional Personalization of Vision Language Models

author.name: Guodong Ding, Angela Yao

entry.summary: Gate-and-Merge enables zero-shot compositional personalization of vision-language models by learning independent LoRA adapters per concept and merging them at inference via a gating mechanism. No co-occurrence training required.

entry.title: Debugging the Debuggers: Failure-Anchored Structured Recovery for Software Engineering Agents

author.name: Chenyu Zhao, Shenglin Zhang, Yihang Lin, Wenwei Gu, Zhimin Chen, Yongqian Sun, Dan Pei, Chetan Bansal, Saravan Rajmohan, Minghua Ma

entry.summary: PROBE is a failure-anchored recovery framework for software engineering agents that converts failed-run telemetry into structured diagnosis and bounded recovery guidance through three layers. Aims to make post-failure recovery systematic rather than ad hoc.

entry.title: Communicating Sound Through Natural Language

author.name: Emanuele Rossi, Emanuele Rodol\`a

entry.summary: Introduces lexical acoustic coding (LAC), where LLM agents transmit sound through natural language by writing their own analysis/synthesis code. Sender analyzes waveforms into descriptors, verbalizes as English; receiver parses and reconstructs.

entry.title: Deterministic Decomposition of Stochastic Generative Dynamics

author.name: Xingyu Song, Yuan Mei, Naoya Takeishi

entry.summary: Shows that the deterministic velocity field of stochastic generative processes admits a transport-osmotic decomposition separating deterministic transport from stochastic fluctuation. Provides theoretical clarity on the relationship between deterministic and stochastic generative models.

entry.title: FraudBench: A Multimodal Benchmark for Detecting AI-Generated Fraudulent Refund Evidence

author.name: Xinyu Yan, Boyang Chen, Jiaming Zhang, Tiantong Wu, Hong Xi Tae, Yichen He, Tiantong Wang, Yachun Mi, Yurong Hao, Yilei Zhao, Lei Xiao, Longtao Huang, Pengjun Xie, Wei Liu, Wei Yang Bryan Lim

entry.summary: FraudBench is a multimodal benchmark for detecting AI-generated fraudulent refund evidence, where manipulated images are used to support fake damage/defect claims. Addresses the gap between generic AI-image detection and claim-conditioned fraud detection.

entry.title: MolWorld: Molecule World Models for Actionable Molecular Optimization

author.name: Yang Qiao, Bo Pan, Hao-Wei Pang, Peter Zhiping Zhang, Liying Zhang, Liang Zhao

entry.summary: MolWorld formulates actionable molecular optimization as sequential expansion of a molecule-transfer graph, where candidates must be reachable from known molecules through valid local transformations, making suggestions practically useful for drug discovery.

entry.title: Octopus Protocol: One-Shot Hardware Discovery and Control for AI Agents via Infrastructure-as-Prompts

author.name: Quilee Simeon, Justin M. Wei, Yile Fan

entry.summary: Octopus Protocol enables one-shot hardware discovery and control for AI agents via a five-stage pipeline that automatically generates MCP servers for newly connected devices, collapsing hardware bring-up to a single command.

entry.title: Fast Rates for Offline Contextual Bandits with Forward-KL Regularization under Single-Policy Concentrability

author.name: Qingyue Zhao, Kaixuan Ji, Heyang Zhao, Quanquan Gu

entry.summary: Establishes first O(ε⁻¹) fast rates for forward-KL-regularized offline contextual bandits under single-policy concentrability, bridging a gap where only reverse-KL had been shown to achieve fast rates. Results hold in both tabular and function approximation settings.

entry.title: Flame3D: Zero-shot Compositional Reasoning of 3D Scenes with Agentic Language Models

author.name: Sagar Bharadwaj, Ziyong Ma, Anurag Ghosh, Srinivasan Seshan, Anthony Rowe

entry.summary: Flame3D is a training-free framework for zero-shot 3D scene understanding that represents scenes as editable visual-textual 3D memories and exposes them to off-the-shelf MLLMs through composable spatial tools. It handles complex reasoning including free space, object grounding, and hypothetical insertions without 3D-specific training.

entry.title: Sub-JEPA: Subspace Gaussian Regularization for Stable End-to-End World Models

author.name: Kai Zhao, Dongliang Nie, Yuchen Lin, Zhehan Luo, Yixiao Gu, Deng-Ping Fan, Dan Zeng

entry.summary: Sub-JEPA improves JEPA-based world models by replacing the isotropic Gaussian prior (used in LeWM) with a subspace Gaussian regularization that respects the low-dimensional manifold structure of latent representations, addressing the bias-variance tradeoff in JEPA training.

entry.title: RePO-VLA: Recovery-Driven Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Weijia Liufu, Xiaoyu Guo, Ruiyi Chen, Jingzhi Liu, Kaidong Zhang, Xiwen Liang, Jianqi Lin, Dawei Sun, Yuze Wang, Rongtao Xu, Bingqian Lin, Bowen Yang, Tongtong Cao, Bowen Peng, Dongyu Zhang, Guangrun Wang, Min Wang, Liang Lin, Xiaodan Liang

entry.summary: RePO-VLA introduces recovery-driven policy optimization for Vision-Language-Action models, leveraging failed and recovery trajectories rather than discarding them. Uses Progress-Aware Semantic Value Function for learning from diverse trajectory types.

entry.title: TAD: Temporal-Aware Trajectory Self-Distillation for Fast and Accurate Diffusion LLM

author.name: Haoyang Zhou, Li Kong, Shijie Ren, Xiting Wang, Shuang Liang, Guowei Wang, Zhenxuan Pan

entry.summary: TAD proposes temporal-aware trajectory self-distillation for diffusion language models, partitioning masked positions into near/distant subsets based on remaining decoding steps. Addresses the accuracy-parallelism tradeoff in parallel text generation.

entry.title: Biosignal Fingerprinting: A Cross-Modal PPG-ECG Foundation Model

author.name: Zhangdaihong Liu, Chang Liu, Fenglin Liu, Yixuan Chen, Yang Yang, David A. Clifton, Xiao Gu

entry.summary: Introduces biosignal fingerprints via a cross-modal foundation model (M2AE) trained on 3.4 million paired ECG-PPG signals. Creates compact transferable representations bridging diagnostic ECG with ubiquitous wearable PPG.

entry.title: One for All: A Non-Linear Transformer can Enable Cross-Domain Generalization for In-Context Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Bowen He, Juncheng Dong, Lin Lin, Xiang Cheng

entry.summary: Establishes a connection between non-linear transformers and reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces to enable cross-domain generalization for in-context reinforcement learning, showing a single transformer can generalize across different task domains.

entry.title: Entropy-informed Decoding: Adaptive Information-Driven Branching

author.name: Benjamin Patrick Evans, Sumitra Ganesh, Leo Ardon

entry.summary: Introduces EDEN, a model-agnostic decoding framework that adaptively allocates computation based on model uncertainty (entropy), approximating beam search with fewer expansions by branching only at high-uncertainty steps.

entry.title: LEVI: Stronger Search Architectures Can Substitute for Larger LLMs in Evolutionary Search

author.name: Temoor Tanveer

entry.summary: Introduces LEVI, an evolutionary framework arguing that stronger search architectures can substitute for larger LLMs in evolutionary search, improving on AlphaEvolve-style approaches by better archive diversity and model allocation.

entry.title: EgoMemReason: A Memory-Driven Reasoning Benchmark for Long-Horizon Egocentric Video Understanding

author.name: Ziyang Wang, Yue Zhang, Shoubin Yu, Ce Zhang, Zengqi Zhao, Jaehong Yoon, Hyunji Lee, Gedas Bertasius, Mohit Bansal

entry.summary: Introduces EgoMemReason, a benchmark for long-horizon egocentric video understanding requiring memory-driven reasoning over multiple days, with tasks testing temporal accumulation, recall, ordering, and pattern abstraction.

entry.title: Rethinking Random Transformers as Adaptive Sequence Smoothers for Sleep Staging

author.name: Guisong Liu, Xin Gao, Martin Dresler, Jiansong Zhang, Pengfei Wei

entry.summary: Reveals that randomly initialized (untrained) Transformers substantially improve sleep staging by acting as adaptive smoothers, formalized via a Random Attention Prior Kernel that balances global averaging with content-based similarity.

entry.title: Metis: Learning to Jailbreak LLMs via Self-Evolving Metacognitive Policy Optimization

author.name: Huilin Zhou, Jian Zhao, Yilu Zhong, Zhen Liang, Xiuyuan Chen, Yuchen Yuan, Tianle Zhang, Chi Zhang, Lan Zhang, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Introduces Metis, a jailbreaking framework using inference-time policy optimization within an adversarial POMDP with a self-evolving metacognitive loop for causal diagnosis of target defenses.

entry.title: ViSRA: A Video-based Spatial Reasoning Agent for Multi-modal Large Language Models

author.name: Tingshu Mou, Jiabo He, Renying Wang, Ce Liu, Hao Yang, Tiehua Zhang, Jingjing Chen, Xingjun Ma

entry.summary: Introduces ViSRA, a training-free video-based spatial reasoning agent for multimodal LLMs that uses expert models for explicit spatial information extraction, enabling plug-and-play 3D understanding without post-training.

entry.title: Coarsening Linear Non-Gaussian Causal Models with Cycles

author.name: Francisco Madaleno, Francisco C Pereira, Alex Markham

entry.summary: Shows that in linear non-Gaussian settings, causal structure learning can handle cyclic high-dimensional models while recovering acyclic low-dimensional summaries through coarsening, relaxing the common acyclicity assumption.

entry.title: LegalCiteBench: Evaluating Citation Reliability in Legal Language Models

author.name: Sijia Chen, Hang Yin, Shunfan Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces LegalCiteBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM citation accuracy in legal contexts, testing closed-book citation recovery, verification, and case matching across ~24K instances.

entry.title: Empty SPACE: Cross-Attention Sparsity for Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models

author.name: Nicola Novello, Andrea M. Tonello

entry.summary: Introduces SPACE, a closed-form concept erasure method for diffusion models that induces sparsity in cross-attention parameters, maintaining effectiveness when scaling from SD 1.5 to SDXL architectures.

entry.title: MemReread: Enhancing Agentic Long-Context Reasoning via Memory-Guided Rereading

author.name: Baibei Ji, Xiaoyang Weng, Juntao Li, Zecheng Tang, Yihang Lou, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes MemReread, an approach for long-context reasoning that triggers memory-guided rereading of document chunks instead of retrieval, avoiding evidence loss during memory formation and interference from invalid queries.

entry.title: Robust Probabilistic Shielding for Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Maris F. L. Galesloot, Thomas Rhemrev, Nils Jansen

entry.summary: Integrates safe policy improvement with probabilistic shielding for offline RL, providing both performance and safety guarantees using only the available dataset without environment interaction.

entry.title: Relations Are Channels: Knowledge Graph Embedding via Kraus Decompositions

author.name: Sayan Kumar Chaki

entry.summary: Proposes knowledge graph embedding using Kraus channel structure from quantum information theory, showing that most existing KGE models are special cases with Kraus rank 1 and generalizing to arbitrary metric geometries.

entry.title: EvoStreaming: Your Offline Video Model Is a Natively Streaming Assistant

author.name: Zichen Wen, Boxue Yang, Junlong Ke, Jiajie Huang, Chenfei Liao, Junxi Wang, Xuyang Liu, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes EvoStreaming, a method to adapt offline video-language models for streaming use by learning when to respond in real-time, plus RealStreamEval benchmark that penalizes unnecessary responses.

entry.title: Physical probes expose and alleviate chemical-environment collapse in molecular representations

author.name: Jiebin Fang, Zidi Yan, Churu Mao, Yongjun Jiang, Xinyi Tang, Lei Miao, Dan Lu, Yun Huang, Wanjing Ding, Zhongjun Ma

entry.summary: Reveals 'chemical-environment collapse' in molecular representations where topologically equivalent atoms have distinct chemical environments, and proposes CLAIM framework using contrastive learning with NMR data to address this.

entry.title: DeepRefine: Agent-Compiled Knowledge Refinement via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Haoyu Huang, Jiaxin Bai, Shujie Liu, Yang Wei, Hong Ting Tsang, Yisen Gao, Zhongwei Xie, Yufei Li, Yangqiu Song

entry.summary: Proposes DeepRefine, an RL-trained LLM reasoning model for refining agent-compiled knowledge bases by addressing incompleteness, incorrectness, and redundancy issues.

entry.title: CrackMeBench: Binary Reverse Engineering for Agents

author.name: Isaac David, Arthur Gervais

entry.summary: Introduces CrackMeBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on binary reverse engineering tasks with deterministic validation, symbol-poor binaries, and externally scored submissions.

entry.title: Re-Triggering Safeguards within LLMs for Jailbreak Detection

author.name: Zheng Lin, Zhenxing Niu, Haoxuan Ji, Yuzhe Huang, Haichang Gao

entry.summary: Proposes embedding disruption method to re-activate LLM internal safeguards for jailbreak detection, cooperating with built-in defense mechanisms rather than replacing them.

entry.title: A Recursive Decomposition Framework for Causal Structure Learning in the Presence of Latent Variables

author.name: Zheng Li, Feng Xie, Shenglan Nie, Xichen Guo, Ruxin Wang, Hao Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DiCoLa, a recursive decomposition framework for causal discovery that works with latent variables, enabling divide-and-conquer approaches beyond the causal sufficiency assumption.

entry.title: Is Data Shapley Not Better than Random in Data Selection? Ask NASH

author.name: Xiao Tian, Jue Fan, Rachael Hwee Ling Sim, Zixuan Wang, Nancy F. Chen, Bryan Kian Hsiang Low

entry.summary: Proposes NASH, a framework that identifies 'Shapley-informative' settings where Data Shapley works well and aggregates valuations from these settings for consistent data selection. Addresses the inconsistency of Data Shapley in practical data selection scenarios.

entry.title: GridProbe: Posterior-Probing for Adaptive Test-Time Compute in Long-Video VLMs

author.name: Mohamed Eltahir, Lama Ayash, Ali Habibullah, Tanveer Hussain, Naeemullah Khan

entry.summary: Proposes GridProbe, a training-free inference method for long-video VLMs that adaptively selects question-relevant frames using the model's own reasoning in answer space, achieving sub-quadratic attention cost.

entry.title: Beyond the Last Layer: Multi-Layer Representation Fusion for Visual Tokenizatio

author.name: Xuanyu Zhu, Yan Bai, Yang Shi, Yihang Lou, Yuanxing Zhang, Jing Jin, Yuan Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes DRoRAE, a lightweight fusion module that aggregates features from all encoder layers via energy-constrained routing for visual tokenization, recovering low-level visual details lost in last-layer-only extraction.

entry.title: Clin-JEPA: A Multi-Phase Co-Training Framework for Joint-Embedding Predictive Pretraining on EHR Patient Trajectories

author.name: Yixuan Yang, Mehak Arora, Ryan Zhang, Baraa Abed, Junseob Kim, Tilendra Choudhary, Md Hassanuzzaman, Kevin Zhu, Ayman Ali, Chengkun Yang, Alasdair Edward Gent, Victor Moas, Rishikesan Kamaleswaran

entry.summary: Presents Clin-JEPA, a multi-phase co-training framework applying Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture to EHR patient trajectories for simultaneous trajectory forecasting and downstream risk prediction.

entry.title: CADBench: A Multimodal Benchmark for AI-Assisted CAD Program Generation

author.name: Anna C. Doris, Jacob Thomas Sony, Ghadi Nehme, Era Syla, Amin Heyrani Nobari, Faez Ahmed

entry.summary: Introduces CADBench, a unified benchmark for multimodal CAD program generation with 18,000 samples spanning 6 benchmark families, 5 input modalities, and 6 metrics for evaluating AI-assisted design.

entry.title: Shields to Guarantee Probabilistic Safety in MDPs

author.name: Linus Heck, Filip Mac\'ak, Roman Andriushchenko, Milan \v{C}e\v{s}ka, Sebastian Junges

entry.summary: Presents a formal framework extending classical shielding to probabilistic safety in MDPs, proving impossibility results for preserving strong safety and permissiveness guarantees simultaneously, and providing practical shield constructions.

entry.title: Variational Inference for L\'evy Process-Driven SDEs via Neural Tilting

author.name: Yaman Kindap, Manfred Opper, Benjamin Dupuis, Umut Simsekli, Tolga Birdal

entry.summary: Introduces a neural exponential tilting framework for variational inference in Lévy-driven SDEs, bridging the gap between rigorous but unscalable Monte Carlo methods and efficient but Gaussian-limited neural variational approaches.

entry.title: Deep Dreams Are Made of This: Visualizing Monosemantic Features in Diffusion Models

author.name: Adam Szokalski, Mateusz Modrzejewski

entry.summary: Proposes latent visualization by optimization (LVO) for mechanistic interpretability of diffusion models, extending feature visualization to latent space with SAE-based monosemantic feature discovery.

entry.title: Distributional Spectral Diagnostics for Localizing Grokking Transitions

author.name: Ziyue Wang, Yufeng Ying, Takafumi Kanamori

entry.summary: Proposes distributional spectral diagnostics using Wasserstein coordinates and Hankel DMD to localize grokking transitions in training trajectories before test accuracy rises, achieving AUROC ~0.93.

entry.title: Exploring and Exploiting Stability in Latent Flow Matching

author.name: Rania Briq, Michael Kamp, Ohad Fried, Sarel Cohen, Stefan Kesselheim

entry.summary: Demonstrates that Latent Flow Matching models are robust to data reduction and model capacity shrinkage, showing similar outputs under identical noise seeds. Exploits this stability for more efficient training and inference.

entry.title: Learning Polyhedral Conformal Sets for Robust Optimization

author.name: Shuyi Chen, Wenbin Zhou, Shixiang Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes decision-aware conformal prediction that learns polyhedral uncertainty sets tailored to robust optimization objectives, bridging the gap between task-agnostic uncertainty quantification and downstream decision quality.

entry.title: Quantile-Coupled Flow Matching for Distributional Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Michael Groom, Victor-Alexandru Darvariu, Lars Kunze, James Wilson, Nick Hawes

entry.summary: Addresses a metric mismatch in distributional RL by aligning flow matching critics with Wasserstein distance through quantile-coupled training, making CFM critics proper surrogates for the distributional Bellman operator.

entry.title: FlashEvolve: Accelerating Agent Self-Evolution with Asynchronous Stage Orchestration

author.name: Zhengding Hu, Mingge Lu, Zhen Wang, Jixuan Ruan, Chang Chen, Zaifeng Pan, Yue Guan, Ruiyi Wang, Zhongkai Yu, Chao Zhang, Yufei Ding

entry.summary: Presents FlashEvolve, a framework that accelerates LLM agent self-evolution by replacing synchronized stage execution with asynchronous workers and queues, handling language-space staleness.

entry.title: Different Prompts, Different Ranks: Prompt-aware Dynamic Rank Selection for SVD-based LLM Compression

author.name: Hengyi Zhu, Zhendong Mi, Grace Li Zhang, Shaoyi Huang

entry.summary: Proposes PARSE, a prompt-aware dynamic rank selection for SVD-based LLM compression that adapts the number of singular components per input rather than using static truncation.

entry.title: Inpainting physics: self-supervised learning for context-driven fluid simulation

author.name: Jonas Weidner, Yeray Martin-Ruisanchez, Daniel R\"uckert, Benedikt Wiestler, Julian Suk

entry.summary: Reformulates CFD inference as an inpainting problem, learning self-supervised priors over velocity fields and imposing boundary constraints only during inference, enabling reuse under boundary condition changes.

entry.title: Muon-OGD: Muon-based Spectral Orthogonal Gradient Projection for LLM Continual Learning

author.name: Binghang Lu, Zheyuan Deng, Runyu Zhang, Bing Hu, Yunhan Zhao, Yuan Tian, Changhong Mou, Guang Lin, Xiaomin Li

entry.summary: Proposes Muon-OGD, adapting the Muon optimizer's spectral-norm geometry for continual learning in LLMs by projecting gradient updates orthogonally to past task subspaces in spectral rather than Frobenius norm. Addresses catastrophic forgetting with a geometry better matched to modern optimizers.

entry.title: Relative Kinetic Utility for Reasoning-Aware Structural Pruning in Large Language Models

author.name: Tianhao Qian

entry.summary: Introduces Relative Kinetic Utility for reasoning-aware structural pruning of LLMs, addressing the 'magnitude trap' where standard pruning methods destroy chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities at high sparsity levels.

entry.title: dFlowGRPO: Rate-Aware Policy Optimization for Discrete Flow Models

author.name: Zhengyan Wan, Yidong Ouyang, Panwen Hu, Qiang Sun

entry.summary: Presents dFlowGRPO, a unified RL framework for discrete flow models supporting various probability paths and non-masked source distributions. Extends GRPO-style policy optimization to general discrete flow models beyond masked diffusion LLMs.

entry.title: Path-Dependent Denoising: A Non-Conservative Field Perspective on Order Collapse in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Jeonseong Kim

entry.summary: Analyzes order collapse in diffusion language models through a non-conservative field perspective, formalizing when arbitrary-order denoising is well-defined via local denoising circulation. Explains why fast DLM decoding drifts toward autoregressive trajectories.

entry.title: Geometry Conflict: Explaining and Controlling Forgetting in LLM Continual Post-Training

author.name: Yuanyi Wang, Yifan Yang, Su Lu, Yanggan Gu, Pengkai Wang, Wenjun Wang, Zhaoyi Yan, Congkai Xie, Jianmin Wu, Jialun Cao, Shing-Chi Cheung, Hongxia Yang

entry.summary: Studies catastrophic forgetting in LLM continual post-training through task geometry, representing post-training tasks as directions in a shared space to determine when sequential updates transfer or interfere.

entry.title: The Truth Lies Somewhere in the Middle (of the Generated Tokens)

author.name: Sophie L. Wang, Phillip Isola, Brian Cheung

entry.summary: Shows that mean pooling across autoregressively generated hidden states yields more semantic representations than any individual token, with generated tokens outperforming prompt tokens. Quantified through kernel alignment across domains.

entry.title: Scaling the Memory of Balanced Adam

author.name: Alberto Fern\'andez-Hern\'andez, Cristian P\'erez-Corral, Jose I. Mestre, Manuel F. Dolz, Enrique S. Quintana-Ort\'i

entry.summary: Studies balanced Adam (β1=β2) and shows that β defines a statistical memory horizon that should scale with the effective learning horizon. Finds a universal rule (R_β ≈ 2) across 11 vision and language experiments.

entry.title: Breaking the Reward Barrier: Accelerating Tree-of-Thought Reasoning via Speculative Exploration

author.name: Shuzhang Zhong, Haochen Huang, Shengxuan Qiu, Pengfei Zuo, Runsheng Wang, Meng Li

entry.summary: Introduces speculative exploration for Tree-of-Thought reasoning to break the reward dependency barrier - a synchronization bottleneck from sequential reward-guided exploration that limits parallelism.

entry.title: Follow the Mean: Reference-Guided Flow Matching

author.name: Pedro M. P. Curvo, Maksim Zhdanov, Floor Eijkelboom, Jan-Willem van de Meent

entry.summary: Shows that flow matching admits control through reference examples by shifting the conditional endpoint mean. Proposes training-free Reference-Mean Guidance and trainable Reference-Conditional Generation for image generation with FLUX.2-klein.

entry.title: Equilibrium Residuals Expose Three Regimes of Matrix-Game Strategic Reasoning in Language Models

author.name: Wenhua Nie, Binhan Luo, Zijie Meng, Jyh-Shing Roger Jang, Ching-Wen Ma

entry.summary: Shows LLMs fail dramatically on anonymous matrix games despite succeeding on named game-theory benchmarks, revealing three regimes: semantic recall, approximate Nash computation, and output-interface bottleneck. Supervised fine-tuning enables generalization.

entry.title: Composing diffusion priors with explicit physical context via generative Gibbs sampling

author.name: Weizhou Wang, Jonathan Weare, Aaron R. Dinner

entry.summary: Proposes GG-PA, a training-free framework that composes pretrained diffusion model priors with explicit physical constraints via Gibbs sampling in an augmented state space. Proves asymptotic exactness and introduces replica exchange over diffusion time for acceleration.

entry.title: AdaPaD: Adaptive Parallel Deflation for PEFT with Self-Correcting Rank Discovery

author.name: Barbara Su, Fangshuo Liao, Anastasios Kyrillidis

entry.summary: Presents AdaPaD, which improves LoRA by training all rank-1 components simultaneously with self-correcting deflation targets, where deflation errors converge to zero over rounds rather than accumulating. Addresses the fundamental rank selection problem in LoRA fine-tuning.

entry.title: Elucidating Representation Degradation Problem in Diffusion Model Training

author.name: Zhipeng Yao, Dazhou Li, Zitong Zhang, Durude Mahee, Fan Zhu, Wenbin Zhang, Xinwei He, Yeying Jin, Rui Yu

entry.summary: Identifies and characterizes 'Representation Degradation' in diffusion model training, where increasing noise levels cause progressive structural distortion linked to NTK spectral weakening. Proposes ERD, a plug-and-play framework that dynamically reallocates optimization effort based on effective recoverability.

entry.title: Quantitative Local Convergence of Mean-Field Stein Variational Gradient Flow

author.name: L\'ena\"ic Chizat, Maria Colombo, Roberto Colombo, Xavier Fern\'andez-Real

entry.summary: Establishes quantitative local convergence rates for mean-field Stein Variational Gradient Descent with Riesz-type kernels, providing the first explicit polynomial convergence rates in strong norms.

entry.title: Scratchpad Patching: Decoupling Compute from Patch Size in Byte-Level Language Models

author.name: Lin Zheng, Vasilisa Bashlovkina, Timothy Dozat, Dan Garrette, Laura Rimell, Joshua Maynez

entry.summary: Introduces Scratchpad Patching for byte-level language models, inserting transient scratchpads within patches to mitigate 'patch lag' and decouple compute from patch size, improving quality without sacrificing efficiency.

entry.title: Metropolis-Adjusted Diffusion Models

author.name: Kevin H. Lam, Tyler Farghly, Christopher Williams, Jun Yang, Yee Whye Teh, Arnaud Doucet

entry.summary: Proposes Metropolis-adjusted corrector steps for diffusion model sampling using score functions instead of exact density ratios, reducing discretization bias in predictor-corrector frameworks.

entry.title: Differentially Private Sampling from Distributions via Wasserstein Projection

author.name: Shokichi Takakura, Seng Pei Liew, Satoshi Hasegawa

entry.summary: Develops a novel framework for differentially private sampling using Wasserstein distance as the utility measure instead of KL divergence. Proposes the Wasserstein Projection Mechanism (WPM), proving minimax optimality and providing efficient algorithms.

entry.title: Regret Analysis of Guided Diffusion for Black-Box Optimization over Structured Inputs

author.name: Masaki Adachi, Anita Yang, Yakun Wang, Song Liu

entry.summary: Develops the first certificate-based expected simple-regret framework for guided-diffusion black-box optimization, avoiding standard assumptions like maximum information gain and RKHS structure that break down in diffusion-BO pipelines.

entry.title: On the global convergence of gradient descent for wide shallow models with bounded nonlinearities

author.name: Romain Petit, Clarice Poon, Gabriel Peyr\'e

entry.summary: Proves that all non-global minimizers of training loss for wide shallow networks with bounded nonlinearities are unstable under gradient descent. Covers multi-head attention layers and sigmoid networks with vector output weights, extending beyond ReLU.

entry.title: Masked Generative Transformer Is What You Need for Image Editing

author.name: Wei Chow, Linfeng Li, Xian Sun, Lingdong Kong, Zefeng Li, Qi Xu, Hang Song, Tian Ye, Xian Wang, Jinbin Bai, Shilin Xu, Xiangtai Li, Junting Pan, Shaoteng Liu, Ran Zhou, Tianshu Yang, Songhua Liu

entry.summary: Proposes EditMGT, the first Masked Generative Transformer-based image editing framework that naturally confines edits to target regions through token-level prediction, avoiding the global entanglement of diffusion models. Includes a 2M-sample training dataset.

entry.title: Towards Closing the Autoregressive Gap in Language Modeling via Entropy-Gated Continuous Bitstream Diffusion

author.name: Georgios Batzolis, Mark Girolami, Luca Ambrogioni

entry.summary: Proposes entropy-gated continuous bitstream diffusion for language modeling, representing tokens as analog bit sequences with matched-filter residual parameterization. Aims to close the gap between diffusion and autoregressive language models.

entry.title: Self-Consolidating Language Models: Continual Knowledge Incorporation from Context

author.name: Zekun Wang, Anant Gupta, Zihan Dong, Christopher J. MacLellan

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Consolidating Language Models (SCoL), where LLMs learn to generate textual update instructions specifying which transformer layers should be updated to consolidate context into model weights while limiting interference.

entry.title: PaT: Planning-after-Trial for Efficient Test-Time Code Generation

author.name: Youngsik Yoon, Sungjae Lee, Seockbean Song, Siwei Wang, Wei Chen, Jungseul Ok

entry.summary: Proposes Planning-after-Trial (PaT), an adaptive test-time policy for code generation that invokes a planner only upon verification failure, enabling cost-efficient models for initial attempts with powerful models reserved for planning interventions.

entry.title: Activation Differences Reveal Backdoors: A Comparison of SAE Architectures

author.name: Sachin Kumar

entry.summary: Compares Crosscoders and Differential SAEs for detecting backdoors in fine-tuned language models, finding Diff-SAE substantially outperforms Crosscoders. Uses a controlled SQL injection backdoor triggered by year-based context.

entry.title: Gradient-Based LoRA Rank Allocation Under GRPO: An Empirical Study

author.name: Yash Ganpat Sawant

entry.summary: Finds that gradient-based adaptive LoRA rank allocation, which works well for SFT, fails under GRPO reinforcement learning, degrading accuracy by 4.5 points compared to uniform allocation. Identifies flatter gradient landscapes and noisy variance under RL as causes.

entry.title: Think-with-Rubrics: From External Evaluator to Internal Reasoning Guidance

author.name: Jiachen Yu, Zhihao Xu, Junjie Wang, Yujiu Yang

entry.summary: Introduces Think-with-Rubrics, integrating rubric generation directly into the LLM's reasoning context during instruction following, transforming rubrics from external evaluation artifacts into internal guidance for generation.

entry.title: SEIF: Self-Evolving Reinforcement Learning for Instruction Following

author.name: Qingyu Ren, Qianyu He, Jiajie Zhu, Xingzhou Chen, Jingwen Chang, Zeye Sun, Han Xia, Fei Yu, Jiaqing Liang, Yanghua Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes SEIF, a self-evolving RL framework for instruction following that creates a closed loop where instruction difficulty and model capability co-evolve, avoiding static-difficulty limitations of existing self-play methods.

entry.title: Why do Large Language Models Fail in Low-resource Translation? Unraveling the Token Dynamics of Large Language Models for Machine Translation

author.name: Shenbin Qian, Yves Scherrer

entry.summary: Systematically analyzes why LLMs fail in low-resource translation by evaluating 15 models across 22 language pairs. Introduces Token Activation Rate (TAR) metric showing that models fail to effectively utilize language-specific tokens for low-resource languages.

entry.title: Guidance Is Not a Hyperparameter: Learning Dynamic Control in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Fan Zhou, Tim Van de Cruys

entry.summary: Recasts classifier-free guidance scale selection in diffusion language models as a sequential decision-making problem, learning dynamic guidance trajectories via reinforcement learning instead of using static hyperparameters.

entry.title: CktFormalizer: Autoformalization of Natural Language into Circuit Representations

author.name: Jing Xiong, Qi Han, Chenchen Ding, He Xiao, Zunhai Su, Chaofan Tao, Ngai Wong

entry.summary: Proposes CktFormalizer, redirecting LLM-driven hardware generation through a dependently-typed HDL embedded in Lean 4. Lean catches width mismatches, combinational loops, and incomplete logic at compile-time, guiding iterative repair.

entry.title: Beyond Confidence: Rethinking Self-Assessments for Performance Prediction in LLMs

author.name: Sree Bhattacharyya, Samarth Khanna, Leona Chen, Lucas Craig, Tharun Dilliraj, James Z. Wang

entry.summary: Proposes multidimensional self-assessment for LLMs drawing on cognitive appraisal theory, eliciting six appraisal-based dimensions beyond confidence. Finds these dimensions better predict model failure across 12 LLMs and 38 tasks.

entry.title: Measuring and Mitigating the Distributional Gap Between Real and Simulated User Behaviors

author.name: Shuhaib Mehri, Philippe Laban, Sumuk Shashidhar, Marwa Abdulhai, Sergey Levine, Michel Galley, Dilek Hakkani-T\"ur

entry.summary: Introduces a method to measure distributional gaps between real and simulated user behaviors for AI assistants, using extracted behavioral representations quantized into discrete distributions. Validates through human study.

entry.title: Beyond "I cannot fulfill this request": Alleviating Rigid Rejection in LLMs via Label Enhancement

author.name: Ying Zhang, Congyu Qiao, Xin Geng, Ning Xu

entry.summary: Proposes LANCE to address rigid rejection in LLMs by using variational inference to predict continuous distributions across rejection categories, enabling more natural and flexible safety responses instead of generic template refusals.

entry.title: Ask Early, Ask Late, Ask Right: When Does Clarification Timing Matter for Long-Horizon Agents?

author.name: Anmol Gulati, Hariom Gupta, Elias Lumer, Sahil Sen, Vamse Kumar Subbiah

entry.summary: Studies when clarification timing matters for long-horizon AI agents, finding that counter to intuition, early clarification is not always optimal - the value depends on information type, with some dimensions benefiting from later clarification.

entry.title: RateQuant: Optimal Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization via Rate-Distortion Theory

author.name: Fei Zuo, Zikang Zhou, Hao Cong, Xiaoyan Xi, Ho Fai Leung

entry.summary: Proposes RateQuant for mixed-precision KV cache quantization using rate-distortion theory. Shows that different quantizers have different distortion curves and that ignoring this leads to suboptimal bit allocation across attention heads.

entry.title: Toeplitz MLP Mixers are Low Complexity, Information-Rich Sequence Models

author.name: Benjamin L. Badger, Ethan Roland

entry.summary: Introduces Toeplitz MLP Mixer (TMM), a sub-quadratic architecture using triangular-masked Toeplitz matrix multiplication instead of attention, achieving O(dn log n) training time and O(dn) inference. Shows better training efficiency in loss per compute.

entry.title: Regulating Branch Parallelism in LLM Serving

author.name: Swapnil Gandhi, Siva Hari, William J. Dally, Christos Kozyrakis

entry.summary: Addresses the problem of managing parallel branch execution in LLM serving systems, showing that both eager and fixed-cap approaches are suboptimal. Introduces TAPER, a per-step admission controller that dynamically manages branch parallelism based on batch composition and accumulated slack.

entry.title: Unsolvability Ceiling in Multi-LLM Routing: An Empirical Study of Evaluation Artifacts

author.name: Saloni Garg, Amit Sagtani

entry.summary: Shows that much of the reported 'unsolvability ceiling' in multi-LLM routing stems from evaluation artifacts including judge biases, truncation effects, and format mismatches rather than genuine model incapability.

entry.title: Tracing the Arrow of Time: Diagnosing Temporal Information Flow in Video-LLMs

author.name: Peitao Han, Fei Cheng, Lis K. Pereira, Qianying Liu, Shigeru Kitazawa

entry.summary: Traces temporal information flow in Video-LLMs finding that video-centric encoders encode strong temporal signals but these are lost during projection/integration stages. Identifies the information bottleneck is not in the encoder but in the projector/LLM interface.

entry.title: OrScale: Orthogonalised Optimization with Layer-Wise Trust-Ratio Scaling

author.name: Yuxuan Lou, Yang You

entry.summary: Introduces OrScale, a trust-ratio extension of Muon optimizer that properly scales layer-wise updates using Frobenius norm of the actual parameter-space direction. Analyzes why naive Muon-LAMB hybrids fail and provides solutions.

entry.title: S2FT: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning in Sparse Spectrum Domain

author.name: Baoquan Zhang, Zhehao Yu, Lisai Zhang, Kenghong Lin, Tianran Chen, Yuxi Sun, Yunming Ye, Yao He

entry.summary: Proposes S2FT for parameter-efficient fine-tuning by finding an invertible transformation where weight changes are sparse, challenging the assumption that weight changes have sparse Fourier spectra.

entry.title: CollabVR: Collaborative Video Reasoning with Vision-Language and Video Generation Models

author.name: Joowon Kim, Seungho Shin, Joonhyung Park, Eunho Yang

entry.summary: Proposes CollabVR, a closed-loop framework coupling VLMs and Video Generation Models for visual reasoning, addressing long-horizon drift and mid-clip simulation errors through collaborative reasoning.

entry.title: Reinforcing Multimodal Reasoning Against Visual Degradation

author.name: Rui Liu, Dian Yu, Haolin Liu, Yucheng Shi, Tong Zheng, Runpeng Dai, Haitao Mi, Pratap Tokekar, Leoweiliang

entry.summary: ROMA proposes an RL fine-tuning framework for MLLMs that maintains reasoning robustness against visual degradations like blur and compression artifacts. Addresses the reward poisoning problem when degraded views are naively injected during rollout.

entry.title: Reflection Anchors for Propagation-Aware Visual Retention in Long-Chain Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Xuan Gong, Hanbo Huang, Hao Zheng, Yiran Zhang, Wenbin Dai, Weishu Zhao, Shiyu Liang

entry.summary: Studies visual information fading during long chain-of-thought reasoning in vision-language models from an information-theoretic standpoint, deriving bounds on downstream visual gain and proposing reflection anchors for intervention.

entry.title: Med-StepBench: A Hierarchical Reasoning Framework for Evaluating Hallucinations in Medical Vision-Language Models

author.name: Minh Khoi Nguyen, Dai Lam Le, Amir Reza Jafari, Tuan Dung Nguyen, Mai Hong Son, Mai Huy Thong, Quang Huy Nguyen, Thanh Trung Nguyen, Reza Farahbakhsh, Noel Crespi, Phi Le Nguyen

entry.summary: Med-StepBench is the first large-scale benchmark for step-wise hallucination detection in 3D oncological PET/CT, with 12,000+ images and 1M+ image-statement pairs. It evaluates whether VLM predictions are grounded in correct localization rather than just final diagnosis.

entry.title: ExtraVAR: Stage-Aware RoPE Remapping for Resolution Extrapolation in Visual Autoregressive Models

author.name: Feihong Yan, Shaoyu Liu, Haixuan Wang, Shuai Lu, Linfeng Zhang, Huiqi Li, Xiangyang Ji

entry.summary: ExtraVAR identifies a 'band-stage mismatch' causing failure modes in Visual Autoregressive models at higher resolutions, and proposes a training-free Stage-Aware RoPE Remapping strategy to enable resolution extrapolation.

entry.title: What Concepts Lie Within? Detecting and Suppressing Risky Content in Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Chenyu Zhang, Lanjun Wang, Yueyang Cheng, Ruidong Chen, Wenhui Li, An-an Liu

entry.summary: This paper addresses risky content detection and suppression in Diffusion Transformer architectures, proposing methods to isolate and erase unsafe concepts despite DiT's entangled joint attention mechanism.

entry.title: Filtering Memorization from Parameter-Space in Diffusion Models

author.name: Yu Zhe, Yang Jiayan, Wei Junhao, Yu-Lin Tsai, Wang Chen

entry.summary: Base-Anchored Filtering (BAF) removes memorized training images from released LoRA weights without access to training data or pipeline, addressing privacy/copyright in LoRA-sharing ecosystems.

entry.title: TIE: Time Interval Encoding for Video Generation over Events

author.name: Zhilei Shu, Shangwen Zhu, Zihang Liang, Xiaofan Li, Qianyu Peng, Xinyu Cui, Bo Ye, Yiming Li, Fan Cheng, Jian Zhao, Yang Cao, Zheng-Jun Zha, Ruili Feng

entry.summary: TIE (Time Interval Encoding) introduces interval-aware temporal encoding for video generation, enabling representation of overlapping concurrent events that point-wise positional encodings cannot express.

entry.title: GenMed: A Pairwise Generative Reformulation of Medical Diagnostic Tasks

author.name: Hantao Zhang, Weidong Guo, Yuhe Liu, Jiancheng Yang, Sathvik Bhagavan, Danli Shi, Mingda Xu, Pascal Fua

entry.summary: GenMed reformulates medical diagnostics as a generative problem, modeling joint distribution P(X,Y) with diffusion models and performing gradient-based test-time optimization for flexible inference across modalities.

entry.title: Verification Mirage: Mapping the Reliability Boundary of Self-Verification in Medical VQA

author.name: Ruinan Jin, Beidi Zhao, Myeongkyun Kang, Qiong Zhang, Xiaoxiao Li

entry.summary: This paper exposes the 'verification mirage' in medical VQA self-verification, where capacity-coupled verifiers create false safety by agreeing with incorrect answers due to high agreement bias.

entry.title: Pixal3D: Pixel-Aligned 3D Generation from Images

author.name: Dong-Yang Li, Wang Zhao, Yuxin Chen, Wenbo Hu, Meng-Hao Guo, Fang-Lue Zhang, Ying Shan, Shi-Min Hu

entry.summary: Pixal3D introduces a pixel-aligned 3D generation paradigm that directly generates 3D assets in the input view's coordinate frame rather than canonical space, improving pixel-level fidelity in image-to-3D synthesis. Draws inspiration from 3D reconstruction to address the implicit 2D-3D correspondence problem.

entry.title: DeltaRubric: Generative Multimodal Reward Modeling via Joint Planning and Verification

author.name: Rui Liu, Dian Yu, Zhenwen Liang, Yucheng Shi, Tong Zheng, Runpeng Dai, Haitao Mi, Pratap Tokekar, Leoweiliang

entry.summary: DeltaRubric reformulates multimodal preference evaluation as a plan-and-execute process within a single MLLM, dynamically synthesizing rubrics that isolate spatial and factual discrepancies between responses to combat lazy judging.

entry.title: Perception Without Engagement: Dissecting the Causal Discovery Deficit in LMMs

author.name: Jiafeng Liang, Zhihao Zhu, Zihan Zhang, Baoqi Ren, Shixin Jiang, Runxuan Liu, Tao Ren, Ming Liu, See-Kiong Ng, Bing Qin

entry.summary: ProCauEval introduces a perturbation-based evaluation protocol that diagnoses LMMs' causal discovery deficits by systematically manipulating visual and textual modalities across five configurations, revealing how models rely on textual prior shortcuts rather than genuine visual causal reasoning.

entry.title: HiDrive: A Closed-Loop Benchmark for High-Level Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zhongyu Xia, Guanyu Zhu, Guo Tang, Wenhao Chen, Yongtao Wang

entry.summary: HiDrive proposes a new closed-loop benchmark for autonomous driving that addresses saturation of existing benchmarks by adding long-tail scenarios, rare safety-critical objects, and advanced decision-making evaluation including legal compliance and ethical reasoning.

entry.title: Neuromorphic Reinforcement Learning for Quadruped Locomotion Control on Uneven Terrain

author.name: Zhuangyu Han, Abhronil Sengupta

entry.summary: Proposes an equilibrium-propagation-based PPO framework for quadruped locomotion that replaces global backpropagation with local learning rules, making it compatible with neuromorphic computing substrates for energy-efficient on-robot adaptation.

entry.title: The Iliad Intensive Course Materials

author.name: Leon Lang

entry.summary: Release of comprehensive course materials for the Iliad Intensive, a month-long AI Alignment course targeting mathematically strong backgrounds, covering singular learning theory, data attribution, and coding problems with solutions.

entry.title: Iterative Finetuning is Mostly Idempotent

author.name: zroe1

entry.summary: Research finding that iterative finetuning on model outputs is mostly idempotent with respect to safety-relevant traits, with trait amplification being rare. When models train on their own outputs, traits usually decay or stay static.

entry.title: AgentPSO: Evolving Agent Reasoning Skill via Multi-agent Particle Swarm Optimization

author.name: Hyunmin Hwang, Jaemin Kim, Choonghan Kim, Hangeol Chang, Jong Chul Ye

entry.summary: Introduces AgentPSO, a particle-swarm-inspired framework where multi-agent reasoning skills evolve through semantic updates toward stronger skills, treating agents as particles whose state is a natural-language skill description.

entry.title: BEACON: Cross-Domain Co-Training of Generative Robot Policies via Best-Effort Adaptation

author.name: Antong Zhang, Han Qi, Heng Yang

entry.summary: BEACON introduces a theory-driven cross-domain co-training framework for generative robot policies using discrepancy-aware importance reweighting, jointly learning diffusion-based policies and per-sample source weights informed by target-domain generalization guarantees.

entry.title: AHD Agent: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Automatic Heuristic Design

author.name: Haoze Lv, Ning Lu, Ziang Zhou, Shengcai Liu

entry.summary: Proposes AHD Agent, a tool-integrated multi-turn framework that empowers LLMs as active agents for automatic heuristic design of NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems, rather than passive generators.

entry.title: When to Re-Commit: Temporal Abstraction Discovery for Long-Horizon Vision-Language Reasoning

author.name: Chen Li, Zhantao Yang, Fangyi Chen, Han Zhang, Anudeepsekhar Bolimera, Marios Savvides

entry.summary: Formalizes 'commitment depth' - how many actions to execute open-loop between replans - as a learnable state-conditioned variable. Shows adaptive commitment Pareto-dominates fixed-depth approaches on Sliding Puzzle and Sokoban.

entry.title: CERSA: Cumulative Energy-Retaining Subspace Adaptation for Memory-Efficient Fine-Tuning

author.name: Jingze Ge, Xue Geng, Yun Liu, Wanqi Dong, Wang Zhe Mark, Min Wu, Ngai-Man Cheung, Bharadwaj Veeravalli, Xulei Yang

entry.summary: Introduces CERSA, a fine-tuning method using SVD to retain only principal components of pre-trained weights and adapt in the compressed subspace, achieving better memory efficiency than LoRA while maintaining performance.

entry.title: The Silent Vote: Improving Zero-Shot LLM Reliability by Aggregating Semantic Neighborhoods

author.name: Sanket Badhe, Priyanka Tiwari, Deep Shah

entry.summary: Identifies 'Renormalization Bias' in zero-shot LLM classification where constrained decoding discards probability mass from semantic synonyms. Proposes 'Semantic Softmax' to recover lost information by aggregating semantic neighborhoods.

entry.title: Natural Policy Gradient as Doubly Smoothed Policy Iteration: A Bellman-Operator Framework

author.name: Phalguni Nanda, Zaiwei Chen

entry.summary: Shows that natural policy gradient can be exactly formulated as doubly smoothed policy iteration (DSPI), unifying policy iteration, dual-averaged policy iteration, and natural policy gradient under a single Bellman-operator framework. Proves distribution-free global geometric convergence.

entry.title: Locking Pretrained Weights via Deep Low-Rank Residual Distillation

author.name: Keitaro Sakamoto, Pierre Ablin, Federico Danieli, Marco Cuturi

entry.summary: Proposes Deep Low-Rank Residual Distillation for 'locking' pretrained model weights against unauthorized fine-tuning, where the model is restructured so that adaptation becomes difficult without an authorized key. Addresses concerns about open-weight model misuse.

entry.title: Extended Wasserstein-GAN Approach to Causal Distribution Learning: Density-Free Estimation and Minimax Optimality

author.name: Shu Tamano, Masaaki Imaizumi

entry.summary: Extends Wasserstein-GAN approaches to distributional causal inference, providing density-free estimation with minimax optimality guarantees. Addresses limitations of existing GAN-based counterfactual methods that rely on unstable density ratio estimation.

entry.title: Can LLMs Take Retrieved Information with a Grain of Salt?

author.name: Behzad Shayegh, Mohamed Osama Ahmed, Fred Tung, Leo Feng

entry.summary: Evaluates eight LLMs on context-certainty obedience - how well they adjust responses based on the expressed certainty of retrieved information. Reveals systematic failures: LLMs struggle to recall prior knowledge after uncertain contexts and overtrust complex contexts.

entry.title: Beyond LoRA vs. Full Fine-Tuning: Gradient-Guided Optimizer Routing for LLM Adaptation

author.name: Haozhan Tang, Xiuqi Zhu, Xinyin Zhang, Boxun Li, Virginia Smith, Kevin Kuo

entry.summary: Proposes MoLF (Mixture of LoRA and Full Fine-Tuning), a gradient-guided approach that dynamically routes between LoRA and full fine-tuning at the parameter level. Evaluates across SQL, Medical QA, and Counterfactual Knowledge tasks.

entry.title: SkillLens: Adaptive Multi-Granularity Skill Reuse for Cost-Efficient LLM Agents

author.name: Yongliang Miao, Ziyang Yu, Liang Zhao, Bowen Zhu, Hasibul Haque

entry.summary: Proposes SkillLens, a hierarchical skill-evolution framework for LLM agents that organizes skills into four layers (policies, strategies, procedures, primitives) and retrieves them at mixed granularity to balance relevance and cost.

entry.title: The Echo Amplifies the Knowledge: Somatic Marker Analogues in Language Models via Emotion Vector Re-Injection

author.name: Jared Glover

entry.summary: Implements 'somatic markers' in language models by identifying emotion-exclusive features via sparse autoencoders and re-injecting emotion vectors during recall, inspired by Damasio's somatic marker hypothesis.

entry.title: M$^3$: Reframing Training Measures for Discretized Physical Simulations

author.name: Yuan Mei, Xingyu Song, Xiaowen Song, Naoya Takeishi

entry.summary: Introduces M³ (Multi-scale Morton Measure), a framework that balances training measures for neural surrogate models on discretized physical simulations, achieving up to 4.7x lower error in large-scale cases.

entry.title: SearchSkill: Teaching LLMs to Use Search Tools with Evolving Skill Banks

author.name: Jinchao Hu, Meizhi Zhong, Kehai Chen, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SearchSkill, which makes LLM query planning explicit through reusable search skills and maintains an evolving SkillBank that expands from failure patterns, improving retrieval-augmented QA.

entry.title: Evidence Over Plans: Online Trajectory Verification for Skill Distillation

author.name: Yang Zhou, Zihan Dong, Zhenting Wang, Can Jin, Shiyu Zhao, Bangwei Guo, Difei Gu, Linjun Zhang, Mu Zhou, Dimitris N. Metaxas

entry.summary: Proposes the Posterior Distillation Index (PDI) for measuring how well distilled agent skills are grounded in environment interaction evidence. Introduces SPARK framework for online trajectory verification in skill distillation.

entry.title: NEXUS: Continual Learning of Symbolic Constraints for Safe and Robust Embodied Planning

author.name: Tiehan Cui, Peipei Liu, Yanxu Mao, Congying Liu, Mingzhe Xing, Datao You

entry.summary: Introduces NEXUS, a modular framework for continual learning in embodied agents that decouples physical feasibility from safety specifications using symbolic grounding and deterministic constraints.

entry.title: From Passive Reuse to Active Reasoning: Grounding Large Language Models for Neuro-Symbolic Experience Replay

author.name: Yanan Xiao, Yixiang Tang, Zechen Feng, Lu Jiang, Minghao Yin, Pengyang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Neuro-Symbolic Experience Replay (NSER) that transforms replay from passive sample reuse into active knowledge construction using LLMs to abstract behavioral rules from experience.

entry.title: TIDE-Bench: Task-Aware and Diagnostic Evaluation of Tool-Integrated Reasoning

author.name: Yize Li, Junzhi Li, Jason Song, Chuxiong Sun, Rui Wang, Changwen Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces TIDE-Bench for evaluating tool-integrated reasoning with diverse task settings including tool-grounded experimental design and dynamic interactive tasks, plus diagnostic capabilities and efficient evaluation.

entry.title: Absurd World: A Simple Yet Powerful Method to Absurdify the Real-world for Probing LLM Reasoning Capabilities

author.name: Ryan Albright, Golam Md Muktadir, Zarif Ikram, S M Jubaer, Mehrab Hossain, Dianbo Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Absurd World, a benchmarking framework that alters real-world scenarios while maintaining logical coherence, testing whether LLMs are robust in simple logical reasoning under modified realism.

entry.title: The Metacognitive Probe: Five Behavioural Calibration Diagnostics for LLMs

author.name: Rafael C. T. Oliveira

entry.summary: Introduces a 5-task metacognitive diagnostic probe for LLMs measuring confidence calibration, epistemic vigilance, knowledge boundaries, calibration range, and reasoning-chain validation across 8 frontier models.

entry.title: RADAR: Redundancy-Aware Diffusion for Multi-Agent Communication Structure Generation

author.name: Zhen Zhang, Wanjing Zhou, Juncheng Li, Hao Fei, Jun Wen, Wei Ji

entry.summary: Introduces RADAR, a redundancy-aware diffusion-based framework for generating adaptive multi-agent communication topologies that reduce token overhead on simple tasks while enabling complex task solving.

entry.title: Positive Alignment: Artificial Intelligence for Human Flourishing

author.name: Ruben Laukkonen, Seb Krier, Chlo\'e Bakalar, Shamil Chandaria, Morten Kringelbach, Adam Elwood, Daniel Ford, Fernando Rosas, Maty Bohacek, Matija Franklin, Nenad Toma\v{s}ev, Stephanie Chan, Verena Rieser, Roma Patel, Michael Levin, Arun Rao

entry.summary: Proposes 'Positive Alignment' - developing AI systems that actively support human flourishing rather than just preventing harm. Argues this parallels psychology's shift from treating illness to promoting wellness.

entry.title: Can Agent Benchmarks Support Their Scores? Evidence-Supported Bounds for Interactive-Agent Evaluation

author.name: Shanshan Gao, Liyi Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for evaluating the reliability of interactive agent benchmark outcome checks. Shows that surface-level outcome detection can make benchmark scores misleading, and provides evidence-supported bounds for agent evaluation.

entry.title: LLM Jaggedness Unlocks Scientific Creativity

author.name: Shray Mathur, J. Anibal Boscoboinik, Esther H. R. Tsai, Kevin G. Yager

entry.summary: Introduces SciAidanBench for measuring LLM scientific creativity by asking models to generate many unique ideas. Finds that model capabilities are 'jagged' - creative performance varies dramatically across domains and doesn't correlate with general benchmarks.

entry.title: MaD Physics: Evaluating information seeking under constraints in physical environments

author.name: Moksh Jain, Mehdi Bennani, Johannes Bausch, Yuri Chervonyi, Bogdan Georgiev, Simon Osindero, Nenad Toma\v{s}ev

entry.summary: Proposes MaD Physics, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents' ability to make informative measurements and conclusions under physical and cost constraints for scientific discovery.

entry.title: Rethinking Temporal Consistency in Video Object-Centric Learning: From Prediction to Correspondence

author.name: Zhiyuan Li, Rongzhen Zhao, Wenyan Yang, Wenshuai Zhao, Pekka Marttinen, Joni Pajarinen

entry.summary: Proposes replacing learned dynamics modules in video object-centric learning with deterministic bipartite matching (Hungarian algorithm) using frozen backbone features. Shows that modern self-supervised vision backbones already encode instance-discriminative features, eliminating the need for expensive learned temporal prediction.

entry.title: Context-Augmented Code Generation: How Product Context Improves AI Coding Agent Decision Compliance by 49%

author.name: Drew Dillon, Kasyap Varanasi

entry.summary: Introduces a benchmark measuring decision compliance in AI coding agents - how well they follow product/design decisions not visible in source code. Shows product-context retrieval improves compliance by 49%.

entry.title: Understanding Asynchronous Inference Methods for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Ayoub Agouzoul

entry.summary: Provides a systematic comparison of four asynchronous inference methods for Vision-Language-Action models in robotics under controlled conditions, addressing observation staleness from inference latency.

entry.title: Normalization Equivariance for Arbitrary Backbones, with Application to Image Denoising

author.name: Youssef Saied, Fran\c{c}ois Fleuret

entry.summary: Characterizes the full class of Normalization Equivariant functions and shows exact NE enforcement requires only a parameter-free wrapper around any backbone, including transformers. Applied to image denoising.

entry.title: Beyond Penalization: Diffusion-based Out-of-Distribution Detection and Selective Regularization in Offline Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Qingjun Wang, Hongtu Zhou, Hang Yu, Junqiao Zhao, Yanping Zhao, Chen Ye, Ziqiao Wang, Guang Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DOSER, a framework for offline RL that uses two diffusion models to distinguish between in-distribution and OOD actions, enabling selective regularization rather than uniform penalization of unseen actions.

entry.title: TinySSL: Distilled Self-Supervised Pretraining for Sub-Megabyte MCU Models

author.name: Bibin Wilson

entry.summary: Introduces TinySSL/CA-DSSL, a teacher-guided self-supervised learning framework for MCU-class models (<500K params), overcoming projection head dominance and representation bottleneck issues at tiny scale.

entry.title: Path-Coupled Bellman Flows for Distributional Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Boyang Xu, Qing Zou, Siqin Yang, Hao Yan

entry.summary: Proposes Path-Coupled Bellman Flows (PCBF) for distributional RL using flow matching with source-consistent Bellman-coupled paths that maintain pathwise affine relations, addressing boundary mismatch and high-variance bootstrapping.

entry.title: SLayerGen: a Crystal Generative Model for all Space and Layer Groups

author.name: Rees Chang, Andrew Novick, Ryan P Adams, Elif Ertekin

entry.summary: Proposes SLayerGen, a generative model for crystals invariant to any space or layer group, enabling generation of 2D and diperiodic materials (thin films, surfaces, 2D superconductors).

entry.title: Toward Optimal Regret in Robust Pricing: Decoupling Corruption and Time

author.name: Kalana Kalupahana, Francesco Emanuele Stradi, Matteo Castiglioni, Alberto Marchesi

entry.summary: Designs the first regret guarantees for robust dynamic pricing that decouple corruption C from time horizon T, improving upon existing bounds where corruption and time are multiplicatively coupled.

entry.title: What Software Engineering Looks Like to AI Agents? -- An Empirical Study of AI-Only Technical Discourse on MoltBook

author.name: Junyu Huo, Ziqi Mao, Zihao Wan, Gouri Ginde

entry.summary: Empirically studies MoltBook, an AI-agents-only social network, analyzing what autonomous AI agents discuss about software engineering when interacting primarily with each other, comparing against human developer discourse on GitHub.

entry.title: A Semantic-Sampling Framework for Evaluating Calibration in Open-Ended Question Answering

author.name: Zhanliang Wang, Jiancong Xiao, Ruochen Jin, Shu Yang, Bojian Hou, Li Shen

entry.summary: Introduces a semantic-sampling framework for evaluating LLM calibration in open-ended QA, addressing limitations of existing methods that require restricted output formats, internal probabilities, or task-specific extraction rules.

entry.title: Recovering Physical Dynamics from Discrete Observations via Intrinsic Differential Consistency

author.name: Yuxiang Luo, Andrew Perrault

entry.summary: Replaces local supervision with a global semi-group constraint (Symmetry Rupture) for recovering continuous-time dynamics from discrete observations, enabling larger step sizes and more robust trajectory reconstruction.

entry.title: MARLaaS: Multi-Tenant Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning as a Service

author.name: Timothy Tin Long Yu, Gursimran Singh, Ge Shi, Hanieh Sadri, Yong Zhang, Zhenan Fan

entry.summary: Proposes MARLaaS, a multi-tenant asynchronous RL fine-tuning system that shares a base model across users via LoRA adapters with a disaggregated architecture separating rollout, environment interaction, and training.

entry.title: PARD-2: Target-Aligned Parallel Draft Model for Dual-Mode Speculative Decoding

author.name: Zihao An, Taichi Liu, Ziqiong Liu, Dong Li, Ruofeng Liu, Emad Barsoum

entry.summary: Proposes PARD-2 for speculative decoding with confidence-adaptive token optimization that reweights tokens to maximize acceptance length rather than prediction accuracy, better aligning draft model training with inference goals.

entry.title: VECTOR-Drive: Tightly Coupled Vision-Language and Trajectory Expert Routing for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Rui Zhao, Jianlin Yu, Zhenhai Gao, Jiaqiao Liu, Fei Gao

entry.summary: VECTOR-DRIVE is a tightly coupled vision-language-action framework built on Qwen2.5-VL-3B for autonomous driving that keeps all tokens coupled through shared self-attention while routing feed-forward computation by token semantics.

entry.title: FragileFlow: Spectral Control of Correct-but-Fragile Predictions for Foundation Model Robustness

author.name: Zhuoyun Li, Boxuan Wang, Jinwei Hu, Xiaowei Huang, Yi Dong

entry.summary: FragileFlow formalizes 'correct-but-fragile' predictions where probability mass flows toward wrong competitors near decision boundaries. Introduces a plug-in regularizer with a PAC-Bayes bound for margin-aware error flow.

entry.title: Evolutionary Ensemble of Agents

author.name: Zongmin Yu, Liu Yang

entry.summary: EvE (Evolutionary Ensemble) organizes existing coding agents into a co-evolving system for algorithmic discovery, maintaining populations of code solvers and agent guidance states evaluated through synchronous racing with Elo ratings.

entry.title: Revisiting Mixture Policies in Entropy-Regularized Actor-Critic

author.name: Jiamin He, Samuel Neumann, Jincheng Mei, Adam White, Martha White

entry.summary: Revisits mixture policies in entropy-regularized actor-critic, proposing a marginalized reparameterization (MRP) estimator that provides lower variance than standard alternatives and enables practical use of mixture policies in continuous RL.

entry.title: RigidFormer: Learning Rigid Dynamics using Transformers

author.name: Zhiyang Dou, Minghao Guo, Haixu Wu, Doug Roble, Tuur Stuyck, Wojciech Matusik

entry.summary: RigidFormer is a Transformer-based model for learning mesh-free rigid-body dynamics with controllable integration steps. It operates at the object level using compact anchors and Anchor-Vertex Pooling, avoiding the limitations of mesh-connectivity-dependent methods.

entry.title: Micro-Defects Expose Macro-Fakes: Detecting AI-Generated Images via Local Distributional Shifts

author.name: Boxuan Zhang, Jianing Zhu, Qifan Wang, Jiang Liu, Ruixiang Tang

entry.summary: MDMF proposes a local distribution-aware framework for detecting AI-generated images by amplifying micro-scale statistical irregularities using learnable Patch Forensic Signatures and MMD-based distributional comparison.

entry.title: Neural Cluster First, Route Second: One-Shot Capacitated Vehicle Routing via Differentiable Optimal Transport

author.name: Samuel J. K. Chin, Maximilian Schiffer

entry.summary: Neural CFRS is the first purely non-autoregressive one-shot neural framework for Capacitated Vehicle Routing, combining differentiable optimal transport for clustering with routing. Revisits the classical Cluster-First-Route-Second paradigm through neural combinatorial optimization.

entry.title: APCD: Adaptive Path-Contrastive Decoding for Reliable Large Language Model Generation

author.name: Tianyu Zheng, Hong Wu, Jiaji Zhong

entry.summary: APCD proposes multi-path decoding for LLMs with entropy-driven branching and controlled path interaction to reduce hallucinations from error accumulation in autoregressive generation.

entry.title: CLR-voyance: Reinforcing Open-Ended Reasoning for Inpatient Clinical Decision Support with Outcome-Aware Rubrics

author.name: Aishik Nagar, Arun-Kumar Kaliya-Perumal, Yu-Hsuan Han, Andrew Sheng-Han Huang, Kristen Kee, Yushi Cao, Yiming Chen, Hongchao Jiang

entry.summary: CLR-voyance reformulates inpatient clinical reasoning as a POMDP with outcome-grounded, clinician-validated rewards. Uses RL to supervise open-ended clinical reasoning without leaking future patient journey information.

entry.title: MedMeta: A Benchmark for LLMs in Synthesizing Meta-Analysis Conclusion from Medical Studies

author.name: Huy Hoang Ha, Benoit Favre, Francois Portet

entry.summary: MedMeta is the first benchmark for evaluating LLMs' ability to synthesize conclusions from medical meta-analyses using cited study abstracts. Tests both RAG and parametric-only approaches.

entry.title: Metal-Sci: A Scientific Compute Benchmark for Evolutionary LLM Kernel Search on Apple Silicon

author.name: V\'ictor Gallego

entry.summary: Presents Metal-Sci, a 10-task benchmark of scientific compute kernels for Apple Silicon, paired with an evolutionary LLM kernel search harness. Tests Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT 5.5 on scientific compute optimization.

entry.title: KV-RM: Regularizing KV-Cache Movement for Static-Graph LLM Serving

author.name: Zhiqing Zhong, Zhijing Ye, Jian Zhang, Weijian Zheng, Bolun Sun, Xiaodong Yu

entry.summary: Presents KV-RM, a runtime design that regularizes KV-cache movement beneath static-graph LLM decoders, decoupling logical KV histories from physical storage to enable predictable execution without over-reserving memory.

entry.title: EvoPref: Multi-Objective Evolutionary Optimization Discovers Diverse LLM Alignments Beyond Gradient Descent

author.name: Dongxin Guo, Jikun Wu, Siu Ming Yiu

entry.summary: Introduces EvoPref, a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm for LLM alignment that maintains populations of LoRA adapters optimized across helpfulness, harmlessness, and honesty using NSGA-II, improving preference coverage by 18% over gradient methods.

entry.title: Intervention-Based Time Series Causal Discovery via Simulator-Generated Interventional Distributions

author.name: Tsuyoshi Okita

entry.summary: Proposes SVAR-FM, using physics-based simulators as mechanical realizations of Pearl's do operator for time series causal discovery, with Flow Matching learning nonlinear interventional conditionals.

entry.title: Yeti: A compact protein structure tokenizer for reconstruction and multi-modal generation

author.name: Nabin Giri, Steven Farrell, Kristofer E. Bouchard

entry.summary: Introduces Yeti, a compact protein structure tokenizer that converts continuous atomic coordinates into discrete representations for multimodal protein modeling, prioritizing both reconstruction fidelity and generative quality.

entry.title: MicroWorld: Empowering Multimodal Large Language Models to Bridge the Microscopic Domain Gap with Multimodal Attribute Graph

author.name: Manyu Li, Ruian He, Chenxi Ma, Weimin Tan, Bo Yan

entry.summary: Introduces MicroWorld, a framework using multimodal attributed property graphs from scientific image-caption corpora to augment MLLM reasoning in microscopy without domain-specific fine-tuning.

entry.title: When Prompts Become Payloads: A Framework for Mitigating SQL Injection Attacks in Large Language Model-Driven Applications

author.name: Farzad Nourmohammadzadeh Motlagh, Mehrdad Hajizadeh, Mehryar Majd, Pejman Najafi, Feng Cheng, Christoph Meinel

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-layered security framework to detect and mitigate SQL injection attacks that exploit LLM-based natural language to SQL translation, addressing a new attack surface from AI-driven database interfaces.

entry.title: DP-LAC: Lightweight Adaptive Clipping for Differentially Private Federated Fine-tuning of Language Models

author.name: Haaris Mehmood, Jie Xu, Karthikeyan Saravanan, Rogier Van Dalen, Mete Ozay

entry.summary: Introduces DP-LAC for differentially private federated fine-tuning of LLMs, using private histogram estimation for initial clipping threshold and lightweight adaptive adjustment to reduce hyperparameter tuning overhead.

entry.title: Active Tabular Augmentation via Policy-Guided Diffusion Inpainting

author.name: Zheyu Zhang, Shuo Yang, Bardh Prenkaj, Gjergji Kasneci

entry.summary: Proposes TAP, combining diffusion inpainting with a learner-conditioned policy for tabular data augmentation that decides what to generate and when to inject based on downstream model's current needs.

entry.title: CoWorld-VLA: Thinking in a Multi-Expert World Model for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Minqing Huang, Yujiao Xiang, Zihan Liang, Jiajie Huang, Jingqi Wang, Zhi Xu, Feiyang Tan, Hangning Zhou, Mu Yang, Gong Che

entry.summary: Proposes CoWorld-VLA, a multi-expert world reasoning framework for autonomous driving where world representations serve as explicit conditions for action planning, using multi-source supervision for complementary world information.

entry.title: HH-SAE: Discovering and Steering Hierarchical Knowledge of Complex Manifolds

author.name: Honghan Wu, Tianyan Wang, Jiacong Mi, Zhoyang Jiang, Yunsoo Kim

entry.summary: Introduces Hybrid Hierarchical SAE (HH-SAE) that factorizes manifolds into contextual, atomic, and compository tiers for discovering and steering hierarchical knowledge in complex domains, achieving cross-domain zero-shot performance.

entry.title: Fairness vs Performance: Characterizing the Pareto Frontier of Algorithmic Decision Systems

author.name: Mieke Wilms, Christoph Heitz

entry.summary: Characterizes the Pareto frontier of fairness vs. performance trade-offs in binary prediction-based decision systems, proving optimal solutions are deterministic group-specific thresholds.

entry.title: When Can Digital Personas Reliably Approximate Human Survey Findings?

author.name: Mumin Jia, Yilin Chen, Divya Sharma, Jairo Diaz-Rodriguez

entry.summary: Evaluates when LLM-powered digital personas can reliably substitute for human survey respondents using the LISS panel. Finds personas improve alignment with human response distributions for stable attributes/values but remain limited for dynamic or context-dependent behaviors.

entry.title: SLIM: Sparse Latent Steering for Interpretable and Property-Directed LLM-Based Molecular Editing

author.name: Mingxu Zhang, Yuhan Li, Lujundong Li, Dazhong Shen, Hui Xiong, Ying Sun

entry.summary: Proposes SLIM, a framework that decomposes LLM hidden states into sparse, property-aligned features via Sparse Autoencoders for controlled molecular editing, improving editing success rate without modifying model parameters.

entry.title: LLMs with in-context learning for Algorithmic Theoretical Physics

author.name: Anamaria Hell, Leander Thiele

entry.summary: Demonstrates that Claude interfaced with Maple CAS can perform algorithmic computations in cosmological perturbation theory for modified gravity, identifying current capabilities and failure modes.

entry.title: Direct Bethe Free Energy Minimization for Bayesian Neural Ne twork

author.name: Pavel Prochazka

entry.summary: Proposes training Bayesian neural networks by directly minimizing the Bethe free energy instead of variational bounds. Shows that for tree-structured factor graphs this is exact, and deterministic layers can use standard backpropagation.

entry.title: AAAC: Activation-Aware Adaptive Codebooks for 4-bit LLM Weight Quantization

author.name: Beshr IslamBouli, David Jin

entry.summary: Proposes AAAC, replacing fixed scalar codebooks in 4-bit quantization with two small learned codebooks per layer, minimizing activation-weighted error. Lightweight at only 64 bytes per layer overhead.

entry.title: Machine Learning Research Has Outpaced Its Communication Norms and NeurIPS Should Act

author.name: Ajay Mandyam Rangarajan, Jeyashree Krishnan

entry.summary: Argues NeurIPS should adopt explicit writing standards, analyzing 2.8M arXiv papers showing ML readability has declined significantly (Flesch Reading Ease from 24 to 13) with sensational language rising 50%.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Neural PDE Solvers via Spatio-Temporal MeanFlow

author.name: Hanru Bai, Yuncheng Zhou, Difan Zou

entry.summary: Introduces Spatio-Temporal MeanFlow for PDE solving, adapting the MeanFlow generative ODE integrator to physical systems by substituting generative velocity fields with PDE operators.

entry.title: VORT: Adaptive Power-Law Memory for NLP Transformers

author.name: Nabil Mlaiki

entry.summary: Introduces VORT, a transformer variant where each token gets a learnable fractional-order retention parameter governing power-law memory decay, approximated via sum-of-exponentials decomposition. Addresses the mismatch between exponential attention decay and natural language's power-law long-range dependencies.

entry.title: Cosine-Gated Adam-Decay: Drop-In Staleness-Aware Outer Optimization for Decoupled DiLoCo

author.name: Vatsal Shah, Jiahao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes CGAD, an age-aware outer optimizer for asynchronous DiLoCo distributed training that scales pseudo-gradients by staleness using exponential decay and cosine gating. Drop-in replacement that adds only two hyperparameters.

entry.title: First Worst-Case Regret Bounds for Combinatorial Thompson Sampling in Sleeping Semi-Bandits

author.name: Zhiming Huang, Bingshan Hu, Jianping Pan

entry.summary: Provides first worst-case regret bounds for Combinatorial Thompson Sampling with Gaussian priors in semi-bandits with sleeping arms. Resolves multiple long-standing open problems including explaining CTS-G's weak empirical performance.

entry.title: Tabular Foundation Model for Generative Modelling

author.name: Xiangjian Jiang, Mingxuan Liu, Nikola Simidjievski, Tassilo Klein, Mateja Jamnik

entry.summary: Introduces TabFORGE, a tabular foundation model for generative modeling that addresses the causal structural prior of heterogeneous tabular data. Aims to match dataset-specific generators in synthetic data quality.

entry.title: Kintsugi: Learning Policies by Repairing Executable Knowledge Bases

author.name: Teng Cao, Yu Deng, Hikaru Shindo, Quentin Delfosse, Lanxi Wen, Suli Wang, Jannis Bl\"uml, Christopher Tauchmann, Kristian Kersting

entry.summary: Introduces Kintsugi, a white-box policy learning framework that represents task knowledge as typed executable Knowledge Base entries, improved through verifier-gated edits from rollout evidence rather than neural weights or test-time LLM reasoning.

entry.title: The Value of Mechanistic Priors in Sequential Decision Making

author.name: Itai Shufaro, Gal Benor, Shie Mannor

entry.summary: Characterizes the value of mechanistic priors in sequential decision-making, introducing mechanistic information as mutual information between model-recommended and optimal policies, with matched regret bounds showing sample complexity reduction.

entry.title: Teaching LLMs to See Graphs: Unifying Text and Structural Reasoning

author.name: Dario Vajda

entry.summary: Introduces GTLM, a parameter-efficient architecture enabling pretrained LLMs to process graph topologies by injecting graph-aware attention biases (only 0.015% additional parameters) while preserving full textual attributes.

entry.title: Identified-Set Geometry of Distributional Model Extraction under Top-$K$ Censored API Access

author.name: Wenhua Nie, ZiCheng Zhu, Jianan Wu, Binhan Luo, Haoran Zheng, Jyh-Shing Roger Jang

entry.summary: Analyzes distribution recovery limits from top-K censored LLM API access, deriving exact total-variation diameter bounds and a layered extraction hierarchy showing progressive capability recovery with more access.

entry.title: Can Muon Fine-tune Adam-Pretrained Models?

author.name: Xingyu Qu, Peigeng Huang, Samuel Horvath

entry.summary: Investigates the optimizer mismatch when fine-tuning Adam-pretrained models with Muon, showing it disrupts pretrained knowledge proportional to update strength. Demonstrates LoRA mitigates this mismatch.

entry.title: Controllability in preference-conditioned multi-objective reinforcement learning

author.name: Pau de las Heras Molins, Beyazit Yalcinkaya, Lasse Peters, David Fridovich-Keil, Georgios Bakirtzis

entry.summary: Identifies that standard MORL metrics fail to measure whether changes in user preferences reliably change agent behavior (controllability), and proposes a complementary metric to assess this. Shows that preference-conditioned agents can score well on standard metrics while being insensitive to preference inputs.

entry.title: Exact Unlearning from Proxies Induces Closeness Guarantees on Approximate Unlearning

author.name: Virgile Dine, Teddy Furon

entry.summary: Proposes a paradigm shift in machine unlearning by linking it to data distributions rather than neural network parameter updates, with theoretical KL divergence bounds from the ideal retrained model. Validated across three forgetting scenarios.

entry.title: MASS-DPO: Multi-negative Active Sample Selection for Direct Policy Optimization
