entry.summary: Proposes PruneTIR, an inference-time method to prune erroneous tool calls during LLM reasoning, observing that erroneous calls correlate with incorrect answers and can be pruned to boost performance without additional training.

entry.title: GLiNER2-PII: A Multilingual Model for Personally Identifiable Information Extraction

author.name: Urchade Zaratiana, Ash Lewis, George Hurn-Maloney

entry.summary: Presents GLiNER2-PII, a compact 0.3B model for detecting 42 types of personally identifiable information across multiple languages, trained on synthetic data generated to overcome privacy constraints.

entry.title: Adaptive Action Chunking via Multi-Chunk Q Value Estimation

author.name: Yongjae Shin, Jongseong Chae, Seongmin Kim, Jongeui Park, Youngchul Sung

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Action Chunking (ACH) for offline-to-online RL that dynamically modulates action chunk length during training and inference based on multi-chunk Q value estimation.

entry.title: Swarm Skills: A Portable, Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System Specification for Coordination Engineering

author.name: Xinyu Zhang, Zhicheng Dou, Deyang Li, Jianjun Tao, Shuo Cheng, Ruifeng Shi, Fangchao Liu, Enrui Hu, Yangkai Ding, Hongbo Wang, Qi Ye, Xuefeng Jin, Zhangchun Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Swarm Skills, a portable specification extending Anthropic Skills standard with multi-agent semantics, enabling multi-agent workflows to be shared as distributable assets across systems.

entry.title: When Reviews Disagree: Fine-Grained Contradiction Analysis in Scientific Peer Reviews

author.name: Sandeep Kumar, Yash Kamdar, Abid Hossain, Bharti Kumari, Tanik Saikh, Asif Ekbal

entry.summary: Introduces RevCI, a dataset and fine-grained formulation for detecting contradictions in scientific peer reviews, identifying evidence spans and graded disagreement intensity rather than binary detection.

entry.title: One-Step Graph-Structured Neural Flows for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Classification

author.name: Mengzhou Gao, Kaiwei Wang, Pengfei Jiao

entry.summary: Proposes one-step Graph-Structured Neural Flows for irregular multivariate time series classification, introducing auxiliary-trajectory self-supervision strategies to model inter-variable interactions without iterative solvers.

entry.title: LeapTS: Rethinking Time Series Forecasting as Adaptive Multi-Horizon Scheduling

author.name: Sheng Pan, Ming Jin, Bo Du, Shirui Pan

entry.summary: Introduces LeapTS, which reformulates time series forecasting as a dynamic scheduling process with hierarchical controllers that adaptively select prediction targets and determine step sizes.

entry.title: SCALAR: A Neurosymbolic Framework for Automated Conjecture and Reasoning in Quantum Circuit Analysis

author.name: Sean Feeney, Pooja Rao, Andreas Klappenecker, Reuben Tate, Yuri Alexeev, Stefano Mensa, Elica Kyoseva, Stephan Eidenbenz

entry.summary: Introduces SCALAR, a neurosymbolic framework combining quantum simulation, symbolic conjecture generation, and LLM interpretation for automated conjecture in quantum circuit analysis, evaluated on MaxCut instances.

entry.title: AnomalyClaw: A Universal Visual Anomaly Detection Agent via Tool-Grounded Refutation

author.name: Xi Jiang, Yinjie Zhao, Zesheng Yang, Feng Zheng

entry.summary: Presents AnomalyClaw, a training-free visual anomaly detection agent using VLMs with tool-grounded refutation approach, performing cross-domain anomaly detection without domain-specific training.

entry.title: Formally Verifying Analog Neural Networks Under Process Variations Using Polynomial Zonotopes

author.name: Yasmine Abu-Haeyeh, Tobias Ladner, Matthias Althoff, Lars Hedrich

entry.summary: Presents a polynomial-based approach to formally verify analog neural network circuits under manufacturing process variations using reachability analysis with polynomial zonotopes.

entry.title: CMKL: Modality-Aware Continual Learning for Evolving Biomedical Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Yousef A. Radwan, Yao Li, Qing Qing, Ziqi Xu, Qixin Zhang, Yongcheng Jing, Renqiang Luo, Xikun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CMKL, a continual learning framework for evolving biomedical knowledge graphs that handles multimodal information and applies modality-aware regularization to address different forgetting dynamics.

entry.title: LLaVA-CKD: Bottom-Up Cascaded Knowledge Distillation for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Nikolaos Gkalelis, Vasileios Mezaris

entry.summary: Proposes LLaVA-CKD, a cascaded knowledge distillation approach for vision-language models that addresses the teacher-student capacity gap through intermediate-sized models.

entry.title: Active Learning for Gaussian Process Regression Under Self-Induced Boltzmann Weights

author.name: Jixiang Qing, Henry Moss, Matthias Sachs

entry.summary: Proposes AB-SID-iVAR, a Gaussian Process-based active learning acquisition function for learning functions under self-induced Boltzmann distributions, relevant to potential energy surface modeling in computational chemistry.

entry.title: Provable Sparse Inversion and Token Relabel Enhanced One-shot Federated Learning with ViTs

author.name: Li Shen, Xiaolei Hao, Qinglun Li, Xiaochun Cao, Zhifeng Hao, Xun Yang

entry.summary: Proposes FedMITR for one-shot federated learning with ViTs, using sparse model inversion to generate high-quality synthetic data and token relabeling to address semantic misalignment in non-IID settings.

entry.title: Do Foundation Model Embeddings Improve Cross-Country Crop Yield Generalisation? A Leave-One-Country-Out Evaluation in Sub-Saharan Africa

author.name: Yaw Osei Adjei

entry.summary: Evaluates geospatial foundation model embeddings (Prithvi, ViT-Base) for cross-country crop yield prediction in sub-Saharan Africa, finding all methods fail under leave-one-country-out validation with negative R².

entry.title: Statistical Inference and Quality Measures of KV Cache Quantisations Inspired by TurboQuant

author.name: Paolo D'Alberto

entry.summary: Analyzes three KV cache quantization schemes under fair bit budgets, showing KQV (WHT+MSE on K, WHT+MSE+QJL on V) wins at the practical n=4 budget and that K-V asymmetry in quantization is unconditional.

entry.title: Revitalizing the Beginning: Avoiding Storage Dependency for Model Merging in Continual Learning

author.name: Xi Wang, Cheng Deng

entry.summary: Analyzes model merging methods under continual learning constraints, identifying error accumulation and vanishing gradient issues, and proposing solutions for storage-free model merging.

entry.title: P-Flow: Proxy-gradient Flows for Linear Inverse Problems

author.name: Zehua Jiang, Fenghao Zhu, Xinquan Wang, Chongwen Huang, Zhaoyang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes P-Flow for inverse problems using flow matching with proxy gradients to update source points, avoiding numerical instability of long-chain differentiation with Gaussian spherical projection.

entry.title: SACHI: Structured Agent Coordination via Holistic Information Integration in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Nikunj Gupta, James Zachary Hare, Jesse Milzman, Rajgopal Kannan, Viktor Prasanna

entry.summary: Proposes SACHI, a multi-agent RL method using graph transformer convolutions over inter-agent coordination graphs for structured information integration, addressing the partial observability bottleneck in cooperative MARL.

entry.title: TARO: Temporal Adversarial Rectification Optimization Using Diffusion Models as Purifiers

author.name: Daniel Wesego, Pedram Rooshenas

entry.summary: Proposes TARO, an inference-time adversarial purification method using diffusion models that builds temporally guided score priors from multiple denoising views, balancing semantic preservation and robustness.

entry.title: SeBA: Semi-supervised few-shot learning via Separated-at-Birth Alignment for tabular data

author.name: Kacper Jurek, Wojciech Batko, Marek \'Smieja, Marcin Przewi\k{e}\'zlikowski

entry.summary: Proposes SeBA (Separated-at-Birth Alignment), a joint-embedding framework for semi-supervised few-shot learning on tabular data that eliminates dependence on data augmentation.

entry.title: Skill-CMIB: Multimodal Agent Skill for Consistent Action via Conditional Multimodal Information Bottleneck

author.name: Zihan Huang, Junda Wu, Tong Yu, Qianqi Yan, Rohan Surana, Uttaran Bhattacharya, Lina Yao, Xin Eric Wang, Julian McAuley

entry.summary: Proposes Skill-CMIB for distilling multimodal agent trajectories into reusable skills using a conditional multimodal information bottleneck, separating verbalizable from perceptual skill content.

entry.title: Generative Actor-Critic with Soft Bridge Policies

author.name: Ke He, Le He, Shunpu Tang, Yafei Wang, Lisheng Fan

entry.summary: Proposes a generative actor-critic for MaxEnt RL using 'soft bridge policies' that provide tractable densities without iterative sampling or backpropagation through time.

entry.title: RareCP: Regime-Aware Retrieval for Efficient Conformal Prediction

author.name: Manuel Heurich, Maximilian Granz, Tim Landgraf

entry.summary: Introduces RareCP, a regime-aware conformal prediction method for time series that uses mixture of cosine-attention experts to separate smoothly drifting errors from distinct error regimes.

entry.title: TopoGeoScore: A Self-Supervised Source-Only Geometric Framework for OOD Checkpoint Selection

author.name: Farid Hazratian, Ali Zia, Hien Duy Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes TopoGeoScore, a source-only geometric method for selecting OOD-robust checkpoints using topological and geometric properties of source embeddings without any target domain data.

entry.title: Bridging Spectral Operator Learning and U-Net Hierarchies: SpectraNet for Stable Autoregressive PDE Surrogates

author.name: Enrique Hern\'andez Noguera, Md Meftahul Ferdaus, Elias Ioup, Mahdi Abdelguerfi, Julian Simeonov

entry.summary: Introduces SpectraNet, an autoregressive neural operator combining spectral convolutions with U-Net hierarchy for time-dependent PDEs. Claims to reduce exponential rollout-error growth to linear drift through residual-target parametrization.

entry.title: FedVSSAM: Mitigating Flatness Incompatibility in Sharpness-Aware Federated Learning

author.name: Bingnan Xiao, Yuan Gao, Bingcong Li, Wei Ni, Xin Wang, Tony Q. S. Quek

entry.summary: Identifies 'flatness incompatibility' in federated SAM optimization where locally flat minima conflict with the global objective's preferred flat region. Proposes FedVSSAM to mitigate this via variance-scaled perturbations.

entry.title: Instance-Adaptive Online Multicalibration

author.name: Zhiming Huang, Jamie Morgenstern, Aaron Roth, Claire Jie Zhang

entry.summary: Studies online multicalibration beyond worst-case, giving an algorithm that adapts to instance difficulty via dyadic grid refinement. Recovers worst-case O(T^{2/3}) while achieving O(√T) in marginal stochastic settings.

entry.title: Selection Plateau and a Sparsity-Dependent Hierarchy of Pruning Features

author.name: Guangqi Li, Yongxin Li

entry.summary: Identifies a 'Selection Plateau' in neural network pruning where all rank-monotone scorers converge to identical accuracy. Proposes the SICS hypothesis: a sparsity-dependent hierarchy of feature complexity governs when different pruning features become necessary.

entry.title: Let the Target Select for Itself: Data Selection via Target-Aligned Paths

author.name: Huitao Yang, Hengzhi He, Guang Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes validation-induced flow for targeted data selection, addressing 'reference path bias' in existing methods that use candidate-pool-induced trajectories. Uses a simple zero-order selection rule from short warmup on target validation proxy.

entry.title: Positional LSH: Binary Block Matrix Approximation for Attention with Linear Biases

author.name: Daniel Wolfson, Tal Wagner

entry.summary: Connects ALiBi positional encoding to locality-sensitive hashing, showing ALiBi's bias matrix is the expectation of block-diagonal binary masks from a 'positional LSH' scheme. Provides approximation guarantees for ALiBi-biased attention.

entry.title: Doubly Robust Proxy Causal Learning with Neural Mean Embeddings

author.name: Bariscan Bozkurt, Alexandre Galashov, Dimitri Meunier, Zikai Shen, Arthur Gretton, Houssam Zenati

entry.summary: Develops a neural doubly robust framework for proxy causal learning with continuous treatments, combining neural mean-embedding estimators for both treatment and outcome bridges. Offers more flexibility than kernel/sieve methods.

entry.title: Selection of the Best Policy under Fairness Constraints for Subpopulations

author.name: Tingyu Zhu, Yuhang Wu, Zeyu Zheng

entry.summary: Formalizes Selection of the Best with Fairness Constraints (SBFC), identifying the highest-performing policy that meets minimum per-subpopulation thresholds. Establishes instance-specific lower bounds and a matching algorithm.

entry.title: Learning Graph Foundation Models on Riemannian Graph-of-Graphs

author.name: Haokun Liu, Zezhong Ding, Xike Xie

entry.summary: Proposes R-GFM, a graph foundation model using Riemannian Graph-of-Graphs that treats structural scale as a first-class modeling concern, learning geometry-adaptive representations across multiple scales.

entry.title: Many Needles in a Haystack: Active Hit Discovery for Perturbation Experiments

author.name: Andrea Rubbi, Arpit Merchant, Samuel Ogden, Amir Akbarnejad, Pietro Li\`o, Sattar Vakili, Mo Lotfollahi

entry.summary: Formalizes hit discovery in perturbation experiments as sequential experimental design and proposes Probability-of-Hit acquisition function that targets threshold exceedance rather than single-optimum finding.

entry.title: Nearly-Optimal Algorithm for Adversarial Kernelized Bandits

author.name: Shogo Iwazaki

entry.summary: Proves that exponential-weight algorithm achieves near-optimal adversarial regret for kernelized bandits, with matching lower bounds for SE and Matérn kernels, plus a computationally efficient Nyström variant.

entry.title: Remember to Forget: Gated Adaptive Positional Encoding

author.name: Riccardo Ali, Alessio Borgi, Christopher Irwin, Mario Severino, Pietro Li\`o

entry.summary: Proposes GAPE (Gated Adaptive Positional Encoding), a drop-in augmentation for rotary positional encodings that adds content-aware bias to attention logits to handle long-context degradation while preserving rotary geometry.

entry.title: ConfoundingSHAP: Quantifying confounding strength in causal inference

author.name: Marie Brockschmidt, Santo M. A. R. Thies, Maresa Schr\"oder, Dennis Frauen, Valentyn Melnychuk, Maximilian Muschalik, Eyke H\"ullermeier, Stefan Feuerriegel

entry.summary: Introduces ConfoundingSHAP, a Shapley-based method for attributing confounding strength to individual covariates in observational causal inference, providing insights into which covariates act as confounders.

entry.title: Higher Resolution, Better Generalization: Unlocking Visual Scaling in Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Raphael Trumpp, \"Omer Veysel \c{C}a\u{g}atan, Bar{\i}\c{s} Akg\"un, Marco Caccamo

entry.summary: Shows that observation resolution is a critical but overlooked variable in pixel-based deep RL, and that replacing Impala's spatial flattening with global average pooling enables effective use of higher-resolution inputs for improved generalization.

entry.title: ConQuR: Corner Aligned Activation Quantization via Optimized Rotations for LLMs

author.name: Chayne Thrash, Ali Abbasi, Soheil Kolouri

entry.summary: Proposes ConQuR, a lightweight post-training rotation calibration method for LLM activation quantization that learns orthogonal rotations to align normalized activation corners with quantization grid points. Avoids expensive end-to-end rotation training.

entry.title: Revisiting Policy Gradients for Restricted Policy Classes: Escaping Myopic Local Optima with $k$-step Policy Gradients

author.name: Alex DeWeese, Guannan Qu

entry.summary: Identifies that standard policy gradients are fundamentally myopic (only using one-step Q-functions) when applied to restricted policy classes, and proposes k-step policy gradients that couple randomness within k-step windows to escape myopic local optima.

entry.title: Test-Time Training for Visual Foresight Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Sangwu Park, Wonjoong Kim, Yeonjun In, Sein Kim, Hongseok Kang, Chanyoung Park

entry.summary: Proposes T³VF, a test-time training approach for Visual Foresight VLA models that exploits the natural supervision pair between predicted future images and actual observations. Addresses OOD vulnerability inherent in VF-VLA architectures.

entry.title: Learnability and Competition in High-Dimensional Multi-Component ICA

author.name: Eser Ilke Genc, Samet Demir, Zafer Dogan

entry.summary: Develops mean-field theory for multi-component online ICA in high dimensions, revealing initialization-driven phase structure including decoupled, competitive, and cooperative regimes that cannot be captured by single-component theory.

entry.title: CONTRA: Conformal Prediction Region via Normalizing Flow Transformation

author.name: Zhenhan Fang, Aixin Tan, Jian Huang

entry.summary: Introduces CONTRA, using normalizing flows' latent spaces to define conformal prediction regions that map high-density latent regions to sharp prediction regions in output space, overcoming limitations of hyperrectangular/elliptical regions for multi-dimensional outputs.

entry.title: MicroDiffuse3D: A Foundation Model for 3D Microscopy Imaging Restoration

author.name: Yongkang Li, Brian Wong, King Wai Chiu, Hanwen Xu, Tangqi Fang, Erin Dunnington, Dan Fu, Sheng Wang

entry.summary: Presents MicroDiffuse3D, a pretrained foundation model for 3D microscopy image restoration that recovers high-quality volumetric structures from degraded measurements, evaluated across super-resolution, denoising, and deconvolution settings.

entry.title: Latent Geometry Beyond Search: Amortizing Planning in World Models

author.name: Hoang Nguyen, Xiaohao Xu, Xiaonan Huang

entry.summary: Replaces iterative planning in world models with a lightweight Goal-Conditioned Inverse Dynamics Model that directly maps current and goal latent states to actions, leveraging the smooth geometry of pretrained world model latent spaces.

entry.title: CrystalREPA: Transferring Physical Priors from Universal MLIPs to Crystal Generative Models

author.name: Chengqian Zhang, Yucheng Jin, Duo Zhang, Tiejun Li, Han Wang

entry.summary: Introduces CrystalREPA, a framework that aligns crystal generative model representations with frozen universal machine learning interatomic potentials through element-aware contrastive objectives, transferring stability-aware priors.

entry.title: Supercharging Bayesian Inference with Reliable AI-Informed Priors

author.name: Jongwoo Choi, Sean O'Hagan

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for using AI predictions as Bayesian priors by rectifying the AI-induced data-generating law before embedding it in a Dirichlet process prior, balancing informativeness with error propagation risk.

entry.title: The Observable Wasserstein Distance

author.name: Edivaldo Lopes dos Santos, Leandro Vicente Mauri, Washington Mio, Tom Needham

entry.summary: Introduces the observable Wasserstein distance that projects measures onto the real line via 1-Lipschitz observables, providing computationally tractable lower bounds on Wasserstein distance for non-Euclidean data.

entry.title: Federated Language Models Under Bandwidth Budgets: Distillation Rates and Conformal Coverage

author.name: Prasanjit Dubey, Xiaoming Huo

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of federated language model training under explicit bandwidth constraints, analyzing two protocols (FPLD for training, FC-RAG for inference) with provable statistical guarantees. Makes bandwidth a first-class statistical parameter in federated learning theory.

entry.title: EnergyLens: Interpretable Closed-Form Energy Models for Multimodal LLM Inference Serving

author.name: Vittorio Palladino, Gianluca Palermo, Michael E. Papka, Zhiling Lan

entry.summary: Presents EnergyLens, using symbolic regression to derive a single 12-parameter closed-form energy model for multimodal LLM inference serving across diverse architectures and hardware. Shows latency and energy optima diverge in 20%+ of configurations.

entry.title: VITA-QinYu: Expressive Spoken Language Model for Role-Playing and Singing

author.name: Jiacheng Xu, Heting Gao, Liufei Xie, Zhenchuan Yang, Lijiang Li, Yiting Chen, Bin Zhang, Meng Chen, Chaoyu Fu, Weifeng Zhao, Wenjiang Zhou

entry.summary: Presents VITA-QinYu, the first end-to-end spoken language model supporting both role-playing and singing generation through a hybrid speech-text paradigm with multi-codebook audio tokens. Includes 15.8K hours of training data.

entry.title: Retrieve, Integrate, and Synthesize: Spatial-Semantic Grounded Latent Visual Reasoning

author.name: Jin Cui, Xinyue Long, Xunyong Zhang, Yadong Zhang, Chuanchang Su, Jingye Gan, Boran Zhao, Pengju Ren

entry.summary: Proposes RIS (Retrieve, Integrate, Synthesize), a spatial-semantic grounded framework for latent visual reasoning in MLLMs that addresses manifold compatibility issues where latent trajectories drift from pretrained reasoning circuits.

entry.title: Conformal Path Reasoning: Trustworthy Knowledge Graph Question Answering via Path-Level Calibration

author.name: Shuhang Lin, Chuhao Zhou, Xiao Lin, Zihan Dong, Kuan Lu, Zhencan Peng, Jie Yin, Dimitris N. Metaxas

entry.summary: Applies conformal prediction to knowledge graph question answering at the path level, providing statistical coverage guarantees for retrieved answers. Addresses validity and discriminability limitations of prior CP approaches for KGQA.

entry.title: InterLV-Search: Benchmarking Interleaved Multimodal Agentic Search

author.name: Bohan Hou, Jiuning Gu, Jiayan Guo, Ronghao Dang, Sicong Leng, Xin Li, Xuemeng Song, Jianfei Yang

entry.summary: Introduces InterLV-Search, a benchmark for interleaved language-vision agentic search where textual and visual evidence is repeatedly used to condition later search steps. Contains 2,061 examples across three difficulty levels.

entry.title: Dimensional Coactivation for Representational Consistency in Frozen Vision Foundation Models

author.name: Izaldein Al-Zyoud Abdulmotaleb El Saddik

entry.summary: Introduces Dimensional Coactivation (DCA), a method for measuring representational consistency within frozen vision foundation models by checking whether the same feature dimensions coactivate across semantic subregions of a single input.

entry.title: From Articulated Kinematics to Routed Visual Control for Action-Conditioned Surgical Video Generation

author.name: Bohan Li, Shuojue Yang, Baorui Peng, Xianda Guo, Erli Zhang, Youqi Tao, Junfeng Duan, Daguang Xu, Qi Dou, Xin Jin, Wenjun Zeng, Hao Zhao, Yueming Jin

entry.summary: Proposes a kinematic-to-visual lifting paradigm for action-conditioned surgical video generation that converts articulated kinematics into image-aligned control modalities with hierarchically routed activation.

entry.title: SynerMedGen: Synergizing Medical Multimodal Understanding with Generation via Task Alignment

author.name: Weiren Zhao, Yi Dong, Cheng Chen

entry.summary: Presents SynerMedGen, a unified framework for medical multimodal understanding and generation that identifies what form of understanding truly benefits generation through 'generation-aligned understanding' tasks.

entry.title: Lost in Volume: The CT-SpatialVQA Benchmark for Evaluating Semantic-Spatial Understanding of 3D Medical Vision-Language Models

author.name: Mashrafi Monon, Umaima Rahman, Asif Hanif, Numan Saeed, Mohammad Yaqub

entry.summary: Introduces CT-SpatialVQA, a benchmark of 9,077 QA pairs for evaluating semantic-spatial reasoning in 3D CT data, testing whether VLMs learn spatially grounded anatomy or rely on learned priors.

entry.title: Can MLLMs Reason About Visual Persuasion? Evaluating the Efficacy and Faithfulness of Reasoning

author.name: Naeun Lee, Hyunjong Kim, Sunghwan Choi, Injin Kong, Yohan Jo

entry.summary: This work reveals that prompting MLLMs to reason before predicting visual persuasiveness can actually hurt performance, and proposes using diverse teacher-generated rationales for supervised fine-tuning to improve both prediction and faithfulness of reasoning.

entry.title: MultiMedVision: Multi-Modal Medical Vision Framework

author.name: Frank Li, Bardia Khosravi, Mohammadreza Chavoshi, Young Seok Jeon, Theo Dapamede, Hari Trivedi, Janice Newsome, Judy Gichoya

entry.summary: MultiMedVision presents a unified 2D/3D medical imaging framework using Sparse Vision Transformers with 3D Rotary Positional Embeddings, processing mixed-modality batches natively without modality-specific adapters.

entry.title: AnyDepth-DETR/-YOLO: Any-depth object detection with a single network

author.name: Woochul Kang, Hyungseop Lee, Jiho Lee

entry.summary: AnyDepth-DETR/YOLO enables a single detection network to operate at any depth at inference time without retraining, using essential and skippable refinement paths that preserve multi-scale feature hierarchy.

entry.title: Forcing-KV: Hybrid KV Cache Compression for Efficient Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models

author.name: Yicheng Ji, Zhizhou Zhong, Jun Zhang, Qin Yang, XiTai Jin, Ying Qin, Wenhan Luo, Shuiyang Mao, Wei Liu, Huan Li

entry.summary: Forcing-KV introduces hybrid KV cache compression for autoregressive video diffusion models, exploiting distinct but stable attention patterns across heads to enable scalable long-horizon video generation.

entry.title: Omni-Persona: Systematic Benchmarking and Improving Omnimodal Personalization

author.name: Yeongtak Oh, Dongwook Lee, Sangkwon Park, Heeseung Kim, Sungroh Yoon

entry.summary: Omni-Persona introduces the first comprehensive benchmark for omnimodal personalization spanning text, image, and audio modalities. It formalizes personalization as cross-modal routing over a Persona Modality Graph with calibrated evaluation metrics.

entry.title: MolSight: Molecular Property Prediction with Images

author.name: Aaditya Baranwal, Akshaj Gupta, Shruti Vyas, Yogesh S Rawat

entry.summary: MolSight presents the first large-scale systematic study of vision-based molecular property prediction using 2D skeletal diagrams, evaluating 10 vision architectures and 7 pre-training strategies across 10 tasks.

entry.title: SciVQR: A Multidisciplinary Multimodal Benchmark for Advanced Scientific Reasoning Evaluation

author.name: Longteng Guo (Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences), Xuanxu Lin (Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences), Dongze Hao (OPPO AI Center), Tongtian Yue (Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences), Pengkang Huo (Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences), Jiatong Ma (Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences), Yuchen Liu (Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences), Jing Liu (Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, School of Artificial Intelligence, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences)

entry.summary: SciVQR introduces a multimodal benchmark covering 54 scientific subfields with domain-specific visuals, evaluating multi-step reasoning with 46% of tasks requiring complex inference chains.

entry.title: DySurface: Consistent 4D Surface Reconstruction via Bridging Explicit Gaussians and Implicit Functions

author.name: Minje Kim, Younghyun Noh, Jaesoon Kim, Tae-Kyun Kim

entry.summary: DySurface bridges explicit Gaussians with implicit SDFs for temporally consistent 4D surface reconstruction of dynamic scenes, addressing geometric ambiguities from photometric-only optimization.

entry.title: CapVector: Learning Transferable Capability Vectors in Parametric Space for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Wenxuan Song, Han Zhao, Fuhao Li, Ziyang Zhou, Xi Wang, Jing Lyu, Pengxiang Ding, Yan Wang, Donglin Wang, Haoang Li

entry.summary: CapVector proposes learning transferable capability vectors in parameter space for Vision-Language-Action models, decoupling general capability enhancement from task-specific action fitting during fine-tuning. Aims to achieve benefits of auxiliary training objectives with the simplicity of standard SFT.

entry.title: XTinyU-Net: Training-Free U-Net Scaling via Initialization-Time Sensitivity

author.name: Alvin Kimbowa, Moein Heidari, David Liu, Ilker Hacihaliloglu

entry.summary: XTinyU-Net introduces a training-free framework to automatically identify ultra-lightweight, dataset-specific U-Net configurations by detecting the transition from stable performance to representational collapse at initialization time.

entry.title: JODA: Composable Joint Dynamics for Articulated Objects

author.name: Tianhong Gao, Cheng Yu, Yinghao Xu, Mengyu Chu

entry.summary: JODA introduces composable joint dynamics for articulated objects in simulation, representing fine-grained dynamical effects (friction, detents, snap latching) as structured three-channel fields over joint degrees of freedom.

entry.title: Encoding and Decoding Temporal Signals with Spiking Bandpass Wavelets

author.name: Jens Egholm Pedersen, Tony Lindeberg, Peter Gerstoft

entry.summary: Recasts spike encoders as time-causal wavelet frames with quantitative bandwidths and reconstruction error bounds, bridging spiking neural networks with signal processing theory.

entry.title: ElasticFlow: One-Step Physics-Consistent Policy with Elastic Time Horizons for Language-Guided Manipulation

author.name: Kewei Chen, Yayu Long, Shuai Li, Mingsheng Shang

entry.summary: ElasticFlow proposes a distillation-free, physics-consistent one-step policy by reconstructing Mean Field Theory to directly model average velocity fields, with elastic time horizons to handle temporal heterogeneity in robotic tasks.

entry.title: Constraint-Aware Diffusion Priors for High-Fidelity and Versatile Quadruped Locomotion

author.name: Jianhui Chen, Ruixin Zhan, Liu Liu, Yang Cai, Ziqiao Li

entry.summary: Diff-CAST proposes diffusion-guided constraint-aware quadruped locomotion using diffusion priors instead of GAN-based discriminators, with mechanisms to handle OOD tracking conflicts and safety constraints for hardware deployment.

entry.title: IMPACT: An Implicit Active-Set Augmented Lagrangian for Fast Contact-Implicit Trajectory Optimization

author.name: Jiayun Li, Dejian Gong, Georgia Chalvatzaki

entry.summary: IMPACT develops an augmented Lagrangian approach to contact-implicit trajectory optimization for solving MPCCs with implicit active-set detection, improving numerical conditioning for contact-rich planning.

entry.title: Safety-Critical LiDAR-Inertial Odometry with On-Manifold Deterministic Protection Level

author.name: Yueqi Zhu, Yan Pan, Chufan Rui, Jiasheng Luo, Shihua Li, Bo Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes safety-critical LiDAR-inertial odometry with deterministic protection levels using unknown-but-bounded assumptions, providing online safety assessment rather than offline accuracy evaluation.

entry.title: VEGA: Visual Encoder Grounding Alignment for Spatially-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Hao Wang, Xiaobao Wei, Jingyang He, Chengyu Bai, Chun-Kai Fan, Jiajun Cao, Jintao Chen, Ying Li, Shanyu Rong, Ming Lu, Xiaozhu Ju, Jian Tang, Shanghang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes VEGA, a framework that directly aligns VLA visual encoder features with 3D-aware foundation models at the encoder level rather than after LLM processing, improving spatial reasoning for robotic manipulation without empirical layer search.

entry.title: Anthropic’s strange fixation on hyperstition

author.name: Simon Lermen

entry.summary: Critiques Anthropic's assertion that 'hyperstition' (writing about misaligned AI causing misalignment) explains observed bad behavior in their models, arguing their actual research shows training on constitutional reasoning traces is what helps, not avoiding bad AI fiction.

entry.title: Strategic commitments shape collective cybersecurity under AI inequality

author.name: Adeela Bashir, Zia Ush Shamszaman, Zhao Song, The Anh Han

entry.summary: Uses evolutionary game theory to study how differential access to AI defense tools shapes collective cybersecurity. Shows uneven AI access drives populations toward weak defense, and proposes commitment mechanisms.

entry.title: Teaching Molecular Dynamics to a Non-Autoregressive Ionic Transport Predictor

author.name: Jiyeon Kim, Byungju Lee, Won-Yong Shin

entry.summary: Proposes a non-autoregressive method for predicting ionic transport properties from static atomic structures by distilling molecular dynamics knowledge. Addresses error accumulation in sequential approaches while leveraging both trajectory and non-trajectory datasets.

entry.title: LiteMedCoT-VL: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for Medical Visual Question Answering

author.name: Runze Ma, Shunbo Jia, Haonan Lyu, Guo Liu, Caizhi Liao

entry.summary: LiteMedCoT-VL transfers chain-of-thought reasoning from a 235B teacher model to 2B student models through LoRA-based fine-tuning for medical visual question answering, enabling deployment on portable clinical devices.

entry.title: Outlier-Robust Diffusion Solvers for Inverse Problems

author.name: Yang Zheng, Jiahua Liu, Tongyao Pang, Wen Li, Zhaoqiang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes outlier-robust diffusion solvers for inverse problems using Huber loss-based iteratively reweighted least squares combined with conjugate gradient methods for learning-rate-free optimization.

entry.title: Central Limit Theorem for Two-Time-Scale Approximate Distributionally Robust RL

author.name: Shengbo Wang, Zexi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes an approximate distributionally robust RL framework using first-order expansion under KL ambiguity sets, with a two-time-scale algorithm that achieves a central limit theorem for convergence characterization.

entry.title: Learning When to Stop: Selective Imitation Learning Under Arbitrary Dynamics Shift

author.name: Surbhi Goel, Jonathan Pei, James Wang

entry.summary: Introduces selective imitation learning under arbitrary dynamics shift, where the learner can choose to stop rather than commit to unreliable actions. Provides theoretical framework for when to stop vs continue acting.

entry.title: FLAME: Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts for Continual Multimodal Multi-Task Learning

author.name: Xing Han, Shravan Chaudhari, Tanvi Ranade, Rama Chellappa, Suchi Saria

entry.summary: Proposes FLAME, an adaptive MoE framework for continual multimodal multi-task learning that handles both co-available pretraining tasks and post-deployment new tasks with unseen modality combinations.

entry.title: Stable Long-Horizon PDE Forecasting via Latent Structured Spectral Propagators

author.name: Xiaoxiao Lu, Ye Yuan, Jiahao Shi

entry.summary: Proposes Structured Spectral Propagators for stable long-horizon PDE forecasting by learning propagation in a latent spectral space, addressing error accumulation in autoregressive neural operator rollouts.

entry.title: RelFlexformer: Efficient Attention 3D-Transformers for Integrable Relative Positional Encodings

author.name: Byeongchan Kim, Arijit Sehanobish, Avinava Dubey, Min-hwan Oh, Krzysztof Choromanski

entry.summary: Presents RelFlexformers, efficient 3D transformer models using Non-Uniform Fourier Transform for relative positional encodings with O(L log L) attention complexity. Generalizes existing RPE methods from structured grids to arbitrary token positions.

entry.title: Active Multiple-Prediction-Powered Inference

author.name: Nicholas Brawand, Nima Leclerc, Anhthy Ngo, Matthew Peterson, Sriram Vishwanath, Laith Alhussein, Ben Wellner

entry.summary: Proposes Active Multiple-Prediction-Powered Inference (AM-PPI) for healthcare AI monitoring, routing instances to cost-appropriate predictor subsets and sampling gold-standard labels proportional to residual uncertainty. Extends PPI to multiple predictors.

entry.title: GLiNER-Relex: A Unified Framework for Joint Named Entity Recognition and Relation Extraction

author.name: Ihor Stepanov, Oleksandr Lukashov, Mykhailo Shtopko, Vivek Kalyanarangan

entry.summary: Introduces GLiNER-Relex, a unified architecture for joint named entity recognition and relation extraction using a shared bidirectional transformer encoder. Enables zero-shot extraction of arbitrary entity and relation types specified at inference time.

entry.title: Not Blind but Silenced: Rebalancing Vision and Language via Adversarial Counter-Commonsense Equilibrium

author.name: Qingxin Xiao, Peilin Zhao, Yangyang Zhao, Lingwei Dang, Qingyao Wu

entry.summary: Proposes Adversarial Counter-Commonsense Equilibrium (ACE), a training-free framework that addresses MLLM hallucinations by perturbing visual context with counter-commonsense patches, framing decoding as a game between linguistic priors and visual information.

entry.title: Rethinking Experience Utilization in Self-Evolving Language Model Agents

author.name: Weixiang Zhao, Yingshuo Wang, Yichen Zhang, Yanyan Zhao, Yu Zhang, Yang Wu, Dandan Tu, Bing Qin, Ting Liu

entry.summary: Studies when and how self-evolving agents should invoke past experience during runtime, finding that flexible interleaving of experience with decision-making outperforms rigid injection strategies.

entry.title: Learning Agent Routing From Early Experience

author.name: Yimin Wang, Jiahao Qiu, Xuan Qi, Xinzhe Juan, Jingzhe Shi, Zelin Zhao, Hongru Wang, Shilong Liu, Mengdi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes BoundaryRouter, a training-free routing framework that uses early behavioral experience and rubric-guided reasoning to decide between lightweight LLM inference and full agent execution under cold-start settings.

entry.title: Beyond Bag-of-Patches: Learning Global Layout via Textual Supervision for Late-Interaction Visual Document Retrieval

author.name: Pascal Tilli, Mohsen Mesgar

entry.summary: Proposes learning global document layout via textual supervision for late-interaction visual document retrieval, augmenting local patch representations with global layout embeddings trained through text descriptions.

entry.title: Unison: Harmonizing Motion, Speech, and Sound for Human-Centric Audio-Video Generation

author.name: Shihao Cheng, Jiaxu Zhang, Quanyue Song, Shansong Liu, Zhizhi Guo, Xiaolei Zhang, Chi Zhang, Xuelong Li, Zhigang Tu

entry.summary: Presents Unison, a framework for coherent motion, speech, and sound generation in human-centric videos using semantic-guided harmonization with bidirectional audio cross-attention and semantic-conditioned gating.

entry.title: Beyond Thinking: Imagining in 360$^\circ$ for Humanoid Visual Search

author.name: Jingdong Zhang, Yizhou Wang, Zhengzhong Tu, Xin Li, Wenping Wang, Xiaohang Zhan

entry.summary: Proposes 'Imagining in 360°' for humanoid visual search, decoupling exploration into an Imaginator that predicts spatial priors of observed and unobserved regions in a single step, and an Actor that executes exploration.

entry.title: FlashAR: Efficient Post-Training Acceleration for Autoregressive Image Generation

author.name: Junkang Zhou, Yefei He, Feng Chen, Weijie Wang, Bohan Zhuang

entry.summary: FlashAR adapts pre-trained raster-scan autoregressive image generators into parallel generators using two-way next-token prediction with lightweight post-training adaptation.

entry.title: Attention Itself Could Retrieve.RetrieveVGGT: Training-Free Long Context Streaming 3D Reconstruction via Query-Key Similarity Retrieval

author.name: Zichen Zou, Xiaosong Jia, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: RetrieveVGGT enables training-free long-context streaming 3D reconstruction by formulating context construction as a retrieval problem using query-key similarity from the first attention layer of VGGT.

entry.title: Only Train Once: Uncertainty-Aware One-Class Learning for Face Authenticity Detection

author.name: Qingchao Jiang, Zhenxuan Hou, Zhiying Zhu, Zhenxing Qian, Xinpeng Zhang, Zaiwang Gu

entry.summary: FADNet proposes a one-class learning approach for face forgery detection using uncertainty-aware self-supervised learning, training only on authentic faces to detect unseen generative paradigms.

entry.title: PaMoSplat: Part-Aware Motion-Guided Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Yinan Deng, Jianyu Dou, Jiahui Wang, Jingyu Zhao, Yi Yang, Yufeng Yue

entry.summary: PaMoSplat incorporates part awareness and motion priors from optical flow into dynamic Gaussian splatting for high-fidelity dynamic scene reconstruction with complex motions.

entry.title: SleepWalk: A Three-Tier Benchmark for Stress-Testing Instruction-Guided Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Niyati Rawal, Sushant Ravva, Shah Alam Abir, Saksham Jain, Aman Chadha, Vinija Jain, Suranjana Trivedy, Amitava Das

entry.summary: SleepWalk benchmarks VLMs on instruction-grounded trajectory prediction in 3D environments, testing whether models can ground language into spatially coherent, physically plausible actions.

entry.title: GemDepth: Geometry-Embedded Features for 3D-Consistent Video Depth

author.name: Yuecheng LiulJunda Cheng, Longliang Liu, Wenjing Liao, Hanrui Cheng, Yuzhou Wang, Xin Yang

entry.summary: GemDepth introduces a Geometry-Embedding Module that predicts camera poses to generate implicit geometric embeddings for video depth estimation, achieving 3D consistency under view changes.

entry.title: Segment Anything with Robust Uncertainty-Accuracy Correlation

author.name: Hongyou Zhou, Marc Toussaint, Ling Shao, Zihan Ye

entry.summary: RUAC adds robust pixel-wise uncertainty estimation to SAM under domain shift, using collaborative style-deformation attacks to train a lightweight uncertainty head that maintains uncertainty-accuracy correlation.

entry.title: On Improving Graph Neural Networks for QSAR by Pre-training on Extended-Connectivity Fingerprints

author.name: Sam Money-Kyrle, Markus Dablander, Thierry Hanser, Stephane Werner, Charlotte M. Deane, Garrett M. Morris

entry.summary: Shows that pre-training GNNs to predict Extended-Connectivity Fingerprints (ECFP) significantly improves QSAR performance, validated with statistical tests and OOD splits across drug discovery benchmarks. However, benefits diminish for more heterogeneous datasets and complex endpoints.

entry.title: Price of Quality: Sufficient Conditions for Sparse Recovery using Mixed-Quality Data

author.name: Youssef Chaabouni, David Gamarnik

entry.summary: Establishes sample-size conditions for sparse recovery from mixed-quality data sources, defining the 'Price of Quality' - the number of low-quality samples needed to replace one high-quality sample - with information-theoretic and algorithmic bounds.

entry.title: MELD: Multi-Task Equilibrated Learning Detector for AI-Generated Text

author.name: Chenjun Li, Cheng Wan, Johannes C. Paetzold

entry.summary: Introduces MELD, a multi-task equilibrated learning detector for AI-generated text that learns generator, attack, and domain structure alongside binary AI/Human classification. Targets robustness to attacks and low false-positive rates.

entry.title: TransmissiveGS: Residual-Guided Disentangled Gaussian Splatting for Transmissive Scene Reconstruction and Rendering

author.name: Zhenyu Liang, Xiao Zhang, Tianchao Li, Jack C. P. Cheng, Chi-Keung Tang

entry.summary: TransmissiveGS proposes dual-Gaussian representation for disentangled reconstruction and rendering of scenes with transmissive surfaces (glass), separating reflection and transmission components.

entry.title: ASACK : Adaptive Safe Active Continual Koopman Learning for Uncertain Systems with Contractive Guarantees

author.name: Chandan Kumar Sah, Rajpal Singh, Jishnu Keshavan

entry.summary: ASACK proposes continual adaptive Koopman learning with contraction-based safety guarantees for uncertain systems, addressing performance degradation under distributional shifts without neural network overhead.

entry.title: PriorVLA: Prior-Preserving Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Xinyu Guo, Bin Xie, Wei Chai, Xianchi Deng, Tiancai Wang, Zhengxing Wu, Xingyu Chen

entry.summary: Proposes PriorVLA, a framework for VLA adaptation that preserves pretrained priors through a frozen Prior Expert while training an Adaptation Expert, using Expert Queries to integrate scene and motor priors without catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Spatial Priming Outperforms Semantic Prompting: A Grid-Based Approach to Improving LLM Accuracy on Chart Data Extraction

author.name: Andrei Lazarev, Dmitrii Sedov, Alexander Galkin

entry.summary: Compares semantic vs spatial priming strategies for improving LLM accuracy on chart data extraction, finding that a simple grid-based spatial priming method significantly outperforms semantic approaches like Chain-of-Thought. Demonstrates that low-level visual cues matter more than high-level reasoning for this task.

entry.title: UxSID: Semantic-Aware User Interests Modeling for Ultra-Long Sequence

author.name: Hongwei Zhang, Qiqiang Zhong, Jiangxia Cao, Yiyang Lv, Huanjie Wang, Liwei Guan, Jing Yao, Yiyu Wang, Junfeng Shu, Zhaojie Liu, Han Li

entry.summary: Proposes UxSID for modeling ultra-long user sequences in recommendation using Semantic IDs and dual-level attention, achieving 0.337% revenue lift in large-scale advertising A/B tests.

entry.title: Token Economics for LLM Agents: A Dual-View Study from Computing and Economics

author.name: Yuxi Chen, Junming Chen, Chenyu He, Yiwei Li, Yicheng Ji, Yifan Wu, Dingyu Yang, Lansong Diao, Lidan Shou, Hongliang Zhang, Huan Li, Gang Chen

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey unifying computer science and economics perspectives on token consumption in LLM agents, proposing 'Token Economics' as a framework. It conceptualizes tokens as production factors, exchange mediums, and units of account across a four-dimensional taxonomy.

entry.title: Position: Avoid Overstretching LLMs for every Enterprise Task

author.name: Kuldeep Singh, Anson Bastos, Isaiah Onando Mulang'

entry.summary: Position paper arguing against using LLMs as monolithic engines for enterprise tasks, advocating instead for treating them as interfaces with externalized knowledge and computation for reliability and scalability.

entry.title: Empowering VLMs for Few-Shot Multimodal Time Series Classification via Tailored Agentic Reasoning

author.name: Lin Li, Jiawei Huang, Qihao Quan, Dan Li, Boxin Li, Xiao Zhang, Erli Meng, Wenjie Feng, Jian Lou, See-Kiong Ng

entry.summary: Proposes MarsTSC, the first VLM agentic reasoning framework for few-shot multimodal time series classification, using a self-evolving knowledge bank refined through reflective reasoning.

entry.title: VulTriage: Triple-Path Context Augmentation for LLM-Based Vulnerability Detection

author.name: Wenxin Tang, Xiang Zhang, Junliang Liu, Jingyu Xiao, Xi Xiao, Jinlong Yang, Yuehe Ma, Zhenyu Liu, Zhengheng Li, Zicheng Wang, Wang Luo, Qing Li, Lei Wang, Peng Xiangli

entry.summary: Proposes VulTriage, a triple-path context augmentation framework for LLM-based vulnerability detection combining control path, vulnerability knowledge, and program semantic paths.

entry.title: EpiGraph: A Knowledge Graph and Benchmark for Evidence-Intensive Reasoning in Epilepsy

author.name: Yuyang Dai, Zheng Chen, Jathurshan Pradeepkumar, Yasuko Matsubara, Jimeng Sun, Yasushi Sakurai, Yushun Dong

entry.summary: Introduces EpiGraph, a large-scale epilepsy knowledge graph integrating 48K papers and clinical resources for evidence-intensive reasoning. Defines clinically motivated benchmark tasks for evaluation.

entry.title: TimeClaw: A Time-Series AI Agent with Exploratory Execution Learning

author.name: Hangchen Liu, Dongyuan Li, Renhe Jiang, Jiewen Deng, Weiwei Ye, Yoshihide Sekimoto

entry.summary: Introduces TimeClaw, an AI agent for time series analysis that learns from exploratory execution rather than just solving current instances. It addresses the limitation of execution-centric systems that don't improve from multiple candidate executions.

entry.title: AgentRx: A Benchmark Study of LLM Agents for Multimodal Clinical Prediction Tasks

author.name: Baraa Al Jorf, Farah E. Shamout

entry.summary: Conducts systematic evaluation of LLM-based agents for multimodal clinical risk prediction, examining how collaborative agent frameworks handle heterogeneous health data including EHR, medical images, and clinical notes.

entry.title: LLM4Branch: Large Language Model for Discovering Efficient Branching Policies of Integer Programs

author.name: Zhinan Hou, Xingchen Li, Yankai Zhang, Tianxun Li, Keyou You

entry.summary: Proposes LLM4Branch, using LLMs to automatically discover efficient branching policies for MILP solvers. The discovered policy is an executable program with LLM-generated skeleton and optimized parameters.

entry.title: Deep Arguing

author.name: Adam Gould, Francesca Toni

entry.summary: Introduces Deep Arguing, a neurosymbolic approach integrating deep learning with argumentation construction for interpretable classification. Neural networks construct argumentation frameworks whose conclusions form predictions.

entry.title: Evolving-RL: End-to-End Optimization of Experience-Driven Self-Evolving Capability within Agents

author.name: Zhiyuan Fan, Wenwei Jin, Feng Zhang, Bin Li, Yihong Dong, Yao Hu, Jiawei Li

entry.summary: Proposes Evolving-RL for end-to-end optimization of experience-driven self-evolving agents. Treats self-evolution as a unified process to be jointly optimized rather than optimizing experience utilization in isolation.

entry.title: The Agent Use of Agent Beings: Agent Cybernetics Is the Missing Science of Foundation Agents

author.name: Xinrun Wang, Chang Yang, He Zhao, Zhuoyi Lin, Shuyue Hu

entry.summary: Proposes 'Agent Cybernetics' as a missing foundational science for LLM-based foundation agents. Argues current engineering-driven approaches lack first principles for understanding long-horizon agent stability, self-improvement safety, and representational limits.

entry.title: Probing Cross-modal Information Hubs in Audio-Visual LLMs

author.name: Jihoo Jung, Chaeyoung Jung, Ji-Hoon Kim, Joon Son Chung

entry.summary: Probes cross-modal information flow between audio and visual modalities in audio-visual LLMs. Investigates where information from one modality is encoded in token representations of the other modality.

entry.title: From Controlled to the Wild: Evaluation of Pentesting Agents for the Real-World

author.name: Pedro Conde, Henrique Branquinho, Valerio Mazzone, Bruno Mendes, Andr\'e Baptista, Nuno Moniz

entry.summary: Presents a practical evaluation protocol for AI pentesting agents that shifts from task completion to validated vulnerability discovery, enabling assessment in realistic settings beyond controlled benchmarks.

entry.title: BenchCAD: A Comprehensive, Industry-Standard Benchmark for Programmatic CAD

author.name: Haozhe Zhang, Kaichen Liu, Miaomiao Chen, Lei Li, Shaojie Yang, Cheng Peng, Hanjie Chen

entry.summary: Presents BenchCAD, a benchmark for industrial CAD code generation with 17,900 execution-verified programs across 106 industrial part families. Tests whether MLLMs can jointly handle 3D understanding, engineering parameters, and manufacturing operations.

entry.title: TTCD:Transformer Integrated Temporal Causal Discovery from Non-Stationary Time Series Data

author.name: Omar Faruque, Sahara Ali, Xue Zheng, Jianwu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TTCD, a transformer-based framework for temporal causal discovery from non-stationary time series data, handling both contemporaneous and lagged relationships in nonlinear, noisy settings.

entry.title: LAGO: Language-Guided Adaptive Object-Region Focus for Zero-Shot Visual-Text Alignment

author.name: Junyi Hu, Qiji Zhou, Lei Zhang, Yue Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes LAGO for zero-shot visual-text alignment that adaptively focuses on relevant object regions guided by language, avoiding redundant crops and error-amplifying early semantic guidance.

entry.title: WATCH: Wide-Area Archaeological Site Tracking for Change Detection

author.name: Girmaw Abebe Tadesse, Titien Bartette, Andrew Hassanali, Allen Kim, Jonathan Chemla, Andrew Zolli, Yves Ubelmann, Caleb Robinson, Inbal Becker-Reshef, Juan Lavista Ferres

entry.summary: Introduces WATCH, a framework for month-level change detection in archaeological sites using satellite imagery (2017-2024), combining training-free, self-supervised, and weakly supervised approaches.

entry.title: LLM Translation of Compiler Intermediate Representation

author.name: Andrea Valenzuela Ramirez, Cristian Gutierrez-Gomez, Marta Barroso, Dario Garcia-Gasulla, Sara Royuela

entry.summary: Explores using LLMs to translate between GCC and LLVM intermediate representations, offering a data-driven alternative to rule-based translators for cross-toolchain interaction.

entry.title: Beyond the False Trade-off: Adaptive EWC for Stealthy and Generalizable T2I Backdoors

author.name: Lu Bowen, Xinyu Tang, Yin Yin Low, Shu-Min Leong

entry.summary: Introduces Cosine-Aware Adaptive EWC for stealthier text-to-image backdoor attacks that dynamically adjusts regularization to balance attack success rate and model fidelity. Shows that static EWC creates artificial trade-offs especially on weak triggers.

entry.title: Do not copy and paste! Rewriting strategies for code retrieval

author.name: Andrea Gurioli, Federico Pennino, Maurizio Gabbrielli

entry.summary: Studies a hierarchy of code rewriting strategies for embedding-based code retrieval, comparing stylistic rephrasing, NL-enriched pseudocode, and full natural-language transcription across six benchmarks and five encoders.

entry.title: Zero-shot Imitation Learning by Latent Topology Mapping

author.name: Maxwell J. Jacobson, Yexiang Xue

entry.summary: Introduces ZALT for zero-shot imitation learning that learns latent topological representations from demonstrations to solve unseen start-goal tasks, reducing error accumulation in long-horizon settings.

entry.title: MC-RFM: Geometry-Aware Few-Shot Adaptation via Mixed-Curvature Riemannian Flow Matching

author.name: Salim Khazem, Ibrahim Mohamed Serouis, Zakaria Ezzahed

entry.summary: Proposes MC-RFM, a mixed-curvature Riemannian flow-matching framework for few-shot adaptation of frozen visual backbones, combining hyperbolic (hierarchy-sensitive) and Euclidean (discriminative) factors.

entry.title: Curvature-Aware Captioning:Leveraging Geodesic Attention for 3D Scene Understanding

author.name: Ziyao He, Yingjie Liu, ZhangYangRui, Mingsong Chen, Xuan Tang, Xian Wei

entry.summary: Proposes a curvature-aware captioning framework for 3D scene understanding that uses non-Euclidean geodesic attention in oblique/hyperbolic spaces to better handle sparse point cloud data for dense captioning.

entry.title: CT-IDP: Segmentation-Derived Quantitative Phenotypes for Interpretable Abdominal CT Disease Classification

author.name: Lavsen Dahal, Joseph Y. Lo

entry.summary: CT-IDP develops a quantitative phenotyping framework for abdominal CT classification using 900+ organ-level descriptors from automated segmentation. Sparse logistic regression on these features matches or approaches deep learning baselines while being interpretable.

entry.title: Investigating Anisotropy in Visual Grounding under Controlled Counterfactual Perturbations

author.name: Gabriele Lombardo, Luigi Maiorana, Liliana Lo Presti, Marco La Cascia

entry.summary: Investigates anisotropy in visual grounding models under semantically mismatched captions, finding that models exhibit approximation behavior (producing plausible but unfaithful bounding boxes) due to analyzable representation-level causes.

entry.title: Navigating LLM Valley: From AdamW to Memory-Efficient and Matrix-Based Optimizers

author.name: Aditya Ranganath

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey of optimizer design for LLM training, covering the evolution from AdamW to memory-efficient and matrix-based optimizers. It organizes methods along dimensions including adaptive moments, curvature approximation, low-rank structure, and matrix-wise updates.

entry.title: Remix the Timbre: Diffusion-Based Style Transfer Across Polyphonic Stems

author.name: Leduo Chen, Junchuan Zhao, Shengchen Li

entry.summary: MixtureTT is claimed as the first system for flexible per-stem timbre transfer directly from a polyphonic mixture, jointly transferring all stems through a shared diffusion process rather than separate-then-transfer pipelines.

entry.title: Kinetic-Optimal Scheduling with Moment Correction for Metric-Induced Discrete Flow Matching in Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech

author.name: Dong Yang, Yiyi Cai, Haoyu Zhang, Yuki Saito, Hiroshi Saruwatari

entry.summary: Derives a kinetic-optimal scheduler for discrete flow matching in text-to-speech that traverses probability paths at constant Fisher-Rao speed, plus a finite-step moment correction. Validated on codec-based TTS (GibbsTTS).

entry.title: Efficient Ensemble Selection from Binary and Pairwise Feedback

author.name: Tzeh Yuan Neoh, Nicholas Teh, Je Qin Chooi, Paul W. Goldberg, Milind Tambe

entry.summary: Studies ensemble selection of AI systems as a distributional variant of multiwinner voting, analyzing binary and pairwise feedback settings. Provides query complexity bounds for both coverage and Condorcet committee objectives.

entry.title: SmartEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Generated Smart Contracts from Natural Language Specifications

author.name: Abhinav Goel, Agostino Capponi, Alfio Gliozzo, Chaitya Shah

entry.summary: SmartEval benchmarks LLM-generated Solidity smart contracts with 9,000 contracts, a five-dimensional evaluation rubric, and reproducible pipeline. Validates with ablation study, human agreement analysis, and model comparison.

entry.title: WISTERIA: Learning Clinical Representations from Noisy Supervision via Multi-View Consistency in Electronic Health Records

author.name: Ruan Dong, Yuanyun Zhang, Shi Li

entry.summary: Proposes WISTERIA, a weakly supervised representation learning framework for EHR data that models clinical labels as stochastic observations of latent clinical states, using multi-view consistency across weak supervision operators.

entry.title: Probing Routing-Conditional Calibration in Attention-Residual Transformers

author.name: Wenhao Liang, Lin Yue, Wei Emma Zhang, Miao Xu, Mingyu Guo, Olaf Maennel, Weitong Chen

entry.summary: Investigates whether routing traces from Attention-Residual transformers provide stable routing-specific evidence for post-hoc calibration beyond confidence scores. Finds routing-conditional gaps are modest and inconsistent.

entry.title: UFO: A Unified Flow-Oriented Framework for Robust Continual Graph Learning

author.name: Danhui Zhang, Zhe Wang, Qing Qing, Jiarui Liu, Wentao Gao, Ziqi Xu, Mingliang Hou, Xikun Zhang, Renqiang Luo

entry.summary: Introduces UFO for robust continual graph learning that handles both catastrophic forgetting and noisy supervision, identifying a new failure mode called 'catastrophic remembering' where models reinforce corrupted knowledge.

entry.title: Nautilus Compass: Black-box Persona Drift Detection for Production LLM Agents

author.name: Chunxiao Wang

entry.summary: Presents Nautilus Compass, a black-box persona drift detector for production LLM coding agents that operates at the prompt-text layer using embedding similarity, working with closed APIs like Claude and GPT-4.

entry.title: Team-Based Self-Play With Dual Adaptive Weighting for Fine-Tuning LLMs

author.name: Wu Li, Yigeng Zhou, Zesheng Shi, Yequan Wang, Min Zhang, Jing Li

entry.summary: Proposes TPAW, a team-based self-play algorithm for LLM alignment where the current policy collaborates and competes with historical checkpoints, using dual adaptive weighting for response quality and iteration gap.

entry.title: Personalizing LLMs with Binary Feedback: A Preference-Corrected Optimization Framework

author.name: Xilai Ma, Liye Zhao, Weijun Yao, Haibing Di, Wenya Wang, Jing Li

entry.summary: Proposes C-BPO for personalizing LLMs using preference-calibrated binary signals, treating other users' data as implicit negative signals with a Positive-Unlabeled learning correction to handle preference overlap.

entry.title: Rethinking Loss Reweighting for Imbalance Learning as an Inverse Problem: A Neural Collapse Point of View

author.name: Jinping Wang, Zixin Tong, Zhiwu Xie, Zhiqiang Gao

entry.summary: Reframes loss reweighting for long-tailed classification through Neural Collapse theory, treating reweighting as an inverse problem to achieve equal per-class loss matching the ideal ETF geometry.

entry.title: Not-So-Strange Love: Language Models and Generative Linguistic Theories are More Compatible than They Appear

author.name: R. Thomas McCoy

entry.summary: Argues that LLMs can instantiate formal structure-based linguistic theories (generative tradition), not just gradient usage-based ones, potentially enabling reconciliation between the two linguistic traditions.

entry.title: PoDAR: Power-Disentangled Audio Representation for Generative Modeling

author.name: Alejandro Luebs, Mithilesh Vaidya, Ishaan Kumar, Sumukh Badam, Stephen W. Bailey, Matthew Bendel, Jose Sotelo, Xingzhe He

entry.summary: Presents PoDAR, a framework for audio latent diffusion that disentangles signal power from semantic content through randomized power augmentation, improving latent modelability and downstream generation quality.

entry.title: HYPERPOSE: Hyperbolic Kinematic Phase-Space Attention for 3D Human Pose Estimation

author.name: Vinduja T., Ashish M., Ajay Waghumbare, Upasna Singh

entry.summary: Introduces HYPERPOSE, a 3D human pose estimation framework operating in hyperbolic space to better preserve the hierarchical tree topology of the human skeleton. Claims geometric advantages over Euclidean-space methods like transformers and GCNs.

entry.title: When Normality Shifts: Risk-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Unsupervised Tabular Anomaly Detection

author.name: Wei Huang, Hezhe Qiao, Kailai Zhang, Zaisheng Ye, Yu-Ming Shang, Xiangling Fu

entry.summary: Proposes a risk-aware test-time adaptation framework for unsupervised tabular anomaly detection that handles distribution shifts between training and test data while avoiding contamination from anomalous test samples.

entry.title: Every finite group admits a just finite presentation

author.name: Marc Lackenby

entry.summary: Resolves an open problem from the Kourovka Notebook (Problem 21.10), proving that every finite group admits a 'just finite' presentation where removing any relation yields an infinite group.

entry.title: Simultaneous Long-tailed Recognition and Multi-modal Fusion for Highly Imbalanced Multi-modal Data

author.name: Heegeon Yoon, Heeyoung Kim

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for long-tailed recognition with multi-modal inputs, using modality-specific confidence estimation to dynamically weight contributions from different data sources.

entry.title: ThreatCore: A Benchmark for Explicit and Implicit Threat Detection

author.name: Davide Bruni, Carlo Bardazzi, Maurizio Tesconi

entry.summary: Introduces ThreatCore, a benchmark for fine-grained threat detection distinguishing explicit threats, implicit threats, and non-threats, with systematic re-annotation revealing inconsistencies in existing datasets.

entry.title: AllocMV: Optimal Resource Allocation for Music Video Generation via Structured Persistent State

author.name: Huimin Wang, Leilei Ouyang, Chang Xia, Yongqi Kang, Yu Fu, Yuqi Ouyang

entry.summary: Proposes AllocMV, a hierarchical framework that formulates music video synthesis as a Multiple-Choice Knapsack Problem to optimally allocate computational resources across video segments while maintaining cross-shot consistency.

entry.title: Dynamic Cross-Modal Prompt Generation for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning

author.name: Tao Hu, Da-Wei Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes dynamic cross-modal prompt generation for multimodal continual instruction tuning, enabling instance-level adaptation to individual query-image pairs rather than task-level routing of existing prompts/experts.

entry.title: Switching-Geometry Analysis of Deflated Q-Value Iteration

author.name: Donghwan Lee

entry.summary: Develops a joint spectral radius framework for analyzing rank-one deflated Q-value iteration in discounted MDPs, providing the first JSR-based convergence analysis for deflated Q-VI in policy optimization.

entry.title: MMVIAD: Multi-view Multi-task Video Understanding for Industrial Anomaly Detection

author.name: Xiran Zhao, Jing Jin, Yan Bai, Zhongan Wang, Yifeng Sun, Yihang Lou, Xuanyu Zhu, Tao Feng, Yingna Wu

entry.summary: Introduces MMVIAD, the first continuous multi-view video dataset for industrial anomaly detection, covering 48 object categories with 6 anomaly types and supporting multiple evaluation tasks.

entry.title: Distributional Reinforcement Learning via the Cram\'er Distance

author.name: Vanya Aziz, Ivo Nowak, E. M. T Hendrix

entry.summary: Introduces C-DSAC, a distributional RL algorithm that combines SAC with distributional value representations and Cramér distance minimization, showing advantages in high-complexity robotic environments.

entry.title: Additive Atomic Forests for Symbolic Function and Antiderivative Discovery

author.name: Reda Belaiche

entry.summary: Presents a framework for simultaneous symbolic recovery of functions and antiderivatives using a derivative algebra approach with complementary EML and SOL primitives that generate self-expanding function-derivative pair libraries.

entry.title: DataArc-SynData-Toolkit: A Unified Closed-Loop Framework for Multi-Path, Multimodal, and Multilingual Data Synthesis

author.name: Zhichao Shi, Cehao Yang, Hao Zhou, Xiaojun Wu, Huajie Li, Xuhui Jiang, Chengjin Xu, Yuanzhuo Wang, Jian Guo

entry.summary: Presents DataArc-SynData-Toolkit, an open-source framework for multi-path, multimodal, and multilingual synthetic data generation with configuration-driven pipelines and quality control.

entry.title: Private Vertical Federated Inference for Time-Series

author.name: Lucas Fenaux, Larris Xie, Aditya Bang, Alex Zhang, Kevin Wilson, Florian Kerschbaum

entry.summary: Proposes PPHH-VFL, a hybrid architecture for private vertical federated inference on time-series that splits the model head into a plaintext public head and a secure lightweight MPC private head.

entry.title: Embedding Dimension Lower Bounds for Universality of Deep Sets and Janossy Pooling

author.name: Ali Syed, Aditya Nambiar, Jonathan W. Siegel

entry.summary: Proves new lower bounds on the embedding dimension required for universality in Deep Sets and Janossy pooling architectures for permutation-invariant learning on point clouds. Shows tighter bounds than previously known.

entry.title: MoMo: Conditioned Contrastive Representation Learning for Preference-Modulated Planning

author.name: Yusuf Syed, Viraj Parimi, Brian Williams

entry.summary: Introduces MoMo, a preference-conditioned contrastive planner that uses a scalar preference to continuously modulate plan conservativeness at inference time without retraining.

entry.title: The Propagation Field: A Geometric Substrate Theory of Deep Learning

author.name: Xingrui Gu

entry.summary: Defines a 'neural propagation field' viewing networks through internal trajectory geometry rather than endpoint functions. Shows endpoint-equivalent models can differ dramatically in internal structure.

entry.title: FedGMI: Generative Model-Driven Federated Learning for Probabilistic Mixture Inference

author.name: Qijun Hou, Yuchen Shi, Pingyi Fan, Khaled B. Letaief

entry.summary: Proposes FedGMI for federated learning where each client's data is a mixture of shared distributions, using generative models to decompose and align mixture components across clients.

entry.title: Accelerating Zeroth-Order Spectral Optimization with Partial Orthogonalization from Power Iteration

author.name: Jiahe Chen, Ziye Ma

entry.summary: Proposes partial orthogonalization for zeroth-order spectral optimization of LLMs, finding that unlike first-order settings, full orthogonalization hurts ZO performance. Targets edge-device LLM fine-tuning.

entry.title: A Tale of Two Problems: Multi-Task Bilevel Learning Meets Equality Constrained Multi-Objective Optimization

author.name: Zhiyao Zhang, Myeung Suk Oh, Zhen Qin, Jiaxiang Li, Xin Zhang, Jia Liu

entry.summary: Extends bilevel optimization to multi-task settings under relaxed lower-level general convexity, reformulating it as equality-constrained multi-objective optimization (ECMO). Provides first algorithms for this new ECMO problem class.

entry.title: Objective-Specific Privileged Bases via Full-Prefix Matryoshka Learning

author.name: Arghamitra Talukder, Philippe Chlenski, Itsik Pe'er

entry.summary: Studies how Matryoshka Representation Learning induces task-aligned privileged bases in representation spaces. Proves that in the linear setting, full-prefix MRL recovers ordered principal directions, and shows empirically that coordinate magnitude reflects informativeness.

entry.title: Rethinking Ratio-Based Trust Regions for Policy Optimization in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Chulabhaya Wijesundara, Andrea Baisero, Zhongheng Li, Gregory Casta\~n\'on, Alan Carlin, Christopher Amato

entry.summary: Analyzes failure modes of ratio-based trust regions (MAPPO, MASPO) in multi-agent RL, showing teammate non-stationarity causes variance-driven failures. Proposes fixes including multiplicative clipping.

entry.title: Function-Space ADMM for Decentralized Federated Learning: A Control Theoretic Perspective

author.name: Akihito Taya, Yuuki Nishiyama, Kaoru Sezaki

entry.summary: Proposes function-space ADMM for decentralized federated learning, operating on model predictions rather than parameters to handle non-IID data and non-convex training. Uses control-theoretic perspective.

entry.title: Inverse Design for Conditional Distribution Matching

author.name: Ori Meidler, Shaul Tolkovsky, Or Zuk

entry.summary: Introduces Conditional Distribution Matching (CDM), a new inverse-design problem finding inputs whose induced conditional distribution matches a target distribution, going beyond pointwise inverse design.

entry.title: HS-FNO: History-Space Fourier Neural Operator for Non-Markovian Partial Differential Equations

author.name: Lennon J. Shikhman

entry.summary: Introduces HS-FNO, a Fourier Neural Operator for non-Markovian PDEs that operates on lifted history-state representations. Handles delay equations and distributed-memory systems where instantaneous state is insufficient.

entry.title: Plan2Cleanse: Test-Time Backdoor Defense via Monte-Carlo Planning in Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Sze-Ann Chen, Zhi-Yi Chin, Kui-Yuan Chen, Chi-Yu Li, Ping-Chun Hsieh

entry.summary: Proposes Plan2Cleanse, a test-time backdoor defense for RL using Monte Carlo Tree Search to detect and neutralize backdoor attacks without model retraining. Recasts backdoor detection as a planning problem.

entry.title: RubricRefine: Improving Tool-Use Agent Reliability with Training-Free Pre-Execution Refinement

author.name: Will LeVine, Brendan Evers, Sam Saltwick, Abhay Venkatesh

entry.summary: Introduces RubricRefine, a training-free pre-execution reliability layer for tool-use agents that generates task-specific rubrics and scores candidate code against contract checks before execution. Targets inter-tool contract violations that run without errors.

entry.title: Hyperparameter Transfer for Dense Associative Memories

author.name: Roi Holtzman, Dmitry Krotov, Boris Hanin

entry.summary: Develops hyperparameter transfer methods for Dense Associative Memories, addressing challenges from weight sharing and rapidly peaking activation functions that differ from standard feedforward networks.

entry.title: FORGE: Fragment-Oriented Ranking and Generation for Context-Aware Molecular Optimization

author.name: Qingchuan Zhang, He Cao, Hao Li, Yanjun Shao, Zhiyuan Liu, Shihang Wang, Shufang Xie, Shenghua Gao, Xinwu Ye

entry.summary: Presents FORGE, a two-stage framework for molecular optimization that uses context-aware fragment ranking and editing rather than natural language prompt-conditioned generation, avoiding chemical hallucinations.

entry.title: BROS: Bias-Corrected Randomized Subspaces for Memory-Efficient Single-Loop Bilevel Optimization

author.name: Hengrui Zhang, Boao Kong, Engao Zhang, Kun Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes BROS, a memory-efficient single-loop bilevel optimization method using randomized subspace updates with Rademacher bi-probe correction, matching convergence rates of exact methods while reducing memory.

entry.title: DeepL\'evy: Learning Heavy-Tailed Uncertainty in Highly Volatile Time Series

author.name: Yang Yang, Du Yin, Hao Xue, Flora Salim

entry.summary: Introduces DeepLévy, a neural framework learning mixtures of Lévy stable distributions for heavy-tailed time series by minimizing characteristic function discrepancy, handling extreme events that Gaussian models miss.

entry.title: Online Sharp-Calibrated Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Marshal Arijona Sinaga, Julien Martinelli, Teemu Turpeinen, Samuel Kaski

entry.summary: Introduces OSCBO, a Bayesian optimization algorithm that adaptively balances GP sharpness and calibration by treating hyperparameter selection as constrained online learning. Addresses the practical problem that GP kernel hyperparameters are refit online from non-i.i.d. data, which can yield miscalibrated uncertainty.

entry.title: The finite expression method for turbulent dynamics with high-order moment recovery

author.name: Xingjian Xu, Di Qi, Chunmei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage framework combining symbolic regression (FEX) with generative models for data-driven modeling of turbulent dynamics, recovering closed-form governing equations and predicting higher-order statistical quantities including non-Gaussian features.

entry.title: Likelihood scoring for continuations of mathematical text: a self-supervised benchmark with tests for shortcut vulnerabilities

author.name: Daniel Ranard

entry.summary: Introduces an automatically generated benchmark for predicting hidden text in technical papers, using equation-suffix prediction from arXiv papers. Tests whether model forecasts transmit information about continuations, combining surface-level text modeling with reasoning.

entry.title: Omni-DeepSearch: A Benchmark for Audio-Driven Omni-Modal Deep Search

author.name: Tao Yu, yiming ding, Shenghua Chai, Minghui Zhang, Zhongtian Luo, Xinming Wang, Xinlong Chen, Zhaolu Kang, Junhao Gong, Yuxuan Zhou, Haopeng Jin, Zhiqing Cui, Jiabing Yang, YiFan Zhang, Hongzhu Yi, Zheqi He, Xi Yang, Yan Huang, Liang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Omni-DeepSearch benchmark for audio-driven cross-modal deep search, where models must start from audio clips and actively search for text, image, and video evidence to perform multi-hop reasoning.

entry.title: Measuring and Decomposing Mode Separation via the Canonical Diffusion

author.name: Shaul Tolkovsky, Ori Meidler, Or Zuk

entry.summary: Proposes measuring mode separation in distributions through a canonical reversible diffusion process, extracting two readouts (SSA and ESA) that separately quantify overall fragmentation and per-direction barrier separation.

entry.title: Tight Generalization Bounds for Noiseless Inverse Optimization

author.name: Pouria Fatemi, Hoomaan Maskan, Suvrit Sra, Peyman Mohajerin Esfahani

entry.summary: Establishes tight O(d/T) generalization bounds for noiseless inverse optimization, matching the fundamental limits over consistent estimators and connecting to best-arm identification in bandits.

entry.title: Accelerating Power Method with Fast Sketching for Stronger Low-Rank Approximation

author.name: Shabarish Chenakkod, Micha{\l} Derezi\'nski

entry.summary: Develops a framework for accelerating the power method using fast sketching for low-rank approximation, achieving strong numerical performance for SVD, low-rank factorization, and Nyström approximation.

entry.title: Unified Approach for Weakly Supervised Multicalibration

author.name: Futoshi Futami, Takashi Ishida

entry.summary: Develops estimators and post-hoc correction methods for multicalibration under weak supervision settings where clean labels are unavailable, providing a unified framework across PU, UU, and positive-confidence learning.

entry.title: Lakestream: A Consistent and Brokerless Data Plane for Large Foundation Model Training

author.name: Ting Sun, Junjie Zhang, Xiao Yan, Songxin Zhang, Zhuoyang Song, Jingyi Xi, Zunyao Mao, Bingyi Jing, Jiaxing Zhang, Zejian Xie

entry.summary: Presents Lakestream, a brokerless data plane for large foundation model training that introduces Transactional Global Batch (TGB) semantics built on lakehouse-style ACID storage. Addresses the gap between static dataloaders and the dynamic needs of distributed training.

entry.title: Exact Fixed-Point Constraints in Neural-ODEs with Provable Universality

author.name: Feliciano Giuseppe Pacifico, Duccio Fanelli, Lorenzo Buffoni, Lorenzo Chicchi, Diego Febbe, Raffaele Marino

entry.summary: Introduces a technique for Neural-ODEs to accommodate exactly planted fixed-points while preserving universality. Proves the Neural-ODE remains universal under local velocity field constraints.

entry.title: Predicting 3D structure by latent posterior sampling

author.name: Azmi Haider, Dan Rosenbaum

entry.summary: Proposes combining NeRF-based 3D representations with diffusion model priors for probabilistic 3D reconstruction from 2D observations. Treats 3D structure as a stochastic latent variable with learned priors for posterior inference.

entry.title: IntentGrasp: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Intent Understanding

author.name: Yuwei Yin, Chuyuan Li, Giuseppe Carenini

entry.summary: Introduces IntentGrasp, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLM intent understanding from 49 corpora across 12 domains, with 262K training instances and evaluation of 20 LLMs across 7 families.

entry.title: CLIPer: Tailoring Diverse User Preference via Classifier-Guided Inference-Time Personalization

author.name: Jinyan Su, Jinpeng Zhou, Claire Cardie, Wen Sun

entry.summary: Introduces CLIPer, a lightweight inference-time personalization approach using classifier models to steer LLM generation toward user preferences without fine-tuning. Enables controllable personalization across single and multi-attribute preferences.

entry.title: Intent-Driven Semantic ID Generation for Grounded Conversational News Recommendation

author.name: Hongyang Su, Beibei Kong, Lei Cheng, Chengxiang Zhuo, Zang Li, Chenyun Yu

entry.summary: Introduces intent-driven Semantic ID generation for conversational news recommendation under a Generate-then-Match paradigm, using GPT-4 CoT distillation to map diverse user intents to hierarchical IDs that are fuzzy-matched to current articles.
