entry.summary: Proposes two extensions to Negative Sample Reinforcement for RLVR: time-dependent scheduling functions (A-NSR) and instance-aware penalty weighting (IA-NSR) that adapts based on problem difficulty and training progress.

entry.title: Real-IAD MVN: A Multi-View Normal Vector Dataset and Benchmark for High-Fidelity Industrial Anomaly Detection

author.name: Wenbing Zhu, Jianing Liang, Linjie Cheng, Yurui Pan, Zhuhao Chen, Qingwang Yan, Yudong Cheng, Jianghui Zhang, Mingmin Chi, Bo Peng

entry.summary: Real-IAD MVN introduces a large-scale industrial anomaly detection dataset using multi-view surface normal maps from five viewpoints, replacing sparse 3D point clouds with high-fidelity geometric representations for detecting micro-defects.

entry.title: Don't Learn the Shape: Forecasting Periodic Time Series by Rank-1 Decomposition

author.name: Takato Honda

entry.summary: FLAIR shows that periodic time series forecasting can be achieved with extremely few parameters (28-57 scalars) by exploiting rank-1 decomposition of reshaped time series matrices, matching PatchTST performance on GIFT-Eval benchmarks.

entry.title: PaT: Planning-after-Trial for Efficient Test-Time Code Generation

author.name: Youngsik Yoon, Sungjae Lee, Seockbean Song, Siwei Wang, Wei Chen, Jungseul Ok

entry.summary: Planning-after-Trial (PaT) proposes invoking a powerful planner only upon verification failure during code generation, rather than always planning upfront. This enables using cost-efficient models for generation and expensive models only for targeted interventions.

entry.title: Signal Reshaping for GRPO in Weak-Feedback Agentic Code Repair

author.name: Jia Li, Yuxin Su, Ting Peng, Hailiang Huang, Yuetang Deng, and Michael R. Lyu

entry.summary: Studies signal reshaping for GRPO in agentic code repair with weak feedback, showing that GRPO's within-group comparison requires reshaping outcome rewards, process signals, and maintaining execution-comparability of rollouts to be meaningful.

entry.title: The Convergence Gap: Instruction-Tuned Language Models Stabilize Later in the Forward Pass

author.name: Yifan Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces the 'convergence gap' diagnostic showing that instruction-tuned LLMs remain farther from their final predictions until later layers compared to pretrained models, with late MLP windows identified as key leverage points.

entry.title: Weather-Robust Scene Semantics with Vision-Aligned 4D Radar

author.name: Kali Hamilton, Christoffer Heckman

entry.summary: Aligns radar encoder to frozen SigLIP vision embeddings and decodes scene captions through a frozen VLM for weather-robust scene understanding. Shows radar outperforms camera baselines in fog and snow, and identifies token-norm mismatch as key failure mode.

entry.title: QuadNorm: Resolution-Robust Normalization for Neural Operators

author.name: Bum Jun Kim, Makoto Kawano, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo

entry.summary: Introduces QuadNorm, replacing uniform averaging in neural operator normalization layers with numerical quadrature for O(h²)-consistent cross-resolution behavior. Provides transfer-error bounds for normalization-induced mismatch across resolutions.

entry.title: Cloud-top infrared observations reveal the four-dimensional precipitation structure

author.name: Tianchi Xu, Ziqiang Ma, Andrea Marinoni, Yuanpeng He, Xiaoqing Li, Chuanfeng Zhao, Kang He, Jintao Xu, Bohan Zhou, Wenbo Zhao, Haoshuang Chen, Tun Wang, Dongdong Wang, Yang Hong

entry.summary: 4DPrecipNet shows that geostationary infrared cloud-top observations encode sufficient information to recover four-dimensional precipitation structure, using a physically constrained deep learning framework with moisture-first constraints anchoring the model in thermodynamic consistency.

entry.title: Diffusion-APO: Trajectory-Aware Direct Preference Alignment for Video Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Jingyuan Zhu, Biaolong Chen, Le Zhang, Aixi Zhang, Hao Jiang, Pipei Huang

entry.summary: Diffusion-APO proposes trajectory-aware preference alignment for video diffusion transformers that synchronizes training noise with inference-time denoising paths to maximize gradient signal, addressing the distribution mismatch between training and inference in video DPO.

entry.title: Open-Ended Task Discovery via Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Masaki Adachi, Yuta Suzuki, Juliusz Ziomek

entry.summary: Open-Ended Task Discovery via Bayesian Optimization proposes Generate-Select-Refine (GSR) that alternates between generating new tasks and optimizing them, with asymptotic concentration on the best task and logarithmic regret overhead.

entry.title: Mathematical Reasoning via Intervention-Based Time-Series Causal Discovery Using LLMs as Concept Mastery Simulators

author.name: Tsuyoshi Okita

entry.summary: CIKA uses LLMs themselves as interventional simulators for causal discovery of concept mastery in mathematical reasoning. Introduces Interventional Capability Probe (ICP) that diagnoses whether an LLM can use a concept by measuring correctness change when setting concept state to 'mastered'.

entry.title: Quotient Semivalues for False-Name-Resistant Data Attribution

author.name: Florian A. D. Burnat, Brittany I. Davidson

entry.summary: Formalizes false-name manipulation in ML data attribution and proposes quotient semivalue mechanisms that compute values over evidence-backed clusters rather than raw identities. Proves impossibility of exact Shapley-fair attribution under manipulation.

entry.title: Debiased Counterfactual Generation via Flow Matching from Observations

author.name: Hugh Dance, Johnny Xi, Peter Orbanz, Benjamin Bloem-Reddy

entry.summary: Shows that observational and counterfactual distributions are tightly linked under standard assumptions, motivating learning counterfactuals via deconfounding flows from observations rather than from scratch. Proposes a flow-matching approach.

entry.title: An Efficient Hybrid Sparse Attention with CPU-GPU Parallelism for Long-Context Inference

author.name: Feiyu Yao, Zhixiong Niu, Xiaqing Li, Yongqiang Xiong, Juan Fang and Qian Wang

entry.summary: Fluxion proposes efficient hybrid CPU-GPU sparse attention for long-context inference with output-aware KV budgeting and cross-device coordinated execution for CPU-resident KV caches.

entry.title: PolySQL: Scaling Text-to-SQL Evaluation Across SQL Dialects via Automated Backend Isomorphism

author.name: Yotam Perlitz, Elad Venezian, Corentin Royer, Francesco Fusco, Andrea Giovannini

entry.summary: Introduces PolySQL, a dual-execution method for evaluating text-to-SQL across multiple SQL dialects without query transpilation. Achieves 100% query coverage and higher fidelity than transpilation-based approaches, revealing that SQLite performance poorly predicts other dialect performance.

entry.title: Text-to-CAD Evaluation with CADTests

author.name: Dimitrios Mallis and Marco Wang and Ahmet Serdar Karadeniz and Elisa Ricci and Anis Kacem and Djamila Aouada

entry.summary: Introduces CADTestBench, the first test-based benchmark for Text-to-CAD using executable software tests (CADTests) that verify geometric and topological requirements. Also shows CADTests can guide generation for improved results.

entry.title: OrScale: Orthogonalised Optimization with Layer-Wise Trust-Ratio Scaling

author.name: Yuxuan Lou, Yang You

entry.summary: Proposes OrScale, a trust-ratio extension of Muon optimizer that properly scales layer-wise update magnitudes using the Frobenius norm of the actual parameter-space direction. Analyzes why three natural Muon-LAMB hybrids fail.

entry.title: SCENE: Recognizing Social Norms and Sanctioning in Group Chats

author.name: Mateusz Jacniacki, Maksymilian Bilski

entry.summary: Introduces SCENE, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents' ability to recognize and adapt to implicit social norms in group chats, including responsiveness to social sanctioning. Evaluates six frontier models.

entry.title: Video Understanding Reward Modeling: A Robust Benchmark and Performant Reward Models

author.name: Yuancheng Wei, Linli Yao, Lei Li, Haojie Zhang, Hao Zhou, Fandong Meng, Xu Sun

entry.summary: Introduces VURB benchmark (2,100 preference pairs with long CoT) and VUP-35K dataset for video understanding reward modeling. Builds reward models achieving strong performance on video understanding tasks.

entry.title: Characterizing and Correcting Effective Target Shift in Online Learning

author.name: Ziyan Li and Naoki Hiratani

entry.summary: Derives closed-form expression for online kernel regression showing it equals offline regression with shifted targets. Proposes target correction to make online learning match offline performance, with both closed-form and iterative solutions.

entry.title: Flatness and Gradient Alignment Are Both Necessary: Spectral-Aware Gradient-Aligned Exploration for Multi-Distribution Learning

author.name: Aristotelis Ballas and Christos Diou

entry.summary: Derives an excess-risk decomposition for multi-distribution learning showing that both flatness and gradient alignment are necessary, as the average Hessian appears inverted in one term and non-inverted in another. Proposes SAGE algorithm addressing both.

entry.title: Graph Representation Learning Augmented Model Manipulation on Federated Fine-Tuning of LLMs

author.name: Hanlin Cai, Kai Li, Houtianfu Wang, Haofan Dong, Yichen Li, Falko Dressler, Ozgur B. Akan

entry.summary: Proposes AugMP, an attack strategy against federated fine-tuning of LLMs that uses graph representation learning to capture correlations among benign updates and generate more effective malicious model updates.

entry.title: Asymptotically Log-Optimal Bayes-Assisted Confidence Sequences for Bounded Means

author.name: Valentin Kilian, Stefano Cortinovis, Fran\c{c}ois Caron

entry.summary: Proposes Bayes-assisted confidence sequences that use a Bayesian working predictive model to adaptively select martingale updates, achieving asymptotically log-optimal width while preserving validity even under model misspecification.

entry.title: Dooly: Configuration-Agnostic, Redundancy-Aware Profiling for LLM Inference Simulation

author.name: Joon Ha Kim, Geon-Woo Kim, Anoop Rachakonda, Daehyeok Kim

entry.summary: Dooly provides a configuration-agnostic profiling framework for LLM inference simulation that exploits structural redundancy across model configurations, enabling a single profiling sweep to serve many configurations and reducing exploration costs.

entry.title: STEPS: A Temporal Smooth Error Propagation Solver on the Manifolds for Test-Time Adaptation in Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Jiaqi Liu, Yifan Ouyang, Zhifei Song, Sim Kuan Goh, and Ashwaq Qasem

entry.summary: STEPS reformulates test-time adaptation for time series forecasting as a Dirichlet boundary value problem on a temporal manifold, propagating observed prefix errors smoothly into the unknown future error field.

entry.title: Interpreting Reinforcement Learning Agents with Susceptibilities

author.name: Chris Elliott and Einar Urdshals and David Quarel and Daniel Murfet

entry.summary: Generalizes susceptibilities for neural network interpretability to deep reinforcement learning, studying the response of regret to perturbations in a gridworld environment and validating findings with activation steering.

entry.title: SCOPE: Structured Decomposition and Conditional Skill Orchestration for Complex Image Generation

author.name: Tianfei Ren, Zhipeng Yan, Yiming Zhao, Zhen Fang, Yu Zeng, Guohui Zhang, Hang Xu, Xiaoxiao Ma, Shiting Huang, Ke Xu, Wenxuan Huang, Lionel Z. Wang, Lin Chen, Zehui Chen, Jie Huang, and Feng Zhao

entry.summary: SCOPE formalizes 'semantic commitments' in complex text-to-image generation and addresses their lifecycle discontinuity through specification-guided skill orchestration with retrieval, reasoning, and repair capabilities.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning for Exponential Utility: Algorithms and Convergence in Discounted MDPs

author.name: Gugan Thoppe, L. A. Prashanth, Ankur Naskar, and Sanjay Bhat

entry.summary: Derives two Q-value extensions for exponential-utility RL in discounted MDPs, proves contraction properties in L∞ and Thompson metrics, and develops two model-free algorithms with convergence guarantees.

entry.title: CA-SQL: Complexity-Aware Inference Time Reasoning for Text-to-SQL via Exploration and Compute Budget Allocation

author.name: James Petullo, Nianwen Xue

entry.summary: CA-SQL dynamically scales exploration breadth for Text-to-SQL based on estimated task difficulty, using evolutionary search-inspired prompt seeding and a novel voting method to improve performance on challenging BIRD benchmark tasks.

entry.title: The AI Industrial Explosion — Part 2: Transition Dynamics

author.name: djbinder

entry.summary: Models the economic transition dynamics from current US economy to a fully automated maximum-growth economy, finding that energy production is the critical bottleneck. Shows that even with full reinvestment after automation, energy cannot double within two years, constraining the speed of an 'AI industrial explosion.'

entry.title: Self-Play Enhancement via Advantage-Weighted Refinement in Online Federated LLM Fine-Tuning with Real-Time Feedback

author.name: Seohyun Lee, Wenzhi Fang, Dong-Jun Han, Seyyedali Hosseinalipour, Christopher G. Brinton

entry.summary: SPEAR introduces an efficient online federated fine-tuning method for LLMs using self-play with advantage-weighted refinement, enabling real-time feedback-based learning on resource-constrained edge devices without requiring ground-truth contexts.

entry.title: VecCISC: Improving Confidence-Informed Self-Consistency with Reasoning Trace Clustering and Candidate Answer Selection

author.name: James Petullo, Sonny George, Dylan Cashman, Nianwen Xue

entry.summary: VecCISC reduces the cost of weighted majority voting in LLM reasoning by clustering reasoning traces to skip redundant critic evaluations while maintaining accuracy comparable to full Confidence-Informed Self Consistency.

entry.title: Task complexity shapes internal representations and robustness in neural networks

author.name: Robert Jankowski, Filippo Radicchi, M. \'Angeles Serrano, Mari\'an Bogu\~n\'a, Santo Fortunato

entry.summary: Introduces five data-agnostic probes to study how task complexity shapes internal representations in neural networks viewed as signed weighted bipartite graphs. Shows that hard-task models are fragile to weight binarization while easy-task models remain robust.

entry.title: XDecomposer: Learning Prior-Free Set Decomposition for Multiphase X-ray Diffraction

author.name: Hanyu Gao, Bin Cao, Yunyue Su, Tong-Yi Zhang, Qiang Liu

entry.summary: Presents XDecomposer, a prior-free framework for joint decomposition and identification of multiphase X-ray diffraction patterns without requiring candidate phase lists or templates. Formulates the problem as set prediction.

entry.title: From Storage to Experience: A Survey on the Evolution of LLM Agent Memory Mechanisms

author.name: Jinghao Luo, Yuchen Tian, Chuxue Cao, Ziyang Luo, Hongzhan Lin, Kaixin Li, Chuyi Kong, Ruichao Yang, Jing Ma

entry.summary: Proposes an evolutionary framework for LLM agent memory mechanisms spanning three stages: Storage (trajectory preservation), Reflection (trajectory refinement), and Experience (trajectory abstraction). Bridges OS engineering and cognitive science perspectives.

entry.title: The Causally Emergent Alignment Hypothesis: Causal Emergence Aligns with and Predicts Final Reward in Reinforcement Learning Agents

author.name: Federico Pigozzi, Michael Levin

entry.summary: Studies causal emergence in RL agents across multiple environments, algorithms, and architectures. Finds that causal emergence aligns with and predicts final reward, suggesting agents that exert more causal power perform better.

entry.title: Revisiting Adam for Streaming Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Florin Gogianu, Adrian Catalin Lutu, Razvan Pascanu

entry.summary: Revisits Adam optimizer for streaming (single-sample, no replay buffer) deep RL. Finds that standard DQN and C51 updates with Adam perform well in streaming settings, and identifies critical corrections to Adam's state management.

entry.title: AGWM: Affordance-Grounded World Models for Environments with Compositional Prerequisites

author.name: Qinshi Zhang (1), Weipeng Deng (2), Zhihan Jiang (3), Jiaming Qu (4), Qianren Li (5), Weitao Xu (5), Ray LC (5) ((1) University of California, San Diego, (2) University of Hong Kong, (3) Columbia University, (4) Amazon, (5) City University of Hong Kong)

entry.summary: Proposes Affordance-Grounded World Models for environments with compositional prerequisites where actions become executable only after preconditions are met. Addresses conventional world models' failure to handle structure-changing events.

entry.title: Multi-Objective Multi-Agent Bandits: From Learning Efficiency to Fairness Optimization

author.name: John Wang and Mengfan Xu

entry.summary: Studies multi-objective multi-agent multi-armed bandits with heterogeneous rewards and communication over time-varying graphs. Develops algorithms for Pareto regret and Nash Social Welfare fairness objectives.

entry.title: TriDE: Triangle-Consistent Translation Directions for Global Camera Pose Estimation

author.name: Francisco Chen, Yiran Wang, Yunpeng Shi

entry.summary: Proposes TriDE for global camera pose estimation, using triangle consistency as a higher-order verification signal to refine pairwise translation directions through message passing in the viewing graph.

entry.title: MIST: Multimodal Interactive Speech-based Tool-calling Conversational Assistants for Smart Homes

author.name: Maximillian Chen and Xuanming Zhang and Michael Peng and Zhou Yu and Alexandros Papangelis and Yohan Jo

entry.summary: Introduces MIST, a multimodal multi-turn voice-driven code generation dataset for IoT device control. Reveals significant gaps between open and closed-weight LLMs and identifies that even frontier models have substantial room for improvement.

entry.title: Bridging the Last Mile of Circuit Design: PostEDA-Bench, a Hierarchical Benchmark for PPA Convergence and DRC Fixing

author.name: Pengju Liu, Nuo Xu, Jinwei Tang, Yu Cao and Caiwen Ding

entry.summary: Introduces PostEDA-Bench, a hierarchical benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on the 'last mile' of electronic design automation - fixing design rule violations and converging power-performance-area targets. Tests 8 LLMs and finds sharp degradation on practical reasoning tasks.

entry.title: Group of Skills: Group-Structured Skill Retrieval for Agent Skill Libraries

author.name: Kun Zeng, Yu Huo, Siyu Zhang, Zi Ye, Yuecheng Zhuo, Haoyue Liu, Yuquan Lu, Junhao Wen, Xiaoying Tang

entry.summary: Introduces GoSkills, a group-structured skill retrieval method for LLM agents that changes retrieval from flat skill lists to compact, role-labeled execution contexts built from typed skill graphs.

entry.title: TRAJGANR: Trajectory-Centric Urban Multimodal Learning via Geospatially Aligned Neural Representations

author.name: Maria Despoina Siampou, Gengchen Mai, Ni Lao, Jinmeng Rao, Neha Arora, Cyrus Shahabi, Shushman Choudhury

entry.summary: Presents TrajGANR, a trajectory-centric multimodal self-supervised learning framework for urban understanding that integrates human mobility trajectories with other geospatial modalities like satellite imagery.

entry.title: PACEvolve++: Improving Test-time Learning for Evolutionary Search Agents

author.name: Minghao Yan, Bo Peng, Benjamin Coleman, Ziqi Chen, Zhouhang Xie, Shuo Chen, Zhankui He, Noveen Sachdeva, Weili Wang, Ed H. Chi, Shivaram Venkataraman, Wang-Cheng Kang, Derek Zhiyuan Cheng, Beidou Wang

entry.summary: Introduces PACEvolve++, an advisor-model RL framework for test-time policy adaptation in LLM-driven evolutionary search, decoupling strategic decisions from implementation using a trainable advisor and frontier model.

entry.title: An Interpretable and Scalable Framework for Evaluating Large Language Models

author.name: Xinhao Qu, Qiang Heng, Hao Zeng, Xiaoqian Liu

entry.summary: Proposes an interpretable and scalable LLM evaluation framework based on Item Response Theory, reformulating it as constrained matrix factorization with majorization-minimization for efficient parameter estimation.

entry.title: 2.5-D Decomposition for LLM-Based Spatial Construction

author.name: Paul Whitten, Li-Jen Chen, Sharath Baddam

entry.summary: Presents a neuro-symbolic pipeline for LLM-based spatial construction that uses 2.5-D decomposition - the LLM plans in 2D while a deterministic executor handles vertical placement, achieving 94.6% structural accuracy.

entry.title: Task Relevance Is Not Local Replaceability: A Two-Axis View of Channel Information

author.name: Houman Safaai, Andrew T. Landau, Celia C. Beron, Yasin Mazloumi, Bernardo L. Sabatini

entry.summary: Introduces a two-axis framework for analyzing channel importance in vision networks, separating task relevance from local replaceability (whether peers can compensate when a channel is removed). Shows these axes are weakly aligned and diverge during training.

entry.title: ARMOR: An Agentic Framework for Reaction Feasibility Prediction via Adaptive Utility-aware Multi-tool Reasoning

author.name: Ye Liu, Botao Yu, Xinyi Ling, Daniel Adu-Ampratwum, Xia Ning

entry.summary: ARMOR is an agentic framework for chemical reaction feasibility prediction that models tool-specific utilities, adaptively prioritizes tools, and resolves conflicts to combine multiple AI tools for more accurate predictions.

entry.title: Stabilized neural Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman solvers: Error analysis and applications in model-based reinforcement learning

author.name: Minseok Kim, Yeongjong Kim, Namkyeong Cho, Yeoneung Kim

entry.summary: Develops error theory for a hybrid neural HJB solver regime that combines finite-difference operators with neural network representations and random collocation, providing convergence guarantees for model-based RL in continuous time.

entry.title: SpecBlock: Block-Iterative Speculative Decoding with Dynamic Tree Drafting

author.name: Weijie Shi, Qiang Xu, Fan Deng, Yaguang Wu, Jiarun Liu, Yehong Xu, Hao Chen, Jia Zhu, Jiajie Xu, Xiangjun Huang, Jian Yang, Xiaofang Zhou

entry.summary: SpecBlock proposes a block-iterative speculative decoding approach that generates K dependent positions per drafter forward call, combining the path dependence of autoregressive drafters with the efficiency of parallel drafters through repeated block applications.

entry.title: How Big Should a Wireless Foundation Model Be?

author.name: Wei-Lun Cheng and Wanjiun Liao

entry.summary: Provides a physics-grounded answer to how large wireless foundation models should be, showing that the intrinsic dimensionality of wireless channels (5-35 degrees of freedom) acts as a scaling ceiling, implying models need far fewer parameters than typical AI models.

entry.title: From 0-Order Selection to 2-Order Judgment: Combinatorial Hardening Exposes Compositional Failures in Frontier LLMs

author.name: Hanmeng Liu, Shichao Weng, Xiulai Liu, Zhicai Zhang, Anli Yan, Xiaozhang Liu

entry.summary: LogiHard transforms multiple-choice benchmarks from 0-order selection to 2-order logical judgment using formal framework integration with Item Response Theory for adaptive testing, significantly increasing thinking overhead to challenge advanced reasoning models.

entry.title: Bifurcation Models: Learning Set-Valued Solution Maps with Weight-Tied Dynamics

author.name: Caleb Jore, Jialin Liu

entry.summary: Introduces bifurcation models using weight-tied dynamics where different initializations converge to different stable equilibria, enabling representation of set-valued solution maps. Proves theoretical properties and validates on frustrated Ising models.

entry.title: GEM: Generating LiDAR World Model via Deformable Mamba

author.name: Yang Wu and Zhaojiang Liu and Qiang Meng and Youquan Liu and Renliang Weng and Jianjun Qian and Jian Yang and Jin Xie

entry.summary: Proposes GEM, a generative LiDAR world model using deformable Mamba architecture that leverages structural similarity between laser scanning and Mamba's processing. Addresses point cloud disorder and dynamic/static object distinction for autonomous driving simulation.

entry.title: CellScientist: Dual-Space Hierarchical Orchestration for Closed-Loop Refinement of Virtual Cell Models

author.name: Mengran Li, Bo Li, Jiaying Wang, Wenbin Xing, Yixuan Dong, Chengyang Zhang, Hongliang Zhang, Yuzhong Peng, Jinlin Wu, Bob Zhang, Bingo Wing-Kuen Ling, Fuji Yang, Zhen Lei, Jiebo Luo, and Zelin Zang

entry.summary: Proposes CellScientist, a dual-space hierarchical framework for virtual cell modeling that couples hypothesis space with implementation space. Enables structured feedback propagation for iterative refinement of computational biology models using LLM agents.

entry.title: GraphReAct: Reasoning and Acting for Multi-step Graph Inference

author.name: Xingtong Yu, Zhongwei Kuai, Chang Zhou, Xuanting Xie, Renhe Jiang, Xikun Zhang, Hong Cheng, Xinming Zhang, Yuan Fang

entry.summary: Proposes GraphReAct, a reasoning-acting framework for multi-step graph inference that combines topological and representational retrieval actions with progressive context refinement for LLMs operating over graph data.

entry.title: Emergent Symbolic Structure in Health Foundation Models: Extraction, Alignment, and Cross-Modal Transfer

author.name: Gajendra Katuwal, Advait Koparkar, Salar Abbaspourazad, Anshuman Mishra, Sarvesh Kirthivasan

entry.summary: Presents a post-training framework for interpreting health foundation model embeddings by decomposing them into interpretable 'symbols' that align across PPG and accelerometer modalities. Enables cross-modal knowledge transfer without retraining.

entry.title: SR$^2$-LoRA: Self-Rectifying Inter-layer Relations in Low-Rank Adaptation for Class-Incremental Learning

author.name: Fengqiang Wan, Yipeng Lin, Kan Lv, Yang Yang

entry.summary: Analyzes catastrophic forgetting through inter-layer relation drift and proposes SR²-LoRA that maintains inter-layer relationships during class-incremental learning with LoRA. Provides theoretical connection between drift and classification margins.

entry.title: GameGen-Verifier: Parallel Keypoint-Based Verification for LLM-Generated Games via Runtime State Injection

author.name: Chaobo Jia, Ruipeng Wan, Ting Sun, Weihao Tan, Borui Wan, Yuxuan Tong, Guangming Sheng, Hong Xu

entry.summary: Proposes GameGen-Verifier for automated verification of LLM-generated games by decomposing specifications into keypoints and grounding them as independent verification units with runtime state injection for parallel testing.

entry.title: Is the Future Compatible? Diagnosing Dynamic Consistency in World Action Models

author.name: Bo-Kai Ruan, Teng-Fang Hsiao, Ling Lo, Hong-Han Shuai

entry.summary: Identifies action-state consistency as a missing reliability axis for World Action Models, showing that the alignment between predicted actions and induced state transitions systematically separates successful and failed rollouts across many tasks.

entry.title: From Feasible to Practical: Pareto-Optimal Synthesis Planning

author.name: Friedrich Hastedt, Dongda Zhang, Antonio del Rio Chanona

entry.summary: MORetro* formulates synthesis planning as multi-objective search, generating Pareto fronts of synthesis routes that explicitly capture trade-offs among cost, sustainability, toxicity, and yield, using weighted scalarization and Bayesian optimization-informed sampling.

entry.title: SGD for Variational Inference: Tackling Unbounded Variance via Preconditioning and Dynamic Batching

author.name: Hippolyte Labarri\`ere, Cesare Molinari, Silvia Villa, Lorenzo Rosasco

entry.summary: Proves existence of ELBO solutions for the elliptic location-scale family and establishes convergence guarantees for SGD-based Black-Box Variational Inference under unbounded variance (Blum-Gladyshev condition), including preconditioning and dynamic batching strategies.

entry.title: Beyond GSD-as-Token: Continuous Scale Conditioning for Remote Sensing VLMs

author.name: Song Zhang, Yanlong Chen, Yilin Li, Yining Chen, Zili Yi, Xiaowei Zhang, and Yawei Li

entry.summary: ScaleEarth introduces continuous GSD conditioning for remote sensing VLMs via CS-HLoRA, which modulates LoRA parameters through a GSD-driven gate, allowing dynamic computation routing by physical scale rather than treating GSD as a discrete token.

entry.title: PolarVLM: Bridging the Semantic-Physical Gap in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yuliang Li, Chu Zhou, Heng Guo, Boxin Shi, Imari Sato, Zhanyu Ma

entry.summary: PolarVLM is the first multimodal framework integrating polarimetric physical parameters into VLMs, using dual-stream architecture to resolve optical ambiguities (reflections, transparency) that standard RGB inputs cannot handle.

entry.title: Stochastic Transition-Map Distillation for Fast Probabilistic Inference

author.name: George Rapakoulias, Peter Garud, Lingjiong Zhu and Panagiotis Tsiotras

entry.summary: Proposes Stochastic Transition-Map Distillation (STMD), a teacher-free framework for accelerating diffusion model inference while preserving stochastic generation, parameterizing SDE transitions with a conditional Mean Flow model.

entry.title: FactoryBench: Evaluating Industrial Machine Understanding

author.name: Yanis Merzouki, Coral Izquierdo, Matei Ignuta-Ciuncanu, Marcos Gomez-Bracamonte, Riccardo Maggioni, Alessandro Lombardi, Camilla Mazzoleni, Federico Martelli, Balazs Gunther, Jonas Petersen, and Philipp Petersen

entry.summary: Introduces FactoryBench, a benchmark evaluating time-series models and LLMs on industrial robotic telemetry understanding, organized along Pearl's causal ladder with 70K+ Q&A items from real cobot data.

entry.title: Structured Coupling for Flow Matching

author.name: Xavier Sumba, Carles Balsells-Rodas, Yingzhen Li

entry.summary: Proposes Structured Coupling for Flow Matching (SCFM), bridging flow matching with latent variable models by introducing structured latent variables into the source distribution, enabling both interpretable structure and generative quality.

entry.title: Guidance Is Not a Hyperparameter: Learning Dynamic Control in Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Fan Zhou, Tim Van de Cruys

entry.summary: Proposes learning dynamic CFG guidance scale trajectories via reinforcement learning instead of using fixed hyperparameters, recasting guidance as a sequential decision problem for diffusion language models.

entry.title: Flow Matching for Count Data

author.name: Ganchao Wei, John Pearson

entry.summary: Proposes count-FM, a flow-matching framework for count data based on continuous-time birth-death processes with local unit jumps, enabling simulation-free training for high-dimensional count data generation.

entry.title: Differentiable Ray Tracing with Gaussians for Unified Radio Propagation Simulation and View Synthesis

author.name: Niklas Vaara, Lam Huynh, Pekka Sangi, Miguel Bordallo L\'opez, Janne Heikkil\"a

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for differentiable RF propagation simulation within 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes, enabling point-to-point path computation for radio-frequency digital twins while preserving visual rendering quality. Bridges visual neural scene reconstruction with radio simulation.

entry.title: Chain-based Distillation for Effective Initialization of Variable-Sized Small Language Models

author.name: Boyu Shi, YiCheng Jiang, Chang Liu, Qiufeng Wang, Xu Yang, Xin Geng

entry.summary: Proposes Chain-based Distillation (CBD) for efficiently initializing variable-sized small language models through stepwise distillation chains with anchor models, avoiding repeated access to large teachers for different target sizes.

entry.title: Flexible Routing via Uncertainty Decomposition

author.name: Charlotte Peale, Siddartha Devic, Parikshit Gopalan, Udi Wieder, Aravind Gollakota

entry.summary: Presents an uncertainty-aware model router that decomposes uncertainty into irreducible and reducible components, avoiding unnecessary oracle calls on inherently ambiguous queries while adapting to different loss functions without retraining.

entry.title: \mathsf{VISTA}: Decentralized Machine Learning in Adversary Dominated Environments

author.name: Hanzaleh Akbari Nodehi, Parsa Moradi, Soheil Mohajer, Mohammad Ali Maddah-Ali

entry.summary: Studies decentralized ML when adversaries control a majority of workers, proposing an incentive-oriented framework where reports are accepted only when mutually consistent, turning adversaries into rational agents trading off error vs rejection risk.

entry.title: Distributional simplicity bias and effective convexity in Energy Based Models

author.name: Aur\'elien Decelle and Alfonso de Jes\'us Navas G\'omez and Beatriz Seoane

entry.summary: Analyzes energy-based learning dynamics showing that under sufficient expressivity, gradient flow admits data-consistent and spurious fixed points, with the loss landscape being effectively convex near data-consistent solutions, explaining training success despite non-convexity.

entry.title: Beyond "I cannot fulfill this request": Alleviating Rigid Rejection in LLMs via Label Enhancement

author.name: Ying Zhang, Congyu Qiao, Xin Geng, Ning Xu

entry.summary: Proposes LANCE to address rigid rejection in LLMs by using variational inference for label enhancement, predicting continuous distributions across rejection categories to produce more nuanced and natural refusal responses.

entry.title: Consistency Regularised Gradient Flows for Inverse Problems

author.name: Alessio Spagnoletti, Tim Y. J. Wang, Marcelo Pereyra, O. Deniz Akyildiz

entry.summary: Proposes a gradient-flow framework combining posterior sampling and prompt optimization in latent space for inverse problems using latent diffusion models, enabling low-NFE inference without backpropagation through autoencoders.

entry.title: One World, Dual Timeline: Decoupled Spatio-Temporal Gaussian Scene Graph for 4D Cooperative Driving Reconstruction

author.name: Yulong Chen, Xiaoyun Dong, Haoyu Zhang, Zongxian Yang, Lewei Xie, Xinke Li, Yifan Zhang, Kai Wang, Jianping Wang

entry.summary: Addresses temporal asynchrony in cooperative autonomous driving reconstruction where vehicle and infrastructure cameras operate on independent clocks. Proposes a dual-timeline Gaussian scene graph that resolves gradient conflicts causing ghosting on dynamic agents.

entry.title: Prototype Guided Post-pretraining for Single-Cell Representation Learning

author.name: Sachini Weerasekara, Natasha Darras, Sagar Kamarthi, Colles Price, Jacqueline Isaacs

entry.summary: CellRefine introduces a post-pretraining method for single-cell foundation models that uses prototype-guided learning to handle long-tailed cell-type distributions and covariate shifts in gene expression data.

entry.title: Penalty-Based First-Order Methods for Bilevel Optimization with Minimax and Constrained Lower-Level Problems

author.name: Yiyang Shen, Yutian He, Weiran Wang, Qihang Lin

entry.summary: Develops penalty-based first-order methods for bilevel optimization with minimax lower-level problems, achieving ε-KKT points with Õ(ε^-4) oracle complexity without requiring strong convexity of the lower-level problem.

entry.title: MoCoTalk: Multi-Conditional Diffusion with Adaptive Router for Controllable Talking Head Generation

author.name: Xinyan Ye, Jiankang Deng, Abbas Edalat

entry.summary: MoCoTalk presents a multi-conditional video diffusion framework for talking head generation with an Adaptive Multi-Condition Router that computes channel-wise, timestep-aware gating over four condition streams.

entry.title: Towards Highly-Constrained Human Motion Generation with Retrieval-Guided Diffusion Noise Optimization

author.name: Hanchao Liu, Fang-Lue Zhang, Shining Zhang, Tai-Jiang Mu, Shi-Min Hu

entry.summary: Presents a retrieval-guided diffusion noise optimization method for highly constrained human motion generation, using relational task parsing to identify difficult constraints and searching motion datasets for guidance.

entry.title: Empirical Bayes Rebiasing

author.name: Wanyi Ling, Sida Li, Junming Guan, Nikolaos Ignatiadis

entry.summary: Proposes an empirical Bayes 'rebiasing' strategy for simultaneous analysis of many noisy, biased estimates. Instead of fully debiasing (which inflates variance), learns from data how much bias to reintroduce by estimating the unknown bias distribution, yielding shorter calibrated intervals.

entry.title: Rollback-Free Stable Brick Structures Generation

author.name: Chenhui Xu, Ziyue Bai, Fuxun Yu, Heng Huang, Jinjun Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes using reinforcement learning to train autoregressive models to generate physically stable brick structures without needing rollbacks or external simulators during inference. The RL policy internalizes physical constraints including collision avoidance, connectivity, and interlocking.

entry.title: Inductive Power Grid Cascading Failure Analysis with GRU-Gated Graph Attention

author.name: Tianxin Zhou, Xiang Li, Haibing Lu

entry.summary: Proposes a GRU-gated Graph Attention Network for predicting cascading failures in power grids that can transfer zero-shot to unseen grids without retraining, addressing the open problem of cross-grid generalization.

entry.title: Learning Material-Aware Hamiltonian Risk Fields for Safe Navigation

author.name: Aditya Sai Ellendula and Yi Wang and Chandrajit Bajaj

entry.summary: Proposes a material-aware Hamiltonian risk field for safe navigation that adds a context-energy term to port-Hamiltonian policy, activating evasive maneuvers only when lower-risk alternatives exist and suppressing them otherwise.

entry.title: Classification Fields: Arbitrarily Fine Recursive Hierarchical Clustering From Few Examples

author.name: Yicen Li, Ruiyang Hong, Anastasis Kratsios, Haitz S\'aez de Oc\'ariz Borde, Paul D. McNicholas

entry.summary: Introduces 'classification fields'—infinite-depth hierarchical cluster structures generated by a recursive refinement rule. Learns these structures from finite prefixes of hierarchies, enabling arbitrarily fine clustering beyond observed data.

entry.title: MEMOREPAIR: Barrier-First Cascade Repair in Agentic Memory

author.name: Yang Zhao, Chengxiao Dai, Mengying Kou, Yue Xiu

entry.summary: MemoRepair formalizes the cascade update problem in agentic memory where outdated derived artifacts persist after source invalidation, proposing a barrier-first repair contract that withdraws affected descendants before constructing validated successors.

entry.title: Instruction Tuning Changes How Upstream State Conditions Late Readout: A Cross-Patching Diagnostic

author.name: Yifan Zhou

entry.summary: Companion paper showing that instruction tuning changes how upstream state conditions late readout using first-divergence cross-patching, separating the contributions of early-layer state and late-layer stack to model behavior.

entry.title: CyBiasBench: Benchmarking Bias in LLM Agents for Cyber-Attack Scenarios

author.name: Taein Lim, Seongyong Ju, Munhyeok Kim, Hyunjun Kim, Hoki Kim

entry.summary: Introduces CyBiasBench revealing that LLM agents exhibit distinct attack-selection biases in cybersecurity scenarios, disproportionately favoring narrow subsets of attack families regardless of prompt variations.

entry.title: TimeLesSeg: Unified Contrast-Agnostic Cross-Sectional and Longitudinal MS Lesion Segmentation via a Stochastic Generative Model

author.name: Vicent Caselles-Ballester, Eloy Mart\'inez-Heras, Giuseppe Pontillo, Zoe Mendelsohn, Elena M. Marr\'on, Juan Luis Garc\'ia Fern\'andez, Laia Subirats, Jon Stutters, Jeremy Chataway, Frederik Barkhof, Sara Llufriu, Ferran Prados

entry.summary: TimeLesSeg introduces a unified contrast-agnostic framework for MS lesion segmentation that handles both cross-sectional and longitudinal inputs with a single CNN, modeling pathological priors through lesion masks and a stochastic generative approach.

entry.title: PET-Adapter: Test-Time Domain Adaptation for Full and Limited-Angle PET Image Reconstruction

author.name: R\"uveyda Yilmaz, Yuli Wu, Johannes Stegmaier, and Volkmar Schulz

entry.summary: PET-Adapter enables test-time domain adaptation for PET image reconstruction by introducing low-rank anatomical conditioning to generative models pretrained on phantom data, adapting to clinical datasets without paired ground truth.

entry.title: When Stored Evidence Stops Being Usable: Scale-Conditioned Evaluation of Agent Memory

author.name: Jiaqi Shao, Yiyi Lu, Yunzhen Zhang, and Bing Luo

entry.summary: Presents a scale-conditioned evaluation protocol for agent memory that measures whether stored evidence remains usable as irrelevant sessions accumulate, identifying usable-scale boundaries and failure regimes across different memory architectures.

entry.title: Adaptive Domain Decomposition Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Traffic State Estimation with Sparse Sensor Data

author.name: Eunhan Ka, Ludovic Leclercq, Satish V. Ukkusuri

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive domain decomposition for physics-informed neural networks to better reconstruct traffic speed fields with shockwaves from sparse sensor data, using residual-guided subdomain placement.

entry.title: ChatSearch: a Dataset and a Generative Retrieval Model for General Conversational Image Retrieval

author.name: Zijia Zhao, Longteng Guo, Tongtian Yue, Erdong Hu, Shuai Shao, Zehuan Yuan, Hua Huang and Jing Liu

entry.summary: Creates ChatSearch, a dataset for conversational image retrieval, and proposes ChatSearcher, a generative retrieval model that handles interleaved image-text inputs/outputs for multi-round conversational image search. Demonstrates strong reasoning with multimodal context.

entry.title: State Representation and Termination for Recursive Reasoning Systems

author.name: Debashis Guha, Amritendu Mukherjee, Sanjay Kukreja, Tarun Kumar

entry.summary: Addresses state representation and termination for recursive reasoning systems using epistemic state graphs. Defines the 'order-gap' between expand-then-consolidate and consolidate-then-expand orderings and proves conditions for non-degenerate termination criteria.

entry.title: Multimodal synthesis of MRI and tabular data with diffusion in a joint latent space via cross-attention

author.name: Daniel Mensing, Jan Kapar, Jochen G. Hirsch, Matthias G\"unther, Horst Hahn, Marvin N. Wright

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal latent diffusion model that jointly synthesizes volumetric MRI and tabular clinical data within a shared latent space using cross-attention, evaluated on 10,000+ participants from the German National Cohort.

entry.title: A Finite-Iteration Theory for Asynchronous Categorical Distributional Temporal-Difference Learning

author.name: Ege C. Kaya, Abolfazl Hashemi

entry.summary: Provides finite-iteration convergence theory for asynchronous categorical distributional TD learning driven by Markovian trajectories. Bridges gap between theory (synchronous updates) and practice (single-state asynchronous updates).

entry.title: On the Divergence of Differential Temporal Difference Learning without Local Clocks

author.name: David Antrobius, Shangtong Zhang

entry.summary: Constructs a counterexample showing differential temporal difference learning diverges without local clocks in average-reward RL, breaking the convergence correspondence that holds in discounted settings.

entry.title: Dual-Scale Temporal Fusion Reveals Structured Predictability in Subseasonal-to-Seasonal Temperature Prediction

author.name: Elnaz Bashir, Jiali Wang, Lin Yan

entry.summary: Develops a dual-scale learning framework for subseasonal-to-seasonal temperature prediction that separates historical climate context from recent weather evolution. Shows S2S predictability is organized across interacting temporal components.

entry.title: Advancing Reliable Synthetic Video Detection: Insights from the SAFE Challenge

author.name: Kirill Trapeznikov, Gabriel Mancino-Ball, Jonathan Li, Paul Cummer, Jai Aslam, Danial Samadi Vahdati, Tai Nguyen, Matthew C. Stamm, Peter Bautista, Michael Davinroy, Laura Cassani, Jill Crisman

entry.summary: Reports results from the SAFE synthetic video detection challenge with 600+ submissions from 12 teams. Evaluates detection of synthetic videos under fully blind conditions.

entry.title: MultiSoc-4D: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Instruction-Induced Label Collapse in Closed-Set LLM Annotation of Bengali Social Media

author.name: Souvik Pramanik, S.M. Riaz Rahman Antu, Shak Mohammad Abyad, Md. Ibrahim Khalil, Md. Shahriar Hussain

entry.summary: Presents MultiSoc-4D, a 58K+ Bengali social media benchmark annotated along four dimensions, revealing 'instruction-induced label collapse' where LLMs systematically prefer fallback labels in closed-set annotation tasks for low-resource languages.

entry.title: Kurtosis-Guided Denoising Score Matching for Tabular Anomaly Detection

author.name: Victor Livernoche, Jie Zan, Reihaneh Rabbany

entry.summary: Introduces kurtosis-based noise scaling (K-DSM) for denoising score matching applied to tabular anomaly detection. Uses per-feature kurtosis to set perturbation scales automatically, solving the key hyperparameter selection challenge.

entry.title: Bridging Textual Profiles and Latent User Embeddings for Personalization

author.name: Zhaoxuan Tan, Xiang Zhai, Yan Zhu, Meng Jiang and Mohamed Hammad

entry.summary: Presents BLUE, an RL framework that aligns textual user profiles generated by an LLM profiler with embedding-based recommendation objectives, bridging interpretable profiles with effective retrieval.

entry.title: Cognitive Agent Compilation for Explicit Problem Solver Modeling

author.name: Hyeongdon Moon, Carolyn Ros\'e, John Stamper

entry.summary: Proposes Cognitive Agent Compilation (CAC), a framework that uses a teacher LLM to compile problem-solving knowledge into an explicit, inspectable target agent with separated knowledge representation, policy, and verification rules.

entry.title: Dr-BA: Separable Optimization for Direct Radar Bundle Adjustment & Localization

author.name: Daniil Lisus, Cedric Le Gentil, Timothy D. Barfoot

entry.summary: Introduces Dr-BA, the first radar bundle adjustment framework operating directly on 2D spinning radar intensity images, using separable optimization for joint dense map and pose estimation for all-weather robustness.

entry.title: WiCER: Wiki-memory Compile, Evaluate, Refine Iterative Knowledge Compilation for LLM Wiki Systems

author.name: Juan M. Huerta

entry.summary: Proposes WiCER, an iterative compile-evaluate-refine approach for LLM Wiki systems that addresses the 'compilation gap' where naive LLM distillation of documents into wikis catastrophically discards critical facts.

entry.title: Online Allocation with Unknown Shared Supply

author.name: Tzeh Yuan Neoh, Davin Choo, Mengchu Yue, Milind Tambe

entry.summary: Introduces the Online Shared Supply Allocation (OSSA) problem for humanitarian logistics scenarios where a central hub allocates unknown supply across multiple sites. Proposes a deterministic policy GPA achieving 4/3-approximation to the offline optimum.

entry.title: Actor-Critic with Active Importance Sampling

author.name: Majid Molaei, Gabor Paczolay, Matteo Papini, Alberto Maria Metelli, Marcello Restelli

entry.summary: AISAC extends Actor-Critic by optimizing the behavior policy to minimize gradient variance while preserving unbiased gradient estimates, using importance sampling principles. Demonstrates improved sample efficiency on continuous control tasks.

entry.title: Conformal-Style Quantile Analyses for Stochastic Bandits

author.name: Chengyu Du and Mengfan Xu

entry.summary: ACP-UCB1 is a conformal-style bandit algorithm that targets the upper tail of reward distributions rather than means, addressing situations where arms with strong upper-tail performance are preferred. Provides regret analysis for this quantile-based objective.

entry.title: AdaTKG: Adaptive Memory for Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning

author.name: Seunghan Lee, Jun Seo, Jaehoon Lee, Sungdong Yoo, Minjae Kim, Tae Yoon Lim, Dongwan Kang, Hwanil Choi, SoonYoung Lee, Wonbin Ahn

entry.summary: AdaTKG maintains per-entity adaptive memory for temporal knowledge graph reasoning, updating representations every time an entity participates in a fact. Departs from static entity representations that don't trace interaction history.

entry.title: Neurosymbolic Framework for Concept-Driven Logical Reasoning in Skeleton-Based Human Action Recognition

author.name: Talha Ilyas, Deval Mehta and Zongyuan Ge

entry.summary: Introduces a neurosymbolic framework for skeleton-based human action recognition that grounds first-order logic predicates in learnable spatial and temporal motion concepts, bridging representation learning and symbolic inference for interpretable HAR.

entry.title: FAME: Forecasting Academic Impact via Continuous-Time Manifold Evolution

author.name: Jianrong Ding, Jianyuan Zhong, Zhengyan Shi, Qiang Xu

entry.summary: FAME proposes a spatiotemporal framework for forecasting academic paper impact using continuous-time manifold evolution, showing that frontier LLMs alone fail to reliably distinguish high-impact papers. Uses citation network dynamics rather than static text features.

entry.title: CASCADE: Context-Aware Relaxation for Speculative Image Decoding

author.name: Selin Yildirim, Subhajit Dutta Chowdhury, Mohammad Mahdi Kamani, Vikram Appia, Deming Chen

entry.summary: CASCADE proposes context-aware relaxation for speculative decoding in autoregressive image generation, formalizing semantic interchangeability and convergence properties to reduce draft token rejection rates that limit speedups.

entry.title: Adaptive Subspace Projection for Generative Personalization

author.name: Van-Anh Nguyen, Anh Tuan Bui, Tamas Abraham, Junae Kim, Amardeep Kaur, Rollin Omari, Thuy-Trang Vu, Dinh Phung

entry.summary: AdaptSP addresses semantic collapsing in generative personalization by identifying that semantic drift concentrates in a low-dimensional subspace, then projecting it out using the stable pre-trained embedding as an anchor in a training-free manner.

entry.title: From Clouds to Hallucinations: Atmospheric Retrieval Hijacking in Remote Sensing Vision-Language RAG

author.name: Jiaju Han, Chao Li, Chengyin Hu, Qike Zhang, Xuemeng Sun, Xin Wang, Fengyu Zhang, Xiang Chen, Yiwei Wei, Jiahuan Long, Jiujiang Guo

entry.summary: CloudWeb introduces an atmospheric retrieval hijacking attack on remote sensing multimodal RAG systems that overlays parameterized cloud/haze patterns on images to redirect retrieval to adversary-chosen documents while keeping all other system components fixed.

entry.title: Predictive but Not Plannable: RC-aux for Latent World Models

author.name: Wenyuan Li, Guang Li, Keisuke Maeda, Takahiro Ogawa, Miki Haseyama

entry.summary: RC-aux proposes a lightweight auxiliary objective for latent world models that addresses spatiotemporal mismatch between local predictive training and long-horizon planning deployment, adding multi-horizon and budget-conditioned reachability supervision.

entry.title: Sword: Style-Robust World Models as Simulators via Dynamic Latent Bootstrapping for VLA Policy Post-Training

author.name: Jiaxuan Gao, Yongjian Guo, Zhong Guan, Wen Huang, Wanlun Ma, Xi Xiao, Junwu Xiong and Sheng Wen

entry.summary: Sword addresses style sensitivity and error accumulation in world models used as simulators for VLA policy training, proposing dynamic latent bootstrapping to maintain fidelity during long-horizon closed-loop rollouts.

entry.title: Mage: Multi-Axis Evaluation of LLM-Generated Executable Game Scenes Beyond Compile-Pass Rate

author.name: Hugh Xuechen Liu, K{\i}van\c{c} Tatar

entry.summary: Proposes Mage, a four-axis evaluation protocol for LLM-generated game scenes (compile success, runtime success, structural fidelity, mechanism adherence). Shows that compile-pass rate is misleading: high runtime-pass models produce structurally vacuous scenes.

entry.title: Disambiguating 2D-3D Correspondences in Gaussian Splatting-based Feature Fields for Visual Localization

author.name: Miso Lee, Sangeek Hyun, Yerim Jeon, Jae-Pil Heo

entry.summary: Identifies that Gaussian Splatting-based feature fields create ambiguous many-to-one pixel-to-point mappings that hurt visual localization. Proposes SplitGS-Loc with Mixture-of-Gaussians splitting to create precise one-to-one correspondences.

entry.title: TTF: Temporal Token Fusion for Efficient Video-Language Model

author.name: Simin Huo and Ning LI

entry.summary: Proposes Temporal Token Fusion (TTF), a training-free method to compress video tokens for video-language models by exploiting temporal redundancy through local window similarity search between anchor and subsequent frames.

entry.title: RELO: Reinforcement Learning to Localize for Visual Object Tracking

author.name: Xin Chen, Chuanyu Sun, Jiao Xu, Houwen Peng, Dong Wang, Huchuan Lu, Kede Ma

entry.summary: Introduces RELO, formulating visual object tracking target localization as a Markov decision process. Replaces handcrafted heatmap priors with RL-learned localization policies optimized directly for IoU and AUC metrics.

entry.title: StreamPhy: Streaming Inference of High-Dimensional Physical Dynamics via State Space Models

author.name: Panqi Chen, Yifan Sun, Shikai Fang, Xiao Fu, Lei Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes StreamPhy for streaming inference of physical dynamics from irregular sparse measurements using state-space models. Enables efficient online updates without requiring full temporal observations.

entry.title: Offline Policy Optimization with Posterior Sampling

author.name: Hongqiang Lin, Dongxu Zhang, Yiding Sun, Mingzhe Li, Ning Yang, Haijun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PSPO for model-based offline RL that uses Bayesian posterior sampling to balance generalization and robustness against exploitation errors in out-of-distribution regions, avoiding excessive pessimistic regularization.

entry.title: Exposing and Mitigating Temporal Attack in Deepfake Video Detection

author.name: Zheyuan Gu, Minghao Shao, Zhen Wang, Yusong Wang, Mingkun Xu, Shijie Zhang, Hao Jiang

entry.summary: Exposes temporal spectrum vulnerability in deepfake detectors and proposes SpInShield, a spectral-invariant defense framework that decouples semantic motion from manipulatable spectral artifacts using learnable spectral adversary training.

entry.title: VNN-LIB 2.0: Rigorous Foundations for Neural Network Verification

author.name: Ann Roy, Allen Antony, Andrea Gimelli, Matthew L. Daggitt

entry.summary: Develops VNN-LIB 2.0 with rigorous formal foundations for neural network verification, introducing 'network theories' as abstract mathematical framework with precise syntax, semantics, and type system.

entry.title: DIMoE-Adapters: Dynamic Expert Evolution for Continual Learning in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Mengxin Qin, Xiang Zhang, Xi Wang, Kun Wei, Xu Yang, Cheng Deng

entry.summary: DIMoE-Adapters introduces dynamic expert evolution for continual learning in vision-language models, with Self-Calibrated Expert Evolution that grows/splits experts based on task demands and Prototype-Guided Expert Selection for routing.

entry.title: Why Self-Inconsistency Arises in GNN Explanations and How to Exploit It

author.name: Wenxin Tai, Yaqian Liu, Ting Zhong, Fan Zhou

entry.summary: Identifies re-explanation-induced context perturbation as the cause of self-inconsistency in self-interpretable GNNs, then proposes Self-Denoising (SD), a training-free post-processing method that removes self-inconsistent edges to improve explanation quality.

entry.title: Implicit Preference Alignment for Human Image Animation

author.name: Yuanzhi Wang, Xuhua Ren, Jiaxiang Cheng, Bing Ma, Kai Yu, Tianxiang Zheng, Qinglin Lu, Zhen Cui

entry.summary: Proposes Implicit Preference Alignment (IPA) for human image animation that eliminates the need for paired preference data. Uses implicit reward maximization to align hand motion generation by maximizing likelihood of self-generated high-quality samples.

entry.title: Dynamic Mode Decomposition along Depth in Vision Transformers

author.name: Nishant Suresh Aswani and Saif Eddin Jabari

entry.summary: Applies Dynamic Mode Decomposition to Vision Transformer depth, testing whether ViT layers implement approximately autonomous linear dynamics. Finds DMD can predict intermediate activations for short spans with high cosine similarity.

entry.title: Beyond Distribution Estimation: Simplex Anchored Structural Inference Towards Universal Semi-Supervised Learning

author.name: Yaxin Hou, Jun Ma, Hanyang Li, Bo Han, Jie Yu, Yuheng Jia

entry.summary: Proposes Simplex Anchored Structural Inference for Universal Semi-supervised Learning where unlabeled data can follow arbitrary distributions. Leverages reliable inter-sample relations rather than potentially erroneous pseudo-labels.

entry.title: Beyond Defenses: Manifold-Aligned Regularization for Intrinsic 3D Point Cloud Robustness

author.name: Pedro Alonso, Chongshou Li, Tianrui Li

entry.summary: Proposes manifold-aligned regularization for intrinsic 3D point cloud robustness, addressing the geometric root cause of adversarial fragility by aligning latent geometry with the intrinsic surface geometry rather than relying on augmentation or defense mechanisms.

entry.title: MAVEN: Multi-Agent Verification-Elaboration Network with In-Step Epistemic Auditing

author.name: Yinsheng Yao and Jiehao Tang and Zhaozhen Yang and Dawei Cheng

entry.summary: MAVEN proposes a multi-agent verification-elaboration network with adversarial Skeptic-Researcher-Judge roles for improving LLM reasoning through explicit verification at intermediate steps, preventing error cascading.

entry.title: Fortifying Time Series: DTW-Certified Robust Anomaly Detection

author.name: Shijie Liu, Tansu Alpcan, Christopher Leckie, Sarah Erfani

entry.summary: Proposes DTW-certified robust anomaly detection for time series, providing formal robustness guarantees under Dynamic Time Warping distance rather than Lp-norms, which better captures temporal structure.

entry.title: DRIP-R: A Benchmark for Decision-Making and Reasoning Under Real-World Policy Ambiguity in the Retail Domain

author.name: Hsuvas Borkakoty, Sebastian Pohl, Cheng Wang, Bei Chen, Yufang Hou

entry.summary: DRIP-R benchmarks LLM agents on real-world retail policy ambiguities where no single correct resolution exists, with multi-judge evaluation covering policy adherence and conversational quality.

entry.title: Finite-Time Analysis of MCTS in Continuous POMDP Planning

author.name: Da Kong and Vadim Indelman

entry.summary: Provides finite-time analysis for MCTS in POMDPs with concentration bounds for both discrete and continuous observation spaces, introducing polynomial exploration bonus and abstract partitioning frameworks.

entry.title: Bayesian Fine-tuning in Projected Subspaces

author.name: Viktar Dubovik, Patryk Marsza{\l}ek, Jacek Tabor, Tomasz Ku\'smierczyk

entry.summary: Proposes Bayesian fine-tuning in projected subspaces, showing effective uncertainty quantification can be achieved in very low-dimensional parameter spaces, addressing the parameter overhead of Bayesian LoRA variants.

entry.title: SOD: Step-wise On-policy Distillation for Small Language Model Agents

author.name: Qiyong Zhong, Mao Zheng, Mingyang Song, Xin Lin, Jie Sun, Houcheng Jiang, Xiang Wang, Junfeng Fang

entry.summary: SOD proposes step-wise on-policy distillation for small language model agents doing tool-integrated reasoning, addressing error cascading across tool calls by resetting at step boundaries.

entry.title: Drifting Field Policy: A One-Step Generative Policy via Wasserstein Gradient Flow

author.name: Juil Koo, Mingue Park, Jiwon Choi, Yunhong Min, Minhyuk Sung

entry.summary: Drifting Field Policy proposes a one-step generative policy via Wasserstein-2 gradient flow for offline RL, decomposing updates into value ascent and score matching with anchor policy. Achieves SOTA on manipulation benchmarks.

entry.title: RuleSafe-VL: Evaluating Rule-Conditioned Decision Reasoning in Vision-Language Content Moderation

author.name: Zhifeng Lu, Dianyuan Wang, Yuhu Shang, and Zhenbo Xu

entry.summary: RuleSafe-VL benchmarks vision-language models on rule-conditioned content moderation decisions, testing whether models apply explicit policy rules correctly rather than using superficial cues.

entry.title: Pre-trained Tabular Foundation Models as Versatile Summary Networks for Neural Posterior Estimation

author.name: Elliot Pickens, Chiraag Gohel, Sidharth Satya

entry.summary: Proposes PFN-NPE using TabPFN as a training-free summary network for simulation-based Bayesian inference, leveraging in-context learning for modular posterior estimation that matches or outperforms established methods.

entry.title: Radiologist-Guided Causal Concept Bottleneck Models for Chest X-Ray Interpretation

author.name: Amy Rafferty, Rishi Ramaesh, Ajitha Rajan

entry.summary: Proposes XpertCausal, a radiologist-guided causal Concept Bottleneck Model for chest X-ray interpretation that models pathology-to-concept relationships using a probabilistic noisy-OR framework, inverted via Bayesian inference.

entry.title: The Minimax Rate of Second-Order Calibration

author.name: Kamil Ciosek, Banafsheh Rafiee, Sina Ghiassian, Nicol\`o Felicioni

entry.summary: Characterizes the minimax rate for estimating second-order calibration error in binary classification, achieving O(1/√n) rate using polynomial regression on analytically continued calibration functions, with matching lower bound.

entry.title: Approximation-Free Differentiable Oblique Decision Trees

author.name: Subrat Prasad Panda, Blaise Genest, Arvind Easwaran

entry.summary: Proposes DTSemNet, an approximation-free differentiable formulation of hard oblique decision trees as neural networks, avoiding the need for soft approximations or straight-through estimators while maintaining semantic equivalence.

entry.title: ADKO: Agentic Decentralized Knowledge Optimization

author.name: Lucas Nerone Rillo, Zhanhong Jiang, Nastaran Saadati, Aditya Balu, Baskar Ganapathysubramanian, Chinmay Hegde, Soumik Sarkar

entry.summary: Introduces ADKO, a framework for collaborative black-box optimization across autonomous agents using Gaussian Process surrogates and compact knowledge tokens, preserving privacy while enabling sample-efficient optimization.

entry.title: Semantic-Aware Adaptive Visual Memory for Streaming Video Understanding

author.name: Hang Wu, Sherin Mary Mathews, Yujun Cai, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Yiwei Wang

entry.summary: Presents SAVEMem, a training-free framework for streaming video understanding that brings semantic awareness into memory management with three-tier streaming memory and adaptive retrieval scope per query.

entry.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Cardiac Shape Reconstruction with Deep Signed Distance Functions via MCMC methods

author.name: Jan Verh\"ulsdonk, Thomas Grandits, Francisco Sahli Costabal, Thomas Beiert, Simone Pezzuto, Alexander Effland

entry.summary: Proposes a probabilistic framework for uncertainty-aware cardiac shape reconstruction combining Deep Signed Distance Functions with MCMC sampling for Bayesian inference in the latent space of the generative model.

entry.title: PropSplat: Map-Free RF Field Reconstruction via 3D Gaussian Propagation Splatting

author.name: William Bjorndahl, Maninder Pal Singh, Farhad Nouri, and Joseph Camp

entry.summary: PropSplat models radio frequency propagation using 3D anisotropic Gaussian primitives without requiring floor plans or terrain data, learning path loss offsets relative to a baseline model from observed transmitter-receiver measurements.

entry.title: TopoFisher: Learning Topological Summary Statistics by Maximizing Fisher Information

author.name: Matteo Biagetti and Mathieu Carri\`ere and Francesco Conti and Enrico Maria Ferrari and Sven Heydenreich and Karthik Viswanathan

entry.summary: Introduces TopoFisher, a differentiable persistent-homology pipeline that learns topological summary statistics by maximizing Fisher information. Optimizes filtrations, vectorizations, and compressors end-to-end without requiring posterior samples or supervised targets.

entry.title: Context Modification as a Negative Alignment Tax

author.name: Florian_Dietz

entry.summary: Argues that context degradation ('context rot') in LLMs is both a capability and alignment problem. Since transformers have no persistent hidden state, all reasoning is scaffolded on visible context, making context modification (compaction, summarization) a critical alignment-relevant operation.

entry.title: Agentic Coding Needs Proactivity, Not Just Autonomy

author.name: Nghi D. Q. Bui, Georgios Evangelopoulos

entry.summary: Argues that agentic coding systems need proactivity (noticing changes, connecting signals across tools, deciding when to interrupt) rather than just autonomy. Proposes definitions, acceptance criteria, and metrics for proactive coding agents.

entry.title: SmellBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Architectural Code Smell Repair

author.name: Ion George Dinu (1), Marian Cristian Mih\u{a}escu (1), Traian Rebedea (2) ((1) University of Craiova, Craiova, Romania, (2) University Politehnica of Bucharest, Bucharest, Romania)

entry.summary: Presents SmellBench, the first empirical evaluation of LLM agents on architectural code smell repair, with a task orchestration framework and scoring methodology. Evaluates 11 agent configurations across multiple LLMs.

entry.title: From Pixels to Primitives: Scene Change Detection in 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Chamuditha Jayanga Galappaththige, Jason Lai, Timothy Patten, Donald Dansereau, Niko Suenderhauf, Dimity Miller

entry.summary: Proposes detecting scene changes directly in the primitive space of 3D Gaussian Splatting rather than the traditional render-then-compare approach, showing that native Gaussian attributes carry sufficient signal for change detection despite optimization non-uniqueness challenges.

entry.title: Modulated learning for private and distributed regression with just a single sample per client device

author.name: Praneeth Vepakomma, Amirhossein Reisizadeh, Samuel Horv\'ath, Munther Dahleh

entry.summary: Proposes modulated learning for federated regression where each device holds only a single data sample, addressing the breakdown of standard federated learning in this extreme data scarcity regime while maintaining privacy.

entry.title: Can Agents Price a Reaction? Evaluating LLMs on Chemical Cost Reasoning

author.name: Yuyang Wu, Yue Huang, Shuaike Shen, Xujian Wang, Shuhao Zhang, Qiyao Xue, Weichen Liu, Runtian Gao, Jian Ma, Xiangliang Zhang, Olexandr Isayev

entry.summary: ChemCost benchmarks LLM agents on chemical procurement cost estimation, requiring agents to ground chemical identities, retrieve supplier quotes, and compute costs from reaction descriptions, providing judge-free ground truth evaluation for scientific tool use.

entry.title: Mask2Cause: Causal Discovery via Adjacency Constrained Causal Attention

author.name: Omar Muhammad, Pasupuleti Dhruv Shivkant, Deepak N. Subramani

entry.summary: Mask2Cause proposes end-to-end causal discovery from time series during forecasting, using adjacency-constrained masked attention and inverted variable embedding to recover causal graphs directly in the forward pass.

entry.title: EgoPro-Bench: Benchmarking Personalized Proactive Interaction in Egocentric Video Streams

author.name: Dongchuan Ran, Linyu Ou, Xueheng Li, Wenwen Tong, Chenxu Guo, Hewei Guo, Kaibing Wang, Lewei Lu

entry.summary: EgoPro-Bench introduces a benchmark for proactive interaction in streaming egocentric videos with 2,400 evaluation videos across 12 domains, using simulated user profiles to generate diverse intentions and evaluating both timing and content of proactive assistance.

entry.title: Disagreement-Regularized Importance Sampling for Adversarial Label Corruption

author.name: Csongor Horv\'ath, Ida-Maria Sintorn and Prashant Singh

entry.summary: Proposes Disagreement-Regularized Importance Sampling (DR-IS) that uses loss rank-disagreement across proxy ensembles to identify and down-weight corrupted examples, with theoretical concentration bounds for separating bulk-corrupted from boundary-clean examples.

entry.title: Response-G1: Explicit Scene Graph Modeling for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding

author.name: Ke Ma, Jiaqi Tang, Bin Guo, Xueting Han, Ruonan Xu, Qingfeng He, Ziheng Wang, Xu Wang, Qifeng Chen, Zhiwen Yu, Yunhao Liu

entry.summary: Response-G1 uses explicit scene graph modeling for proactive streaming video understanding, with online query-guided graph generation, memory-based retrieval, and retrieval-augmented trigger prompting for deciding when to respond during video playback.

entry.title: A Refined Generalization Analysis for Extreme Multi-class Supervised Contrastive Representation Learning

author.name: Nong Minh Hieu and Antoine Ledent

entry.summary: Provides refined generalization analysis for supervised contrastive learning in extreme multi-class settings, removing the ρ_min^{-1/2} dependency that makes existing bounds vacuous for rare classes by handling dependencies among tuples constructed from finite data pools.

entry.title: FLAM: Evaluating Model Performance with Aggregatable Measures in Federated Learning

author.name: Fabian Stricker, Jose A. Peregrina, David Bermbach, Christian Zirpins

entry.summary: FLAM addresses the challenge that common metric aggregation strategies in federated learning don't match centralized evaluation results. Proposes aggregatable measures that generalize beyond accuracy to ensure consistency between local and global evaluation.

entry.title: Evaluation of an Actuated Spine in Agile Quadruped Locomotion

author.name: Nico Bohlinger, Piotr Kicki, Davide Tateo, Krzysztof Walas, Jan Peters

entry.summary: Empirically evaluates the benefits of an actuated 1-DOF spine for quadruped robot locomotion across multiple agile tasks in simulation, finding the spine provides the most significant benefits for high-speed running and hurdling.

entry.title: MPD$^2$-Router: Mask-aware Multi-expert Prior-regularized Dual-head Deferral Router in Glaucoma Screening and Diagnosis

author.name: Wenxin Zhan

entry.summary: MPD²-Router introduces a multi-expert learning-to-defer framework for glaucoma screening that accounts for expert availability, workload balance, asymmetric diagnostic costs, and OOD detection in human-AI routing decisions.

entry.title: SatSurfGS: Generalizable 2D Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Satellite Surface Reconstruction

author.name: Min Chen, Wei Guo, Bin Wang, Wen Li, Tong Fang, Jinbo Zhang, Junqi Zhao, Hong Kuang, Han Hu, Xuming Ge, Qing Zhu, Bo Xu

entry.summary: SatSurfGS proposes a generalizable 2D Gaussian Splatting framework for sparse-view satellite surface reconstruction, addressing the spatially heterogeneous reliability of multi-view matching under satellite imaging conditions.

entry.title: PISTO: Proximal Inference for Stochastic Trajectory Optimization

author.name: Hongzhe Yu, Zinuo Chang, and Yongxin Chen

entry.summary: PISTO reveals that STOMP (stochastic trajectory optimization) implicitly minimizes KL divergence from a Boltzmann distribution, then proposes a proximal KL-regularized variant with closed-form updates that stabilizes planning under non-differentiable costs.

entry.title: Sat3R: Satellite DSM Reconstruction via RPC-Aware Depth Fine-tuning

author.name: Qiaoyi Yang, Chaoyi Zhou, Xi Liu, Run Wang, Minghui Xu, Mert D. Pes\'e, Feng Luo, Yuhao Xu, Zhi-Qi Cheng, Qiushi Chen, Hairong Qi, Siyu Huang

entry.summary: Sat3R enables feed-forward satellite DSM reconstruction by fine-tuning Depth Anything V2 with RPC-aware metric depth using SiLog loss, bridging the domain gap between general depth models and satellite imagery with Rational Polynomial Camera models.

entry.title: PerCaM-Health: Personalized Dynamic Causal Graphs for Healthcare Reasoning

author.name: Elahe Khatibi, Ziyu Wang, Saba A. Farahani, Di Huang, Hung Cao, Ramesh Jain, and Amir M. Rahmani

entry.summary: PerCaM-Health learns personalized dynamic causal graphs from longitudinal health data by starting with a population-level temporal graph and conservatively adapting it per-patient, addressing the gap between population-level causal models and patient-specific mechanisms.

entry.title: AT-VLA: Adaptive Tactile Injection for Enhanced Feedback Reaction in Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Xiaoqi Li, Muhe Cai, Jiadong Xu, Juan Zhu, Hongwei Fan, Yan Shen, Guangrui Ren, Hao Dong

entry.summary: AT-VLA proposes adaptive tactile injection for VLA models that introduces tactile feedback without disrupting pretrained capabilities, addressing both the modality disruption problem and slow inference speed limitations for contact-rich manipulation.

entry.title: Curvature Beyond Positivity: Greedy Guarantees for Arbitrary Submodular Functions

author.name: Yixin Chen, Alan Kuhnle

entry.summary: Extends curvature analysis for submodular functions to handle both non-monotonicity and negativity simultaneously, providing greedy algorithm guarantees for arbitrary submodular functions beyond the classical non-negative monotone setting.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Structured Data Extraction from Full CMR Reports via Distilled LLMs

author.name: Yi Yu, Parker Martin, Zhenyu Bu, Yixuan Liu, Yi-Yu Zheng, Orlando Simonetti, Yuchi Han, Yuan Xue

entry.summary: CMR-EXTR converts free-text cardiac MRI reports into structured data using teacher-student LLM distillation with uncertainty quantification for quality control, achieving 99.65% variable-level accuracy.

entry.title: Evaluating Prompt Injection Defenses for Educational LLM Tutors: Security-Usability-Latency Trade-offs

author.name: Alexandre Cristov\~ao Maiorano

entry.summary: Evaluates prompt injection defenses for educational LLM tutors, revealing trade-offs among adversarial robustness, usability, and latency. A multi-layer safeguard pipeline achieves 46.34% bypass rate with 0% false positives.

entry.title: GraphDC: A Divide-and-Conquer Multi-Agent System for Scalable Graph Algorithm Reasoning

author.name: Wenjin Li, Jiaming Cui

entry.summary: Proposes GraphDC, a divide-and-conquer multi-agent framework where LLMs decompose large graphs into subgraphs for local reasoning by specialized agents, with a master agent integrating results. Improves LLM performance on graph algorithmic tasks.

entry.title: From Specification to Deployment: Empirical Evidence from a W3C VC + DID Trust Infrastructure for Autonomous Agents

author.name: Lars Kersten Kroehl

entry.summary: Presents MolTrust, a production-deployed trust infrastructure for autonomous AI agents built on W3C Verifiable Credentials and Decentralized Identifiers with blockchain anchoring. Addresses the need for cryptographically verifiable agent identity.

entry.title: Geometric Kolmogorov--Arnold Network (GeoKAN)

author.name: Abhijit Sen, Bikram Keshari Parida, Giridas Maiti, Mahima Arya, Denys I. Bondar

entry.summary: Introduces Geometric KANs (GeoKANs) that perform approximation in learned, geometry-adapted coordinates via a diagonal Riemannian metric that warps input before basis expansion. Develops multiple variants for different use cases.

entry.title: A Statistical Framework for Algorithmic Collective Action with Multiple Collectives

author.name: Claudio Battiloro, Pietro Greiner, Dario Rancati, Bret Nestor, Oumaima Amezgar, Francesca Dominici

entry.summary: Proposes a statistical framework for algorithmic collective action with multiple collectives acting on the same system, extending prior single-collective ACA theory to fragmented real-world settings.

entry.title: McNdroid: A Longitudinal Multimodal Benchmark for Robust Drift Detection in Android Malware

author.name: Md Mahmuduzzaman Kamol, Jesus Lopez, Saeefa Rubaiyet Nowmi, Emilia Rivas, Md Ahsanul Haque, Edward Raff, Aritran Piplai, Mohammad Saidur Rahman

entry.summary: Presents McNdroid, a large longitudinal multimodal Android malware benchmark spanning 2013-2025 with three aligned modalities (static, dynamic, graph-based). Evaluates drift detection methods across temporal splits.

entry.title: Causal-Aware Foundation-Model for Bilevel Optimization in Discrete Choice Settings

author.name: Shivaram Subramanian, Zhengliang Xue, Markus Ettl, Yingdong Lu, Jayant Kalagnanam

entry.summary: Introduces C3PO, a causal-aware foundation model framework for real-time pricing optimization in discrete choice environments, integrating imitation learning, multi-task learning of revenue responses, and in-context learning of price elasticity.

entry.title: OneViewAll: Semantic Prior Guided One-View 6D Pose Estimation for Novel Objects

author.name: Yang Luo, Yan Gong, Yongsheng Gao, Jie Zhao, Xinyu Zhang, Huaping Liu

entry.summary: Proposes OneViewAll, a framework for 6D object pose estimation from a single RGB-D reference view without CAD models, using hierarchical semantic priors and a Project-and-Compare paradigm.

entry.title: Functional-prior-based Bayesian PDE-constrained inversion using PINNs

author.name: Ryoichiro Agata, Tomohisa Okazaki

entry.summary: Introduces a unified framework for incorporating functional priors (rather than weight-space priors) into Bayesian PINN-based inverse problems, with two complementary approaches for prior specification.

entry.title: Learning to Track Instance from Single Nature Language Description

author.name: Yaozong Zheng, Bineng Zhong, Qihua Liang, Shuimu Zeng, Haiying Xia, Shuxiang Song

entry.summary: Introduces a self-supervised vision-language tracker that tracks objects by language description without bounding-box ground truth, using a Dynamic Token Aggregation Module that treats visual tokens unequally.

entry.title: InfoGeo: Information-Theoretic Object-Centric Learning for Cross-View Generalizable UAV Geo-Localization

author.name: Hongyang Zhang and Maonnan Wang and Ziyao Wang and Hongrui Yin and Man OnPun

entry.summary: InfoGeo applies object-centric learning to UAV geo-localization, reformulating cross-view matching as an information bottleneck process to handle domain shifts from varying textures, weather, and visual clutter in UAV imagery.

entry.title: Simple KNN-Based Outlier Detection Achieves Robust Clustering

author.name: Tianle Jiang, Yufa Zhou

entry.summary: Proves that simple KNN-based outlier detection achieves performance comparable to prior work for robust k-Means clustering (k-Means with outliers) under practical cluster size assumptions, yielding constant-factor approximation guarantees.

entry.title: TriP: A Triangle Puzzle Approach to Robust Translation Averaging

author.name: Zhekai Fan, Wanze Li, Jinxin Wang, Yunpeng Shi

entry.summary: TriP proposes a triangle-based framework for robust translation averaging in Structure-from-Motion, using triangle geometry to infer local relative edge scales and synchronize them globally in logarithmic domain.

entry.title: Neurosymbolic Imitation Learning with Human Guidance: A Privileged Information Approach
