author.name: Nikhilesh Prabhakar, Varun Balaji, Athresh Karanam, Kristian Kersting, Sriraam Natarajan

entry.summary: Proposes a neurosymbolic approach to imitation learning that handles high-dimensional data while generalizing well, exploiting privileged information (gaze data) available only during training.

entry.title: Learning Multi-Relational Graph Representations for DNA Methylation-Based Biological Age Estimation

author.name: Qing Qing and Xikun Zhang and Zhongyuan Zhang and Jiarui Liu and Xingtong Yu and Xiaotao Shen and Ziqi Xu and Qixin Zhang and Zhe Wang and Renqiang Luo

entry.summary: RelAge-GNN constructs multi-relational graphs over CpG sites capturing co-methylation, genomic co-localization, and gene-level associations for DNA methylation-based biological age estimation, moving beyond treating CpG sites as independent features.

entry.title: Masks Can Talk: Extracting Structured Text Information from Single-Modal Images for Remote Sensing Change Detection

author.name: Kai Zheng, Hang-Cheng Dong, Jiatong Pan, Zhenkai Wu, Fupeng Wei, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes extracting structured text descriptions from ground-truth mask labels for remote sensing change detection, observing that masks already encode fine-grained change semantics (what changed, how, how many objects) that multimodal methods typically generate noisily.

entry.title: Closed-Form Linear-Probe Dataset Distillation for Pre-trained Vision Models

author.name: Bincheng Peng, Guang Li, Ping Liu, Takahiro Ogawa, Miki Haseyama

entry.summary: Proposes a closed-form dataset distillation method specifically designed for frozen pre-trained vision encoders with linear probing, exploiting the fact that this setting admits an exact solution without NTK approximations or inner-loop trajectories.

entry.title: HMACE: Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Collaborative Evolution for Combinatorial Optimization

author.name: Yuping Yan, Jirui Han, Fei Ming, Yuanshuai Li, and Yaochu Jin

entry.summary: HMACE introduces a heterogeneous multi-agent framework using LLMs for automated heuristic design in combinatorial optimization, with specialized agents (Proposer, Generator, Evaluator) collaborating in an evolutionary loop to avoid premature convergence.

entry.title: Towards multi-modal forgery representation learning for AI-generated video detection and localization

author.name: Dat Le, Khoa Nguyen, Xin Wang, Shu Hu

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-modal architecture for AI-generated video detection combining an LMM semantic branch, spatio-temporal visual branch, and multi-scale audio branch for simultaneous detection and temporal localization of manipulated content.

entry.title: Sample Complexity of Stochastic Optimization with Integer Variables

author.name: Hongyu Cheng, Yinghao Zheng, Marco Molinaro, Amitabh Basu

entry.summary: Establishes sample complexity results for stochastic integer optimization, showing that integer constraints can require either more or fewer samples than continuous optimization depending on problem structure, providing tight characterizations for different norm balls.

entry.title: LENS: Low-Frequency Eigen Noise Shaping for Efficient Diffusion Sampling

author.name: Haewon Jeon, Si-Hyeon Lee

entry.summary: LENS proposes efficient noise modulation for distilled diffusion models by operating in a low-dimensional eigenspace of low-frequency components, avoiding costly optimization in full latent space while maintaining image quality.

entry.title: BioProVLA-Agent: An Affordable, Protocol-Driven, Vision-Enhanced VLA-Enabled Embodied Multi-Agent System with Closed-Loop-Capable Reasoning for Biological Laboratory Manipulation

author.name: Zhaohui Du, Zhe Wang, Hongmei Fei, Xiwen Cao, Ting Xiao, Qi Wang, Huanbo Jin, Jiaming Gu, Quan Lu, Zhe Liu

entry.summary: BioProVLA-Agent presents an affordable embodied multi-agent system for biological lab automation combining protocol parsing, visual state verification, and VLA-based execution for wet-lab manipulations with transparent/reflective labware.

entry.title: RCoT-Seg: Reinforced Chain-of-Thought for Video Reasoning and Segmentation

author.name: Junwei Wen, Deshui Miao, Guangming Lu, Xin Li, Wenjie Pei

entry.summary: Proposes RCoT-Seg for video reasoning segmentation, decomposing the task into temporal video reasoning and keyframe target perception. Uses reinforcement learning for agentic keyframe selection to improve temporal understanding in complex multi-object scenes.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Neural Network Evaluation with Sample-Wise Activation Patterns

author.name: Yameng Peng, Andy Song, HaythamM. Fayek, Vic Ciesielski, Xiaojun Chang

entry.summary: Proposes SWAP-Score, a zero-shot neural network evaluation metric based on sample-wise activation patterns that works across both CNNs and Transformers and across multiple task domains.

entry.title: Velocity-Space 3D Asset Editing

author.name: Hao Liu, Yuxuan Lin, Jingfeng Guo, Ruihang Chu, Junjie Wang, Ruotong Li, Yujiu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a velocity-space decomposition for local 3D asset editing with rectified-flow generators, addressing identity leakage by separating edit and preservation velocity fields inside the ODE sampler.

entry.title: BalCapRL: A Balanced Framework for RL-Based MLLM Image Captioning

author.name: Shaokai Ye, Vasileios Saveris, Yihao Qian, Jiaming Hu, Elmira Amirloo, Peter Grasch

entry.summary: Proposes BalCapRL, a balanced framework for RL-based MLLM image captioning that addresses trade-offs across multiple quality dimensions (accuracy, fluency, utility) rather than optimizing a single narrow objective.

entry.title: Uncovering Hidden Systematics in Neural Network Models for High Energy Physics

author.name: Lucie Flek, Philipp Alexander Jungs, Akbar Karimi, Timo Saala, Alexander Schmid, Matthias Schott, Philipp Soldin, Christopher Wiebusch, Ulrich Willemsen

entry.summary: Investigates how neural networks in high-energy physics can harbor hidden systematic uncertainties by showing that subtle adversarial-style perturbations consistent with experimental uncertainties can cause significant output shifts that aren't captured by standard uncertainty propagation.

entry.title: NPMixer: Hierarchical Neighboring Patch Mixing for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Jung Min Choi, Vijaya Krishna Yalavarthi, Lars Schmidt-Thieme

entry.summary: NPMixer proposes a hierarchical architecture for multivariate time series forecasting using a Learnable Stationary Wavelet Transform for signal decomposition and a Neighboring Mixer Block that captures local temporal dynamics through hierarchical MLPs on non-overlapping patches.

entry.title: PathPainter: Transferring the Generalization Ability of Image Generation Models to Embodied Navigation

author.name: Yijin Wang, Yuru Tian, Xijie Huang, Weiqi Gai, Mo Zhu, Xin Zhou, Yuze Wu, Fei Gao

entry.summary: PathPainter uses image generation models to interpret natural language navigation commands on BEV maps, generating traversability masks and employing cross-view localization to align robot odometry with BEV maps for ground robot navigation.

entry.title: Model-Driven Policy Optimization in Differentiable Simulators via Stochastic Exploration

author.name: Yuval Aroosh, Ayal Taitler

entry.summary: MDPO introduces stochastic exploration into differentiable planning by injecting noise into the action space during optimization, with noise magnitude adapted based on gradient-derived sensitivity. Addresses ill-conditioned optimization landscapes in nonlinear hybrid domains.

entry.title: Multi-Environment POMDPs with Finite-Horizon Objectives

author.name: L\'eonard Brice, Filip Cano, Krishnendu Chatterjee, Thomas A. Henzinger, Stefanie Muroya

entry.summary: Establishes PSPACE-completeness for multi-environment POMDPs with finite-horizon objectives and presents a practical algorithm that significantly outperforms the only previously known algorithm on classical benchmarks.

entry.title: Ensemble Distributionally Robust Bayesian Optimisation

author.name: Tigran Ramazyan and Denis Derkach

entry.summary: Proposes Ensemble Distributionally Robust Bayesian Optimization that remains computationally tractable with continuous context, providing theoretical sublinear regret bounds that improve state-of-the-art results.

entry.title: SAM 3D Animal: Promptable Animal 3D Reconstruction from Images in the Wild

author.name: Xuyi Hu, Jin Lyu, Jiuming Liu, Yebin Liu, Silvia Zuffi, Liang An, Stefan Goetz

entry.summary: SAM 3D Animal presents the first promptable framework for multi-animal 3D reconstruction from a single image, supporting keypoints and masks as prompts. They also introduce Herd3D, a dataset with 5K+ images for multi-animal 3D scenarios. This addresses a real gap in handling crowded, occluded animal scenes.

entry.title: EggHand: A Multimodal Foundation Model for Egocentric Hand Pose Forecasting

author.name: Jaeyoung Choi, Hyeondong Kim, Yujin Kim, Daehee Park

entry.summary: EggHand is a foundation-model-based framework for egocentric hand pose forecasting that combines a Vision-Language-Action model's action decoder with an egocentric video-text encoder for semantic reasoning and dynamic motion modeling.

entry.title: Towards Billion-scale Multi-modal Biometric Search

author.name: Arka Koner, Chetan S. Naik, Lokesh Kurre, Vivek Raghavan, Barada P. Sabut, Tanusree Deb Barma, Anoop M. Namboodiri and Anil K. Jain

entry.summary: Describes Bharat ABIS, the first billion-scale multimodal biometric search system using open-source architectures, processing fingerprint, face, and iris modalities with a 13.5KB template per person.

entry.title: GASim: A Graph-Accelerated Hybrid Framework for Social Simulation

author.name: Xuan Zhou, Yanhui Sun, Hantao Yao, Allen He, Yongdong Zhang, Wu Liu

entry.summary: GASim proposes graph-accelerated hybrid multi-agent simulation combining LLM agents with graph-optimized memory and graph message passing for parallel agent updates, reducing latency for large-scale social simulations.

entry.title: When Losses Align: Gradient-Based Composite Loss Weighting for Efficient Pretraining

author.name: Ivan Karpukhin, Andrey Savchenko

entry.summary: Proposes a gradient-based bilevel method for learning pretraining loss weights online by aligning composite pretraining gradients with downstream objectives, reducing hyperparameter tuning overhead to ~30% above single training run.

entry.title: Efficient Verification of Neural Control Barrier Functions with Smooth Nonlinear Activations

author.name: Jun Zhang, Haibo Zhang, Chun Liu, Xiaofan Wang, Liang Xu

entry.summary: LightCROWN computes tighter Jacobian bounds for neural control barrier function verification by exploiting analytical properties of smooth activations like tanh, achieving up to 100% verification success rates.

entry.title: APEX: Assumption-free Projection-based Embedding eXamination Metric for Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Caterina Gallegati and Monica Bianchini and Franco Scarselli and Vittorio Murino and Barbara Toniella Corradini

entry.summary: Introduces APEX, an image quality assessment metric using Sliced Wasserstein Distance as an assumption-free similarity measure, addressing the closed-vocabulary bottleneck of FID and parametric limitations of existing metrics.

entry.title: PPI-Net connects molecular protein interactions to functional processes in disease

author.name: Kyle Higgins, Guadalupe Gonzalez, Dennis Veselkov, Ivan Laponogov, Kirill Veselkov

entry.summary: Presents PPI-Net, a hierarchical graph neural network integrating protein-protein interaction networks with pathway-level representations for disease modeling, achieving strong classification across cancer types and cardiac conditions.

entry.title: Melding LLM and temporal logic for reliable human-swarm collaboration in complex scenarios

author.name: Junfeng Chen, Yuxiao Zhu, An Zhuo, Xintong Zhang, Shuo Zhang, Guanghui Wen, Xiwang Dong, Meng Guo, Zhongkui Li

entry.summary: Introduces a neuro-symbolic framework combining LLMs with temporal logic for long-horizon human-swarm collaboration, ensuring valid task orderings and feasible robot actions while reducing operator cognitive burden.

entry.title: Black-box model classification under the discriminative factorization

author.name: Hayden Helm and Merrick Ohata and Carey Priebe

entry.summary: Introduces the discriminative factorization for black-box model classification, providing a framework to distinguish high- and low-quality query sets when auditing models through API access.

entry.title: Rebalancing gradient to improve self-supervised co-training of depth, odometry and optical flow predictions

author.name: Marwane Hariat, Antoine Manzanera, David Filliat

entry.summary: CoopNet improves self-supervised co-training of depth, odometry, and optical flow by dynamically rebalancing gradient apportionment across the cooperating networks, using a hybrid loss based on photometric reconstruction error distributions.

entry.title: Towards Apples to Apples for AI Evaluations: From Real-World Use Cases to Evaluation Scenarios

author.name: Yee-Yin Choong, Kristen Greene, Alice Qian, Meryem Marasli, Ziqi Yang, Sophia Chen, Laura Dabbish, Anand Rao, Hong Shen

entry.summary: Proposes a repeatable process for transforming high-level AI use cases into detailed evaluation scenarios with methodological transparency, using a structured worksheet with six key elements to enable more comparable AI evaluations.

entry.title: GRAPHLCP: Structure-Aware Localized Conformal Prediction on Graphs

author.name: Peyman Baghershahi, Fangxin Wang, Debmalya Mandal, Sourav Medya

entry.summary: Introduces GRAPHLCP, a conformal prediction framework for GNNs that incorporates graph topology and inter-node dependencies into localization and weighting. Uses Personalized PageRank-based kernels and feature-aware densification to produce better-calibrated prediction sets.

entry.title: Clarifying the role of the behavioral selection model

author.name: Alex Mallen

entry.summary: Clarifies the behavioral selection model for predicting AI motivations, emphasizing that similar training behavior can correspond to radically different deployment outcomes depending on underlying motivations. Discusses limitations including the role of reflection and deliberation.

entry.title: Enabling Unsupervised Training of Deep EEG Denoisers With Intelligent Partitioning

author.name: Qiyu Rao, Haozhe Tian, Homayoun Hamedmoghadam, Danilo Mandic

entry.summary: Proposes intelligent partitioning for self-supervised EEG denoising (iPSD) that eliminates the need for clean reference signals by learning to partition EEG segments into independent noisy realizations sharing the same underlying signal.

entry.title: The E$\Delta$-MHC-Geo Transformer: Adaptive Geodesic Operations with Guaranteed Orthogonality

author.name: Arash Shahmansoori

entry.summary: Proposes a novel transformer architecture combining manifold-constrained hyper-connections, deep delta learning, and Cayley transforms for unconditionally orthogonal residual connections across all inputs and parameters.

entry.title: R$^3$L: Reasoning 3D Layouts from Relative Spatial Relations

author.name: Zhifeng Gu, Yuqi Wang, Bing Wang

entry.summary: Proposes R³L for 3D layout generation from relative spatial relations, addressing error accumulation in multi-hop spatial reasoning by MLLMs through invariant spatial decomposition and consistent spatial validation.

entry.title: PAMPOS: Causal Transformer-based Trajectory Prediction for Attack-Agnostic Misbehavior Detection in V2X Networks

author.name: Konstantinos Kalogiannis, Ahmed Mohamed Hussain, and Panos Papadimitratos

entry.summary: Presents PAMPOS, a causal transformer-decoder for attack-agnostic misbehavior detection in V2X networks. Trained only on benign trajectories, it identifies anomalies at inference time without requiring labeled attack data.

entry.title: Temporal Attention for Adaptive Control of Euler-Lagrange Systems with Unobservable Memory

author.name: Giansalvo Cirrincione, Adriano Fagiolini

entry.summary: Proposes a meta-control architecture for Euler-Lagrange systems where self-attention generates controller gains from recent motion history. Addresses non-Markovian dynamics from unobservable friction states.

entry.title: XiYOLO: Energy-Aware Object Detection via Iterative Architecture Search and Scaling

author.name: Tony Tran, Richie R. Suganda, Bin Hu

entry.summary: Presents XiYOLO, an energy-aware NAS framework combining energy-aware search space, two-stage energy estimator, and compound scaling to create a family of energy-efficient object detectors for edge deployment.

entry.title: AI and Consciousness: Shifting Focus Towards Tractable Questions

author.name: Iulia-Maria Comsa

entry.summary: Argues that the question of whether AI systems can be conscious is currently intractable, and proposes redirecting research toward 'perceived AI consciousness' - how humans perceive and attribute consciousness to AI systems.

entry.title: A Behavioral Framework for Data-Driven Modeling of Nonlinear Systems in Vector-Valued Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces

author.name: Boya Hou, Maxim Raginsky

entry.summary: Generalizes Willems' behavioral approach to nonlinear systems in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces, covering Volterra series and Hammerstein-type systems, and applies it to data-driven modeling without explicit identification.

entry.title: From Assistance to Agency: Rethinking Autonomy and Control in CI/CD Pipelines

author.name: Marcus Emmanuel Barnes, Taher A. Ghaleb, Safwat Hassan

entry.summary: Presents a vision of agentic CI/CD focusing on authority transfer from humans to AI agents, distinguishing data-plane authority (patch generation) from control-plane authority (pipeline configuration changes).

entry.title: Sub-Gaussian Concentration and Entropic Normality of the Maximum Likelihood Estimator

author.name: Leighton P. Barnes and Alex Dytso

entry.summary: Strengthens classical MLE asymptotic normality results by proving sub-Gaussian tail bounds, moment convergence, and entropic central limit theorems for the normalized maximum likelihood estimator under additional regularity conditions.

entry.title: RRCM: Ranking-Driven Retrieval over Collaborative and Meta Memories for LLM Recommendation

author.name: Shijun Li, Wooseong Yang, Yu Wang, Tianxin Wei, Joydeep Ghosh

entry.summary: RRCM proposes ranking-driven retrieval over collaborative and meta memories for LLM-based recommendation, addressing context construction challenges by dynamically determining what collaborative and metadata evidence is beneficial per instance.

entry.title: PRIMED: Adaptive Modality Suppression for Referring Audio-Visual Segmentation via Biased Competition

author.name: Yuchen He and Jing Zhang

entry.summary: PRIMED models referring audio-visual segmentation through biased competition theory from cognitive neuroscience, enabling adaptive modality suppression when certain modalities are irrelevant or misleading for a given reference expression.

entry.title: Cost-Ordered Feasibility for Multi-Armed Bandits with Cost Subsidy

author.name: Ishank Juneja, Carlee Joe-Wong, Osman Ya\u{g}an

entry.summary: Characterizes expected sub-optimal samples for multi-armed bandits with cost subsidy where the goal is minimizing cost subject to reward constraints. Proposes Cost-Ordered Feasibility (COF) algorithm leveraging instance-dependent lower bounds.

entry.title: Repeated Deceptive Path Planning against Learnable Observer

author.name: Shiyue Cao, Pei Xu, Likun Yang, Lei Cui, Shizhao Yu, Shiyu Zhang, Yongjian Ren, Xiaotang Chen, Kaiqi Huang

entry.summary: Introduces Repeated Deceptive Path Planning (RDPP) where adversarial observers learn from historical trajectories, and proposes Deceptive Meta Planning (DeMP) to maintain deception against adaptive observers.

entry.title: Towards Autonomous Business Intelligence via Data-to-Insight Discovery Agent

author.name: Dongming Wu, Junwen Li, Ming Lu, Gang Wang, Ting Chen

entry.summary: AIDA proposes an end-to-end autonomous business intelligence agent framework that uses a domain-specific language to bridge semantic reasoning with SQL execution, combined with reinforcement learning guided by the Pareto Principle for cumulative business analysis.

entry.title: DINO-MVR: Multi-View Readout of Frozen DINOv3 for Annotation-Efficient Medical Segmentation

author.name: Wei Jiang, Feng Liu, Nan Ye, Hongfu Sun

entry.summary: DINO-MVR shows that frozen DINOv3 features already contain useful structural cues for medical segmentation, and proposes a lightweight multi-view readout framework using only MLP probes on features from the last three transformer blocks, without any backbone fine-tuning.

entry.title: TAS-LoRA: Transformer Architecture Search with Mixture-of-LoRA Experts

author.name: Jeimin Jeon, Hyunju Lee, Bumsub Ham

entry.summary: TAS-LoRA introduces parameter-efficient LoRA experts into transformer architecture search to address the feature collapse problem in supernets, using a Mixture-of-LoRA-Experts strategy with dynamic routing based on subnet architectures.

entry.title: SplatWeaver: Learning to Allocate Gaussian Primitives for Generalizable Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Yecong Wan, Fan Li, Mingwen Shao, Wangmeng Zuo

entry.summary: SplatWeaver proposes adaptive allocation of Gaussian primitives for novel view synthesis, predicting region-dependent cardinalities rather than uniform fixed allocation, enabling more expressiveness for complex regions and efficiency for smooth ones.

entry.title: SOM: Structured Opponent Modeling for LLM-based Agents via Structural Causal Model

author.name: Shiyue Cao, Pei Xu, Likun Yang, Lei Cui, Xiaotang Chen, Kaiqi Huang

entry.summary: SOM proposes structured opponent modeling for LLM agents using Structural Causal Models to explicitly separate opponent model construction from prediction, capturing directed dependencies between observations and actions.

entry.title: Discovering Ordinary Differential Equations with LLM-Based Qualitative and Quantitative Evaluation

author.name: Sum Kyun Song, Bong Gyun Shin, Jae Yong Lee

entry.summary: Proposes DoLQ, a multi-agent system using LLMs for discovering ordinary differential equations from data. A Scientist Agent provides qualitative evaluation alongside quantitative metrics to ensure physical plausibility of discovered equations.

entry.title: ST-Gen4D: Embedding 4D Spatiotemporal Cognition into World Model for 4D Generation

author.name: Haonan Wang, Hanyu Zhou, Tao Gu, Luxin Yan

entry.summary: Proposes ST-Gen4D, a 4D generation framework with spatiotemporal cognition-based world model that captures both global appearance structure and local dynamic topology for physically consistent 4D content generation.

entry.title: Learning Image-Adaptive Scale Fields for Metric Depth Recovery

author.name: Yuanyan Li, Matthias Althoff

entry.summary: Formulates metric depth recovery as image-adaptive scale field modeling using a low-dimensional linear combination of semantic/geometric basis maps. Sparse metric anchors determine weights via least-squares.

entry.title: AudioFace: Language-Assisted Speech-Driven Facial Animation with Multimodal Language Models

author.name: Kai Zheng, Zejian Kang, Rui Mao, Hongyuan Zou, Yuanchen Fei, Xuanyang Xu, Xiangru Huang

entry.summary: AudioFace proposes a language-assisted framework for speech-driven facial animation that uses multimodal LLMs to incorporate transcript and phoneme-level cues, treating blendshape prediction as a structured generation problem guided by linguistic information.

entry.title: Excluding the Target Domain Improves Extrapolation: Deconfounded Hierarchical Physics Constraints

author.name: Tsuyoshi Okita

entry.summary: Proposes Deconfounded Hierarchical Gate (DHG) for physics-constrained deep generative models that removes confounding (particularly temperature effects) from hierarchical physical constraints, surprisingly showing that excluding target domain data improves extrapolation.

entry.title: Hierarchical Dual-Subspace Decoupling for Continual Learning in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Mengxin Qin, Xiang Zhang, Kun Wei, Xu Yang, Cheng Deng

entry.summary: HDSD proposes hierarchical dual-subspace decoupling for continual learning in vision-language models, decomposing parameter space into general and task-specific subspaces with a Feature Modulation Module to reduce cross-task interference.

entry.title: LARAG: Link-Aware Retrieval Strategy for RAG Systems in Hyperlinked Technical Documentation

author.name: Giorgia Bolognesi, Claudio Estatico, Ulderico Fugacci, Isabella Mastroianni, Claudio Muselli, Luca Oneto

entry.summary: LARAG introduces link-aware retrieval for RAG systems that leverages hyperlink topology in technical documentation, encoding hyperlink relations as metadata to perform graph-like retrieval of locally relevant content.

entry.title: Probabilistic Object Detection with Conformal Prediction

author.name: Christopher Ries, Moussa Kassem Sbeyti, Nicolas Bianco, Nadja Klein

entry.summary: Systematically compares unscaled and scaled Conformal Prediction for multi-class object detection, integrating CP with complementary probabilistic detection approaches. Provides coverage guarantees for safety-critical applications.

entry.title: How to utilize failure demo data?: Effective data selection for imitation learning using distribution differences in attention mechanism

author.name: Kana Miyamoto, Kanata Suzuki, Tetsuya Ogata

entry.summary: Proposes using attention mechanism distribution differences between success and failure demonstrations for data selection in imitation learning, with a latent mode selected from initial observation to improve action stability.

entry.title: Optimal Recourse Summaries via Bi-Objective Decision Tree Learning

author.name: Ioannis Chatzis and Jason Liartis and Athanasios Voulodimos and Giorgos Stamou

entry.summary: SOGAR formulates recourse summary learning as optimal decision tree learning to find Pareto fronts trading off recourse effectiveness against cost, enabling fair comparison across subgroups for bias detection.

entry.title: Intent-Driven Semantic ID Generation for Grounded Conversational News Recommendation

author.name: Hongyang Su, Beibei Kong, Lei Cheng, Chengxiang Zhuo, Zang Li, Chenyun Yu

entry.summary: Proposes intent-driven Semantic ID generation for conversational news recommendation under a Generate-then-Match paradigm. Uses GPT-4 CoT distillation to map diverse user intents to hierarchical IDs that are fuzzy-matched to news articles.

entry.title: Learning to Communicate Locally for Large-Scale Multi-Agent Pathfinding

author.name: Valeriy Vyaltsev, Alsu Sagirova, Anton Andreychuk, Yuri Kuratov, Konstantin Yakovlev, Aleksandr Panov, Alexey Skrynnik

entry.summary: Introduces a learnable communication module for decentralized multi-agent pathfinding that enables agents to share local information, improving coordination while maintaining scalability. Follows the Dec-POMDP formulation with reinforcement/imitation learning.

entry.title: Direction-Preserving Number Representations

author.name: Bardia Zadeh and George A. Constantinides

entry.summary: Introduces a geometric framework for analyzing directional coverage of product-structured codes (low-precision number representations), quantifying the gap between element-wise quantization and optimal spherical codes for vector direction preservation.

entry.title: Toward Better Geometric Representations for Molecule Generative Models

author.name: Shaoheng Yan, Zian Li, Cai Zhou, Qiaojing Huang, Kai Liu, Muhan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes LENSEs, a framework for improving geometric representations for molecule generative models by better exploiting and smoothing pretrained molecular encoder representations for two-stage generation.

entry.title: Cross-Attention and Encoder-Decoder Transformers: A Logical Characterization

author.name: Veeti Ahvonen, Damian Heiman, Antti Kuusisto, Miguel Moreno, Matias Selin

entry.summary: Gives a logical characterization of encoder-decoder transformers with cross-attention using a temporal logic extending propositional logic with counting and past modalities, plus distributed automata characterization.

entry.title: Hierarchical Task Network Planning with LLM-Generated Heuristics

author.name: Felipe Meneguzzi, Alexandre Buchweitz, Augusto B. Corr\^ea, Victor Scherer Putrich, Andr\'e Grahl Pereira

entry.summary: Investigates using LLMs to generate search heuristics for Hierarchical Task Network planning, extending prior work on LLM-generated heuristics from classical planning to the HTN setting.

entry.title: Neural Operators as Efficient Function Interpolators

author.name: Vasilis Niarchos, Angelos Sirbu and Sokratis Trifinopoulos

entry.summary: Reframes neural operators as function interpolators by introducing an auxiliary base-space, showing they can match or outperform MLPs and KANs with fewer parameters. Applied to nuclear mass model corrections as a real-world demonstration.

entry.title: SARA: Semantically Adaptive Relational Alignment for Video Diffusion Models

author.name: Jiesong Lian, Zixiang Zhou, Ruizhe Zhong, Yuan Zhou, Qinglin Lu, Rui Wang, Long Hu, Yixue Hao, Baoru Huang

entry.summary: Presents SARA for video diffusion models, adding text-conditioned saliency to token-relation distillation to better allocate supervision budget based on semantic relevance to the prompt, reducing entity dropping and attribute mis-binding.

entry.title: Divide and Conquer: Object Co-occurrence Helps Mitigate Simplicity Bias in OOD Detection

author.name: Boyang Dai, Chaoqi Chen, Yizhou Yu

entry.summary: Proposes an object-centric OOD detection framework that captures object co-occurrence patterns within images to mitigate simplicity bias, inspired by human visual system's use of contextual co-occurrence for scene understanding.

entry.title: Actor-Critic Algorithm for Dynamic Expectile and CVaR

author.name: Yudong Luo and Erick Delage

entry.summary: Develops model-free actor-critic algorithms for dynamic risk measures (expectile and CVaR) by leveraging elicitability, with a surrogate policy gradient that avoids transition perturbation under softmax parameterization.

entry.title: AERO-VIS: Asynchronous Event-based Real-time Onboard Visual-Inertial SLAM

author.name: Yannick Burkhardt, Sebasti\'an Barbas Laina, Simon Boche, Leonard Frei{\ss}muth, Stefan Leutenegger

entry.summary: Presents AERO-VIS, a stereo event-inertial SLAM system with data-driven keypoint detection that processes event streams asynchronously, achieving real-time performance on UAVs with unprecedented accuracy in onboard event-based SLAM.

entry.title: Linear Response Estimators for Singular Statistical Models

author.name: Chris Elliott and Daniel Murfet

entry.summary: Defines susceptibilities as measures of statistical model response to data perturbations and proves consistency and asymptotic unbiasedness of estimators for singular statistical models.

entry.title: Active Embodiment Identification with Reinforcement Learning for Legged Robots

author.name: Nico Bohlinger, Jan Peters

entry.summary: Presents an active embodiment identification method for legged robots that learns information-seeking behavior and explicit embodiment prediction jointly using a history-augmented architecture across different morphologies.

entry.title: Accurate and Efficient Statistical Testing for Word Semantic Breadth

author.name: Yo Ehara

entry.summary: Identifies a statistical pitfall in comparing word semantic breadth using dispersion measures on contextualized embeddings, where directional differences can masquerade as dispersion differences, inflating Type-I error.

entry.title: Conformal Path Reasoning: Trustworthy Knowledge Graph Question Answering via Path-Level Calibration

author.name: Shuhang Lin, Chuhao Zhou, Xiao Lin, Zihan Dong, Kuan Lu, Zhencan Peng, Jie Yin, Dimitris N. Metaxas

entry.summary: Presents Conformal Path Reasoning (CPR) for knowledge graph question answering, providing statistical coverage guarantees over retrieved answers. Introduces query-level calibration over path-level scores and a dual-score mechanism to improve both coverage validity and prediction set efficiency.

entry.title: Star Elastic: Many-in-One Reasoning LLMs with Efficient Budget Control

author.name: Ali Taghibakhshi, Ruisi Cai, Saurav Muralidharan, Sharath Turuvekere Sreenivas, Aditya Vavre, Ameya Sunil Mahabaleshwarkar, Bilal Kartal, Sheldon Liang, Marcin Chochowski, Zijia Chen, Akhiad Bercovich, Ran Zilberstein, Ran El-Yaniv, Yonatan Geifman, Daniel Korzekwa, Yoshi Suhara, Oluwatobi Olabiyi, Ashwath Aithal, Nima Tajbakhsh, Pavlo Molchanov

entry.summary: As covered in News yesterday via MarkTechPost, Star Elastic creates N nested submodels within a single parent reasoning LLM via one post-training job, enabling elastic budget control where different submodels handle different reasoning phases. From NVIDIA authors.

entry.title: A Self-Healing Framework for Reliable LLM-Based Autonomous Agents

author.name: Cheonsu Jeong, Younggun Shin

entry.summary: Proposes a reliability-aware self-healing framework for LLM-based autonomous agents with failure detection, reliability assessment, and automated recovery mechanisms including prompt restructuring and model switching.

entry.title: Bi3: A Biplatform, Bicultural, Biperson Dataset for Social Robot Navigation

author.name: Andrew Stratton, Phani Teja Singamaneni, Pranav Goyal, Rachid Alami, Christoforos Mavrogiannis

entry.summary: Contributes Bi3, a social robot navigation dataset with 74 participants across USA and France, five navigation algorithms, two robot platforms, and 10.5 hours of multimodal data including motion tracks, video, and user impressions.

entry.title: Generalising Travel Time Prediction To Varying Route Choices In Urban Networks

author.name: {\L}ukasz Gorczyca, Kacper Drozd, Micha{\l} Bujak, Rafa{\l} Kucharski

entry.summary: Proposes GenTTP for travel time prediction that generalizes across varying route choices rather than learning a single demand realization. Captures relationships between route assignments and resulting travel times.

entry.title: Locally Near Optimal Piecewise Linear Regression in High Dimensions via Difference of Max-Affine Functions

author.name: Haitham Kanj and Kiryung Lee

entry.summary: Presents a parametric solution to piecewise linear regression through the Adaptive Block Gradient Descent algorithm, using difference of max-affine (DoMA) function parameterization with non-asymptotic convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Bringing Multimodal Large Language Models to Infrared-Visible Image Fusion Quality Assessment

author.name: Yuchen Guo, Junli Gong, Yao Lu, Xintong Xu, Yiuming Cheung, Weifeng Su

entry.summary: Introduces FuScore, an MLLM-based quality assessment method for infrared-visible image fusion that leverages multimodal LLM reasoning rather than scalar regression, addressing the limitations of existing metrics.

entry.title: Learning Cross-Atlas Consistent Brain Disorder Representations via Disentangled Multi-Atlas Functional Connectivity Learning

author.name: Minheng Chen, Chao Cao, Jing Zhang, Tianming Liu, Dajiang Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes MADCLE, a multi-atlas disentangled connectivity learning framework that jointly encodes functional connectivity from different brain parcellations while addressing cross-atlas heterogeneity for brain disorder classification.

entry.title: AGA3DNet: Anatomy-Guided Gaussian Priors with Multi-view xLSTM for 3D Brain MRI Subtype Classification

author.name: Peiyu Duan, Xueqi Guo, Sepehr Farhand, Mehmet Berk Sahin, Xinyuan Zheng, James S. Duncan, Gerardo Hermosillo Valadez, Yoshihisa Shinagawa

entry.summary: AGA3DNet uses anatomical phrases from radiology reports as soft prior channels for 3D brain MRI classification, converting them to atlas-defined Gaussian spatial priors and fusing with a 3D CNN and multi-view xLSTM aggregation.

entry.title: Hierarchical Perfusion Graphs for Tumor Heterogeneity Modeling in Glioma Molecular Subtyping

author.name: Han Jang, Junhyeok Lee, Heeseong Eum, Joon Jang, Yoseob Han, Seung Hong Choi, Kyu Sung Choi

entry.summary: HiPerfGNN uses vector-quantized hemodynamic representations from dynamic MRI time-intensity curves for non-invasive glioma molecular subtyping, capturing IDH mutation and 1p/19q codeletion status without invasive tissue sampling.

entry.title: AsyncEvGS: Asynchronous Event-Assisted Gaussian Splatting for Handheld Motion-Blurred Scenes

author.name: Jun Dai, Renbiao Jin, Bo Xu, Yutian Chen, Linning Xu, Mulin Yu, Tianfan Xue, Shi Guo

entry.summary: AsyncEvGS combines event cameras with RGB cameras in an asynchronous, high-resolution setup for 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction from motion-blurred handheld captures. It uses event data for sharp image reconstruction and cross-domain pose estimation for robust initialization.

entry.title: Improved Model-based Reinforcement Learning with Smooth Kernels

author.name: Kun Long, Yuqiang Li and Xianyi Wu

entry.summary: Proposes an improved kernel-smoothing model-based RL approach for continuous state-action spaces with a Bernstein-style exploration bonus, achieving better regret bounds than prior work under Lipschitz continuity assumptions.

entry.title: bispectrum: Selective $G$-Bispectra Made Practical

author.name: Johan Mathe, Adele Myers, Simon Mataigne, Nina Miolane

entry.summary: Presents an open-source PyTorch library implementing selective G-bispectra for seven different group actions as differentiable modules, making principled complete invariant features practical for machine learning applications.

entry.title: On the Complexity of the Matching Problem of Regular Expressions with Backreferences

author.name: Soh Kumabe and Yuya Uezato

entry.summary: Provides complexity analysis for matching regular expressions with backreferences, showing conditional impossibility of near-linear time algorithms and establishing tight complexity bounds related to ReDoS attacks.

entry.title: Amortized-Precision Quantization for Early-Exit Vision Transformers

author.name: Rui Fang, Hsi-Wen Chen, Ming-Syan Chen

entry.summary: Introduces Amortized-Precision Quantization (APQ) for Vision Transformers with early exit, accounting for layer-wise stochastic exposure to quantization noise. MAQEE jointly optimizes exit thresholds and bit-widths under explicit risk control for stable inference.

entry.title: SoLAR: Error-Resilient Streamable Long-Horizon Free-Viewpoint Video Reconstruction with Anchor Activation and Latent Recalibration

author.name: Haotian Zhang, Xu Mo, Yixin Yu, Guanhua Zhu, Jian Xue, Tongda Xu, Yan Wang, Jiaqi Zhang, Siwei Ma, and Wen Gao

entry.summary: Proposes SoLAR, the first error-resilient streamable free-viewpoint video framework for long sequences. Uses anchor activation dynamics and asynchronous state reconciliation to maintain quality without group-of-pictures partitioning.

entry.title: Convex Optimization with Nested Evolving Feasible Sets

author.name: Karthick Krishna M., Haricharan Balasundaram, and Rahul Vaze

entry.summary: Studies convex optimization with nested evolving feasible sets (CONES), achieving simultaneous regret and movement cost guarantees. Generalizes the nested convex body chasing problem with optimization objectives.

entry.title: EditTransfer++: Toward Faithful and Efficient Visual-Prompt-Guided Image Editing

author.name: Lan Chen, Qi Mao, Yiren Song, Yuchao Gu, Siwei Ma

entry.summary: Proposes EditTransfer++ for visual-prompt-guided image editing that combines progressively structured training with text-decoupled conditioning to improve faithfulness to visual editing prompts over existing diffusion transformer methods.

entry.title: Implicit Multi-Camera System Calibration Using Gaussian Processes

author.name: Ivan De Boi, Bart Ribbens, Veronika Golanova, Ursula Kapov, Simon Verspeek

entry.summary: Proposes Gaussian Process regression for implicit multi-camera calibration that directly maps 2D image coordinates to 3D world coordinates, bypassing explicit intrinsic/extrinsic parameter estimation while providing inherent uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: GESR: Graph-Based Edge Semantic Reconstruction for Stealthy Communication Detection with Benign-Only Training

author.name: Henghui Xu, Yuchen Zhang, Xiaobo Ma

entry.summary: GESR proposes graph-based detection of stealthy malicious communications by testing structural consistency of communication edges, operating under benign-only training conditions without requiring labeled attack data.

entry.title: VIMCAN: Visual-Inertial 3D Human Pose Estimation with Hybrid Mamba-Cross-Attention Network

author.name: Zepeng Yang, Junxuan Bai, Hao Li, Ju Dai, Junjun Pan, Yongfeng Yin, Bin Li

entry.summary: VIMCAN combines Mamba's efficient sequence modeling with Cross-Attention for visual-inertial 3D human pose estimation, addressing Transformer quadratic complexity for long sequences while maintaining spatial reasoning capability for multimodal fusion.

entry.title: BrickCraft: Visuomotor Skill Composition with Situated Manual Guidance for Long-Horizon Interlocking Brick Assembly

author.name: Jichuan Yu, Bowei Li, Zhenran Tang, Guanxing Lu, Chuxiong Hu, Ruixuan Liu, Changliu Liu

entry.summary: BrickCraft presents a compositional framework for long-horizon robotic interlocking brick assembly using relative formulations and situated manuals for spatial guidance. It decomposes complex assembly into reusable primitive skills bridging high-level plans and physical execution.

entry.title: Is She Even Relevant? When BERT Ignores Explicit Gender Cues

author.name: Jonas Klein, Chiara Manna, Eva Vanmassenhove

entry.summary: Investigates when gender information emerges during training of a Dutch BERT model, finding that the model sometimes ignores explicit gender cues. One of the first checkpoint-level analyses of bias formation for a language with morphological gender.

entry.title: Operating Within the Operational Design Domain: Zero-Shot Perception with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Berkehan \"Unal, Dierend Hauke, Fazlija Dren and Plachetka Christopher

entry.summary: Explores using vision-language models for zero-shot perception of Operational Design Domain elements in autonomous driving, evaluating their potential for safety-compliant perception without task-specific training.

entry.title: PhySPRING: Structure-Preserving Reduction of Physics-Informed Twins via GNN

author.name: Yixiong Jing and Xingyuan Chen and Guangming Wang and Olaf Wysocki and Haibing Wu and Brian Sheil

entry.summary: PhySPRING uses GNNs to reduce complexity in spring-mass digital twins by learning coarsened graph topologies and mechanical parameters, making forward dynamics rollouts more efficient for robotics applications.

entry.title: Online Goal Recognition using Path Signature and Dynamic Time Warping

author.name: Douglas Tesch, Nathan Gavenski, Leonardo Amado, Odinaldo Rodrigues, Felipe Meneguzzi

entry.summary: Introduces path signatures for online goal recognition in continuous domains, providing compact trajectory representations that outperform state-of-the-art in predictive accuracy and computational efficiency.

entry.title: Alternating Target-Path Planning for Scalable Multi-Agent Coordination

author.name: Yu Kumagai, Keisuke Okumura

entry.summary: Proposes an iterative refinement framework for concurrent target assignment and pathfinding that decouples assignment from pathfinding, leveraging modern fast MAPF solvers like LaCAM with feedback-driven reassignment.

entry.title: GRASP -- Graph-Based Anomaly Detection Through Self-Supervised Classification

author.name: Robin Buchta, Carsten Kleiner, Felix Heine, Gabi Dreo Rodosek

entry.summary: Introduces GRASP, a provenance-based intrusion detection system using masked self-supervised classification to detect APT attacks by learning to infer process executables from system activity graphs.

entry.title: BRIDGE: Background Routing and Isolated Discrete Gating for Coarse-Mask Local Editing

author.name: Peilin Xiong, Honghui Yuan, Junwen Chen, and Keiji Yanai

entry.summary: Proposes BRIDGE for coarse-mask local image editing, addressing mask-shape bias where rough masks become unintended shape priors. Keeps masks outside the DiT backbone and uses BridgePath generation for background preservation.

entry.title: EyeCue: Driver Cognitive Distraction Detection via Gaze-Empowered Egocentric Video Understanding

author.name: Lang Zhang, JinYi Yoon, Matthew Corbett, Abhijit Sarkar, and Bo Ji

entry.summary: Proposes EyeCue, a gaze-empowered framework for detecting driver cognitive distraction from egocentric video. Introduces CogDrive dataset and shows that gaze-visual context interaction captures cognitive distraction invisible to standard behavioral approaches.

entry.title: Adaptive Regularization for Sparsity Control in Bregman-Based Optimizers

author.name: Ahmad Aloradi, Tim Roith, Emanu\"el A. P. Habets, Daniel Tenbrinck

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive regularization scheme for Bregman-based optimizers that automatically adjusts the regularization parameter to achieve a user-specified sparsity target, eliminating expensive hyperparameter sweeps.

entry.title: Aggregation in conformal e-classification

author.name: Vladimir Vovk

entry.summary: Studies cross-conformal e-prediction experimentally as a method for aggregating conformal e-predictors, exploring modifications that are conceptually simpler and more flexible while retaining validity.

entry.title: Graph-Structured Hyperdimensional Computing for Data-Efficient and Explainable Process-Structure-Property Prediction

author.name: Jingzhan Ge, Ajeeth Vellore, Ajinkya Palwe, Ahsan Khan, David Gorsich, Matthew P. Castanier, SeungYeon Kang, and Farhad Imani

entry.summary: PSP-HDC applies graph-structured hyperdimensional computing to process-structure-property prediction in micro-fabrication, encoding directed PSP graphs as internal priors for data-efficient and interpretable prediction.

entry.title: A Note on Non-Negative $L_1$-Approximating Polynomials

author.name: Jane H. Lee, Anay Mehrotra, Manolis Zampetakis

entry.summary: Proves existence of non-negative L1-approximating polynomials with respect to Gaussian distributions for classes with bounded Gaussian surface area, with degree scaling as O(Γ²/ε²).

entry.title: Statistical Convergence of Spherical First Hitting Diffusion Models

author.name: Simon Bienewald and Lukas Trottner

entry.summary: Provides theoretical statistical convergence analysis for spherical first hitting diffusion models (FHDM), a class of denoising diffusion models with random adaptive generation time for data on known manifolds. Builds on Doob's h-transform framework.

entry.title: Intention assimilation control for accurate tracking with variable impedance in teleoperation

author.name: Atsushi Takagi, Yanan Li, Hiroaki Gomi, Etienne Burdet

entry.summary: Proposes intention assimilation control (IAC) for teleoperation that estimates and transmits the leader's target position rather than current position, enabling tracking accuracy without high stiffness.

entry.title: Latent Order Bandits

author.name: Emil Carlsson, Newton Mwai, Fredrik D. Johansson

entry.summary: Proposes Latent Order Bandits (LOB) that relax latent bandit assumptions to require only prior knowledge of partial action preference orderings per state, allowing instances within the same state to vary in reward distributions.

entry.title: Tacit Knowledge Extraction via Logic Augmented Generation and Active Inference

author.name: Lorenzo Lamazzi, Aldo Gangemi, Alessio Giberti, Andrea Giovanni Nuzzolese, Vittorio Andrea Rocca, Mattia Torta, Francesco Poggi

entry.summary: Introduces a neuro-symbolic framework combining Logic-Augmented Generation with Active Inference for extracting tacit knowledge from procedural domains and formalizing it into machine-interpretable representations.

entry.title: HIVE-COTE 2.0: a new meta ensemble for time series classification

author.name: Matthew Middlehurst, James Large, Michael Flynn, Jason Lines, Aaron Bostrom and Anthony Bagnall

entry.summary: Proposes HIVE-COTE 2.0, a significantly upgraded meta-ensemble for time series classification that improves accuracy and usability over the original state-of-the-art algorithm from 2016. The changes include comprehensive updates to the ensemble components and evaluation on the UCR archive.

entry.title: LLM-Based SQL Generation: Prompting, Self-Refinement, and Adaptive Weighted Majority Voting

author.name: Yu-Jie Yang, Hung-Fu Chang, Po-An Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SSEV, a pipeline for LLM-based text-to-SQL generation combining self-refinement with weighted majority voting. Achieves competitive results on benchmarks without requiring ground-truth data for refinement.

entry.title: Information-theoretic Limits of Learning and Estimation

author.name: Abbas El Gamal and Maxim Raginsky

entry.summary: Provides a textbook chapter introducing information-theoretic fundamental limits on learning and estimation, covering concentration inequalities, metric entropy, Rademacher complexity, VC dimension, and minimax risk.

entry.title: A Closed-Form Upper Bound for Admissible Learning-Rate Steps in Belief-Space Dynamics

author.name: Zixi Li, Youzhen Li

entry.summary: Derives a closed-form upper bound for admissible learning-rate steps by modeling updates as projected steps on the probability simplex with contractivity in KL/Bregman geometry.

entry.title: Overcoming data scarcity through multi-center federated learning for organs-at-risk segmentation in pediatric upper abdominal radiotherapy

author.name: Mianyong Ding, Maximilian Knoll, Semi Harrabi, Martine van Grotel, Annemieke S. Littooij, Max van Noesel, Jens-Peter Schenk, Marry M. van den Heuvel-Eibrink, Geert O. Janssens, Matteo Maspero

entry.summary: Evaluates federated learning for pediatric organ-at-risk segmentation across two European medical centers, addressing data scarcity in pediatric radiotherapy. Uses nnU-Net framework to segment 19 organs from CT images.

entry.title: Accelerated Relax-and-Round for Concave Coverage Problems

author.name: Matthew Fahrbach, Mehraneh Liaee, Morteza Zadimoghaddam

entry.summary: Presents an accelerated relax-and-round algorithm for concave coverage problems with improved running time using projected accelerated gradient methods and specialized hypersimplex rounding.

entry.title: Streaming Adversarial Robustness in Fuzzy ARTMAP: Mechanism-Aligned Evaluation, Progressive Training, and Interpretable Diagnostics

author.name: Shane Cairns, Leonardo Enzo Brito da Silva, Sasha Petrenko, Donald C. Wunsch II, Jian Liu

entry.summary: Studies adversarial robustness of Fuzzy ARTMAP, a streaming single-pass neural learner. Introduces WB-Softmax attack and finds defense rankings can reverse across evaluation protocols.

entry.title: You Only Stack Once (YOSO): A Motion-Filtered, Deep-Learning Framework for Detecting Faint Moving Sources

author.name: Nitya Pandey, C\'esar Fuentes, Pedro Bernardinelli, Valeria Fr\'ias, Colin Orion Chandler, David E. Trilling, Matthew J. Holman, Steven Stetzler, Dallin Spencer, Hsing Wen Lin, Luis E. Salazar Manzano, Darin Ragozzine, Ryder Strauss, Mario Juri\'c, Andrew J. Connolly, Hayden Smotherman, Scott S. Sheppard, and Kevin Napier

entry.summary: Presents YOSO, a pipeline for detecting faint Solar System objects using a Gaussian Motion Filter that operates at pixel level. Discovers 216 near-Solar System objects and 11 new TNOs.

entry.title: A Reproducible Optimisation Protocol for Calibrating Prompt-Based Large Language Model Workflows in Evidence Synthesis

author.name: Teo Susnjak

entry.summary: Presents a reproducible calibration workflow for prompt-based LLMs in evidence synthesis tasks, separating scientific task rules from the prompt harness that applies them. Uses DSPy and GEPA tools with title/abstract screening as validation case.

entry.title: Decentralized Time-Varying Optimization for Streaming Data via Temporal Weighting

author.name: Muhammad Faraz Ul Abrar, Nicol\`o Michelusi, and Erik G. Larsson

entry.summary: Studies decentralized optimization with streaming data over distributed networks, adopting a temporally weighted objective formulation and analyzing decentralized gradient descent with limited communication budgets.

entry.title: AirBender: Adaptive Transportation of Bendable Objects Using Dual UAVs

author.name: Jiawei Xu, Longsen Gao, Rafael Fierro, David Salda\~na

entry.summary: Presents an adaptive controller for dual UAVs collaboratively transporting bendable objects without explicit elasticity models, with Lyapunov stability proofs and hardware validation.

entry.title: Beyond the Wrapper: Identifying Artifact Reliance in Static Malware Classifiers using TRUSTEE

author.name: Riyazuddin Mohammed, Lan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a framework using TRUSTEE explainability tool to identify when static malware classifiers learn packing artifacts rather than true malicious behavior, conducting controlled experiments on dataset composition.

entry.title: SAGE: Hierarchical LLM-Based Literary Evaluation through Ontology-Grounded Interpretive Dimensions

author.name: Tianyu Wang and Nianjun Zhou

entry.summary: SAGE is a hierarchical framework for evaluating literary quality using LLMs, decomposing assessment into cultural, emotional-psychological, and existential-philosophical dimensions with multi-round iterative reflection. Tested on canonical works, pulp fiction, and LLM-generated narratives.

entry.title: UniV2D: Bridging Visual Restoration and Semantic Perception for Underwater Salient Object Detection

author.name: Laibin Chang, Shaodong Wang, Yunke Wang, Xu Zhang, Kui Jiang, Chang Xu, and Bo Du

entry.summary: UniV2D jointly optimizes visual restoration and salient object detection for underwater images, breaking the sequential 'enhance-then-detect' paradigm that can introduce task-irrelevant noise.

entry.title: DPG-CD: Depth-Prior-Guided Cross-Modal Joint 2D-3D Change Detection

author.name: Luqi Zhang, Zhen Dong, Bisheng Yang

entry.summary: DPG-CD addresses joint 2D-3D change detection using cross-modal inputs (pre-event DSM and post-event imagery), designed for practical scenarios where 3D data collection is too expensive for frequent updates.

entry.title: PicoEyes: Unified Gaze Estimation Framework for Mixed Reality with a Large-Scale Multi-View Dataset

author.name: Fuxin Duan and Hui Wang

entry.summary: PicoEyes presents a unified gaze estimation framework for mixed reality that predicts all key gaze attributes (3D eye parameters, segmentation, optical/visual axes, depth maps) from monocular or binocular inputs end-to-end. It also introduces a large-scale multi-view near-eye dataset with comprehensive annotations.

entry.title: HARMONY: Bridging the Personalization-Generalization Gap by Mitigating Representation Skew in Heterogeneous Split Federated Learning

author.name: Jiseok Youn, You Rim Choi, Goodsol Lee, Sangtae Ha, Hyung-Sin Kim, Saewoong Bahk

entry.summary: HARMONY addresses the representation skew problem in heterogeneous split federated learning where different client architectures produce misaligned features in shared space, degrading server-side out-of-distribution prediction.

entry.title: MIPIAD: Multilingual Indirect Prompt Injection Attack Defense with Qwen -- TF-IDF Hybrid and Meta-Ensemble Learning

author.name: Al Muhit Muhtadi and Mostafa Rifat Tazwar

entry.summary: MIPIAD presents a defense framework against multilingual indirect prompt injection attacks combining a Qwen2.5 sequence classifier with TF-IDF features and meta-ensemble learning, evaluated on English and Bangla.

entry.title: Palm-sized Omnidirectional Vision-Based UAV Exploration with Sparse Topological Map Guidance

author.name: Zirui Wang, Xinjia Luo, Haotian Sun, Jun Ma, Jian Guo, Boyu Zhou

entry.summary: Presents a lightweight autonomous UAV exploration system using omnidirectional vision from multi-fisheye cameras and sparse topological maps, designed for palm-sized drones with strict size/weight/power constraints.

entry.title: UniD-Shift: Towards Unified Semantic Segmentation via Interpretable Share-Private Multimodal Decomposition

author.name: Shuai Zhang, Zhecheng Shi, Zhuxiao Li, Jing Ou, Tengxi Wang, Yuan Liu, Wufan Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes UniD-Shift for unified 2D-3D semantic segmentation using shared/private multimodal feature decomposition with SAM-based vision encoder and SPTNet-based geometric encoder.

entry.title: UniISP: A Unified ISP Framework for Both Human and Machine Vision

author.name: Hanxi Li, Yao Cheng, Bo Zhang, Li Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes UniISP, an image signal processing framework that simultaneously produces images optimized for both human viewing and machine vision tasks, addressing the trade-off between visual quality and recognition accuracy from raw sensor data.

entry.title: Have Graph -- Will Lift? The Case for Higher-Order Benchmarks

author.name: Bastian Rieck

entry.summary: Opinion paper arguing that topological deep learning needs native higher-order benchmark datasets rather than just lifting existing graph datasets. Calls for community effort to source new datasets for the field.

entry.title: Tracking Large-scale Shared Bikes with Inertial Motion Learning in GNSS Blocked Environments

author.name: Feng Liu (1), Kejia Li (1), Zhiwei Yang (2), Chunwei Yang (2), Qun Li (2), Guobin Wu (2), Qiang Ni (3), Ruipeng Gao (1) ((1) Beijing Jiaotong University, (2) DiDi Company, (3) Lancaster University)

entry.summary: Proposes an inertial tracking framework for shared bikes combining bicycle mechanical constraints with mixture-of-experts models for GNSS-blocked environments like urban canyons. Deployed at scale with DiDi.

entry.title: Risk-Consistent Multiclass Learning from Random Label-Subset Membership Queries

author.name: Jiaxu Su, Junpeng Li, Changchun Hua, Yana Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a multiclass learning framework for random label-subset membership queries, a weak supervision setting where annotators answer whether labels belong to subsets rather than providing exact labels.

entry.title: Effective and Memory-Efficient Alternatives to ECC for Reliable Large-Scale DNNs

author.name: Mohammad Hasan Ahmadilivani, Marten Roots, Marco Restifo, Sven-Markus Loorits, Luca Di Mauro, Jaan Raik

entry.summary: Proposes two lightweight alternatives to Error Correction Codes for protecting DNN parameters in memory: MSET (selective bit hardening) and CEP (fine-grained protection). Both achieve superior reliability with less memory overhead.

entry.title: A Flexible Adaptive Stable Clustering Algorithm for Archive-Scale Online Mass Spectrometry

author.name: Shao Shi, Xin Yang, Huiran Feng, Jianhuai Ye, Tianlong Hu, Yaling Zeng, Tzung-May Fu, Lei Zhu, Huizhong Shen, Chen Wang, Shu Tao

entry.summary: Introduces FASC, a flexible adaptive stable clustering algorithm for multi-terabyte online mass spectrometry data. Uses dynamical systems framework with density-augmented similarity selection for deterministic, order-independent convergence.

entry.title: GRaSp: Automatic Example Optimization for In-Context Learning in Low-Data Tasks

author.name: Simen Bihaug-Fr{\o}yland and Henrik Br{\aa}dland

entry.summary: Proposes GRaSp, a three-stage framework for in-context example optimization using synthetic generation, clustering, and genetic algorithms. Shows improvements on NER with diversity-adaptive mutation.

entry.title: Learning Minimal-Deviation Corrections for Multi-Dimensional Mismodelling in HEP Simulations

author.name: Matthias Schott, Lucie Flek

entry.summary: Proposes a neural network method to correct mismodelling in high-energy physics Monte Carlo simulations by learning transformations that match 1D target distributions while preserving multi-dimensional correlation structure. The minimal-deviation principle ensures corrections stay close to the original simulation.

entry.title: Transfer Learning Across Fast- and Full-Simulation Domains in High-Energy Physics

author.name: Matthias Schott, Lucie Flek

entry.summary: Systematically studies transfer learning between fast-simulated and fully-simulated datasets in LHC physics across three tasks and architectures. Shows pretrained models on fast simulation consistently outperform independently trained models on full simulation with limited data.

entry.title: WeatherSyn: An Instruction Tuning MLLM For Weather Forecasting Report Generation

author.name: Zinan Zheng and Yang Liu and Nuo Chen and Juepeng Zheng and Hong Cheng and Jia Li

entry.summary: WeatherSyn proposes an instruction-tuned multimodal LLM for weather forecast report generation, with a new dataset covering 31 cities and 8 weather aspects. First model specialized in generating weather forecast reports from multi-source data.

entry.title: FS-I2P:A Hierarchical Focus-Sweep Registration Network with Dynamically Allocated Depth

author.name: Zhixin Cheng, Yujia Chen, Xujing Tao, Bohao Liao, Xiaotian Yin, Baoqun Yin, Tianzhu Zhang

entry.summary: FS-I2P proposes a Focus-Sweep paradigm for image-to-point cloud registration within an SSM-based framework, addressing attention drift and scale ambiguity issues. It introduces dynamic layer allocation for adaptive iteration depth.

entry.title: Multi-Dimensional Evaluation of LLMs for Grammatical Error Correction

author.name: Adnan Labib, Qiao Wang, Yixuan Huang and Zheng Yuan

entry.summary: Evaluates latest-generation LLMs on grammatical error correction across multiple dimensions (precision, fluency, meaning retention), finding fine-tuned GPT-4o achieves SOTA. Shows LLMs have similar error correction profiles, suggesting ensembles may not help.

entry.title: LithoBench: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models for Remote-Sensing Lithology Interpretation

author.name: Jun Wang and Fengpeng Li and Hang Dong and Tianjin Huang and Wei Han

entry.summary: LithoBench is a multi-level benchmark for evaluating large multimodal models on remote-sensing lithology interpretation, requiring geological knowledge for rock type inference from visual, spectral, and geomorphological cues.

entry.title: Learning Large-Scale Modular Addition with an Auxiliary Modulus

author.name: Hanato Kikuchi, Ryosuke Masuya, Kazuhiko Kawamoto, Hiroshi Kera

entry.summary: Proposes using an auxiliary modulus to enable covariate-shift-free learning of large-scale modular addition, theoretically analyzing and empirically validating the approach as an alternative to zero-padding methods.

entry.title: Aquatic Neuromorphic Optical Flow

author.name: Pei Zhang and Yunkai Liang and Kaiqiang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces a self-supervised framework using spiking neural networks to estimate optical flow from event camera streams in underwater environments, addressing data scarcity through neuromorphic vision.

entry.title: TRACE: Tourism Recommendation with Accountable Citation Evidence

author.name: Zixu Zhao, Sijin Wang, Yu Hou, Yuanyuan Xu, Yufan Sheng, Xike Xie, Wenjie Zhang, Won-Yong Shin, Xin Cao

entry.summary: TRACE introduces a tourism recommendation benchmark coupling multi-turn recommendations with verbatim review-span evidence and rejection recovery, addressing the need for trustworthy and verifiable conversational recommendations.

entry.title: OphEdit: Training-Free Text-Guided Editing of Ophthalmic Surgical Videos

author.name: Ritul Jangir, Arkya Jyoti Bagchi, Aiman Farooq, Mangalton Okram, Saurabh Seetaram Korgaonkar, and Deepak Mishra

entry.summary: OphEdit proposes a training-free framework for text-guided editing of ophthalmic surgical videos using ODE inversion and selective attention value tensor injection to preserve anatomical structure while enabling edits.

entry.title: CommandSwarm: Safety-Aware Natural Language-to-Behavior-Tree Generation for Robotic Swarms

author.name: Mohammed Majid and Amjad Yousef Majid

entry.summary: CommandSwarm presents a safety-aware pipeline for generating XML behavior trees from natural language commands for robotic swarms, combining safety filtering, constrained prompting, and LoRA-adapted LLMs.

entry.title: Interactive Trajectory Planning with Learning-based Distributionally Robust Model Predictive Control and Markov Systems

author.name: Erik B\"orve, Nikolce Murgovski, Morteza Haghir Chehreghani, and Leo Laine

entry.summary: Investigates interactive trajectory planning under uncertainty using PAC learning combined with distributionally robust MPC optimization. The framework interpolates between robust MPC and omnipotent stochastic MPC based on available samples.

entry.title: Pre-training Enables Extraordinary All-optical Image Denoising

author.name: Xudong Lv, Yuxiang Sun, Shuo Wang, Nanxing Chen, Jun Guan, Jingtian Hu

entry.summary: Reports a pre-training approach for optical neural networks (diffractive networks) that substantially improves all-optical image denoising. Uses two-step training: pre-training on 3.45M diverse images followed by task-specific fine-tuning.

entry.title: Many-to-Many Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery

author.name: Ethan Schneider, Jingkai Chen, Tianyi Gu, Kunlei Lian, Seth Hutchinson, Sonia Chernova

entry.summary: Proposes M2M algorithm for many-to-many Multi-Agent Pickup and Delivery in warehouses where items can be at multiple locations, solving the resulting NP-hard four-dimensional assignment problem.

entry.title: Physics-Constrained Denoising Autoencoders for Data-Scarce Wildfire UAV Sensing

author.name: Abdelrahman Ramadan, Zahra Dorbeigi Namaghi, Emily Taylor, Lucas Edwards, Xan Giuliani, David S. McLagan, Sidney Givigi, Melissa Greeff

entry.summary: Presents PC²DAE, a physics-informed denoising autoencoder for wildfire UAV sensing that embeds physical constraints (non-negative concentrations, temporal smoothing) directly into the architecture to address data scarcity.

entry.title: Exploring the non-convexity in machine learning using quantum-inspired optimization

author.name: Kandula Eswara Sai Kumar, Parth Dhananjay Danve, Abhishek Chopra, Rut Lineswala

entry.summary: Proposes a quantum-inspired evolutionary optimization (QIEO) framework for non-convex optimization in machine learning, using probabilistic representations to maintain a global view of the search space and tunnel through local optima.

entry.title: 6D Pose Estimation via Keypoint Heatmap Regression with RGB-D Residual Neural Networks

author.name: Ismail Aljosevic, Amir Masoud Almasi, Ana Parovic, Ashkan Shafiei

entry.summary: Proposes a modular 6D pose estimation framework combining YOLOv10m detection with ResNet18 keypoint heatmap regression, including a cross-fusion architecture for RGB-D data.

entry.title: EmambaIR: Efficient Visual State Space Model for Event-guided Image Reconstruction

author.name: Wei Yu and Yunhang Qian

entry.summary: Proposes EmambaIR, a state space model for event-guided image reconstruction that addresses CNN's limited global modeling and ViT's quadratic complexity. Introduces a cross-modal Top-k Sparse Attention Module and Gated State-Space Module for efficiently processing event streams.

entry.title: Expectation-Maximization as a Spectrally Governed Relaxation Flow

author.name: Qiao Wang

entry.summary: Provides a unified dynamical analysis of the EM algorithm by making explicit the latent-variable operator connecting global monotonicity and local linear convergence. Shows the likelihood increment admits a global energy decomposition in terms of posterior-relative entropy.

entry.title: High-Fidelity Surface Splatting-Based 3D Reconstruction from Multi-View Images

author.name: Nandhana Sunil and Abhirami R Iyer and Avirup Mandal

entry.summary: Proposes improved multi-view mesh reconstruction using a compact polynomial kernel for Implicit Moving Least Squares (IMLS) that offers better control over frequency content than exponential kernels, enabling better high-frequency geometry recovery.

entry.title: LAMES: A Large-Scale and Artisanal Mining Environmental Segmentation Dataset

author.name: Matthias Kahl, Zhaiyu Chen, Sudipan Saha, Mrinalini Kochupillai, Lukas Kondmann, Xiao Xiang Zhu

entry.summary: LAMES introduces a segmentation dataset for monitoring artisanal and large-scale mining operations and their environmental impacts from satellite imagery, addressing illegal mining detection.

entry.title: Benchmarking Foundation Models for Renal Lesion Stratification in CT

author.name: Hartmut H\"antze, Sarah de Boer, Myrthe Buser, Alessa Hering, Bram van Ginneken, Mathias Prokop, Jawed Nawabi, Sebastian Ziegelmayer, Lisa Adams, Keno Bressem

entry.summary: Benchmarks three medical foundation models against radiomics and ResNet for CT-based renal lesion classification using frozen feature probing, finding mixed results for FM transfer.

entry.title: Inferring Asteroseismic Parameters from Short Observations Using Deep Learning: Application to TESS and K2 Red Giants

author.name: Nipun Ghanghas, Siddharth Dhanpal, Shravan Hanasoge, Praneeth Netrapalli, Karthikeyan Shanmugam

entry.summary: Develops a deep learning method to infer asteroseismic parameters (ν_max and Δν) from short-duration TESS and K2 observations of red giant stars. Addresses the need for fast, scalable analysis of 300,000+ oscillating red giants observed by TESS.

entry.title: CogEvolution: A Human-like Generative Educational Agent to Simulate Student's Cognitive Evolution

author.name: Wei Zhang, Yihang Cheng, Zhirong Ye, Kezhen Huang

entry.summary: Proposes CogEvolution, an educational agent that simulates student cognitive evolution by modeling dynamic knowledge internalization, transfer, and cognitive state transitions rather than using static personas.

entry.title: Edge Deep Learning in Computer Vision and Medical Diagnostics: A Comprehensive Survey

author.name: Yiwen Xu, Tariq M. Khan, Yang Song, Erik Meijering

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of edge deep learning for computer vision and medical diagnostics, including novel categorization of edge hardware platforms and analysis of model optimization techniques for deployment.

entry.title: Medical Imaging Classification with Cold-Atom Reservoir Computing using Auto-Encoders and Surrogate-Driven Training

author.name: Nuno Batista, Ana Morgado, Oscar Ferraz, Sagar Silva Pratapsi, Jorge Lobo, Gabriel Falcao

entry.summary: Introduces a hybrid quantum-classical pipeline using neutral-atom reservoir computing for medical image classification. Uses a differentiable surrogate model to overcome the gradient barrier of quantum measurements.

entry.title: FastOmniTMAE: Parallel Clause Learning for Scalable and Hardware-Efficient Tsetlin Embeddings

author.name: Ahmed K. Kadhim, Lei Jiao, Rishad Shafik, Ole-Christoffer Granmo, Mayur Kishor Shende

entry.summary: Proposes FastOmniTMAE, a reformulation of Tsetlin Machine autoencoders that replaces sequential training with parallel evaluation and update stages, achieving up to 5x faster training while maintaining embedding quality.

entry.title: NSMQ Riddles: A Benchmark of Scientific and Mathematical Riddles for Quizzing Large Language Models

author.name: George Boateng, Naafi Ibrahim, Samuel John, Philemon Badu, Patrick Agyeman-Budu, Jonathan Mensah, Kevin Yeboah, William Edor, Andrew Mensa-Onumah, Nana Yeboah and Victor Wumbor-Apin Kumbol

entry.summary: Presents NSMQ Riddles, a benchmark of scientific and mathematical riddles from Ghana's National Science and Maths Quiz for evaluating LLMs, addressing underrepresentation of Global South educational datasets.

entry.title: Direct-to-Event Spiking Neural Network Transfer

author.name: Nhan Trong Luu, Duong Trung Luu, Pham Ngoc Nam and Truong Cong Thang

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic investigation of converting SNNs pretrained with direct coding into event-based representations, addressing the gap between training efficiency and deployment energy efficiency on neuromorphic hardware.

entry.title: PersonaGest: Personalized Co-Speech Gesture Generation with Semantic-Guided Hierarchical Motion Representation

author.name: Junchuan Zhao, Qifan Liang, Ye Wang

entry.summary: PersonaGest presents a two-stage framework for personalized co-speech gesture generation using semantic-guided RVQ-VAE that disentangles motion content from gestural style within the residual quantization structure.

entry.title: DCGL: Dual-Channel Graph Learning with Large Language Models for Knowledge-Aware Recommendation

author.name: Xinchi Zou, Tongzhenzhi Su, Jianjun Li, Yuan Fu, Chang Liu, Zhiying Deng, and Zhiwei Shen

entry.summary: Proposes DCGL, a dual-channel graph learning framework combining knowledge graphs and LLM embeddings for recommendation systems. It addresses semantic relationship modeling, signal interference from single-channel fusion, and interaction frequency variations. Incremental but solid work in KG-enhanced recommendations.

entry.title: InsHuman: Towards Natural and Identity-Preserving Human Insertion

author.name: Jie Li and Shulian Zhang and Yangyang Gao and Wenbo Li and Yulun Zhang and Yong Guo and Jian Chen

entry.summary: Proposes InsHuman for natural identity-preserving human insertion into scenes, with Human-Background Adaptive Fusion that uses binary masking and region-aware weighting to maintain pose, identity, and count consistency.

entry.title: Inference of Qualitative Models from Steady-State Data via Weighted MaxSMT

author.name: Ond\v{r}ej Huvar, Nikola Bene\v{s}, Martin Jon\'a\v{s}, David \v{S}afr\'anek, Samuel Pastva

entry.summary: Introduces a robust inference method for qualitative biological models using weighted MaxSMT, encoding uncertain observations as weighted soft constraints to handle measurement errors gracefully.

entry.title: Lightweight Unpaired Smartphone ISP Transfer with Semantic Pseudo-Pairing

author.name: Yujin Cho, Flavien Armangeon, Yanhao Li

entry.summary: Presents a lightweight approach for unpaired smartphone ISP using semantic pseudo-pairing via DINOv2 embeddings and Fused Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport to build pseudo pairs between RAW and RGB images. Developed for NTIRE 2026 challenge.

entry.title: Multimodal Stepwise Clinically-Guided Attention Learning for Pathological Complete Response Prediction in Breast Cancer

author.name: Alice Natalina Caragliano, Valerio Guarrasi, Michela Gravina, Carlo Sansone and Paolo Soda

entry.summary: Proposes multimodal stepwise clinically-guided attention learning for predicting pathological complete response in breast cancer from MRI, using a training strategy inspired by physician reasoning that progressively focuses attention.

entry.title: Parallel Lifted Planning via Semi-Naive Datalog Evaluation

author.name: Dominik Drexler and Oliver Joergensen and Jendrik Seipp

entry.summary: Develops parallel lifted planning via semi-naive Datalog evaluation with two levels of parallelism (rule-level and grounding), extending existing Datalog-based planning with a grounder based on clique enumeration.

entry.title: Robust stochastic first order methods in heavy-tailed noise via medoid mini-batch gradient sampling

author.name: Manojlo Vukovic, Dusan Jakovetic

entry.summary: Proposes R-SGD-Mini, a robust stochastic gradient descent method using medoid mini-batch gradient sampling for heavy-tailed noise settings where gradient variance may be infinite. An alternative to gradient clipping approaches.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Reduced-Order Operator Learning for Hyperelasticity in Continuum Micromechanics

author.name: Hamidreza Eivazi, Henning Wessels

entry.summary: Combines the Equilibrium Neural Operator with QR-based discrete empirical interpolation for physics-informed operator learning in hyperelastic micromechanics, reducing computational cost of loss evaluation.

entry.title: Offline-Online Hierarchical 3D Global Relocalization With Synthetic LiDAR Sensing and Descriptor-Space Retrieval

author.name: Jiahua Ren, Kai Shen, Muhua Zhang, and Lei Ma

entry.summary: Proposes an offline-online hierarchical framework for 3D global relocalization using synthetic LiDAR sensing and descriptor-space retrieval, decoupling the search space for faster online performance.

entry.title: Robust and Reliable AI for Predictive Quality in Semiconductor Materials Manufacturing with MLOps and Uncertainty Quantification

author.name: Min Gao, Julia Maria Perathoner, Anton Ludwig Bonin, Steven Eulig and Gianni Klesse

entry.summary: Benchmarks MLOps retraining strategies for semiconductor manufacturing quality prediction using 5 years of real data, finding fixed retraining every 5 batches without hyperparameter retuning is optimal.

entry.title: Head Similarity: Modeling Structured Whole-Head Appearance Beyond Face Recognition

author.name: Yingfeng Wang, Yuxuan Xiao, Shengcai Liao

entry.summary: Introduces 'Head Similarity,' a formulation extending face recognition to structured whole-head appearance modeling that captures intra-identity variation (hairstyle, styling) and works under occlusion or rear-view conditions. This addresses a practical gap where conventional face recognition collapses appearance variations.

entry.title: Enhancing Federated Quadruplet Learning: Stochastic Client Selection and Embedding Stability Analysis

author.name: Ozgu Goksu and Nicolas Pugeault

entry.summary: Proposes FedQuad for federated learning that enforces minimizing intra-class representations and enabling inter-class splits across clients using quadruplet learning to address data heterogeneity.

entry.title: Unsupervised Feature Based Algorithms for Time Series Extrinsic Regression

author.name: David Guijo-Rubio, Matthew Middlehurst, Guilherme Arcencio, Diego Furtado Silva, Anthony Bagnall

entry.summary: Expands the Time Series Extrinsic Regression archive from 19 to 63 problems and introduces two new algorithms (FreshPRINCE and others) that outperform prior baselines. Shows that none of the previously evaluated regressors could beat a rotation forest adaptation.

entry.title: Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks with Post-hoc Explanations for Multi-modal and Explainable Land Use Inference

author.name: Xuehao Zhai, Junqi Jiang, Adam Dejl, Antonio Rago, Fangce Guo, Francesca Toni, Aruna Sivakumar

entry.summary: Presents heterogeneous graph neural networks for urban land use inference using multi-modal mobility data with post-hoc explanations. Addresses both spatial correlations among objects and the interpretability needs of urban planning applications.

entry.title: A Wasserstein GAN-based climate scenario generator for risk management and insurance: the case of soil subsidence

author.name: Antoine Heranval (BioSP), Olivier Lopez (CREST), Didier Ngatcha, Daniel Nkameni (CREST)

entry.summary: Develops a Wasserstein GAN-based framework using Conditional GANs to generate future spatio-temporal trajectories of climatic indices for insurance risk management, focusing on soil subsidence in France.

entry.title: Robustness of Refugee-Matching Gains to Off-Policy Evaluation Choices

author.name: Kirk Bansak, Elisabeth Paulson, Dominik Rothenh\"ausler, Jeremy Ferwerda, Jens Hainmueller, Michael Hotard

entry.summary: Demonstrates the stability of counterfactual impact evaluation for refugee matching across multiple off-policy evaluation methods (IPW, AIPW variants), various modeling architectures, and assignment procedures.
